title: [2027 Master's graduates] Consulting Associate (European Competition practice)
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that offers economic, financial, and strategic expertise to major law firms, corporations, and governments around the world. Since 1965, CRA experts have combined rigorous cutting-edge research, state-of-the-art methodology, and proven experience to address our clients’ most complex challenges.

CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings before competition authorities and courts: mergers and acquisitions, abuse of dominance allegations, cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, market investigations, litigation and disputes, intellectual property or state aid. We also provide advice to regulatory authorities in similar matters.

We have played a key role in many cases that have shaped European competition policy in recent years: from aerospace to software, and manufacturing to transportation. More recently, we have been at the forefront of economic thinking in antitrust investigations and regulation in the tech sector.

We seek candidates for our London, UK location.

Position Overview

The Consulting Associate position is the entry-level position for applicants with a postgraduate qualification in economics. Consulting Associates work closely with senior consultants, scholars and industry experts on project teams, and will have the opportunity to immediately work on some of the largest, high-profile and most significant competition cases in Europe, providing conceptual and practice input to projects. A typical Consulting Associate would:

  • Identify potential issues and conduct analyses that can be used to illustrate economic arguments;
  • Assemble compelling evidence from data and research that support our expert opinions and business recommendations;
  • Program, build models and/or perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R), including large data projects requiring use of cloud computing;
  • Assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers summarising opinions, conclusions, and recommendations using financial, market, industry or client-proprietary data;
  • Interact with clients and communicate complicated economic concepts and arguments to non-experts in an understandable, accessible manner;
  • Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions; and
  • Participate in practice-building activities (training, recruiting, publication, expertise sharing, etc.).

Desired Qualifications 

  • First degree in economics with a postgraduate qualification (MSc/MPhil) in economics from well-regarded institutions, graduating between December 2026 and August 2027;
  • Strong foundation in microeconomics, with a specialism in industrial economics preferred;
  • High degree of numeracy and comfort with data manipulation are essential, familiarity with econometric techniques desirable;
  • Curious and analytical thinkers who bring creative approaches to non-standard problems;
  • Effective oral and written communication skills;
  • Eagerness to learn new skills and programming languages;
  • Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership;
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities;
  • Excellent time management and task prioritisation skills; and
  • Clear and demonstrated interest in consulting through coursework, work experience, activities, or attendance at CRA recruiting events.

As much of our work occurs in our offices, minimal travel is required.

To Apply

To be considered for this position, please submit the following:

  • CV/Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Covering letter – please describe your interest in the European Competition practice and how this role matches your goals.
  • Academic Results - from all relevant degrees.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Career Growth and Benefits 

  • Charles River Associate’s robust skills development programs, including a commitment to offering 100 hours of training annually through formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with research and analysis skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

Charles River Associates creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently ask that individuals spend 3 to 4 days a week on average working in the office (which may include traveling to another Charles River Associates office or to a client's location), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team. At certain times of the year (e.g. holiday periods), additional remote work options are offered to those whose work commitments permit it, although our offices remain open for those who choose or need to be there.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Diversity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer. As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment (Equality Act 2010).

The statements included in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

title: Abteilungsleitung Bautechnik (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Zur Direkteinstellung bei der Ulmer Wohnungs- und Siedlungs-Gesellschaft mbH (UWS) suchen wir eine erfahrene Abteilungsleitung Bautechnik (m/w/d) am Standort Ulm.

Die UWS steht seit 1930 für die verantwortungsvolle Bewirtschaftung und Entwicklung von Wohnraum in Ulm. Mit rund 7.700 eigenen Wohnungen trägt das kommunale Wohnungsunternehmen langfristig Verantwortung für den Erhalt, die Modernisierung und die Zukunftsfähigkeit seines Immobilienbestands.

In dieser Position übernehmen Sie die Leitung der Abteilung Bautechnik mit den beiden Bereichen Bestand und Neubau. Sie führen Ihre Teams, steuern technische und wirtschaftliche Entscheidungen und sorgen dafür, dass notwendige Maßnahmen sinnvoll priorisiert und zuverlässig umgesetzt werden.

Dabei berichten Sie direkt an die Geschäftsführung und gestalten die Weiterentwicklung der technischen Organisation aktiv mit.

Das erwartet Sie

  • Führung und Zusammenarbeit: Sie leiten die Abteilung Bautechnik mit den beiden Teams Bestand und Neubau. Dabei übernehmen Sie die fachliche, personelle und organisatorische Verantwortung, geben Orientierung, treffen Entscheidungen und fördern eine offene, verbindliche Zusammenarbeit.

  • Technische Bestandsbewirtschaftung: Sie verantworten die technische Entwicklung eines Wohnungsbestands mit rund 7.700 Wohnungen. Sie erkennen Instandhaltungs- und Modernisierungsbedarfe, setzen wirtschaftlich sinnvolle Prioritäten und sorgen dafür, dass notwendige Maßnahmen umgesetzt werden.

  • Projektsteuerung und Priorisierung: Sie behalten laufende Modernisierungs- und Neubauprojekte im Blick, koordinieren unterschiedliche Anforderungen und sorgen auch bei engen Fristen, dringenden Maßnahmen oder parallellaufenden Ausschreibungen für klare Prioritäten und verlässliche Entscheidungen.

  • Bauherrenvertretung und Umsetzung: Sie steuern externe Planungsbüros, Bauunternehmen und weitere Projektbeteiligte. Sie verantworten Ausschreibungen und Vergaben und achten darauf, dass Bauleistungen funktional, wirtschaftlich und in der vereinbarten Qualität umgesetzt werden.

  • Wirtschaftliche Verantwortung: Sie verantworten Budgets, Investitionsplanungen und Kostenkontrollen. Dabei wägen Sie technische Notwendigkeiten und wirtschaftliche Möglichkeiten sorgfältig gegeneinander ab und entwickeln fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für die Geschäftsführung.

  • Präsenz und praktische Lösungen: Sie verlassen sich nicht ausschließlich auf Berichte und Kennzahlen, sondern verschaffen sich bei Bedarf auch selbst vor Ort ein Bild. Sie erkennen Probleme frühzeitig, sprechen diese offen an und entwickeln gemeinsam mit Ihren Teams praktikable Lösungen.

  • Weiterentwicklung der Organisation: Sie hinterfragen bestehende Abläufe, verbessern die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Bestand und Neubau und entwickeln technische Prozesse und digitale Arbeitsweisen sinnvoll weiter.

Das macht die Rolle besonders

  • Verantwortung für einen großen Wohnungsbestand: Sie gestalten die technische und wirtschaftliche Entwicklung von rund 7.700 Wohnungen und leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zum langfristigen Werterhalt und zur Zukunftsfähigkeit des Bestands.

  • Führung von zwei unterschiedlichen Teams: Mit den Bereichen Bestand und Neubau übernehmen Sie zwei Teams mit unterschiedlichen Anforderungen. Sie schaffen Orientierung, fördern die Zusammenarbeit und sorgen dafür, dass beide Bereiche ihre Aufgaben zuverlässig erfüllen.

  • Direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung: Sie berichten unmittelbar an die Geschäftsführung, bringen Ihre fachlichen Einschätzungen ein und wirken an wesentlichen technischen und wirtschaftlichen Entscheidungen mit.

  • Gestalten statt nur verwalten: Sie haben die Möglichkeit, bestehende Strukturen weiterzuentwickeln, Abläufe zu vereinfachen und Verbesserungen anzustoßen, die im Arbeitsalltag tatsächlich etwas bewirken.

  • Pragmatismus und Wirtschaftlichkeit im Mittelpunkt: Im Vordergrund stehen funktionale, langlebige und wirtschaftlich tragfähige Lösungen. Entscheidend ist nicht die aufwendigste Planung, sondern das passende Ergebnis für Gebäude, Bewohner und Unternehmen.

  • Ein kommunales Unternehmen mit langfristiger Perspektive: Sie übernehmen Verantwortung in einem regional verwurzelten Wohnungsunternehmen, das nicht auf kurzfristige Projekte, sondern auf nachhaltigen Werterhalt und die langfristige Entwicklung von Wohnraum ausgerichtet ist.

Das bringen Sie mit – Must-have

  • Technische Qualifikation: Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise im Bauingenieurwesen, in der Architektur oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung. Entscheidend ist Ihre Erfahrung in der technischen und wirtschaftlichen Umsetzung von Bau- und Bestandsmaßnahmen.

  • Erfahrung mit Wohnimmobilien: Sie bringen mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung in der Wohnungswirtschaft, im technischen Immobilienmanagement oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld mit Schwerpunkt Wohnimmobilien mit.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der Bestandsbewirtschaftung: Sie kennen die Herausforderungen bei der Instandhaltung und Modernisierung größerer Wohnungsbestände und können technische Maßnahmen nach Dringlichkeit, Wirtschaftlichkeit und langfristigem Nutzen bewerten.

  • Führungserfahrung: Sie haben bereits Mitarbeitende geführt und verstehen es, unterschiedliche Persönlichkeiten einzubinden, Verantwortung zu übertragen und klare Erwartungen zu formulieren. Sie sind ansprechbar, kommunizieren auf Augenhöhe und treffen auch dann verbindliche Entscheidungen, wenn es erforderlich ist.

  • Wirtschaftliches und technisches Verständnis: Sie verfügen über Erfahrung in der Steuerung technischer Maßnahmen und Bauprojekte einschließlich Budgetplanung und Kostenkontrolle. Mit Bauprojektmanagement sowie Bauvertrags- und Vergaberecht, insbesondere HOAI und VOB, sind Sie vertraut.

  • Strukturierte und vorausschauende Arbeitsweise: Sie behalten auch bei mehreren parallellaufenden Projekten, Ausschreibungen und Terminen den Überblick. Sie erkennen dringenden Handlungsbedarf, setzen klare Prioritäten und sorgen dafür, dass Entscheidungen rechtzeitig getroffen werden.

  • Lösungsorientierung und Umsetzungsstärke: Sie denken lösungsorientiert, handeln verantwortungsbewusst und haben Freude daran, Themen voranzubringen. Sie verbinden den Blick für das große Ganze mit der Bereitschaft, sich bei Bedarf auch um konkrete Herausforderungen vor Ort zu kümmern.

Das bringen Sie mit – Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung in der Planung, Steuerung oder Realisierung größerer Wohnungsbauprojekte.

  • Kenntnisse der Strukturen und Entscheidungswege kommunaler oder genossenschaftlicher Wohnungsunternehmen.

  • Zusätzliche Qualifikationen im Bauprojektmanagement oder in der Projektsteuerung.

  • Erfahrung in der Weiterentwicklung technischer Organisationsstrukturen und digitaler Arbeitsprozesse.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Project sowie Baukostencontrolling-, Planungs- und Ausschreibungssoftware (AVA).

Das wird Ihnen geboten

  • Firmenwagen: Ein Firmenwagen, den Sie auch privat nutzen können.

  • 31 Tage Urlaub: Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Interessen.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung: Sie gestalten Ihre Arbeitszeit im Rahmen Ihrer Führungsverantwortung flexibel.

  • Weitere Angebote: Jobticket oder Stellplatz, Essenszuschuss, Jobrad und Gesundheitsangebote im Rahmen der betrieblichen Regelungen. Einzelne Leistungen gelten erst nach der Probezeit.

  • Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten: Eine verantwortungsvolle Führungsposition mit direkter Anbindung an die Geschäftsführung und der Möglichkeit, technische und organisatorische Entwicklungen langfristig mitzugestalten.

  • Regionales Tätigkeitsgebiet: Ihre Tätigkeit konzentriert sich überwiegend auf das Ulmer Stadtgebiet.

  • Langfristige Perspektive: Eine Führungsaufgabe in einem kommunalen Wohnungsunternehmen mit regionaler Verwurzelung und langfristiger Verantwortung für seinen Immobilienbestand.

Klingt interessant?

Senden Sie uns Ihre Bewerbung, wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden bei Ihnen und stellen Ihnen die Position in einem kurzen Gespräch vor.

Danach entscheiden Sie, ob Sie in den weiteren Auswahlprozess einsteigen möchten.

Die HR-Werkstatt unterstützt unseren Kunden im Besetzungsprozess dieser Vakanz. Etwaige Unterlagen werden zunächst von uns entgegengenommen und erst im Rahmen des weiteren Bewerbungsprozesses – also nach dem Erstgespräch und mit Ihrer Zustimmung – an unseren Kunden weitergeleitet.

title: Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business in France: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You're excited by AI: you'll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space.
  • You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value.
  • Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice.
  • Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost.
  • Write personalised, researched outreach (including cold emails) that carries a specific point of view into every call, rather than working from a generic script.
  • Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to.
  • Keep meticulous account and contact records in Salesforce.
  • Become a product expert and represent the Samsara brand at trade shows and events.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1–3 years professional experience, ideally in customer-facing roles
  • 6–12 months experience in a sales or equivalent target driven role
  • Highly motivated and committed, with a strong desire to work in target-driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding targets in previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Curious, and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French
  • AI literacy and ability to showcase examples of leveraging AI in your work

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfort turning unstructured information (an annual report, a website, a news article) into a clear commercial argument
  • Experience multi-threading or navigating multiple stakeholders within a single sale
  • A genuine willingness to prepare — to research and write — before a call, rather than relying on improvising well under pressure
  • Experience in closing-sales roles or similar target driven environment
  • A proven track record of achievement beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space.

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility. With emphasis on continued professional development, training doesn't stop after onboarding — we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and competitors, develop hard skills, and work with mentors to progress through three levels:

  • ADR I — focus on inbound leads: a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with interested prospects. Learning opportunities include call sessions with senior Sales team members, tool training (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, and objection handling.
  • ADR II — work on top-of-funnel movement, creating high-quality sales engagements, and supporting Account Executives. Enrolled in specialised training including professional writing, persona-based messaging, cold calling 2.0, and AE collaboration.
  • ADR III — work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers. Partner on large accounts, implement territory plans, join weekly strategy meetings, and schedule/attend customer demos, alongside a mentorship program ahead of an AE interview.

Please submit an English CV with your application.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2.1B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €10k to €300k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

title: AI Builder
descriptionHtml:
The short version

Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in.

As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching.

We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building.

What Contentoo does

Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap.

None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster.

There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. The difference is that we get those foundations right first and then actually do the work. We've been doing that for ten years: 300+ brands, 300,000+ completed projects and 49 languages.

What you'll do

A suite of Workflows already runs in production, from localisation and creation to brand checks and content refresh. Each one combines AI agents with human experts and works from the client's brand context.

In practice, your week splits two ways. Half of it is implementation: getting new clients live, finding out where their situation is different from the last client's, and building the fix quickly, whether that's a new skill for their agent, a connection to their CMS, or a check only their market needs. Then you make that whole process faster and more automated on our side, so the next client goes live with less hand work.

The other half is the layer on top, which we're building right now: brand intelligence. Today most marketing teams guess what to write next. We want every client to know. Their own search data shows which pages are slipping, and a page that slips already gets a one-click refresh. Competitor rankings show where others win the topics the client should own. Strategy gets drafted from search data in each market and confirmed by the client, so every piece has a reason to exist. And every week we ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI to answer the questions their buyers ask, to see whether the client is named or a competitor is. Every expert fix and every client comment flows back into the brand context, so the platform gets better with each piece.

What works for one client becomes a feature for all of them. And our own teams are clients too. Sales asks the CRM and the agents for a prospect's history before a call. Anyone in the company can ask Conny, our assistant on top of KIWI, our company knowledge base, how billing works or what a package includes. Product feedback from clients gets sorted and routed to the right owner by an agent. When one of those tools needs to get better, you build that too, with Claude Code, the Claude and GPT APIs, MCP servers and agent skills: whatever does the job.

The team

You join the Product team under Olivier (CPO) and report to Joost (AI Lead), in our growing AI team. You'll work closely with Jorge (Product Lead), Cesar (Tech Lead) and our development hub in Valencia.

Around you are the Connies: our people in Amsterdam and in our growing Valencia office. Once a month we stop for Success & Drinks, a company update with no slides and lots of energy, where anyone can take the floor to show what they've built. Wins get celebrated in #shoutout, from a sales call that nailed it to the talent team finding the right experts for a client's healthcare content. We play a padel tournament every year, run the city business run together (the ones who don't run come for the drinks afterwards), and take honest feedback seriously enough to train for it.

Who you are

You're a builder who gets energy from seeing a client actually use what you made. Three things come together in you:

Judgement. You quickly see what's really going on with a client, and you're as credible talking ROI with a CFO as architecture with an engineer.

You build. You prototype fast and ship, and you're at home with LLM APIs, agents, MCP, skills, and tools like Claude Code. You've built AI tools that real people use, and you can tell us what happened after launch.

Hands in the mud. You love being close to clients: fixing what gets in their way, building what solves their next problem, and owning what you ship. Under the hood, it has to work, stay up, and be safe. Your best hours go to the client.

You might come from strategy, product, solutions engineering, or technical implementation. Or you became the AI person at your last company and want a lot more of it.

Fluent English is a must; Dutch is a plus. We are looking for someone available 32-40h per week.

If seeing a client use something you built last week excites you more than perfecting the architecture behind it, you'll love it here. You'd be building on a business that's doing very well, with a large network of expert freelancers behind it: clients, data, and experts from day one, and an operation that keeps running while we scale. If you'd rather start from a blank page, a startup will suit you better. But if you want to make AI fly at scale, this is the place.

What you’ll get

  • A competitive salary based on experience

  • 25 vacation days per year

  • Pension contribution

  • Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens, 2-3 days in office, plus remote flexibility)

  • A small AI team with a mandate to grow: real leadership opportunities, an L&D budget and direct exposure to the MT and founders

  • Laptop of choice (Mac or HP)

  • A monthly Alleo budget

  • A learning budget

  • Lunch and a bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

  • A fun, inclusive team, regular company events, boat days, and more

Why Contentoo, why now

  • You'll build things people keep using. In client conversations, in the code and in the product, every week.

  • The foundations are already there. 300+ clients, real integrations, structured brand context, Workflows in production, and real budget committed to AI. You build on top, not from zero.

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.

What we expect from you

  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: AI Research Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Graphcore

At Graphcore, we’re building the future of AI compute.We’re a team of semiconductor, software and AI experts, with deep experience in creating the complete AI compute stack - from silicon and software to infrastructure at datacenter scale.As part of the SoftBank Group, backed by significant long-term investment, we are delivering key technology into the fast-growing SoftBank AI ecosystem.To meet the vast and exciting AI opportunity, Graphcore is expanding its teams around the world.We are bringing together the brightest minds to solve the toughest problems, in a place where everyone has the opportunity to make an impact on the company, our products and the future of artificial intelligence.

Job Summary

As a research engineer at Graphcore, you will contribute to the advancement of AI research, investigating new ideas that push the limits on important AI/ML problems. Specialised hardware has been the key driver of the progress of AI over the last decade, and we believe that hardware-aware AI algorithms and AI-aware hardware developments will continue to be critical to advancing this exciting field. We are therefore looking for individuals who combine strong machine learning experience with practical engineering skills to deliver impactful AI research. We are seeking AI researchers with strong software engineering experience, particularly in lower-level programming and performance optimisation for hardware efficiency. Our research spans a broad range of topics, including efficient training and inference, world models, life sciences, reinforcement learning, and beyond. You will work closely with researchers to generate ideas and translate them into scalable implementations, contributing to publications and projects that help to steer the future of AI hardware.

The Team

Graphcore Research participates in both fundamental and applied research, to characterise the computational requirements of machine intelligence and to demonstrate how hardware can drive the next generation of innovative AI models. We publish at leading AI/ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) as well as specialist workshops, and collaborate with other research teams and organisations across the world.

We pride ourselves on being a supportive and collaborative team, where we organise around our individual research interests to solve problems together in domains such as efficient compute, model scaling and distributed training and inference of AI models for multiple modalities and applications, including for sequence- and graph-based data. We’re based across London, Cambridge and Bristol, with projects and discussions that involve all our locations.

Perhaps the best way to get an idea of what we’re all about is to read one of our papers or an article on our blog. If you’re excited to work at the cutting edge of AI supported by new hardware and want to develop your skills in this area, we’d love to hear from you!

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Generate AI/ML ideas, design experiments, implement them & evaluate results.
  • Prepare, submit & present your work to AI conferences and workshops.
  • Provide technical insight to internal teams by designing experiments and delivering clear, actionable reports.
  • Collaborate with researchers, silicon and software engineers at Graphcore to help define, build and test Graphcore’s next generation of AI hardware.

About you:

Essential:

  •  Master’s, PhD or equivalent experience in a technical discipline (e.g., Maths, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry).
  • Python programming in a modern deep learning framework, e.g. PyTorch or JAX.
  • Familiar with deep learning fundamentals: models, optimisation, evaluation and scaling.
  • Capable of designing, executing and reporting from ML experiments.
  • Lower-level programming for hardware efficiency, e.g. C++/CUDA/Triton.
  • Practical familiarity with hardware capabilities for deep learning – threads, caches, vector & matrix engines, data dependencies, bus widths and throttling.
  • Practical familiarity with software stacks for deep learning – compilation, kernel fusion, XLA/ATen ops, streams, and asynchronous execution

Desirable:

  • Mathematics skills to support the above: calculus, probability theory and linear algebra.
  • Experience submitting papers to international scientific conferences or workshops.

Benefits

In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension (matched up to 5%), life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We offer a range of healthy food and snacks at our central Bristol office and have our own barista bar! We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

Applicants for this position must hold the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately at this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support for visa applications

  • Agentic Coding: Du setzt LLMs ein um hochwertigen Code effizient zu entwickeln, bestehende Anwendungen zu erweitern und neue Features umzusetzen ohne dabei per Hand Code zu schreiben.

  • Vom Prompt zum Produkt: Du machst aus Anforderungen und Ideen funktionierende Anwendungen. Dabei setzt du KI gezielt für Architektur, Implementierung, Debugging, Refactoring und Testing ein.

  • Intelligente Automatisierung: Du identifizierst Prozesse, die sich mit KI und Code automatisieren lassen, und entwickelst dafür pragmatische, skalierbare Lösungen.

  • KI-Integration: Du integrierst LLMs und passende APIs in bestehende Systeme und entwickelst beispielsweise intelligente Assistenten, datengetriebene Tools oder automatisierte Workflows.

  • Qualität statt blindem Vertrauen: Du überprüfst KI-generierten Code, erkennst Schwachstellen und stellst sicher, dass deine Lösungen performant, wartbar und sicher sind.

  • Tech-Stack weiterdenken: Du testest neue KI-Tools und Entwicklungsansätze, bewertest ihren praktischen Nutzen und bringst die besten Lösungen in unseren Arbeitsalltag.

title: AI Transformation Lead
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward transformation leads to be part of our early team at Resonance in Berlin. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent, and we're building our Berlin hub to serve clients across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As an AI Transformation Lead in Berlin, you’ll work on our most ambitious client engagements across DACH, helping leading businesses redefine themselves through AI. You’ll own major workstreams alongside a Senior AI Transformation Lead and the AI engineers who build with you. You’ll map how a business runs its key processes, find where AI fundamentally changes the economics, and redesign them agentic-first rather than bolting AI onto today’s process. You’ll prototype the new workflows yourself with Claude Code or similar, build the analysis behind the business case, and track the productivity or revenue each build delivers once it’s live. You’ll lead the change on the ground by training users, running workshops and helping people work in entirely new ways. What you learn shapes our products, platform and playbooks, so every engagement is faster and more ambitious than the last, and as one of our first 100 you’ll help shape how Resonance hires, operates and grows in DACH.

What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency, operate with urgency, and have consistently been among the top performers wherever you’ve been, at university or at work. You typically have up to four years in consulting, PE, banking, strategy, operations or a high-growth startup. You structure complex problems quickly and back your arguments with data. You’re a builder with a deep understanding of technology. You don’t need to write production code, but you use AI every day, build with it yourself (prototype workflows, agents, internal tools), know what models can and can’t do, and hold your own with engineers. You’re as comfortable with a client’s managers as with the operators doing the work. PE portfolio or value creation experience, exposure to software or services businesses, and German for client work in DACH are a plus. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Frontier AI work with real stakes, driving tangible outcomes for consequential companies. Learning from people who have embedded AI into 50+ businesses, with scope that grows as fast as your impact. A team built to be one of the most talent-dense in Europe, and the chance to shape how the firm delivers and grows in Berlin as an early joiner. A chance to help close Europe’s AI gap, moving European businesses to the right side of the productivity chasm.

Logistics: Berlin, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in DACH and Europe. English is our working language; German is a plus. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates, and start dates are flexible.

Apply

Send your CV and a short note on a problem you're proudest of solving and the impact it had.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

title: AIT Systems Integration Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Role

The AIT Systems Integration Engineer owns functional and system-level testing of our spacecraft and the verification tracking for each satellite campaign. Working within the Assembly, Integration & Test (AIT) team, you will take the satellite from integrated subsystems to a flight-ready, fully verified vehicle.

You will bridge systems engineering, subsystem teams and the AIT Engineering Functions. You will turn requirements into test procedures, run and lead test campaigns, and make sure every requirement is closed out with traceable evidence before launch.

The role suits someone who knows SmallSat development approaches, is hands-on with Hardware and Ground Support Equipment (GSE), and understands how satellite subsystems behave together.

Responsibilities

Functional and system testing

  • Own the functional and system test programme for the spacecraft, from unit-level acceptance, integration, thought to whole System End-to-End Testing.

  • Write, review and run test specifications and procedures, including basic functional testing, FDIR, end-to-end tests and mission/day-in-the-life simulations.

  • Lead test readiness reviews and test review boards, and sign off test reports.

  • Run tests before, during and after environmental campaigns (vibration, thermal vacuum, EMC) to confirm spacecraft health.

  • Diagnose anomalies, raise and track Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and drive root-cause investigations with subsystem engineers.

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts and telemetry/telecommand (TM/TC) databases used for testing.

Verification tracking

  • Own the verification matrix (VCRM) for the satellite campaign, mapping each requirement to its method: test, analysis, inspection or review of design.

  • Plan the verification approach with Systems Engineering and keep it current through the campaign.

  • Collect and link verification evidence, and report close-out status against milestones.

  • Prepare verification data packages for key reviews (e.g. CDR, TRR, QR, PSR/FAR) and customer acceptance.

GSE and test infrastructure

  • Specify, integrate and validate Electrical GSE, including power supplies, battery simulators, RF test sets, umbilicals and break-out boxes.

  • Maintain the spacecraft checkout software and ground segment interfaces used on the AIT floor.

  • Make sure GSE is calibrated, configuration-controlled and safe for use with flight hardware.

Integration and campaign support

  • Support subsystem and payload integration, including electrical interface checks, harness verification and safe-to-mate procedures.

  • Plan and schedule system test activities within the wider AIT campaign.

  • Support launch campaign activities, including transport, launch site checkout and launch vehicle interface testing.

  • Work to cleanroom, ESD and flight hardware handling standards, and contribute to lessons learned for future missions.

Requirements

  • Degree in Aerospace, Electronic, Electrical or Systems Engineering, Physics, or equivalent experience.

  • Typically 3+ years in spacecraft AIT, systems integration or test engineering.

  • Hands-on experience with functional and system-level testing of satellites or space subsystems.

  • Familiarity with SmallSat development approaches: agile, rapid iteration, protoflight models, and pragmatic use of COTS components.

  • Working knowledge of satellite subsystems: EPS, OBC/C&DH, ADCS, communications (TT&C and payload RF), propulsion, thermal, structures and payloads.

  • Experience using and setting up GSE, including EGSE, checkout systems and RF test equipment.

  • Experience with requirements verification and maintaining a verification matrix through to close-out.

  • Comfortable with lab equipment: oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters, spectrum analysers, logic analysers.

  • Familiarity with common spacecraft interfaces and protocols (e.g. CAN, I2C, SPI, RS-422, SpaceWire, CCSDS).

  • Clear technical writing for procedures, test reports and NCRs.

Desirables

  • End-to-end involvement in at least one satellite mission that reached launch.

  • Test automation and scripting in Python or similar, and experience with spacecraft control or checkout software (e.g. OpenC3/COSMOS, Yamcs, SCOS-2000).

  • Experience planning or supporting environmental test campaigns (vibration, TVAC, EMC).

  • Knowledge of ECSS standards (e.g. ECSS-E-ST-10-02 Verification, ECSS-E-ST-10-03 Testing) or NASA equivalents.

  • Requirements management tools (e.g. DOORS, Jama, Polarion, Valispace).

  • Launch campaign experience at a launch site.

  • Cleanroom and ESD-certified flight hardware handling.

  • Eligibility for UK security clearance, or the ability to obtain it, if required by the programme.

Personal attributes

  • Takes ownership: drives tests and verification to close-out without waiting to be asked.

  • Methodical and detail-focused, with a strong sense of safety and quality around flight hardware.

  • Calm, structured problem-solver when anomalies appear under schedule pressure.

  • Communicates clearly across disciplines, from subsystem engineers to programme managers and customers.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced SmallSat environment, balancing rigour with pace.

  • Willing to work flexibly during test and launch campaigns, including occasional travel.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

We invest in our people, encourage continuous learning, and give you the opportunity to grow your career while building technology that is used every day at global scale.

As an Applied AI Scientist, Simulation & Reinforcement Learning, you'll own the simulator behind SDL, our programme building a world-first, reinforcement-learning-driven orchestration framework for people and robots. That framework needs a simulator that is trustworthy enough to develop, tune and validate it before it touches a live warehouse.

You will take over day-to-day ownership of our discrete-event simulation (built on SimPy), make it measurably closer to reality, and use it as the training and evaluation ground for learning-based policies. Simulation comes first; reinforcement learning grows to be the larger part of the role as the simulator matures. You'll compare your simulations against live operational data from some of the world's largest fulfilment sites, and your work will decide what is validated and shipped to fleets of robots in customer sites worldwide.

This is not a notebook role. The simulator you own is the foundation that decides what ships to customer sites worldwide. You will work in a small, collaborative team where research meets production, as part of Applied Data Science (ADS), reporting to Oscar Mendez.

  • Location: This is a remote position based in the United Kingdom. Candidates must reside in the UK. Right to Work: Candidates must have the legal right to work in the UK. Locus Robotics is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position, now or in the future.

Responsibilities

Own the simulator

  • Own and develop our SimPy-based discrete-event simulator, including its logic, design choices and the fragile areas that need care.
  • Pay down technical debt: improve test coverage, code quality, reproducibility and developer tooling.
  • Build the experiment infrastructure around the simulator: orchestration, study management, reporting and automated runs across benchmark sites.
  • Generate and maintain site data (e.g. distance files, configs) needed to simulate customer warehouses.
  • Support scenario testing and sensitivity analysis for our order-engine and orchestration teams.

Tune and close the sim2real gap

  • Define, measure and reduce the sim-to-real gap against real site data.
  • Run parameter optimisation and tuning studies (e.g. Optuna), and diagnose anomalies and non-determinism.
  • Model warehouse processes such as congestion, picker behaviour and queueing at the right level of fidelity.
  • Communicate results and confidence clearly to engineering, product and operations stakeholders.
  • Use Optimization, RL & DL to tune the simulator

Grow into reinforcement learning

  • Turn the simulator into a proper RL environment (Gymnasium/Gym-style interfaces) with fast, repeatable, scalable training runs.
  • Design, train and evaluate RL policies, starting with guidance generation, and benchmark them against current heuristic algorithms.
  • Guard against overfitting to simulator artefacts, and design experiments that show what transfers to the real world.
  • Prototype, evaluate and productionise learning-based components alongside the wider ML, MLOps and OE teams.
  • Stay current with RL, multi-agent systems and simulation research, and assess what is applicable to Locus.
  • Contribute to internal technical papers, patents and, where appropriate, publications.

Qualifications

  • A PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, Robotics, Mathematics, Physics, Operations Research or a related quantitative field, or MSc and 5+ years of industry experience applying AI/ML or simulation to real-world problems.
  • Hands-on experience building, extending or validating simulators, ideally discrete-event simulation (SimPy or similar).
  • Practical experience with reinforcement learning and training simulation-based agents, including simulation for RL and Gym-style environments.
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals: testing, code review, maintainable and reproducible code.
  • Rigorous experimental and statistical thinking: benchmarking, tuning, ablations, uncertainty.
  • Experience in robotics, logistics, warehouse or other operations-heavy domains.
  • Publications in major AI, ML, robotics or vision venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV).
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage diverse audiences effectively and explain uncertain results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences in a multidisciplinary environment.

The expected base salary range for this role is GBP 70,000 - 120,000 based on external market data, plus bonus and equity. Actual offers will depend on factors such as the candidate's experience, education, training, key or critical skills, geographic location, and current market and business conditions.

title: Backend Engineer - Integration Platform
descriptionHtml:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

BLP’s AI agents are only as good as their data: they need reliable context from our customers’ ERP systems, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or Oracle, and a safe way to write their results back.

We are forming a new backend platform team, and you will be one of its first engineers. You will start by learning our existing data synchronization platform, keeping it reliable, and gradually taking ownership of it. From there, you will build the backend services and tooling that let BLP connect to any ERP system through configuration instead of custom code.

What you'll do

  • Shape the platform: work with the engineers and implementation teams who connect our customers’ ERP systems, find where that work is slow or fragile, and turn it into platform improvements.

  • Build great software: design and build clean, maintainable services in Go, and raise the bar through thoughtful code reviews.

  • Lead technically: drive technical decisions on key initiatives, influence the product roadmap, and support your teammates as they grow.

  • Improve how we work: share what you learn openly and keep improving our processes, tools, and team practices.

  • Tech stack: Go, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub CI/CD, running on GCP.

What you bring

  • 3+ years as a software engineer, with a degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

  • Experience with Go, or strong backend experience and the motivation to learn Go quickly

  • Craftsmanship: a solid grasp of Clean Code and Clean Architecture

  • Product thinking: you turn business problems into precise requirements, specifications, and ultimately code

  • Ownership: you take responsibility for your code, the product, and the team

  • Clear communication: you simplify complex systems and explain them to engineers and business stakeholders alike

  • Fluent English: you work comfortably in English, in writing and in conversation

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, GCP and infrastructure as code.

  • Experience with observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana or Google Cloud Monitoring.

  • German.

What you'll get

  • Real leverage: every improvement you make to the platform speeds up go-lives and stabilizes integrations for hundreds of enterprise customers.

  • Full ownership: from internal user problem to shipped and operated code.

  • A modern, varied tech stack and continuous learning as the platform scales.

  • Fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

  • Regular team events.

Practical information

  • Location: Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week.

  • Employment: full-time, permanent.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

title: Brand Designer, Web
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR — We're seeking an exceptional Brand Designer to own the visual direction and craft of our website. You'll shape how Lovable looks, feels and communicates online - working closely with design engineering and marketing to turn ideas into world-class web experiences.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.


What we're looking for

  • 7+ years of experience, with a portfolio of shipped websites that demonstrate strong visual craft and brand thinking

  • Portfolio showing landing pages, brand systems, or marketing sites where design decisions clearly serve the story (if your portfolio is mostly product/UI work - check out our other roles)

  • A sharp eye for typography, layout, color, and motion, with the taste to know what's on-brand and what isn't

  • Comfort designing directly for the web - you think in real breakpoints, real type scales, and real constraints, not just static comps

  • Ability to systematise creative choices in design systems - contributing to a shared design system across both product and brand

  • Experience partnering closely with design engineers to get explorations into production without losing the soul of the idea

  • You’re no stranger to shipping your own designs directly to production - perhaps with a little help from AI

  • Ideally - you've got a point of view on where web design is headed and aren't afraid to push for something unexpected

  • We’re prioritising candidates based in London or Stockholm, or willing to relocate


What you'll do

In one sentence: Own the visual and brand craft of Lovable's website, making sure every page feels unmistakably Lovable.

  • Design landing pages, campaign sites, and web experiences that make people stop scrolling

  • Set and evolve the visual language for lovable.dev - typography, layout systems, imagery, motion principles

  • Pair closely with design engineering to translate explorations into scalable, web-native implementations, staying involved through to shipped pixels

  • Collaborate with marketing and brand to make sure the website tells the right story at the right moment - launches, campaigns, positioning shifts

  • Build and maintain a visual system that keeps the site consistent while leaving room for creative surprises

  • Bring a strong opinion on craft and hold the line on quality, even under deadline pressure

  • Help define what "world-class" looks like for marketing sites

How we hire

  1. Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with a recruiter.

  2. Show us some of your work you're really proud of.

  3. Walk us through your process and craft across several design interviews.

  4. In some cases, we may opt to do paid, trial work.

About your application

  • Please submit your application in English — it's our company language so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join

  • We treat all candidates equally — if you're interested please apply through our careers portal

title: Brand & Graphic Designer
descriptionHtml:
Wir bauen humanoide Systeme: Full Stack, von Hardware und Elektronik über Software bis zur Fertigung, alles in-house in Berlin.

Bei Cell Labs verschieben wir die Grenze dessen, was Robotik leisten kann. Unser Ziel ist klar: Systeme bauen, die Menschen stärken statt sie zu ersetzen. Unsere Technologie ist bereits bei führenden Industriekunden und Partnern im Einsatz. Jetzt steht unser eigenes Produkt kurz vor dem Launch.

Die leise Phase ist vorbei. Wir suchen Menschen, die früh dabei sein wollen, Verantwortung übernehmen und das bauen, worüber andere nur reden.

Ort: Berlin · Start: Ab sofort · Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort · Anstellung: Vollzeit

Deine Aufgaben

  • Markenentwicklung: Du entwickelst unsere bestehende visuelle Identität weiter und sorgst für einen einheitlichen Markenauftritt über alle Kanäle hinweg. Außerdem erstellst du Designrichtlinien und direkt nutzbare Vorlagen für Präsentationen, Dokumente und Social Media.

  • Digital Design: Du gestaltest unseren digitalen Markenauftritt für Investoren, Kunden und Partner. Dazu gehören unsere Website inklusive des bevorstehenden Launches sowie Präsentationen, Newsletter und digitale Datenräume – alles auf Basis eines konsistenten Designsystems.

  • Print & Merchandise: Du gestaltest Broschüren, Produktdatenblätter, Geschäftsausstattung und Beschilderungen für unsere Büros und Werkstätten. Auch Merchandise, das unser Team gerne trägt und nutzt – von Hoodies bis Stickern – gehört dazu.

  • Produktlaunch & Events: Du entwickelst Key Visuals und Kampagnenmaterialien für unseren bevorstehenden Produktlaunch und gestaltest Messestände, Banner und Displays. Dabei koordinierst du die Zusammenarbeit mit Druckereien und Messebauern und unterstützt bei Bedarf den Aufbau vor Ort.

  • Social Media Design: Du erstellst Grafiken für LinkedIn, Instagram, X und YouTube – von Posts und Karussells über Stories bis hin zu Bannern und Thumbnails. Dabei passt du die Gestaltung an die jeweilige Plattform an und setzt unsere Roboter überzeugend in Szene.

  • Teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit: Du unterstützt andere Unternehmensbereiche bei ihren Designanforderungen, beispielsweise im Recruiting und Employer Branding, bei technischen Dokumentationen, Pressematerialien und PR sowie bei internen Veranstaltungen

Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Du hast Grafikdesign, Kommunikationsdesign, Brand Design oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang absolviert. Alternativ hast du dir deine Fähigkeiten selbst angeeignet und überzeugst uns mit deinem Portfolio.

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst einige Jahre Erfahrung im Design mit – ob aus einer Agentur, einem Designstudio, einem Unternehmen oder deiner freiberuflichen Tätigkeit. Entscheidend ist für uns nicht, wo du gearbeitet hast, sondern was du bisher gestaltet hast.

  • Printproduktion: Du weißt, wie man professionelle Druckdaten erstellt, und hast bereits mit Druckereien zusammengearbeitet. Farbproofs, Papierauswahl und Produktionsfristen sind dir vertraut.

  • Design-Tools: Du arbeitest sicher mit Figma und der Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) und kennst dich mit Pitch, Google Slides, PowerPoint und Keynote aus. Erfahrung mit Webflow oder Framer ist ein Plus.

  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest eigenständig, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert. Du entwickelst lieber schnell einen ersten Entwurf und verbesserst ihn schrittweise, statt dich in Details zu verlieren. Auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten behältst du den Überblick und weißt, wann ein Ergebnis bereit für die Umsetzung ist.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

Benefits

  • Du prägst unseren Markenauftritt: Ob Website, Messestand oder Investorenpräsentation – deine Arbeit bestimmt maßgeblich, wie unser Unternehmen und unsere Roboter von außen wahrgenommen werden. Du erhältst viel gestalterischen Freiraum und kannst unsere visuelle Identität aktiv weiterentwickeln.

  • Alles unter einem Dach: Unser Büro, unsere Werkstatt und unsere Testanlagen befinden sich im selben Gebäude in Berlin-Kreuzberg. Wenn du eine technische Funktion besser verstehen oder einen Roboter in Aktion erleben möchtest, kannst du dich direkt mit unseren Ingenieuren austauschen – ohne lange Abstimmungswege.

  • Raum für deine Entwicklung: Wir bieten dir bezahlte Lernzeit und ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget für Kurse, Designkonferenzen und die Tools, die du benötigst. Du kannst Neues ausprobieren und an Projekten arbeiten, die mit der wachsenden Bekanntheit unseres Unternehmens auch dein Portfolio bereichern.

  • Individuelle Benefits: Du stellst dir dein Benefit-Paket selbst zusammen – beispielsweise aus Angeboten rund um Mobilität, Gesundheit, Verpflegung oder Fitness. Zusätzlich erhältst du einen bezahlten freien Tag pro Jahr für ehrenamtliches Engagement oder ein persönliches Herzensprojekt.

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns einfach einen Link zu deinem Portfolio. Idealerweise zeigst du uns ein Projekt, bei dem du ein visuelles Designsystem entwickelt hast, das sowohl digital als auch im Printbereich funktioniert. Über einen kurzen Einblick in deine Herangehensweise freuen wir uns.

Ein Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess: Kennenlerngespräch → Design-Challenge -> Portfolio-Deep-Dive mit Founder*in → Halbtägiger Besuch vor Ort mit einer kleinen Designaufgabe → Vertragsangebot

Wir entwickeln Roboter für alle Menschen und möchten ein Team aufbauen, das unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Erfahrungen vereint. Entscheidend sind für uns deine Fähigkeiten und dein Potenzial. Deshalb freuen wir uns ausdrücklich auch über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die in Design- und Tech-Berufen bisher unterrepräsentiert sind.

Auch wenn du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass die Position zu dir passt, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Brand Identity Designer
descriptionHtml:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

Define how Act is seen by the world.

You'll create the visual identity behind our brand across product launches, website, recruiting, social media, presentations, merchandise, and marketing. You'll play a key role in building a global AI brand from the ground up.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Develop and evolve Act's visual identity.

  • Design launch materials, marketing assets, presentations, and social content.

  • Design graphics for our website, recruiting, events, and merchandise.

  • Create and maintain brand guidelines and design templates.

  • Ensure consistency across all visual communications.

 

What You Will Need

  • Strong portfolio in visual or brand design.

  • Excellent typography, layout, and visual communication skills.

  • High attention to detail.

  • Proficiency with Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Ability to turn ideas into polished visual assets.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams. We operate with high talent density, fast execution speed, and strong ownership. We care deeply about product quality, clear thinking, and practical execution.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly, operate independently, and make good decisions under ambiguity. Our goal is to build products that are genuinely useful to billions of people globally.

 

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design challenge.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.
