title: Build Your Own Internship – m/f/d (min. 6 Months)
descriptionHtml:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

 

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe’s largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows, helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

 

About the Role

This is a full-time internship of at least 6 months at our Berlin HQ, and it is not a regular internship application. We don’t want your CV first. We want to see what you have built.

If you build with AI because you can’t stop, with Langdock, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or anything else, show us. If your project convinces us, we shape the internship around you and your strengths.

 

What We Want to See

Record a Loom of something you built with AI. It should be no longer than 5 minutes. Two kinds of projects get our attention:

  • Something that would help Langdock. Look at our product roadmap and at our product, and build something that solves a real problem for us or our customers. That could be a feature prototype, an internal tool, a GTM engine, a support automation, an eval setup, or something we haven’t thought of yet.

  • A genuine passion project. Something you built because you couldn’t stop thinking about it, and that shows how you think.

What we don’t want: basic chatbots, simple prompt wrappers, “summarize my inbox” agents, or linear three-step workflows. Our customers build those every day. Show us something that made you think hard, and that makes us think too.

 

What Your Loom Should Cover

  • The problem: what you solved and why it matters.

  • The demo: show it working live, not on slides.

  • How it’s built: the models, tools, architecture, and key decisions behind it.

  • What broke: where it failed and what you learned from that.

  • What’s next: what you would build at Langdock if you joined.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own a real project. Ideally it’s the one you showed us. You take it from prototype to something our team or customers actually use.

  • Work directly with the team. You work alongside Product, Engineering, or GTM, depending on where your project lives.

  • Ship, measure, iterate. You present your progress regularly and decide based on real feedback.

 

How to Apply

Paste your Loom URL into the field “Your Build” in the application form. Your LinkedIn profile is enough; a CV is optional.

 

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • You build, not just talk about AI. You have shipped things that work, even if they’re rough.

  • You think in impact, not just in technology.

  • You show high agency. You don’t wait for tasks; you find them.

  • You experiment constantly with new models and tools.

  • You communicate clearly and professionally in English. German is a plus.

  • You are kind and care about the people around you.

 

What We Need

  • Availability for a full-time internship of at least 6 months, 100% on-site in Berlin.

  • A work permit for Germany.

 

The Environment

You will work from our Berlin office at Greifswalder Straße 212, where all of us work together in person, surrounded by people building AI products and infrastructure every day. Lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, and gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. We value Calm Urgency, Ambitious Execution, and Caring Ownership. The vibe is calm but intense.

 

Next Steps

We move fast. If you have built something you’re proud of, show us.

descriptionHtml:
LOBELLIA Conseil est une société en pleine expansion d’une centaine de consultants spécialisés dans le conseil et la mise en œuvre autour des solutions de pilotage de la performance :

  • Issus des grandes écoles d’ingénieurs, disposant généralement d’une double formation et d’une expérience significative dans les projets de mise en place de systèmes d’information
  • Dynamiques, compétents et motivés, tous mobilisés pour apporter les solutions les plus appropriées au contexte de nos clients.

Vos missions

Nos postes sont très variés. Nous ne recrutons pas pour une mission, nous recrutons un profil !

Une personne qui sait s’adapter et s’épanouir tout au long de sa carrière. Notre vision n’est pas tournée vers le court terme, car nous avons à coeur de vous faire grandir aussi bien professionnellement, que personnellement !

Bien évidemment, si vous êtes sur cette offre, c’est que vous souhaitez en savoir plus.

Voici donc les travaux que vous pourrez être amené à faire :

  1. En fonction des besoins, participation aux ateliers d’expression de besoin ou de conception avec la MOA et élaboration des spécifications fonctionnelles
  2. Préparation, organisation et exécution des tests de qualification de l’ensemble de la solution
  3. Suivi et assistance auprès des directions Métiers lors du processus de validation de la solution
  4. Rédaction des guides utilisateurs et administrateurs et prise en charge si nécessaire des plans de formation et plan de communication
  5. Pilotage et coordination des actions des différents acteurs Projet (MOA et MOE): suivi des actions, consolidation et reporting, suivi des jalons

Au sein d’une équipe projet sous la responsabilité d’un chef de projet, vous pourrez être amené à intervenir sur les différentes problématiques liées au stockage et à la modélisation, à l’alimentation et aux restitutions de données, dans différents secteurs d’activités.

Vous assurez la bonne qualité des composants et vous intervenez sur les différentes phases de qualification, validation et déploiement de la solution.

Nous sommes une entreprise à taille humaine, nous n’abandonnons aucun soldat au front ! C’est pourquoi, vous bénéficierez de toute l’expertise de LOBELLIA Conseil en termes de conduite et de méthodologie de définition et construction de solutions décisionnelles. Dans ce cadre, vous serez formé et encadré sur l’utilisation de différents outils de Business Intelligence

Vos compétences

Dynamique et motivé, vous êtes avant-tout « agile » !

En outre, si vous souhaitez des détails, nous acceptons les personnes qui ont :

  • Un diplôme BAC + 5 (école d’ingénieur ou universitaire), vous souhaitez progresser dans la maîtrise des outils BI et dans la de mise en place de solutions décisionnelles
  • Un bon esprit d’analyse et de synthèse,

Dit ben jij

  • Je hebt commercieel gevoel: je denkt net zo graag mee over het aanbod als over de cijfers erachter.

  • Je bent een sterke sparringpartner: je daagt collega’s uit met data en laat je zelf ook uitdagen.

Wat wij bieden

title: CDI - Senior AI Builder - Paris
descriptionHtml:
L’IA ne transforme pas une entreprise parce qu’elle est disponible, mais parce que les collaborateurs s’en emparent pour travailler autrement. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers : “We Make AI Work”. Notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, au cœur des métiers et à grande échelle.

Et tout commence par vous.

Mission

En tant que Senior AI Builder, vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients. **Vous transmettez et construisez : vous pilotez des initiatives de montée en compétences, concevez avec les métiers des agents et solutions IA qui répondent à leurs besoins, et accompagnez leur adoption. Vous coachez les consultants juniors et êtes responsable de la qualité et des résultats de vos travaux.

Vous partez des défis des utilisateurs métiers, de leurs processus et de leurs irritants pour transformer les possibilités de l’IA en résultats tangibles. **Vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide** : vous concevez et animez des expériences d’apprentissage qui donnent envie de passer à l’action, construisez des agents et des solutions fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et les faites évoluer au contact de leurs utilisateurs pour ancrer de nouveaux usages.

Au plus près des métiers, vous identifiez les opportunités de repenser les tâches, faire évoluer les rôles et responsabilités, et réinventer les façons de travailler avec l’IA. Vous faites le lien entre les initiatives de terrain (bottom-up) et les programmes de transformation à grande échelle (top-down), aux côtés de nos équipes AI Strategy et Engineering. Votre réussite se mesure à l’adoption réelle des solutions, à l’autonomie des équipes et aux changements concrets dans leur quotidien.

Activités & Responsabilités

I. Analyse & Cadrage

Animer des ateliers avec les métiers et le L&D pour analyser les besoins, segmenter les publics et cartographier un workflow.Proposer la solution cible, le rôle de l’humain et de l’agent, les contrôles nécessaires et les critères d’acceptation.Concevoir le séquencement d’un module ou d’un parcours, avec cas d’usage, temps de pratique et modalités d’évaluation.

II. Développement & Déploiement des Solutions

Créer des ateliers et playbooks contextualisés, prototyper des assistants ou agents simples en amont et en direct avec les participants, à l'aide de plateformes approuvées et de patterns réutilisables.Définir et exécuter jeux d'essai, tests utilisateurs et critères qualité; documenter les limites et faire valider les points sensibles.Animer de manière autonome, adapter la séance au niveau du public et coacher un Junior sur ses premières animations.Traduire une question business en KPIs, en définitions et en dashboards complets livrés en autonomie, et transformer les analyses en storyline avec un « so what » clair.

III. Adoption & Animation de Communauté

Organiser office hours, challenges d'application et train-the-trainer, outiller des champions et des managers de proximité.Accompagner la mise en usage, former les référents makers et préparer les supports de transfert.Exploiter les retours des utilisateurs pendant le périmètre convenu et proposer des améliorations priorisées.

IV. Structuration et Pilotage de la démarche Change

Suivre l'adoption et la valeur du use case, les compétences acquises, la capacité à répliquer et les premiers usages; proposer des ajustements concrets pour améliorer l'activation.Contribuer à l’analyse des freins et au plan de change du programme, sous la responsabilité du chef de mission.Identifier les dépendances SI, les risques sécurité et le besoin d'escalade vers la DSI ou AI Engineering.

Profil recherché

Vous vous reconnaissez si… vous aimez avoir la main sur un périmètre, structurer des problèmes complexes et voir vos recommandations se concrétiser, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre les mains du client plutôt que lui décrire une vision.

  • 2 à 5 ans d’expérience en conseil, transformation digitale, data / IA ou conduite du changement, avec une première expérience de pilotage d’un stream ou d’une mission et de coaching de consultants juniors.
  • Une formation supérieure de niveau licence ou master, issue d’un cursus académique d’excellence.
  • Une bonne maîtrise de l’IA générative et agentique, et un état d’esprit de maker : capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer des agents et solutions IA fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding).
  • Une aisance dans la conception et l’animation d’expériences d’apprentissage engageantes, d’ateliers collaboratifs et de dispositifs de montée en compétences par la pratique.
  • Une capacité à comprendre les enjeux et processus métier, à embarquer les parties prenantes et à accompagner la transformation des tâches, des rôles et des pratiques de travail.
  • Une maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais (oral et écrit).

À propos d’Artefact

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. À la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Notre accompagnement s'étend sur l'intégralité de la chaîne de valeur : Strategize AI (cadrage stratégique, opportunités à fort impact, trajectoires, modèles opérationnels), Deploy AI (ingénierie, industrialisation, architectures agentiques, produits data) et Adopt AI (conduite du changement, acculturation, usage quotidien de l'IA).

Envie d'en savoir plus ? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Pourquoi nous rejoindre?

De la stratégie à la réalisation
Ne pas s’arrêter aux recommandations : participer à la conception et à la concrétisation de solutions IA répondant à de véritables enjeux métiers.Une collaboration entre expertises
Occuper un rôle à la croisée de l'humain (AI Adoption), de la stratégie (AI Strategy), de la technologie (AI Engineering).Un rôle avec de l’autonomie et des perspectives
Piloter des streams, développer une expertise, faire grandir une équipe et contribuer au développement de l’activité.Un parcours clair de progression

Un accompagnement concret : counsellor, parcours de formation et programme de leadership.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Un entretien de fit RH (30 / 45’) avec les RH / Talent Acquisition
  2. Un entretien de fit expert (60’) avec un AI Builder Senior ou Manager
  3. Une présentation d’un cas réel (60’) sur lequel le candidat a travaillé par le passé avec un Manager
  4. Un role play AI Adoption Senior (45 / 60’) avec Directeur
  5. Un entretien de fit final (30’) avec un AI Builder Partner

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 63 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 5 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

title: CDI - Senior Product Engineer - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Ce que vous construisez ne reste pas à l’état de démonstration : de vrais utilisateurs, au sein de grands groupes, s’en servent chaque jour. Applications et agents se conçoivent et s’exploitent en binôme avec l’AI Product Manager. Une équipe sinistres retrouve ainsi sur un seul écran les documents utiles et un brouillon de réponse ; ailleurs, un processus de commande ne demande plus aucune ressaisie manuelle.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que de vrais utilisateurs s’appuient sur ce que vous livrez.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Product Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

À chaque projet, l’AI Product Manager pilote le produit avec le client : ce qui se construit en premier, et la vérification que les utilisateurs s’en servent, se décident à deux.

Autour de l’application, trois métiers se croisent : les AI Engineers pour le comportement du modèle, les Platform Engineers pour le déploiement, les Context & Analytics Engineers pour les données dont l’application a besoin. Les tests se font avec les utilisateurs finaux, le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des applications métier : front end, back end et API.

  • Intégrer des agents et des assistants dans un processus métier, avec des contrôles humains là où ils comptent.

  • Automatiser des processus de bout en bout.

  • Intégrer un modèle dans un outil que les équipes utilisent déjà.

  • Construire les connecteurs dont le cas d’usage a besoin, par exemple un serveur MCP pour un outil métier.

  • Concevoir l’expérience utilisateur de l’IA : quand une personne valide, comment afficher les sources et l’incertitude.

  • Définir avec l’AI Product Manager les évaluations propres au cas d’usage et les suivre en production.

  • Assumer ce que vous livrez après la mise en production : monitoring, incidents, adoption.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit des applications avec un front end, un back end et des API, même si votre expertise est plus marquée d’un côté.

  2. Du code testé, relu et documenté, en Python, TypeScript ou dans un langage similaire.

  3. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

  4. Des besoins d’utilisateurs transformés en une première version, puis améliorée à partir de leurs retours.

  5. Le monitoring, les incidents et l’adoption font, pour vous, partie du métier.

  6. Une aisance à expliquer vos choix techniques à des personnes non techniques.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Une expérience de construction d’agents ou d’assistants au-dessus d’un LLM : appel d’outils, orchestration.

  • Une expérience de conception de parcours avec validation humaine (human-in-the-loop) ou d’interfaces d’IA.

  • Une expérience d’intégration à des logiciels métier, comme un ERP ou un CRM.

  • Une expérience au contact des clients.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Entre le produit, l’interface et le modèle, le Product Engineer occupe le point où l’IA rencontre ses utilisateurs. Leurs réactions s’observent directement, et chaque version livrée tient compte de ce que les usages ont révélé.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : conception d’agents, évaluation par cas d’usage, expérience utilisateur de l’IA, avec l’appui des AI Engineers et de la communauté Product Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Product Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme le chapter AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 60 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 6 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: CFO Advisory - Consultant & Senior Consultant
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our CFO Advisory practice are looking for experienced Consultants & Senior Consultant to join the team. 

Our CFO Advisory capability blends technical accounting, finance and treasury knowledge consulting and industry experience to focus on our client’s most strategic priorities. Independent by design, we act as an impartial, critical friend to CFOs. We help our clients address challenges, and respond to opportunities around business integration, business performance, and climate and sustainability across all industry groups. 

What you will be doing

  • Finding business efficiencies and opportunities by reviewing operating models, technology and change strategies across finance and treasury, including: Operating Model Transformation, Technology, Data & ERP Strategy and People, Talent & Change

  • Enabling data based decisions so that Finance can add value and drive enterprise performance right across the organisation, including: Business Insights, Integrated Planning and Forecasting & Scenario Modelling

  • Helping embed sustainability into finance, respond to regulatory requirements, and anticipate and respond to consumer and investor sentiment, including: Investor Relations & Financing, Carbon Budgeting and Disclosures

  • At this time, we have a particular interest in candidates who are passionate about:

    • Technology-driven Finance and Treasury transformation

    • EPM processes and tools

    • End-to-end Finance process improvement and automation 

Your skills and experience

  • You will be a passionate and curious finance and treasury professional with a background in consultancy or experience in a project focused role within industry - FS and non FS clients are both of interest

  • You will need to have excellent relationship building and communication skills, and experience of working well in teams

  • You will need to have a strong understanding of finance and treasury transformation projects with project / programme experience across the full project lifecycle and the ability to take ownership, provide a point of view and deliver results in challenging, client-facing environment

  • You would benefit from having Tier 1 ERP experience, with knowledge of what good looks like 

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

title: Commercial Operations Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The team

Griffin is a UK bank built for builders. We give fintechs and platforms the bank accounts and payment rails to launch their own financial products, and clients like Uber, Yonder, Anna Money and Counting Up build on us. Our commercial team brings sales, customer success and marketing together to win, onboard and grow those clients. We’re a team of 10 people, made up of former founders and growth specialists.

The opportunity

You’ll become the engine behind how our commercial team makes decisions. Working alongside the Chief Revenue Officer, the Head of Commercial and the Head of Marketing, you’ll see the full picture of how a bank wins, onboards and grows its clients, and your analysis will shape where the team focuses next. There’s no narrow lane here. One week you’re building a forecast, the next you’re preparing a renewal review, and if something needs an owner, it’s yours.

What success looks like

In your first 6 months, you’ll have given the commercial team a forecast it trusts and spotted risks early, so every quarter end runs smoothly. People across Sales, Customer Success and Marketing will rely on our data because it’s accurate and up to date, and the team’s reviews will run like clockwork. The board and investors will receive numbers they can follow with confidence, and the executive team will already be turning to you for its priority projects.

To do this you’ll own

  • The numbers: the reporting that runs our commercial business, from pipeline and bookings to annual recurring revenue (ARR), net revenue retention and consumption against forecast, plus pricing and deal-structure modelling, including consumption-based pricing and customer profitability

  • Our CRM: clean, well-structured data, built with Sales and Customer Success around clear stage definitions and fields people actually use

  • Sales and customer success insight: analysis of conversion, sales cycle length, win and loss reasons and pipeline coverage, plus account analysis for renewals covering volumes, revenue, margin and product adoption

  • Marketing performance: campaign tracking and pipeline attribution so every pound of spend ties back to revenue, alongside ad hoc work like target account lists and event reporting

  • Commercial governance: deal approval and discount policies, pricing and contract records and clear audit trails, working with Legal, Compliance and Finance

  • Our operating cadence: documented processes and the weekly, monthly and quarterly reviews that keep the team in rhythm

  • Executive projects: high-priority projects, briefings and materials that give you close exposure to how strategic decisions get made

We expect you to shape this role

This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that’s for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

To ensure this, we’re looking for people who have most of the following:

  • You’ll have some experience as an operator. If it’s in a commercial, revenue operations, sales operations, analytics, consulting or finance role then that’s a bonus

  • A habit of rolling up your sleeves and taking ownership without waiting to be asked

  • Curiosity about fintech, banking and how money moves

  • A structured mind and an eye for detail, with the flexibility to switch between spreadsheets, research and talking to people, and a knack for finding the story in the numbers and explaining it simply

  • The ability to learn quickly, ask good questions and take feedback well

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write)

Ideally, you would also:

  • Have experience in fintech, SaaS or a fast-growing startup

  • Want to build a career in commercial, sales or growth

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We don’t work with recruitment agencies, so please don’t send us speculative CVs.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

title: Complaints Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

The role

The Dealer Resolutions role is on the front line when dealing with high-risk complaints from dealers that require cross-department collaboration. You will be right there resolving complex dealer issues, providing exceptional support, and helping us improve what we do by collaborating across different departments to prevent potential reputational risk. A Dealer Resolutions Specialist will own complex cases from start to finish, handle formal complaints, and provide dedicated support to the dealer throughout the cases' journey, including managing business-critical issues escalated to the C-suite.

What you’ll be doing:

  • High-Stakes Escalation Management: Own and resolve the most complex, sensitive, and high-emotion dealer escalations from intake to final resolution, serving as the definitive point of contact for aggrieved parties.

  • Reputation Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify, assess, and manage potential brand and legal risks embedded in complaints, neutralizing negative exposure across social media, review platforms, and regulatory bodies.

  • Incident Response Coordination: Lead the immediate response to critical service incidents or systemic failures, orchestrating cross-functional communication to ensure impacted customers are managed with transparency, speed, and care.

  • Strategic Goodwill Administration: Exercise autonomous judgment in awarding Gestures of Goodwill (GoGs), financial compensation, or fee waivers, balancing customer retention with commercial viability and internal policy frameworks.

  • Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement: Transform negative feedback into operational intelligence by analyzing complaint data and trend patterns, partnering with leadership to implement process changes that eliminate future friction points.

  • Compliance & Audit Readiness: Ensure all final responses and case documentation strictly adhere to regulatory guidelines, industry compliance standards, and tight internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

What you’ll bring:

  • You’ll have an interest or experience in working in a Marketplace environment

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt quickly in our fast-paced environment

  • Comfortable liaising and communicating with a wide range of stakeholders; from Specialist to C-Suite level

  • You’ll have a collaborative approach to problem-solving; the role will require you to co-ordinate outcomes with multiple teams using great communication skills

  • Dedication to excellent customer service, able to show empathy and understanding to the needs of your customers

  • Excellent communication and writing skills

  • A strong understanding of the motor industry is preferred but not essential

  • An eye for risk assessment, prioritisation, and managing your workload.

  • A preventive rather than a reactive approach; you’ll spot issues before they happen and intervene early

Benefits

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.

  • Competitive salary

  • Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway's success

  • 25 days holiday

  • Sea-front office with bi-weekly massages and free snacks

  • Private medical insurance via BUPA

  • Life assurance

  • Enhanced family leave (e.g. 26 weeks full pay for maternity or adoption)

  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

  • EV leasing scheme

  • Nursery salary sacrifice scheme

  • 1 paid volunteering day a year

descriptionHtml:
Du machst aus politischen und gesellschaftlichen Themen Social-Media-Content, der Menschen erreicht und ins Gespräch bringt. Für unser Team suchen wir eine*n Content Creator*in, die*der Ideen entwickelt und sie eigenständig in plattformgerechte Texte, Bilder und Videos übersetzt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Konzeption und Umsetzung von Social-Media-Content für Kund*innen aus Politik, Verbänden und Gesellschaft – darunter Reels, Shorts, Stories, Karussell-Posts und Single Image Posts.

  • Entwicklung von Content-Ideen und Redaktionsplänen, die politische Botschaften verständlich und zielgruppengerecht übersetzen.

  • Texten, Kürzen und Zuspitzen: von der Kampagnenidee bis zur fertigen Caption.

  • Einfache Foto- und Videoproduktion, Schnitt und Bearbeitung – auch bei Veranstaltungen und Wahlkampfterminen.

  • Beobachtung aktueller Debatten, Trends und Plattformlogiken sowie Auswertung der Beitragsperformance zur Weiterentwicklung der Inhalte.

  • Aufbereitung von Inhalten für Kund*innenpräsentationen und enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Berater*innen und Designer*innen.

  • Unterstützung des Community Managements bei Bedarf und nach Absprache. Dazu gehört auch die gegenseitige Vertretung mit den Kolleg*innen im Community Management. Die Hauptzu-ständigkeiten und Übergaben stimmen wir im Team ab.

Das bringst du mit

  • Nachweisbare praktische Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Social-Media-Content, zum Beispiel aus einer Agentur, Redaktion, Partei oder Organisation.

  • Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Umsetzung von Content nach Briefing – von der Idee bis zur fertigen Veröffentlichung.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Schnitt- und Gestaltungstools wie Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Canva oder CapCut.

  • Ein sehr gutes Gespür für Sprache, Bilder und Tonalität auf verschiedenen Plattformen.

  • Politisches Denken: Du verstehst, wie politische Debatten funktionieren, kannst Positionen einordnen und Botschaften präzise zuspitzen, ohne sie zu verzerren.

  • Interesse an gesellschaftspolitischen Themen und eine demokratische Grundhaltung.

  • Kreativität, konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie eine strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise.

  • Kundenorientiertes Denken, Teamgeist und sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift.

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, zum Beispiel in Kommunikations-, Politik- oder Medienwissenschaft oder Journalismus, eine vergleichbare Ausbildung oder eine anderweitig erworbene Qualifikation.

Was dich erwartet

  • Abwechslungsreiche Projekte mit politischem und gesellschaftlichem Bezug

  • Eigenständige Arbeit an Projekten und Raum für eigene Ideen

  • Ein professionelles, aufgeschlossenes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und wertschätzender Zusammenarbeit

  • Arbeitsort Berlin-Schöneberg; mobiles Arbeiten ist im Rahmen der betrieblichen Regelungen möglich

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Vergütung nach Tarifvertrag und eine 35-Stunden-Woche

  • Geleistete Mehrarbeit kann im Rahmen der betrieblichen Regelungen durch Freizeit ausgeglichen werden

Arbeitsort und Einsatz

Dein Arbeitsort ist unsere Betriebsstätte in Berlin. Die Stelle ist nicht als Remote-Stelle angelegt. Mobiles Arbeiten ist im Rahmen der geltenden Betriebsvereinbarung und abhängig vom jeweiligen Arbeitseinsatz möglich.

Für Veranstaltungen, Produktionen und Wahlkampftermine bist du bei Bedarf auch außerhalb Berlins im Einsatz. Dafür setzen wir die Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen voraus. In kampagnenintensiven Phasen kann außerdem zeitliche Flexibilität erforderlich sein; die Einsätze stimmen wir im Team ab.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit aussagekräftigen Arbeitsbeispielen.

title: Corporate Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Overview 

As a Corporate Account Executive, you will own new-logo ARR growth across private-sector organisations with 2,000–7,499 employees in the UK, Ireland and South Africa. This is a pure acquisition and self-sourcing role with no inherited customer base or ongoing account-management responsibility. While you will have access to BDR, Solution Engineering, Partner Account Management and Marketing support, you remain personally accountable for building sufficient pipeline, creating your own qualified opportunities and achieving the ARR target. Once fully ramped, the role will carry an annual net-new ARR quota in the region of US $900,000.

What will you be doing? 

You will build, own and execute a territory and pipeline-generation plan that creates sustainable pipeline and converts opportunities into net-new ARR. The territory is not verticalized, so you will use available account intelligence, SKU performance, industry growth and market data to determine where to focus. You will personally self-source qualified opportunities while using internal and partner resources to extend your reach and accelerate results. You will manage the full sales cycle, from account prioritisation and prospecting through discovery, solution alignment, commercial negotiation and close.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Building, owning and executing a data-led territory and pipeline-generation plan that explains how you will achieve your net-new ARR quota, where you will focus, how you will personally create qualified opportunities and which resources you will engage.
  • Generating business exclusively through new-logo acquisition across the defined private-sector segment; the role will not inherit existing customers.
  • Using account, industry, SKU-growth and market data to prioritise opportunities and continually refine your territory strategy.
  • Personally self-sourcing qualified opportunities through disciplined prospecting and account development, while effectively using BDR, Marketing and partner resources to complement—not replace—your own pipeline creation. Building pipeline through a balanced combination of self-sourced activity, BDR support, marketing programmes and partner-led engagement.
  • Working closely with the Partner Account Manager to identify the right partners, develop joint account plans, create pipeline and progress opportunities. As a channel-first organisation, effective partner engagement is fundamental to success in this role.
  • Leading consultative, value-based sales cycles across business, technical and executive stakeholders, positioning a platform outcome rather than relying on a single-product sale.
  • Partnering with Solution Engineering to shape discovery, demonstrate relevant capabilities and build credible business and technical solutions.
  • Planning and delivering compelling presentations, proposals and business cases that connect customer challenges to measurable outcomes, value and return on investment.
  • Maintaining strong deal control throughout complex sales cycles, including stakeholder mapping, qualification, mutual action planning, commercial negotiation and accurate forecasting.
  • Maintaining complete, accurate and current account, opportunity, pipeline and forecast information in the CRM system.
  • Attending customer and partner meetings remotely and in person across the territory; this is a field-based role in which face-to-face collaboration is expected.
  • Coordinating with Customer Success when a new customer reaches the applicable ARR threshold, ensuring an effective transition and appropriate post-sale engagement.

The Team Behind Your Territory

You will retain clear ownership of the territory plan, pipeline creation and ARR result while working as part of a collaborative go-to-market team. The supporting teams provide expertise, reach and leverage, but do not replace the Account Executive’s responsibility to self-source opportunities and create sufficient pipeline. Support available includes:

  • Business Development Representative: support with targeted prospecting, account engagement and meeting creation.
  • Solution Engineer: technical discovery, demonstrations, solution design and technical validation.
  • Partner Account Manager: partner strategy, account alignment, introductions, joint pipeline creation and channel-led deal execution.
  • Marketing: campaigns, events, content, intent signals and account-based support.
  • Customer Success: post-sale engagement for customers that meet the applicable ARR threshold.

Is this the role for you?

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, commercially focused sales professional who is comfortable creating a market rather than inheriting one. You will be confident making evidence-based choices about where to invest your time, mobilising internal and partner resources, and remaining accountable for the execution of your plan and the ARR outcome.

To be successful in this role, you will bring:

  • A strong track record of winning net-new business and meeting or exceeding ARR or ACV-based quotas in a complex B2B sales environment.
  • Experience managing full-cycle software or technology sales into medium-to-large private-sector organisations.
  • Demonstrated ability to build productive channel relationships and create and close partner-led opportunities in a channel-first model.
  • Experience developing and executing territory and account plans using market, industry, product and account data, with a proven ability to self-source qualified pipeline.
  • Confidence selling to business, technical and executive stakeholders and translating complex requirements into clear commercial value.
  • Strong pipeline creation, qualification, forecasting, negotiation and closing discipline.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, listening and stakeholder-management skills.
  • The initiative, resilience and accountability to operate independently while bringing the right cross-functional resources together.

A collaborative, curious and adaptable approach, with the willingness to test new ideas and continuously improve.

descriptionHtml:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Hims & Hers is seeking an enterprising, dynamic and highly self-sufficient Counsel, International to join our fast-paced International Legal team.

In this role, you will be a key player supporting our European footprint with a primary focus on Germany, while also driving expansion into new European markets through our international launch function. Operating at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and e-commerce, you will tackle novel legal questions, bring clarity to complex regulatory frameworks, and partner closely with business leaders to build compliant, high-growth healthcare experiences across Europe.

You will be a central operational driver for our German and pan-European commercial, telehealth, and pharmacy strategy.

 

You Will:

  • Support German Operations: Serve as a key legal advisor on day-to-day matters across Germany advising on healthcare and pharmacy regulations, e-commerce compliance, digital health, and marketing.

  • First-Principles Problem Solving: Untangle complex, novel, or undefined regulatory challenges where traditional precedents don't exist. You will help build legal frameworks using first principles rather than off-the-shelf templates.

  • Deliver Actionable, Concise Advice: Cut through ambiguity and synthesise complex legal risks into clear, commercially pragmatic guidance. Your advice will be direct, risk-calibrated, and focused on business value.

  • Navigate Pharmacy & Healthcare Regs: Advise cross-functional teams on German, Dutch, and cross-European pharmacy regulations, telemedicine rules, prescribing workflows, healthcare compliance and privacy. Particular focus on Germany’s AMG and HWG.

  • Commercial Risk & Disputes: Mitigate commercial risk, negotiate key partner/vendor agreements, and assist with advertising and competition matters (including Germany’s unfair competition / UWG litigation environment).

  • Drive Market Expansion & Growth: Partner with the international launch team to scale existing operations and launch Hims & Hers into new European markets, navigating local regulatory, legal, and operational landscapes from scratch.

 

Who You Are:

  • Qualified Attorney: Admitted to practice in the UK, Germany, or Ireland (other EU jurisdictions considered by exception) with ~5+ years PQE in a top-tier law firm, tech company, or fast-growing digital health/telehealth business.

  • First-Principles Thinker: You thrive on novelty and ambiguity. When faced with a problem that has never been solved before, you dig into core principles to construct creative, compliant paths forward.

  • Pragmatic & Commercial: You balance legal requirements with real-world commercial pressure. You understand what the business values and can move quickly without sacrificing quality or compliance.

  • Exceptional Communicator: You get straight to the point accurately and efficiently. You can explain intricate healthcare or consumer laws to non-lawyers clearly and concisely.

  • Self-Sufficient Operator: You take ownership, run autonomously, and prioritise effectively in a high-velocity environment without needing hand-holding.

 

Nice to Have:

  • Domain Exposure: Prior experience navigating German and/or European pharmacy regulations, digital health/e-health laws, or Germany's unfair competition landscape is strongly favored. GDPR experience will also be viewed favourably, particularly in a healthcare context.

  • Language Skills: German

 

Nice to Have:

  • Preferred: Based in London with a hybrid work structure (time spent in our Old Street office collaborating with team members).

  • Flexible: We are also open to exceptional candidates based remotely in Ireland or Germany.

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

title: Customer Director
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

As a Customer Director at Faculty, you will spearhead ambitious growth across our Public Services portfolio. Blending strategic consulting with AI delivery, you will unlock potential for UK Government departments and international partners.

You will lead multi-disciplinary teams to design AI solutions, navigate multi-million-pound programmes, and build trusting relationships with senior government stakeholders across key areas like the Home Office, Department for Education, DWP, HMRC, DEFRA, and MHCLG.

This is an entrepreneurial opportunity to shape the future of public services by turning cutting-edge AI into operational impact.

What you'll be doing:

  • Driving sales growth and executing strategic account plans to hit ambitious multi-million-pound revenue targets across central government accounts.

  • Leading complex commercial negotiations, bidding opportunities, and pricing proposals for new and existing public sector portfolios.

  • Nurturing long-term relationships with senior government budget holders and C-suite stakeholders to ensure high client satisfaction.

  • Overseeing cross-functional delivery teams to guarantee high-quality execution of large-scale AI transformation programmes and GDS-style digital products and the associated digital service and technology infrastructure required

  • Mentoring team members to accelerate their professional development while supporting scalable business unit growth.

  • Proactively identifying innovative, data-oriented AI use cases that solve complex public sector challenges.

  • Advising client directors on AI strategy, engineering concepts, and technical implementation to demonstrate continuous value.

  • Serving as a key member of the Public Services leadership group, shaping strategic direction, driving commercial growth, and embedding customer excellence across the sector.

Who we're looking for:

  • You bring a comprehensive background in consulting or public sector strategy, with proven experience leading large-scale transformation programmes across government and public accounts.

  • You possess a natural business development mindset, combining an appetite for commercial hunting with deep relationship-building skills to manage multi-million-pound deal processes.

  • You bring demonstrable experience in digital government transformation alongside strong commercial fluency in cutting-edge AI capabilities.

  • You excel at managing complex stakeholder relationships, guiding senior civil servants through fast-paced, high-stakes programmes with structured problem-solving.

  • You bring technical curiosity and acumen to engage confidently with technical teams and advise client directors on AI and advise client directors on the creative and safe applications of AI within their most important areas of business.

  • You demonstrate an entrepreneurial, adaptable leadership style with a proven ability to translate intricate technical concepts into real business value.

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to Hiring Manager (60 minutes)

  3. Discovery Role Play Interview (60 minutes)

  4. Commercial & Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Customer Information Manager
descriptionHtml:

title: Customer Intelligence Solutions Lead - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
What we’re all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

Want to transform customer engagement and growth at some of the world's largest institutions? We're looking for an EMEA lead for our Customer Intelligence solution. You'll own the solution across banking, insurance and the public sector, set the direction for the whole region, and take it to market – with real autonomy over how. You'll be the name the market knows on this subject, and the person Quantexa turns to for it.

Every large organisation is investing in data, analytics and AI to serve customers better. Most hit the same wall. The same person appears multiple times across systems that don't talk to each other. Relationships stay hidden – from families and social groups to corporate hierarchies and supply chains. The data is there, but it's fragmented, inconsistent and stripped of context, so nobody quite trusts what it says. The cost shows up everywhere: disjointed customer experiences, frustrated customer-facing teams, wasted marketing spend, and revenue left on the table.

That's the problem we solve, at scale. We connect data to build a real-world view of people, businesses, places and events, and the relationships between them – unlocking insight that accelerates revenue growth and makes customer experience genuinely better. Context is the part most approaches miss, and it's the part that makes everything downstream work: better decisions, trusted outputs, and AI that delivers on its promise across sales, marketing and customer service.

You'd lead this from our Product team, which sits where the market meets the product. We listen to what banks, insurers and public sector organisations really need. We shape the proposition around it. Then we make sure clients, partners and colleagues can see the value. The reach is unusual: our product roadmap, our go-to-market strategy and the conversations we have in the market all start here. Complex problems, senior audiences, commercial consequence. Ready?

What you’ll be doing.

  • Own the Customer Intelligence proposition across EMEA – shape the positioning, the messaging and the segments we go after, and turn what you hear in the market into requirements that influence our global roadmap.

  • Be the region’s senior expert – guide sales opportunities and client programmes as a trusted advisor to some of the largest financial institutions and government agencies in EMEA.

  • Build our voice in the market – publish thought leadership, speak at industry events, brief analysts, and host the client roundtables that shape their thinking and ours.

  • Team up with Marketing and Sales – on campaigns, market and competitor analysis, and the collateral and enablement that help our teams sell with confidence.

  • Grow the ecosystem with Alliances – develop the technology, data and delivery partnerships that give us scale, differentiation and pipeline across the region.

  • Feed the region back into global strategy – work with Product, R&D and Solution Engineering to keep the solution ahead of a market that never sits still.

What you’ll bring.

You have deep expertise in customer intelligence, customer analytics or data-led marketing, ideally in banking or financial services. Don’t tick every box below? If you recognise yourself in most of it, we’d still like to hear from you.

  • Real depth in customer intelligence. You know the data, the analytics, and how both turn into commercial outcomes. Credible with practitioners. Credible with their executives.

  • A voice the market listens to. You can present, write, and hold a room of experienced stakeholders. Whether or not you enjoy the spotlight, you make complex ideas land.

  • Strategy, and sleeves rolled up. You’ll set the direction – then happily build the business case, the demo or the deck yourself.

  • Curiosity about the tech. You’ll learn our platform properly, so you can say what it does and where it’s genuinely different. Never settling for the surface-level answer.

  • Judgement, and generosity with it. There’ll always be more opportunity than time, so you’ll choose well and bring colleagues, partners and clients with you. Experience across several EMEA markets, or extra languages, is welcome rather than required.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

     

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

Wir automatisieren Personal- und Lohnprozesse für Unternehmen und Steuerberater – von Zeiterfassung, Abwesenheiten und Spesen bis zur Vertragsverwaltung und Lohnvorbereitung. Unsere KI liest Dokumente aus, prüft Daten und bereitet Abrechnungen automatisch vor, nahtlos integriert mit DATEV und anderen Systemen. Unser Ziel: HR und Payroll so einfach, effizient und intelligent wie möglich zu machen.

Damit unsere Kund:innen das volle Potenzial von Taxmaro nutzen, suchen wir dich als Customer Support Specialist (m/w/d). Du bist die erste Ansprechperson, wenn es Fragen gibt – und sorgst dafür, dass jede:r schnell, freundlich und kompetent eine Lösung bekommt. Du arbeitest eng mit Produkt und Operations zusammen und bist die Stimme unserer Kund:innen im Unternehmen.

Tasks

  • Du beantwortest Kundenanfragen über Chat, E-Mail und Telefon – schnell, freundlich und auf den Punkt.
  • Du analysierst und löst Probleme rund um HR- und Payroll-Themen, Datenimporte und Integrationen wie DATEV.
  • Du begleitest neue Kund:innen beim Onboarding und sorgst dafür, dass sie sicher mit der Plattform starten.
  • Du dokumentierst Lösungen, baust unsere Hilfe-Artikel und FAQ aus und machst Wissen für alle zugänglich.
  • Du erkennst wiederkehrende Themen, gibst strukturiertes Feedback an Produkt und Engineering und treibst Verbesserungen mit an.
  • Du nutzt KI-gestützte Support-Tools, um Anfragen effizienter zu bearbeiten und die Qualität hochzuhalten.
  • Du baust die KI-Automatisierung unseres Supports aktiv mit auf: Du trainierst und optimierst KI-Assistenten und Chatbots, automatisierst wiederkehrende Anfragen und entwickelst unsere Support-Workflows kontinuierlich weiter.

Requirements

  • Erste Erfahrung im Customer Support, Service oder einer vergleichbaren kundennahen Rolle – idealerweise in SaaS.
  • Du kommunizierst klar, empathisch und lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei hohem Aufkommen den Überblick.
  • Technisches Verständnis und die Neugier, dich in eine HR- und Payroll-Plattform tief einzuarbeiten.
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise und ein hoher Anspruch an Servicequalität.
  • Begeisterung für KI und Automatisierung sowie Lust, Support-Prozesse mit KI-Tools selbst weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch (C1/C2) in Wort und Schrift; gutes Englisch von Vorteil.
  • Ein Plus: Vorkenntnisse in HR, Lohnabrechnung, Steuerberatung oder mit DATEV.

Benefits

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle an der Schnittstelle zu unseren Kund:innen mit direktem Einfluss auf ihre Erfahrung.
  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung in Produkt, HR- und Payroll-Themen sowie unsere Support-Prozesse.
  • Moderne, KI-gestützte Support-Tools, die dir die Arbeit erleichtern.
  • Direkter Draht zu Produkt und Gründung, kurze Entscheidungswege und sichtbarer Impact.
  • Attraktives Gehaltspaket, modernes Büro im Herzen Berlins und regelmäßige Teamevents.
  • Budget für Weiterbildung und persönliche Entwicklung.

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – ein Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze, warum du gerne für unsere Kund:innen da bist, genügen.

title: Cybersecurity Manager
descriptionHtml:
Cybersecurity Manager

Location: Remote - Europe (European time zones)

About FullEnrich:

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them and verifying data in real-time until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted GTM data infrastructure layer powering modern revenue teams and AI agents. Today, more than 6,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, Intercom, Unify,and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

The Role:

You'll be joining as our Cybersecurity Manager, reporting directly to our VP of Engineering.

At FullEnrich, security and privacy aren't just compliance requirements; they're fundamental to our product and the trust our customers place in us. As we scale, we're looking for someone to take ownership of our security, compliance, and corporate IT programs, ensuring we continue to protect our customers, strengthen our infrastructure, and meet the expectations of increasingly sophisticated enterprise clients.

As our first dedicated security and IT hire, you'll have the opportunity to build and shape this function from the ground up. You'll own our security strategy and compliance roadmap, working closely with Engineering, leadership, and teams across the business to implement practical, scalable controls. Our engineers build and operate the platform, while you'll define, oversee, and continuously improve the security measures that protect it.

We're already SOC 2 compliant, with ISO 27001 and additional certifications on the horizon. Operating across multiple regions and working with 20+ data providers also brings interesting challenges around data privacy, vendor security, and international regulations.

This is a hands-on role with significant autonomy, direct exposure to leadership, and the opportunity to build a security function that grows alongside the business.

What You'll Do:

Security & Infrastructure

  • Own and continuously improve our application and infrastructure security posture, partnering with Engineering to implement and maintain effective security controls.

  • Lead our vulnerability management program, including external penetration testing, vulnerability disclosure, and remediation tracking.

  • Identify, assess, and prioritize security risks, ensuring vulnerabilities are addressed based on their potential business impact.

Compliance & Certifications

  • Own our security compliance program end to end, maintaining SOC 2 and leading future certifications such as ISO 27001.

  • Manage ongoing evidence collection, auditor relationships, control assessments, and remediation activities.

  • Develop and maintain a scalable compliance roadmap aligned with business growth and customer requirements.

Security Governance & Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain security policies, risk assessments, and our company-wide risk register.

  • Lead regular access reviews, security awareness initiatives, and incident response preparedness.

  • Coordinate security incidents and drive continuous improvements to our security processes and controls.

Corporate IT & Identity Management

  • Own our corporate IT security framework, including device management (MDM), identity providers, SSO, and SaaS access controls.

  • Oversee secure employee onboarding and offboarding, account provisioning, and hardware inventory management, working with our operational IT team on execution.

  • Improve and automate IT security processes to ensure they remain reliable and scalable as the company grows.

Data Privacy & Vendor Security

  • Oversee privacy operations, including data subject requests, vendor data processing agreements, and cross-border data transfers.

  • Ensure our practices align with applicable privacy regulations, including GDPR and US state privacy laws, coordinating with our DPO and relevant stakeholders.

  • Build and maintain a risk-based vendor security assessment process across our data providers and wider SaaS ecosystem.

Customer Trust & Enterprise Security

  • Own the security due diligence process for enterprise customers, including questionnaires, audits, and security reviews.

  • Maintain our customer-facing security documentation, trust page, and audit report distribution.

  • Partner with Sales and leadership to turn security and compliance into a competitive advantage, helping customers move through procurement and security reviews with confidence.

What Success Looks Like:

By 3 months

  • You've taken full ownership of our existing SOC 2 compliance program, with evidence collection, control monitoring, and auditor coordination running smoothly.

  • You've assessed our current security posture, completed an initial risk assessment, and identified the highest-priority improvements across infrastructure, corporate IT, and identity management.

  • You've established an effective process for handling enterprise security questionnaires and customer due diligence, with turnaround times measured in days rather than weeks.

  • You've developed an initial 12-month security roadmap covering remediation priorities, penetration testing, incident response, and future certifications.

By 6 months

  • You've implemented improvements to our highest-priority security and IT controls, including identity management, endpoint security, and access governance.

  • You've established a repeatable vulnerability management process, with penetration testing completed or underway and remediation tracked through to resolution.

  • You've strengthened our incident response readiness through documented procedures and a tabletop exercise.

  • You've implemented consistent processes for vendor security reviews and privacy operations, ensuring risks are assessed and regulatory obligations are managed effectively.

By 12 months

  • Our SOC 2 compliance program is operating as a continuous, audit-ready process, with renewals running smoothly and minimal disruption to the wider business.

  • You've made measurable progress against our security roadmap, including advancing ISO 27001 or other certifications agreed with leadership.

  • Our corporate IT and security processes are reliable, scalable, and embedded into everyday operations.

  • Security is actively supporting business growth, with faster enterprise due diligence, stronger customer confidence, and fewer security-related obstacles in the sales process.

What We're Looking For:

  • Proven experience owning a security and compliance program end to end, including SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification, auditor management, evidence collection, and control remediation.

  • Strong understanding of application and cloud infrastructure security, with the ability to partner effectively with Engineering teams to identify risks and implement practical controls.

  • Hands-on experience with corporate IT security, including MDM, identity providers, SSO/SCIM, SaaS access management, and employee lifecycle processes.

  • Solid knowledge of data privacy regulations, particularly GDPR, and experience navigating international data protection requirements and cross-border transfers.

  • Experience managing security governance processes, including risk assessments, vulnerability management, incident response, and security policies.

  • A proactive, hands-on approach, with the ability to balance strategic thinking with practical execution in a fast-moving environment.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the confidence to work across technical and non-technical teams, engage with auditors, and represent security in enterprise customer discussions.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience working in a data-heavy or API-first SaaS business, particularly data enrichment, data brokerage, or similar industries.

  • Security management certifications such as CISM (Certified Information Security Manager) or equivalent.

  • Experience working as, or closely alongside, a Data Protection Officer (DPO).

  • Experience supporting enterprise sales processes through security due diligence and customer-facing security reviews.

  • French language skills or proficiency in another European language.

The Hiring Process:

  • Intro to FullEnrich with our Talent Team (30 min) – A chance to learn more about you, introduce FullEnrich and the role, and explore whether there's a mutual fit.

  • Practical case on a real security & compliance scenario from our world (1 hr) – A chance for you to showcase how you think and work.

  • Deep dive with the VP of Engineering (1 hr) – A chance to talk through your approach, strategy, and how you'd operate in this role.

  • Final with the CEO (45 min) – A chance for you to meet our CEO, Ben, and have a conversation around FullEnrich's values, ambitions, how we work, and what we're building together.

Benefits:

Your benefits package will reflect the requirements and market practices of the country in which you're employed, including applicable leave, healthcare, retirement and wellbeing benefits.

Full details will be shared during the hiring process.

FullEnrich is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.
