title: Founding Data Researcher
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Researcher to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically.

You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself.

What you will be working on

  • Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable.

  • Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data.

  • Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage.

  • Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining.

  • Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture.

  • Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you.

  • Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself.

  • Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation.

  • Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture.

Nice to have

  • Computer vision and document understanding, images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD.

  • Graph and structured scientific data, molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data.

  • Synthetic worlds and simulation, a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap.

  • Foundation models from scratch, real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning.

  • Public evidence of data ownership, lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data.

  • GIS and geometry, parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization.

  • Multi-country data, heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules.

Why Join Davis

  • Own the data end to end, from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from.

  • Shape a foundation model from scratch, on a structured representation no one else is training on.

  • Work on genuinely hard problems, image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity, at a founding level, in an early-stage company.

  • Join a world-class team, a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we are a team of twelve: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability, and parametric tools only check constraints after generation, which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable.

This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application.

title: Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

The role

You build the experience traders see when they work with Leonidas AI: a streaming, branching conversation where agents answer with live price tiles, charts, ARB analysis and sources, inside our app and wherever traders already work, such as Microsoft Teams and Excel. You own features end to end, from the backend-for-frontend to the component in a trader's hands.

This is a full stack role for the agentic era. The interface is no longer a set of fixed screens: it renders what an agent decides to show, as it thinks. You make that feel instant, trustworthy and easy to act on.

What you will do

  • Build agentic UI. Streaming chat, typed blocks parsed mid-stream, tool-call status, branching threads, and dashboards that turn an answer into something a trader can watch.

  • Own the BFF. Route handlers, auth, persistence of conversations and blocks, and the contract between the front end and the agent runtime.

  • Surface data people trust. Show source and as-of time on every number, with charts and tables that make curves and ARBs easy to read.

  • Work with the people who use it. Pair with designers, product and SMEs, and talk to traders to see where the experience breaks.

  • Use AI to build faster. Prototype with Claude Code, write tests that keep pace, and help raise our bar on testing beyond the UI.

What you bring

  • Proven experience building production web applications across front end and back end.

  • Strong TypeScript, React.

  • Experience with real-time UIs: streaming (SSE or WebSockets), optimistic updates and resilient reconnects.

  • Backend skills in Node.js or Python, with Postgres and API design (REST, tRPC or GraphQL).

  • A product eye: you sweat latency, empty states and the detail of a chart.

  • Good testing habits: unit, integration and end-to-end.

Nice to have

  • Built UI for LLM products or integrated with an agent backend.

  • Data visualisation for time series or financial data.

  • Design systems and monorepos (Nx, Storybook).

  • Microsoft Teams or Office add-in development.

Our stack for this team

TypeScript · React · tRPC · Kotlin · Postgres · Redis · Python · AWS

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.

Over 90% of global trade depends on ships, and the shipping industry depends on the 2 million seafarers who operate them. What most people don't know is there's a complex, mission-critical travel operation going on 24/7 to bring seafarers to the ships where they're needed, when they're needed. That's called crew logistics, and without it, global trade wouldn't function.

But it's an operation often built on manual processes and legacy systems, meaning high-stress for operators, an unreliable experience for seafarers, and poor outcomes for the industry. That is until Tilla enters the scene.

Backed by strong investor support, with more than 10,000 crew changes executed in the platform each year across over 600 vessels globally, our platform is a game changer in crew logistics, streamlining collaboration between operators and seafarers, making crew operations more humane, efficient, and cost-effective.

title: GNC Engineer H/F
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

The GNC team is growing across Paris and Kyiv. As one of our early GNC engineers, you'll help shape the architecture of our autonomous systems from the earliest design studies through flight testing and final acceptance. We work in short iterations, with a strong culture of experimentation and field validation. Our engineers regularly work alongside operators and end users, ensuring that every algorithm is designed for real operational conditions: not just simulation.

Role & Mission

As a GNC Engineer, you will develop the guidance, navigation, and control capabilities that enable our autonomous platforms to operate reliably in challenging environments. You'll contribute across the entire development lifecycle—from system architecture and flight modelling to live flight testing and operational validation.

We are looking for engineers who enjoy taking ownership of their work, iterating quickly, and seeing their algorithms perform outside the lab.

Guidance, Navigation & Control

  • Design, develop, and improve guidance, navigation, and control algorithms for autonomous aerial systems.

  • Develop and maintain flight dynamics and vehicle models.

  • Contribute to system architecture, control strategies, and performance trade-offs from the earliest design phases.

  • Integrate and tune GNC software on target platforms.

  • Participate in flight-test campaigns and operational demonstrations.

  • Analyze flight data, investigate anomalies, and continuously improve system performance.

  • Work closely with software, AI, systems engineers, test pilots, and operators to validate solutions in real operational conditions.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of professional experience in Guidance, Navigation & Control, flight control, robotics, or autonomous systems.

  • Solid experience in algorithm development with two or more:

    • MATLAB & Simulink

    • Python

    • C/C++

  • Great systems engineering skills. Prior experience with aerospace V&V processes.

  • Motivation to participate in field testing and work directly on deployed systems.

  • Strong analytical skills, engineering rigor, and ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • Embedded software development experience.

  • Experience with open source flight control software stacks.

  • Programming skills in C++ and Python.

  • Experience with UAVs, robotics, or autonomous systems.

  • Familiarity with ROS/ROS2 or real-time embedded systems.

  • Experience with state estimation, sensor fusion, or navigation algorithms.

  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.

  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Group Master Data Manager Customers
descriptionHtml:
We want you to grow with us:

We are strengthening our Information Management function. As our next Group Master Data Manager Customers, you will lead the customer agenda within Group Master Data, continuously developing our Customer Master Data governance and processes to ensure high-quality, consistent and compliant customer data across all countries.

You will join the Information Management team, reporting to the Master Data Manager and working closely with process owners, solution owners, transformation teams, colleagues and internal IT across the organisation. You will take ownership of global standards, drive continuous improvement and shape the development of the Customer Master Data community across the Intersnack Group through a train-the-trainer approach.

What we can offer:

This position places you at the centre of how Intersnack manages its customer data worldwide. You will own the Group's Customer Master Data standards, policies and governance, continuously adapt global processes across our Management Units and partner directly with business stakeholders and internal IT to turn high-quality data into measurable business value.

This role has group-wide scope and visibility, with regular travel from Düsseldorf to our Management Units (up to 20% annually). You will be part of an international, collaborative environment that values knowledge sharing, innovation and continuous improvement, with professional development opportunities to deepen your expertise in master data management, governance and data-driven business transformation.

How you will spend your time as our next Group Master Data Manager Customers:

You will combine ownership of Customer Master Data with hands-on governance and continuous improvement, working closely with business stakeholders, Process Owners and internal IT to ensure our customer data is accurate, consistent and aligned with business processes across the group.

What you will do

  • Own and further shape the Group's Customer Master Data standards, policies, governance and controls

  • Continuously adapt the defined global processes, ensuring consistency across countries while accommodating justified local requirements

  • Drive customer data quality, monitor performance and resolve underlying issues to improve accuracy, consistency and compliance

  • Act as the Group's Customer Master Data expert, working with business stakeholders, Process Owners and internal IT to meet business needs

  • Oversee customer master data solutions, configuration and integrations, ensuring alignment with global standards and business processes

  • Manage functional requirements, testing and approval of system changes and releases, ensuring effective implementation

  • Lead the Group Customer Master Data community across the Intersnack Group, sharing best practices and supporting local teams through a train-the-trainer approach

  • Identify and deliver improvements to data governance, processes and systems, taking ownership of decisions and outcomes

What we expect of you:

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience in one or more of the following areas: Master Data Management (MDM), ERP or CRM, with a focus on customer master data in an internationally operating industrial company

  • Strong understanding of customer business processes, governance and data management

  • Experience in roll-out and training concepts, applying a structured project management approach

  • Proactive, solution-focused working style with a positive can-do attitude and the ability to deliver quality results on time

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative working style

  • Ability to work effectively in a complex, collaborative matrix environment with virtual teams in a multi-cultural and geographically diverse setting

  • Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the capacity for mature judgment in challenging situations

  • A strong command of spoken and written English is required, and knowledge of German is considered a plus

  • Willingness to travel to Intersnack locations as required (up to 20% annually)

Valuable Experience

  • Experience within FMCG, manufacturing or the food industry

  • Prior experience with train-the-trainer approaches in cross-border master data rollouts

Important: Please note that a valid work and residence permit is required for non-EU applicants for this position.

About Intersnack IT: 

Intersnack IT KG is a member of the Pfeifer & Langen Industrie- und Handels-KG’s group of companies and a sister company to Intersnack Group. Explore exciting career opportunities and learn more by visiting our website at Intersnack IT KG.

Intersnack has become one of Europe’s leading savory snacks producers by ‘creating happy snacking moments’ in people’s lives. Being privately owned, we operate with a long-term view and commit ourselves to a more sustainable world. Successfully and sustainably growing, our turnover in 2024 was more than €4.5 bn. title: Growth Analytics Associate
descriptionHtml:
Growth at HRtechX

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why HRtechX

HRtechX is a world leading HRtech community, connecting industry executives, entrepreneurs and professionals. We are a start-up on a growth journey who help leaders evolve and create stronger businesses through people and technology. We aim to address the challenges and opportunities for HR and HR Tech. We bring together the most influential executives, investors, and entrepreneurs to share their insights on how technology will shape the future of HR, as well as forge long lasting partnerships and client relationships.

HRtechX is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Growth Marketing
descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

This role is for someone who can drive growth, generate demand, and build a repeatable marketing engine as Axle scales. You'll be our first Growth Marketing hire and be responsible for shaping our growth marketing strategy from the ground up, experimenting with channels, campaigns and messaging to find what works and scale it.

You’ll help Axle reach the right customers, bring our technology to market, and turn awareness into measurable commercial growth for our direct to consumer business.

We’re looking for someone who combines commercial instinct with analytical rigour and creative thinking. You’ll move quickly, take ownership, and work closely with our commercial, product and leadership teams to turn ambitious growth targets into results.

What you will be doing

  • Building and executing targeted campaigns that reach priority audiences, generate qualified leads and contribute directly to user growth.

  • Developing positioning, messaging, customer segmentation and launch strategies for new propositions, markets and customer segments.

  • Testing and growing marketing channels, partnerships and campaigns to identify repeatable, cost-effective ways to acquire customers.

  • Translating complex energy and technology concepts into clear messaging and content that resonates with our target audiences.

  • Tracking acquisition, conversion and pipeline performance, using data and experimentation to improve marketing effectiveness and maximise commercial impact.

  • Manage our community engagement in social forums (e.g. Facebook groups, Reddit etc.)

What we’re looking for

  • Experience in a B2C growth marketing role.

  • You're data-driven but practical. You run experiments and learn from the results, but also know when there isn’t enough data and you need to trust your judgement.

  • You use AI tools to work smarter across marketing, from researching audiences and analysing data to building reports, automating workflows and creating content.

  • You’re scrappy and hands-on. You test ideas quickly, find ways to make a budget go further and get stuck into whatever needs doing.

  • You’re comfortable building from scratch. This is our first growth marketing hire, so you’ll be shaping our approach, tools and processes as you go.

Nice to have

  • Experience with product analytics tools such as PostHog.

  • Experience with paid social, referral programmes or community-led growth.

Benefits

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary. We operate with a deliberately flat structure. We aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bupa private healthcare from day one of employment.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office in Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide.

  • Accelerate Pipeline. Turn use cases and cross-sell motions into focused programs that help the field identify, engage, and progress the right opportunities. 
  • Bring Launches to Life. Take new capabilities from launch to field execution, making sure sellers understand what’s new, why customers should care, and how to take it to market. 
  • GTM Enablement. Provide sales teams with the messaging, plays, training, and real-world insights they need to have stronger customer conversations and execute consistently. 

What You’ll Do 

  • Drive pipeline velocity. Partner with Demand Gen, Sales, and RevOps to build targeted GTM motions around priority use cases, and cross-sell opportunities. Develop sharper discovery and qualification tools and help identify the accounts where we have the strongest opportunity to win. 
  • Own launch activation. Turn launches into field-ready GTM programs. Develop regional activation content and programs that help sellers quickly understand the opportunity and start customer conversations. 
  • Build GTM plays that sellers will use. Create playbooks with talk tracks, discovery questions, objection handling, competitive positioning, and clear customer value. Reinforce them through hands-on regional training and ongoing field engagement. 
  • Stay close to real deals. Collaborate directly with sales leaders to understand what is working, where deals are getting stuck, and what the field needs next. Turn those insights into better messaging, content, and GTM programs to enhance frictionless deal execution. 
  • Create a continuous field feedback loop. Bring what you learn from customers and sellers back to Product Marketing, GTM organization and Product Teams to help us continuously improve our platform, and how we position, launch, and sell.

Why This Role Mater

Qualifications

title: Head of Agency, EMEA - Ad Solutions
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. In support of that mission, the Ads Solutions team partners closely with advertisers, agencies and strategic partners to help businesses unlock value through AI-powered advertising solutions while maintaining strong standards for user trust, platform integrity and responsible innovation.

As OpenAI’s advertising business continues to scale globally, the Head of Agency, EMEA will play a critical role in developing strategic agency partnerships, accelerating advertiser adoption and shaping how agencies help their clients succeed with OpenAI. You will work closely with EMEA and global leadership to translate our advertising strategy into a clear plan for the region’s agency ecosystem.

About the Role

We are seeking an Head of Agency, EMEA - Ad Solutions to lead and scale OpenAI’s agency partnerships across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. You will own the regional agency strategy, building relationships with agency holding companies, their networks and leading independent agencies to drive sustainable revenue growth and advertiser success. This role is based in London and reports to the Head of Ads Solutions for EMEA.

This is a highly strategic and hands-on leadership role. You will engage senior agency executives, develop joint business plans and commercial partnerships, and work with country sales and customer success teams to turn regional agreements into meaningful local execution. You will help agencies build the knowledge, capabilities and confidence to incorporate OpenAI’s advertising solutions into their clients’ marketing strategies.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations and Policy teams to ensure agency and advertiser feedback informs product development and go-to-market decisions. Working alongside global agency teams, you will align international partnerships with the needs of EMEA markets and help establish scalable ways of working across the region.

The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of the EMEA agency landscape with strong commercial judgement, executive influence and operational rigour. You are equally comfortable negotiating a strategic partnership, working with local teams to unlock client opportunities, and helping agency leaders understand the possibilities of AI-powered advertising.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop and execute OpenAI’s EMEA agency strategy, prioritising partnerships, markets and growth opportunities across agency holding companies, networks and independent agencies.

  • Own agency partnership revenue goals and business performance, working with country leaders to establish clear targets, accountabilities and execution plans.

  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with agency leaders across management, investment, trading, strategy, planning, activation, data and measurement.

  • Develop joint business plans that connect agency priorities with advertiser outcomes, with clear commitments, milestones and measures of success.

  • Lead the development and negotiation of regional trading agreements and strategic commercial partnerships, working closely with Finance, Legal and regional leadership.

  • Translate regional and global agency agreements into local activation, coordinating with country sales and customer success teams on account plans, advertiser onboarding and growth.

  • Expand the number of agency clients advertising with OpenAI and deepen adoption across relevant products and use cases.

  • Partner with Marketing and customer-facing teams to deliver agency education, leadership engagement and enablement programmes that build lasting capability across planning and buying teams.

  • Establish a disciplined operating cadence for pipeline management, forecasting, partnership reviews and tracking delivery against commercial commitments.

  • Define clear ways of working across agency, direct advertiser, country and global account teams to coordinate customer engagement and support shared growth.

  • Bring agency and advertiser insights to Product, Engineering and leadership teams, helping identify opportunities to improve the customer experience, measurement and product adoption.

  • Provide strategic direction and coaching to colleagues working on agency partnerships across EMEA, building shared playbooks and consistently high standards of execution.

  • Represent OpenAI’s advertising offering in senior agency discussions and industry forums, maintaining a strong commitment to user trust and responsible innovation.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 15+ years of experience in the advertising industry, including significant experience in agency partnerships, digital advertising sales or senior agency leadership.

  • Have a proven track record of exceeding revenue targets and building strategic agency partnerships across multiple EMEA markets.

  • Bring deep knowledge of the EMEA agency ecosystem and established senior relationships across agency holding companies, networks and independent agencies.

  • Have experience developing and negotiating complex trading agreements, joint business plans and multi-market commercial partnerships, and translating them into measurable results.

  • Understand how agency investment decisions are made and can build relationships across executive leadership, trading, planning, activation, data and measurement teams.

  • Can articulate a compelling business case for a new advertising platform, connecting brand and performance objectives with relevant products and credible measurement.

  • Combine strong strategic thinking with a bias towards execution, operational excellence and personal accountability.

  • Are highly data-driven and comfortable using analytics to prioritise investment, assess partnership performance and identify opportunities for growth.

  • Have experience leading complex initiatives across distributed teams and influencing senior stakeholders without relying on direct reporting relationships.

  • Enjoy coaching and developing colleagues, sharing expertise and helping teams build effective agency partnerships.

  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-changing environments and enjoy building new commercial models, processes and partnerships from the ground up.

  • Are passionate about AI and excited by the opportunity to shape how agencies and advertisers adopt transformative technologies responsibly at scale.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

title: Head of CRM & Customer Engagement
descriptionHtml:
🎯 Ton objectif :

Faire du CRM un moteur de croissance en passant d'une logique produit à une logique “moments de vie client”, qui générera jusqu'à 15% des revenus à horizon 3 ans.

En 5 hashtags, ça donne 👉 #CRM #CustomerLifecycle #MarketingAutomation #CustomerIntelligence #NextBestAction

🍒 sur le 🎂 : tu arrives pile au moment où tout se construit, migration vers un nouvel outil d'orchestration multicanale, déploiement d'un outil de Next Best Action, budget de fonctionnement CRM en hausse de 40% et lancement d'un nouveau plan stratégique à 3 ans.

🚀 Tes missions principales :

  • Piloter le plan de communication client dans son ensemble : emails commerciaux, automatisés et transactionnels.

  • Définir la stratégie CRM et la roadmap Customer Lifecycle, pour sortir des triggers purement produits et capitaliser sur les moments de vie client.

  • Faire de la connaissance client un avantage compétitif : piloter les outils data, produire des insights actionnables et évangéliser la culture client en interne.

  • Construire le “Next Best Action” et l'orchestration augmentée par l'IA, pour passer d'un CRM intuitif à un CRM cognitif où la décision d'adressage, le canal, la pression et l'offre sont finement automatisés.

  • Piloter la performance client de bout en bout : indicateurs digitaux et business, ventes croisées, réactivation, revenu par client, repeat, lifetime value.

  • Manager et faire monter en compétences ton équipe de 4 collaboratrices (toutes les 4 sont des Pépites !).

  • Devenir le·la partenaire interne des équipes marketing, produit, data et tech.

💛 Ton équipe :

  • L'entreprise : un comparateur digital dans les secteurs de l’assurance et des services financiers, créé il y a 14 ans et réunissant une centaine de personnes à son siège parisien. En forte croissance, sa culture est tech, rapide et collaborative.

  • Ton équipe : 4 personnes aux métiers complémentaires : une PMO CRM, une responsable de la communication client, une cheffe de projet campagnes et une alternante en production. Une équipe compétente, motivée et franchement top !

  • Ton manager : le CMO, tout juste promu en interne après avoir lui-même porté le périmètre CRM. Très humain et motivant pour ses équipes, c’est un véritable manager-mentor : il connaît le sujet à fond, accompagne la progression de chacun·e et donne les moyens de réussir.

  • Tes interlocuteurs : tu évolues au sein d’une équipe marketing d’une trentaine de personnes, avec des expertises clés en SEO, acquisition payante, marque, contenu et service client. Tu collabores également avec les équipes data, produit et tech, ainsi qu’avec tes homologues à l’international.

💻 Tes Conditions de travail :

  • Ton bureau : de très beaux bureaux, hyper agréables, dans le 17ème arrondissement de Paris, à côté du Parc Monceau.

  • Le midi : pas de cantine, mais une carte tickets restaurant.

  • Ton package de rémunération :

    • Salaire 100% fixe : entre 65 et 80k€ brut annuels, selon expérience.

    • Participation/Intéressement : participation jusqu'à 10% du salaire annuel selon les objectifs d'entreprise (rentabilité, marge), soit jusqu’à 8k€/an. Un intéressement est en cours de mise en place.

    • Autres avantages : très bonne mutuelle, prime annuelle de vacances (environ 800€ cette année), primes culture et sport, soirées au minimum une fois par mois.

  • Ton rythme :

    • 5 semaines de congés payés

    • Une dizaine de jours de RTT par an.

    • Jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine (et encore plus de souplesse sur juillet/août).

    • Possibilité de semaine en full-remote durant les fêtes de fin d’année.


Tes expériences & compétences :

  • Tu as piloté un périmètre CRM de bout en bout, avec la responsabilité du business et pas seulement de la stratégie ou de l'implémentation d'outils.

  • Tu maîtrises les outils du marché type Batch, Braze, Salesforce ou équivalents.

  • Tu as construit une stratégie CRM et une roadmap Customer Lifecycle, avec des parcours automatisés et transactionnels.

  • Tu connais les sujets “Next Best Action” et orchestration augmentée par l'IA.

  • Tu pilotes tes KPI digitaux et business : ventes croisées, réactivation, revenu par client, repeat, lifetime value.

  • Tu as déjà managé hiérarchiquement une équipe.

  • Tu parles anglais couramment, c'est indispensable pour travailler avec le groupe.

  • Une expérience du secteur de la banque/assurance ou en marketplace serait appréciée.

  • Avoir vécu une organisation BU et centrale serait un vrai plus pour comprendre la dynamique groupe.

  • Les profils “annonceur” comme “conseil” sont bienvenus, à condition d'avoir réellement piloté du business sur le terrain.

Ta personnalité :

  • Visionnaire et analytique, tu pars des chiffres et du contexte pour poser une vision client, et surtout tu sais la raconter.

  • Pédagogue et collaboratif·ve, tu embarques le marketing, la data, le produit et la tech, parce que la culture client s'évangélise autant qu'elle se pilote.

  • Manager bienveillant·e et exigeant·e, tu aimes faire grandir une équipe jeune, motivée et déjà très sachante.

  • À l'aise avec le changement, tu as envie de créer plutôt que de faire tourner l'existant.

Mon avis de recruteuse sur ce job :

C'est un poste pour quelqu'un qui aime construire : la maturité CRM est à 50%, la vision client à 20%, et les moyens sont là, budget en hausse et nouveaux outils en cours de déploiement. J'aime le fait que le manager ait tenu le périmètre avant toi, il sait exactement de quoi il parle et où il veut aller. Si tu cherches un CRM à faire passer du running à un vrai levier de croissance, dans une boîte tech et très peu politique, tu es au bon endroit.

title: Head of Expansion South-West Europe
descriptionHtml:
Fastned is on a mission to accelerate the transition to electric mobility. Since 2012, we have been building and operating a rapidly growing network of iconic fast-charging stations across Europe powered entirely by solar and wind energy. With 500+ colleagues, we now operate over 450+ stations across nine countries, with an ambitious goal of reaching 1,000 stations by 2030. We are not building infrastructure for its own sake. Every station we open is a tangible step in the transition away from fossil fuels. This role offers you the unique opportunity to be at the forefront of driving this transition across France, Italy and Spain.

The role

As Head of Expansion South-West Europe, you will accelerate the reliable, high-quality expansion of sites for our charging stations across France, Spain and Italy. You will translate strategy into clear regional priorities, practical plans and effective ways of working. You will lead and coach the Expansion Leads and Expansion team members across your region, support cross-functional collaboration and ensure that risks, dependencies and opportunities are visible and addressed. The role combines people leadership, strategic implementation and governance. You will strengthen local ownership while creating alignment, sharing learnings and improving execution across the South-West region.

This role is based in Paris (France) and requires regular travel within Europe.

Your responsibilities

1. Tactical support and people leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop the Expansion Leads and additional team members across France, Spain and Italy.

  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm covering performance, funnel reviews, forecasting, risks and action tracking.

  • Use data and business insights to identify blockers, support needs and capacity requirements.

  • Coordinate cross-functional support and help resolve dependencies while strengthening country autonomy.

2. Strategic implementation

  • Translate ‘Network Development’ priorities into clear regional and country actions.

  • Support Expansion Leads and Country Directors in developing aligned expansion plans and strategic roadmaps.

  • Drive the adoption of new initiatives, processes and tools across the region.

  • Monitor market, competitor, regulatory and customer developments and turn relevant insights into recommendations.

3. ‘Network Development’ leadership and governance

  • Represent the South West region in Network Development strategy, planning and portfolio discussions.

  • Assess projects and initiatives based on value, risk, dependencies, capacity and strategic fit.

  • Ensure country implications are considered early and that approved projects are implemented effectively.

  • Lead continuous improvement by embedding lessons learned, standardising successful practices and tracking measurable outcomes.

What success looks like

  • You ensure that Expansion Leads have clear priorities, decision space and the support needed to deliver.

  • Expansion plans and roadmaps are aligned with Network Development strategy and local market realities.

  • Risks, dependencies and performance issues are identified early and addressed effectively.

  • Strategic initiatives and project outcomes are adopted consistently across the region.

  • Successful ways of working are shared, standardised and scaled across countries.

Who we are looking for

You are a genuine people leader who inspires, challenges, and grows the people around you. You bring:

  • Significant relevant experience in expansion, commercial, infrastructure, real estate, energy, mobility or a comparable field in an international environment.

  • Experience leading teams or senior professionals across multiple countries or markets, demonstrating your ability to adaptively lead and inspire.

  • A proven ability to translate strategy into practical plans, implementation and measurable results.

  • Strong commercial acumen, analytical skills and experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders.

  • A coaching-oriented leadership style, strong communication skills and the confidence to challenge constructively.

  • Professional fluency in both French & English is required. Fluency in Spanish or Italian would be an advantage.

  • Affinity with Fastned's mission: a genuine belief in the energy transition.

Join us in building a better future

We are on a mission to make a positive impact, but we don't forget to recognise & celebrate our successes, big and small. We put a focus on work-life balance, provide you with genuine work flexibility and have family-friendly policies in place. We offer you a wide range of attractive secondary benefits. Just to mention a few:

  • A training and development budget of €3,000 per year per employee, because development and training are important to us and our sector offers endless opportunities.

  • In order to experience and enjoy the EV life, you get access to our fully electric vehicle fleet (all charging expenses covered).

  • A meal voucher card, worth €12.20 per day.

  • 25 days of annual leave, plus RTT days and 2 Mission Days, which you can use to contribute to Fastned’s missions and support a charitable cause that matters to you.

  • Fastned covers 60% of your Alan health insurance and 100% of your salary during the first 30 days of sick leave or incapacity for work.

  • A Gymlib membership, giving you access to a wide network of gyms and studios.

  • Mental wellbeing support through nilo health, with access to a confidential mental health platform offering one-to-one coaching sessions with psychologists, group sessions, and a variety of tools.

  • Stock option plan - we believe in shared value creation.

  • Fun events, including ski trips, Fastned Days, and team-building activities, give us opportunities to get together, connect, and celebrate our successes.

Interested? Apply today!

We’re looking forward to having a conversation with you! Our recruitment team will get back to all applicants in due time.

Fastned stands for equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, gender identities, sexual orientations, religions, neurodiversity, disabilities, parental status or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique.

title: Head of Finance (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie.

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com.

Rotzinger Transver ist Teil von Coesia, einer weltweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe für innovative Industrie- und Verpackungslösungen mit Hauptsitz in Bologna. Coesia ist in 34 Ländern vertreten, vereint 21 Unternehmen und beschäftigt per 2026 mehr als 8'000 Mitarbeitende weltweit.

Über die Rolle

Als Head of Finance (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für den Finanzbereich an den beiden Standorten Kaiseraugst und Altendorf. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit dem lokalen Management zusammen und sorgen für Transparenz, einheitliche Finanzprozesse sowie eine verlässliche Berichterstattung.

Sie führen die Bereiche Accounting und Controlling und stehen im regelmässigen Austausch mit den lokalen Führungsteams sowie dem Coesia Headquarter. Darüber hinaus gestalten Sie die Weiterentwicklung der Finanzorganisation an beiden Standorten aktiv mit.

Der Schwerpunkt der Position liegt in Kaiseraugst (ca. 80 %), mit regelmässiger Präsenz in Altendorf (ca. 20 %). Die Reisetätigkeit zwischen den beiden Standorten ist ein fester Bestandteil der Rolle.

  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung der Bereiche Accounting und Controlling

  • Harmonisierung der beiden unterschiedlichen ERP-Systemlandschaften an den Standorten

  • Gestaltung, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Finanzprozessen und internen Kontrollen

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung transparenter Reporting-Strukturen sowie relevanter KPIs

  • Koordination der Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse

  • Verantwortung für Cashflow-Reporting, Liquiditätsüberwachung und Finanzplanung

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem lokalen Management sowie dem Coesia Headquarter in finanziellen und strategischen Fragestellungen

  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung interner Richtlinien, finanzieller Standards und Reporting-Anforderungen


Was Sie mitbringen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Finance Manager, Head of Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren Führungsfunktion im Finanzbereich

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Accounting und Controlling

  • Erfahrung in den Bereichen Finanzreporting, Budgetierung, Forecasting und Cashflow-Management

  • Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams im Bereich Finanzen, Accounting oder Controlling

  • Berufserfahrung in der Schweiz sowie gute Kenntnisse der Schweizer Rechnungslegungsstandards

  • Erfahrung in einem produzierenden oder industriellen Umfeld, idealerweise im Maschinenbau, in der Automatisierungstechnik oder im projektorientierten Geschäft

  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität sowie die Fähigkeit, Strukturen und Prozesse aufzubauen, zu standardisieren und kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln

title: Head of Finance (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Werde Teil von PartSpace und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Bauteilbeschaffung!

PartSpace ist ein wachstumsstarkes, innovatives Tech-Unternehmen mit einer klaren Mission: Mit Künstlicher Intelligenz und echten Engineering-Daten definiert PartSpace den technischen Einkauf der Zukunft neu. Unsere cloudbasierte Plattform macht die Beschaffung von Bauteilen in der Industrie intelligenter - und agiert dabei wie ein Ingenieur.

Wir haben Großes vor: Dafür suchen wir ambitionierte Talente, die nicht nur mitdenken, sondern mitgestalten wollen.

Bei uns bekommst du nicht nur Gestaltungsfreiraum und Mitspracherecht - du wirst Teil eines ambitionierten Teams, das täglich mit Leidenschaft daran arbeitet, unsere KI-Plattform weiterzuentwickeln und die industrielle Beschaffung nachhaltig zu verändern - und das ist unser Anspruch. Um unser Wachstum weiter voranzutreiben, suchen wir Dich als Head of Finance (m/w/d) am Standort Deggendorf oder München.

Lust, mit uns die Industrie effizienter zu machen? Dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen!

Als Head of Finance übernimmst du die operative und strategische Finanzverantwortung in einem wachstumsstarken Tech-Unternehmen in der frühen Skalierungsphase. Dein Fokus liegt auf dem Aufbau einer skalierbaren Finance-Infrastruktur, der Implementierung professioneller Reporting-Prozesse und der Erstellung fundierter Budgets und Forecasts. Du arbeitest strategisch, aber hands-on und legst das Fundament für zukünftiges Wachstum.

Das erwartet Dich

Reporting & Controlling

  • Du baust ein professionelles, transparentes Reporting für Geschäftsführung und Investoren auf
  • Du etablierst ein Controlling-System mit relevanten SaaS-KPIs (CAC, LTV, Churn, ARR, MRR, Unit Economics)
  • Du behältst die Geschäftsentwicklung im Blick, erkennst Chancen frühzeitig und leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab - inkl. Optimierung der Revenue Engine (Sales-Ziele, Quotas, Provisionsmodelle)
  • Du analysierst Kundenbeziehungen und Margenprofile und unterstützt bei Vertragsprozessen

Budgetierung, Planung & Forecasting

  • Du erstellst detaillierte Budgets und Business Pläne, die unser Wachstum widerspiegeln
  • Du verantwortest rollierende Forecasts und sorgst für eine solide Liquiditätsplanung
  • Du entwickelst Planungsszenarien, die strategische Entscheidungen fundiert unterstützen
  • Du steuerst und monitorst aktiv die Budget-Einhaltung

Finance-Infrastruktur & Prozesse

  • Du baust skalierbare Geschäftsprozesse auf und optimierst sie - so, dass sie sich nahtlos in zukunftssichere Finance-Prozesse übersetzen
  • Du implementierst und optimierst Finance-Tools und -Systeme
  • Du sorgst für eine saubere, effiziente Buchhaltungsintegration ohne Reibungsverluste
  • Du verantwortest Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Steuerberatern

Stakeholder Management & strategisches Sparring

  • Du kommunizierst auf Augenhöhe mit Investoren, Wirtschaftsprüfern und Steuerberatern
  • Du unterstützt die Geschäftsführung bei strategischen Finanzfragen und bist ein verlässlicher Sparringspartner
  • Du bereitest uns aktiv auf zukünftige Finanzierungsrunden oder Exit-Prozesse vor

Team & Leadership

  • Du baust im Laufe der Zeit ein Finance-Team auf und führst es
  • Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen und trägst zur Etablierung einer datengetriebenen Unternehmenskultur bei

Das macht Dich aus

Must-have:

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Finance, Accounting oder Controlling
  • Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung und erste Führungserfahrung im Finanzbereich mit - idealerweise in Tech-, SaaS- oder Scale-up-Umgebungen
  • Du hast nachweislich Reporting-Systeme und Finance-Prozesse von Grund auf aufgebaut
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Budgetierung, Forecasting und Finanzplanung
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit relevanten Tools - von Excel/Google Sheets über Power BI bis hin zu Accounting-Software
  • Du arbeitest hands-on, packst selbst an und scheust dich nicht vor operativer Arbeit
  • Du denkst analytisch und kannst Zahlen in verständliche, entscheidungsrelevante Insights übersetzen

Nice-to-have:

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Finanzierungsrunden
  • Du kennst dich mit Fördermittelakquise aus
  • Du hast Finance-Systeme bereits implementiert
  • Du bringst rechtliches Know-how im Bereich Corporate Governance, Gesellschafts- und Vertragsrecht mit - z. B. durch Stationen im juristischen Umfeld

Das bieten wir Dir

  • Attraktives Vergütungspaket mit verschiedenen Bausteinen wie betrieblicher Altersvorsorge und Weiterbildungsbudget
  • Vergünstigungen über Corporate Benefits - z.B. Business Bike, Firmenfitness, BahnCard und zahlreiche Rabatte bei Partnern

title: Head of Product
descriptionHtml:
Head of Product

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Location: Delft, the Netherlands (hybrid
Report to: CEO

About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.

Your role

As Head of Product, you own our product hands-on. You are the bridge between what the market and our operators need and what we build, turning field feedback and market insight into a clear roadmap and products people actually want to use. You own how our capabilities become real products: how they are shaped, packaged, priced, taken to market, and adopted by the people who use them in the field.

This is a hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves role, not a purely strategic one. You set the product’s direction together with the founders, and you do the work to make it happen: talking to users, writing requirements, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to ship. You bring structure to how we do product without turning it into bureaucracy.

You will work closely with the founders, engineering, and commercial. The company strategy is set with the founders; your job is to own the product within it and make it succeed.

Your responsibilities will include

• Product strategy & roadmap. Owning the product roadmap and prioritization, and keeping the product direction aligned with the company strategy as the market and the technology evolve.

• Market-to-technical bridge. Translating operator needs, market signals, and partner requirements into clear, well-scoped work for engineering, and translating technical capability back into value the market understands.

• Hands-on product delivery. Writing requirements, shaping features, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to get things shipped and validated.

• Product portfolio. Helping shape how our capabilities in detection, navigation, interception, and beyond fit together as a modular, scalable line-up rather than isolated tools.

• User experience & adoption. Owning how usable our products are for end users: ease of use, onboarding, training, documentation, and the adoption path from first deployment to routine operational use.

• Pricing & business model. Contributing to pricing, packaging, and business models across the product line-up, and owning the product side of the classic marketing mix (the 4Ps).

• Go-to-market. Partnering with commercial and business development on go-to-market for each capability, from positioning and narrative to capability briefs and demos.

• Market intelligence. Keeping an eye on the market: trends, competitors, adjacent opportunities, and where the next product bets should be.

• Regulatory & compliance awareness. Given the defence context, factoring export control, procurement, and relevant standards into product decisions, working with the right internal and external stakeholders.

• Lightweight product practices. Bringing just enough structure, process, and documentation to make product work repeatable, suited to a fast-moving deep-tech company.

What you will deliver in your first year

• A clear, documented product roadmap, aligned with the founders and understood across the company.

• A working feedback loop that turns field and operational insight into product decisions.

• Well-scoped, prioritized work flowing to engineering, with product shipped and validated with users.

• Input into pricing and business-model choices for the core product lines.

• A joint go-to-market plan with commercial for at least one capability, taken through to execution.

• Measurable improvement in product adoption and usability through better onboarding, documentation, and training for operators and partners.

• A working market map that informs the next set of product bets.

What we expect from you

• 5+ years in product management, with a track record of owning a product’s roadmap and shipping it in a technical product environment.

• Experience in a startup or scale-up environment: comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and wearing several hats.

• A strong bridge-builder: you connect customers and market reality to engineering, and you are comfortable in deeply technical conversations without being the engineer yourself.

• A genuinely hands-on mindset: you want to talk to users, write requirements, and work day-to-day with engineering, not only set direction from a distance.

• Exposure to pricing, packaging, and business-model decisions (the product side of the 4Ps).

• Experience working with commercial teams on go-to-market.

• A user-obsessed attitude: you care about adoption, usability, training, and documentation, not only features.

• The ability to read a market, spot trends, and turn them into concrete product opportunities.

• Strong communication and stakeholder skills, from the field and the shop floor to founders, partners, and government stakeholders.

Nice to have

• Domain experience in defence, drones/UAV, aerospace, or other dual-use or high-stakes technology. A real plus, but not a must.

• Experience navigating regulated environments and their impact on product, such as export control, procurement, certification, or standards.

• Experience as an early or first dedicated product hire, setting up lightweight product practices from scratch.

We know this exact combination is rare. If you have a strong track record of building products that reached real users, and the hands-on drive and judgment to navigate the rest, we want to talk.

What we offer

• The chance to own the product of a deep-tech defence company from an early stage, working directly with the founders.

• Equity participation. We want the people building the company to share in it.

• Competitive compensation.

• 25 vacation days per year.

• Reimbursed travel expenses and company laptop.

• (Really) flexible working hours, with a hybrid setup around our Delft office.

• Working in an international, world-class team of engineers and entrepreneurs solving real-life problems with technology that matters.

• Real ownership, fast iteration, and tight feedback loops, and the chance to see what you build deployed in environments where it genuinely counts.

The application procedure

• If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself. This can be a resume, LinkedIn, or other source, as long as we get a clear picture of your background and track record.

• We'll get back to you as soon as possible. If we see a potential fit, we'll set up an initial conversation, followed by deeper sessions with the founders and the team where we work through real product scenarios together.

• If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we'll discuss the specifics.

• Welcome to the team!
