title: Head of Sales & Growth
descriptionHtml:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work.

About the role

You will own revenue at Agent F. That starts with the funnel itself (who we talk to, how we qualify, how we demonstrate, how we price, how we hand a signed customer over to go-live and how we grow them afterwards), and it ends with one number: live ARR. You will build that chain with the CEO and then own it end to end.

You will sell. Our buyers are CEOs, CFOs and heads of finance at corporate subsidiaries and Mittelstand companies: an experienced audience that values clarity, numbers and reliability over charm. You will open those conversations, run them to signature and stay with the account until it is live, paying and expanding. Key accounts are a team effort: the CEO is in the room with you, and the whole company pulls through to go-live.

You will also build the sales organisation. Two Growth & Sales Managers work with you from day one; more will follow. You are their functional lead: you review their pipeline, join their calls, coach them on deals and give them a playbook that works. The foundation you lay is what lets the team scale without losing its direction.

Our north star is live ARR: how many companies have signed, gone live, are satisfied and have started paying, and from there, how many stay and grow with us. Every commercial role at Agent F is measured against that chain.

What you will build and own

  • The revenue chain. Define each stage from first conversation to expansion, give it an owner, a conversion rate and a cycle time, and report the whole chain weekly in one view.

  • Your own accounts. Carry a quota. Lead enterprise and corporate accounts together with the CEO; own mid-market deals outright. Stay with every account through go-live and into expansion.

  • The sales playbook. ICP definitions, qualification criteria, demo script, proposal and pricing standards, go-live hand-over, expansion motion. Not a document: the operating system of the sales team.

  • The team. Weekly pipeline and deal reviews, joint customer meetings, ramp plans for new team members. Measure output, coach on it, raise the bar with every hire.

  • Signed to live. Work with the Forward Deployed Engineers so that every signed customer goes live inside the onboarding SLA. No deal is done until the customer is live and paying.

  • Live to expansion. Own the expansion motion: additional modules, seats, usage, further entities. Own net revenue retention.

  • Business development. Partnerships, resellers and implementation partners where they produce live ARR faster than direct sales.

For example, a corporate subsidiary with three entities signs for one of them. You would run the go-live with the Forward Deployed Engineer, make sure the first entity is live and reconciled inside the SLA, and have the expansion to the other two entities agreed before the first invoice is paid.

What you bring

You have ten or more years in B2B software sales, with personal closes at C-level and a track record that includes a phase of extreme growth, for example from a handful of customers to a team of twenty or more, or from near zero to tens of millions in revenue. You have built or materially shaped a playbook that other people then ran successfully.

You can walk us through a deal you closed with an experienced buyer, what the buyer needed to see, how you got to signature, and what happened after. You can also show us a team member who became better because of you.

Core experience

  • Full-cycle B2B software sales to finance, operations or executive buyers, with personal quota attainment.

  • Selling to German-speaking corporate and Mittelstand buyers; fluent German and English.

  • Building a playbook, a pipeline process and a forecast that a team then runs.

  • Coaching and developing sales people; running pipeline and deal reviews.

  • Expansion and retention of existing customers; net revenue retention as an owned number.

  • CRM discipline: stages, next steps, forecast accuracy as a matter of course.

  • Daily use of AI tools for research, preparation and follow-up.

Useful additional experience

ERP, accounting or financial operations software; channel and partner sales; implementation-heavy products where go-live is part of the sale; experience alongside a technical implementation team.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would take over the active pipeline, close your first deals with the CEO and alone, and write down the playbook as you go. You would set up the weekly revenue view, run the first pipeline reviews with the Growth & Sales Managers and agree the signed-to-live hand-over with the Forward Deployed Engineers.

We would look for closed deals, customers going live inside the SLA, a forecast that holds, and team members whose numbers are improving. The exact priorities will follow the pipeline you find.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in customers who are live, paying and growing. When a signed customer’s go-live is at risk, a live customer threatens to churn or a key deal needs a decision now, you respond the same day, take the lead with the customer and stay on it until it is resolved or explicitly handed over.

Customer commitments shape how we work. You are willing to interrupt planned work, travel to a customer and stay engaged when a go-live, a renewal or a financial deadline is at risk. You keep people informed and see the issue through. Afterwards, you improve the playbook so the same situation becomes less likely.

How you will work

This is a senior role in a small team. You report to the CEO and are the functional lead of the Growth & Sales Managers; line management for everyone stays with the CEO. You will work closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on go-live and with marketing on top of funnel. You will use AI tools for research, preparation and follow-up and remain responsible for the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. Travel to customers across the DACH region is part of the role. Fluent German is required.

Start a conversation

Share a deal you closed with an experienced buyer and an account you grew afterwards. Tell us what the customer needed to see, how you got to signature, what happened at go-live and how you expanded. If you have built a playbook or a team, show us what it looked like and what it produced.

title: Head of Talent Acquisition
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🧲 Our Talent Team

At Joko, hiring has been a founding obsession since day one. Our founders have always been convinced that markets aren't cracked with headcount — they're cracked with talent density. That bet has worked: we've grown to 6 million users and become one of France's most recognized shopping apps with just 30 people in the early years, and we've kept the same bar as we've scaled past 100.

The Talent team exists because we believe talent is the single biggest asset of a company, and that identifying, attracting, and closing the best profiles is a craft worth investing in seriously. We are constantly experimenting with state-of-the-art techniques, tools, and processes to find the people who will build the future of shopping with us.

Today, the Talent team sits within the broader People function, which also covers People Ops, People Business Partnering, and Workplace across France, Spain, and our growing international footprint into the US. We are a team with a big scope and rare ownership per person, and we move fast.

✨ Why this role is special

Recruiting is Joko's #1 company objective — because talent unlocks everything else — which makes this one of the most strategic seats in the company. Three things make it genuinely rare:

  • The team is exceptionally involved in hiring. From ICs to managers to founders, recruiting is treated as a first-class responsibility, not something delegated to TA. You will work with hiring partners who actually show up, give sharp feedback, and care about the bar as much as you do.

  • You will have the tools, and the budget, to be on the frontier. We already work with a modern stack (Ashby, Claude, Claap, and more), and we keep investing to stay among the most performant and modern TA setups out there. You will not be fighting for basic tooling, you will be deciding what comes next.

  • You will live a genuinely unique scale moment. Growing from 100+ people today to 200+ within 18 months, with a real international component (France, Spain, US, and more to come) is the kind of stretch many TA leaders don’t often get to experience. You get to do it here, with a company that has already proven it can build a recognized product with a fraction of the usual headcount.

To be concrete about what this looks like in practice: in year one, the job is to build the team — sourcing, hiring, and coaching the TAMs who will power Joko's growth. The AI strategy, international employer brand, and long-term function design are the horizon you are building toward. They are real, and you will own them fully. But the foundation comes first, and the foundation is the team.

🎯 What you will do

As Head of Talent Acquisition, your mission is to build and lead the TA function that will take Joko from 100+ people today to 200+ within 18 months, and beyond, with the bar, craft, and intentionality that have defined Joko's talent density since day one. You will report to the VP People and be part of the People leadership team, alongside the Head of People Operations and our Lead People Business Partner. You will partner closely with founders, hiring managers, and the broader People team.

  • Build and own the TA team: The most important thing you will do, especially early on, is hire the recruiters who will hire everyone else. Two Talent Acquisition Managers are already in the team, and four more TAM positions are open today. You will make the case for what else the function needs over time, from sourcing specialization onward, and recruit, coach, and grow the team around you.

  • Define how Joko recruits: Inbound, outbound, RPO management, agency relationships, tooling (Ashby), and process are all yours. You will set the standards, not just execute against them — including upskilling hiring managers so the bar is applied consistently across every panel.

  • Recruit senior and critical roles yourself: You will stay close to the hardest hires. You know when to delegate and when to own the desk.

  • Build a global AI strategy for recruiting: The way recruiting is done is changing drastically with AI. You will define and roll out Joko's AI strategy for TA: which parts of the funnel to automate, which tools to deploy, how to keep human judgment where it matters most, and how to turn AI into a real competitive advantage in how we source, screen, and close. You will own this end to end.

  • Drive an international employer brand: We are not well known enough yet, and that is costing us. You will build an employer brand strategy that reflects who we actually are, starting in France, scaling very soon to Spain, and preparing for the US and other markets.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have stood up a TA function before, or rebuilt one, and you have also worked somewhere with best-in-class standards. You can operate in both 0-to-1 mode and best-in-class mode, and you know when to switch. The strongest candidate may not have done "just" Talent — a track record that spans ops, sales, consulting, or building things beyond recruiting is a real asset here.

  • Coaching mindset: You know how to develop the resourcefulness and drive of the people you manage. You see growing recruiters as part of the job, not a tax on it.

  • High-bar mindset: Joko's culture is built on talent density. Our hiring managers are involved, exacting, and not afraid to pass on a 90% candidate. You find that energizing, not frustrating.

  • Ops-oriented and performance-driven: You think in systems, not one-offs. You instrument the funnel, care about the numbers, and build process that holds up as the team scales.

  • Strong sense of craft in TA: You know the difference between a recruiter who has relied on inbound for years and one who genuinely knows how to source. You’ve done both, and you know which approach each situation calls for.

  • Analytical skills: You reason with data — funnel metrics, conversion rates, capacity plans — and you use it to drive decisions, not to decorate slides.

  • Attention to detail: You know candidates judge us on every touchpoint — an outreach message, a scorecard, an offer letter — and you hold the bar on all of them.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. You take ownership without being asked, you welcome feedback, and you go the extra mile by default.

  • Curious and experimental about AI: You don't claim to have it all figured out, the field moves too fast for that. But you have hands-on experience deploying AI tools into a TA function, you have strong opinions formed from real attempts (and real failures), and you genuinely enjoy figuring out what works.

  • International scope: Paris, Barcelona, New York, our footprint is growing. You are comfortable recruiting across geographies and building an Employee Value Proposition that resonates in more than one market.

  • Location: Based in Paris.

  • Education: No specific requirement. Track record matters more than credentials.

  • Languages: You are fluent in French and English (our working language). Spanish is a plus.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

title: Head of Talent
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we're a long way from done!

Your Mission

We're looking for a strategic, hands-on Head of Talent Acquisition to own how Carwow attracts, hires and builds the teams that will get us there.

This is a leadership role at a genuine inflection point: you'll take full ownership of the talent acquisition function - from headcount planning and budget through to the quality of every hire we make - at a business that's scaling fast and changing shape as it goes.

You'll partner directly with senior stakeholders across the business to understand what they need to grow their teams, build the plans to deliver it, and hold the bar high enough that every hire raises the average performance and cultural strength of Carwow.

You'll lead and develop a high-performing talent team, own our employer brand in partnership with our Employee Experience team, and make sure DEI is built into how we hire rather than bolted on. You'll be the person who knows our hiring data - with live dashboards the business trusts - and who gets the most out of our tools (Ashby included) rather than just using them. Above all, you'll bring the rigour, creativity and pace that a fast-moving scale-up needs, and be comfortable picking up whatever the business needs next.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end workforce and capability planning - partnering with and challenging the Exec on what capability we need, when we need it, and whether hiring is always the right answer - and translate that into Carwow's talent acquisition strategy, headcount plan and budget, connected to broader workforce planning and succession.

  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders to understand their talent needs and translate them into hiring plans that deliver against their goals, acting as a trusted advisor on hiring strategy and org design.

  • Lead and directly influence our most senior and business-critical searches, including Exec-level hiring, bringing the judgement and market credibility to attract top-tier talent.

  • Raise the calibre of talent we bring into Carwow - A-players on both performance and culture - backed by consistent scorecards, structured interview processes and quality-of-hire tracking, so we can prove, not just assume, that our bar is going up.

  • Build out our talent intelligence capability so we're not just reacting to open roles - mapping critical and emerging skill pools ahead of need and giving the business a genuine edge as we scale.

  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing talent acquisition team - setting clear expectations, building a culture of ownership and continuous improvement, and flexing the team's capacity and structure as the business scales.

  • Own how AI shows up across sourcing, process and productivity, and use your own expertise to get ahead of how the skills and talent Carwow needs will change, evolving how we assess and hire for it accordingly.

  • Own employer brand and how Carwow shows up externally to candidates, working closely with the Employee Experience team on our proposition, story and candidate experience.

  • Implement and embed our DEI strategy within talent acquisition, ensuring inclusive hiring practices are built into every stage of the process.

  • Upskill hiring managers on how to hire the best talent - from writing better job specs to running structured, bias-aware interviews.

  • Take on projects beyond your core remit as part of the wider leadership team's priorities.

Key Requirements

  • Proven experience leading a talent acquisition function in a fast-paced, high-growth scale-up environment, ideally including significant periods of organisational change.

  • Experience building, leading and developing high-performing talent teams, with strong people management and coaching skills.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, including experience influencing senior leadership and translating business needs into talent plans.

  • A data-driven approach - comfortable building and using dashboards and metrics (e.g. time to hire, cost per hire, quality of hire) to drive decisions and report upwards.

  • Confident, expert-level knowledge of AI tools and how they apply to talent acquisition

  • Hands-on experience implementing DEI strategy within hiring, with a track record of embedding inclusive practices into recruitment processes.

  • You've owned senior, business-critical or Exec-level searches and know how to bring the credibility that level demands.

  • Experience owning employer brand and candidate experience, partnering with People/Employee Experience functions.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, with evolving structures and shifting priorities, and able to balance long-term strategy with short-term delivery.

What's in it for you

  • Hybrid working (2 days working from home)

  • Competitive salary

  • Matched pension contributions

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private medical and dental insurance, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

  • 28 days annual leave

  • 1 day for your wedding

  • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

  • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

  • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

  • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • The option to work from abroad up to 4 weeks

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you've been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch & learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. title: Head of VIP, Influencers & PR
descriptionHtml:
About the Role:

Reporting into the Brand Marketing Director, we’re looking for a Head of VIP, Influencers & PR to build TALA’s profile, cultural relevance and desirability through the people, partnerships, moments and conversations that matter.

You’ll lead the strategy across VIP partnerships, Influencers, Ambassadors, Pro, PR, gifting and events, turning TALA into a brand that people see, talk about and want to be part of.

You’ll know and understand that the fastest way to build awareness is to put TALA in the right hands, in the right places, with the right people.

The successful candidate will bring a serious black book of relevant VIPs from celebrities and musicians to stylists, athletes, creators and cultural tastemakers and know how to build genuine relationships with them.

You’ll be responsible for creating the moments that make TALA feel bigger, more culturally relevant and impossible to ignore.

Tasks

What You’ll Own

VIP & Cultural Partnerships

  • Build and own TALA’s VIP strategy, identifying the people who can meaningfully increase awareness, desirability and cultural relevance.
  • Develop relationships with celebrities, musicians, stylists, athletes, tastemakers and influential cultural figures.
  • Bring a strong existing network and continually build TALA’s VIP black book.
  • Create strategic partnerships that go beyond gifting from organic product placement to collaborations, appearances and brand moments.
  • Ensure TALA is consistently seen on the right people, in the right places and at the right cultural moments.

Ambassador & Pro Programmes

  • Own the strategy, vision and evolution of TALA’s Ambassador and Pro programmes.
  • Define the role these programmes play within TALA’s broader brand and awareness strategy, including who we want to attract, why they matter and what we want them to deliver.
  • Establish the programme proposition, structure, tiers, criteria and long-term growth strategy.
  • Together with the team, build a best-in-class network of ambassadors and professional athletes who genuinely align with TALA and can become powerful advocates for the brand.
  • Set the strategic direction for recruitment, relationship development, activation and retention, with the team responsible for day-to-day programme management and execution.
  • Continuously assess and evolve the programmes based on KPIs including brand impact, reach, engagement and commercial contribution.

Influencer

  • Own the overall influencer strategy, defining how influencer partnerships drive awareness, cultural relevance, desirability and growth.
  • Set the direction for the talent TALA works with, from high-profile creators and cultural tastemakers to emerging talent and community voices.
  • Identify opportunities to move beyond traditional influencer activity into cultural partnerships, organic product placement and high-impact moments.
  • Ensure influencer strategy is integrated with VIP, Ambassador, Pro, PR, gifting, social and campaign activity.
  • Set clear KPIs and continuously evolve the strategy based on performance and cultural opportunity.

Gifting

  • Own the strategic direction for TALA gifting, transforming it from a reactive PR function into a significant awareness and brand-building engine.
  • Together with the team, define who TALA should be gifting, when, why and what we want gifting to achieve.
  • Oversee the strategy for key product launches, cultural moments, VIP gifting, stylist seeding and wider brand moments.
  • Lead the team in developing, signing off and executing gifting programmes, ensuring activity ladders back to wider brand and campaign priorities.

PR

  • Together with the Brand Marketing Director own the overall PR strategy and communications agenda for TALA.
  • Define the role of PR within the wider brand strategy and how it will contribute to building fame, credibility and awareness.
  • Set the annual PR strategy, priorities, narratives and key cultural moments, working closely with Brand Marketing, Social, Influencer and Product.
  • Brief the PR agency to establish the types of stories TALA should be known for and proactively identify opportunities to create news rather than simply respond to it.
  • Ensure the PR team and agency has a clear roadmap and empower them to execute against it.

Events & Experiences

  • Own the TALA events and experiences strategy, defining how physical brand experiences can drive awareness, desirability, community and growth.
  • Set the annual events strategy, including the role of VIP events, consumer experiences, cultural moments, product launches, retail activations and larger-scale brand moments.
  • Define what makes a TALA experience distinctive and ensure every activation is rooted in the brand and designed to generate impact beyond the room.
  • Identify and feed into the events team opportunities for TALA to create culturally relevant moments that can extend into PR, social and organic conversation.
  • Oversee the brief and objectives for key events, with the team responsible for planning and delivering the experience.
  • Oversee the evaluation of the effectiveness of events against awareness, reach, brand impact and commercial objectives, continually evolving the approach.

Requirements

About You

We’re looking for someone who is highly connected, culturally switched-on and relentlessly ambitious.

You will likely have:

  • Significant experience across VIP, celebrity, influencers, PR and events within fashion, beauty, lifestyle or a culturally relevant consumer brand.
  • A strong existing network of VIPs, stylists, agents, managers, media and cultural tastemakers.
  • A proven ability to build authentic relationships with high-profile talent.
  • Experience creating campaigns and moments that generate significant awareness and organic conversation.
  • Strong commercial and strategic thinking, understanding that awareness must ultimately contribute to brand and business growth.
  • A strong understanding of culture, fashion, music, TV, sport, entertainment and what makes people talk.
  • An instinct for what feels cool, relevant and TALA.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and negotiation skills.
  • The confidence to challenge the status quo and create ideas that haven't been done before.
  • A highly proactive, entrepreneurial approach, you’ll spot opportunities rather than wait for a brief.
  • The ability to operate at both strategic and executional level, from defining the annual VIP strategy to picking up the phone to a stylist.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll know you’re succeeding when:

  • TALA is increasingly seen on the right people.
  • We have a strong and growing network of A-list and culturally relevant VIPs who genuinely want to wear and engage with TALA.
  • TALA becomes a brand that celebrities, stylists and cultural tastemakers actively want to be associated with.
  • Our Ambassador and Pro programmes become recognised as some of the most exciting programmes in the category.
  • Gifting creates genuine organic reach, conversation and product desire.
  • Our events become moments people want to attend and talk about.
  • TALA earns more high-quality PR and cultural coverage.
  • We create moments that travel across social, PR and culture, delivering awareness well beyond the original activation.
  • Most importantly, you help move TALA from a brand people discover on social media to a brand people know, recognise and want.

Benefits

What we can offer:

  • 25 days holiday a year plus bank holidays
  • Very generous employee discount after probation period
  • Nominated Friends & Family Discount
  • Clothing allowance spending gift
  • Class Pass or Gym Flex membership
  • Health Shield
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity pay
  • Charity fundraising match of up to £1,000

About us:

TALA is an activewear brand built to actively solve problems without creating new ones for people, the planet, or anyone else. Every collection prioritises functionality and thoughtful design, combining premium fabrics with multi-way versatility and flattering fits that deliver maximum impact with minimal effort. Each piece is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring women can look and feel their best with ease.

When founder Grace Beverley shifted from fast fashion to more sustainable options in her everyday clothing, she found a host of responsibly made options in every category other than activewear. Founding TALA in 2019, the proud female-led brand is on a mission to make consciously made active and off-duty styles accessible and inclusive without sacrificing performance or fit.

Read about TALA's people, purpose and product work here.

Daarnaast denk je actief mee over het verbeteren van processen en het verder professionaliseren van de HR-dienstverlening.

Je maakt deel uit van een betrokken HR-team, bestaande uit een HR Teamlead, HR Business Partner en HR-medewerker. Het team valt onder de afdeling Business Support.

Je komt terecht bij een stabiel en groeiend familiebedrijf waar samenwerking, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en een prettige werksfeer centraal staan.

About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

Where in the world of Kaluza will I be working?

 

You’ll be joining the Identity & Access Management (IAM) team, which sits within the Cyber Security squad in the Kaluza technology community, working hand-in-hand with security engineering as well as with Kaluza’s architecture team and technical leaders across our software engineering community. Your initial focus will be on our product IAM space, covering authentication & authorisation services that ensure the appropriate accesses are permitted on the Kaluza retail platform, whether that’s human or machine. The role will broaden over time to encompass our enterprise IAM and PAM solutions which protect us as a business, enabling us to better align these two aspects of IAM in use across Kaluza.

 

With millions of customers across multiple geographic regions, we naturally invest significant effort into availability, performance, security and observability, and the teams pride themselves on their ability to maintain a balance between rapid development of new services, iterative quality & feature enhancements alongside being highly responsive in incidents.

What will I be doing?

 

  • Collaborate with technical, product leadership to help shape and continuously improve our IAM technical strategy and solutions architecture

  • Lead the team hands-on in resolving complex technical issues, evaluating technical options, designing services and scoping engineering work

  • Work with client engineering teams to help them understand our IAM architecture and how to get the most out of our platform

  • Take the lead on evolving our identity and access best practices across engineering, proactively helping teams to apply these with expert advice and automation

  • Use your deep understanding of the IAM domain to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders across Kaluza as well as client teams

  • Mentoring and coaching engineers within the IAM space, helping them balance risk with speed and quality

  • Continuously improve quality across reliability, observability, functional and non-functional testing as well as development processes and documentation

  • Horizon scanning for emerging technologies and approaches to IAM, enabling Kaluza to continue to evolve, keeping us ahead of adversaries as well as cost-effective

What you will bring

 

  • Good experience of both mentoring engineers as well as developer collaboration (e.g. pairing, swarming)

  • Developing, testing, deploying and maintaining quality SaaS APIs in AWS

  • Working with (and continuous improvement of use with) fundamental DevSecOps engineering elements such as CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure As Code, Kubernetes containerization and platform health alerting & monitoring

  • Application of basic modern identity & access management techniques and standards, such as OAuth2.0 or SAML2.0

  • Integrating an IdP into services to enable SSO and/or federated identity

  • Use of encrypted JWTs as part of an OIDC-compliant user authentication flow and/or creating policies in an RBAC and ABAC environment

  • Experience of applying AI to your own work as well as enabling others to safely build it into their development ways of working

  • Working knowledge of Okta or equivalent solutions, to enable workforce identity and enforce access management policies

  • Experience of applying architectural and software design patterns in a complex domain/environment

  • Experience of being a senior subject matter expert in operational incidents

We would still encourage you to apply even if you don’t have experience of all of the above - we look for potential as much as skills fit.

Leadership, quality & delivery

You’ll be…

  • Proficient at applying your technical and commercial knowledge to a risk based approach, taking the lead on assessing current and future technology and designs

  • A pragmatic decision-maker who takes into account the technical & commercial costs and consequences of those decisions

  • Skilled at identifying new or improved ways of working and driving efficiencies

  • Keen to drive compliance and NFR improvements within the platform to balance meeting information security and commercial goals

  • Accomplished at influencing both upwards and outwards, using a mixture of communications skills

  • Skilled in bringing alignment, clarity of thought and direction to information security, product and engineering challenges

  • Able to establish a clear vision for large-scale technical direction and champion alignment to that vision across multiple teams.

  • Experienced in fostering a culture of learning and improvement, challenging engineering leadership to better support this

 

Our Values

 

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

 

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: Implementation Manager
descriptionHtml:
Retire the ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers - automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Keyshot. People don’t just use Light - they enjoy it.

We’re an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you’re excited to modernise how the world runs money - one workflow at a time - you’re in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors and advised by industry titans, we’re building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

About the Role

You'll own several concurrent implementations end to end — from contract signature to go-live. The plan, the customer relationship, the scope, the timeline, the outcome. You hand over to Customer Success once the customer is live.

Your customers are Financial Controllers, Finance Directors and CFOs at fast-growing multinational SaaS and tech companies. Senior, technical, time-poor. They expect you to keep up on multi-entity accounting, consolidation, intercompany, multi-currency and statutory reporting — and to tell them straight when they're asking for something that won't work.

No two implementations look the same. Every customer brings problems that don't have a textbook answer — a consolidation edge case, a migration shape the playbook doesn't cover, a process that needs rebuilding before it can be automated. You'll work the problem, ship the answer, and move on to the next one.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own several concurrent implementations end to end, from kickoff to go-live

  • Run the customer relationship through implementation — Controllers, Finance Directors, CFOs

  • Translate finance requirements into platform design — chart of accounts, entity structure, consolidation logic, reporting

  • Lead data migration — chart of accounts mapping, opening balances, historical data, cutover

  • Hold scope through the project — keep delivery aligned to what was sold, surface and reset drift early

  • Push back on requests that won't work, and bring the customer with you

  • Spot projects going off-track before the customer does, and intervene

  • Train and enable customer finance teams to run on Light from day one of go-live

  • Contribute to the playbooks, templates, and patterns the team builds over time

Experience & Qualifications

  • Degree in finance, accounting, business, or a related field

  • 5+ years in finance transformation, ERP implementation, or finance advisory — Big 4, a finance-focused boutique, or a vendor-side professional services team (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Workday Financials)

  • You are fluent in accounting and can hold your own with a Controller on multi-entity consolidation, intercompany eliminations, accrual accounting, statutory vs management reporting. Qualified accountant is a plus, not a requirement

  • You bring structure to messy projects — clear plans, sharp prioritisation, and the judgement to know which details matter and which don't.

  • You excel at building trust with C-suite executives and finance leadership teams through clear communication and consistent delivery.

  • You are comfortable working cross-functionally — you have delivered through Product, Engineering, Sales, and customer teams without formal authority over any of them

  • You diagnose implementation issues quickly and deliver practical solutions that balance customer needs with technical feasibility.

  • You have a real implementation with your name on the go-live — vendor-side, consulting-side, or as the lead on a customer-side migration. Not "I've used an ERP"

  • You use AI tools daily, have specific opinions on where they help in delivery work and where they don't

  • Fluent English; additional European languages a plus

  • Bonus: multi-jurisdiction experience (IFRS, US GAAP, local GAAPs); experience losing a customer or missing a go-live and learning from it

You'll probably struggle here if

  • You've only ever implemented one ERP, or only ever on one customer - you’ll be running multiple implementation projects simultaneously.

  • You need a PMO, a mature methodology, or a big delivery org around you to operate - you’ll be operating in a startup environment, without a large structure/org surrounding you, ownership and a self starter nature is key

  • You've never owned a go-live solo; someone else was always accountable - see above!

  • You can't give a concrete example of telling a senior customer "no" and making it stick

  • You've used ChatGPT once and weren't impressed - we go all in on AI at Light and need people just as passionate about it!

The good stuff

In addition to being part of a great team and working in a really fun and innovative environment, we offer:

💸 A competitive salary + potential stock options

🏝 Generous package of paid annual leave + public holidays in the country where you are based.

🥳 Regular socials and company off-sites (last time was Northern Italy and next time is in October).

🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you'll help shape a market-defining product.

The famous last words

Working at Light means you're embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat-code is that we've built something like this before - and are now doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.

Join the rocket ship while it's taking off 🚀

title: Implementation Specialist
descriptionHtml:
I quit medicine because I kept watching patients die needlessly, for avoidable reasons. In almost every case, the medical knowledge and clinicians were there. It was the system that failed: the way information moved, decisions got routed, and fragmented teams and data turned solvable problems into tragedy.

I started Anima to change that.

Our mission is human wellbeing, and we believe personalised medicine will transform it. Our founding insight is that getting there requires a system that learns continuously from care and its outcomes, optimising for human wellbeing. Building that learning engine is the opportunity at the heart of Anima.

We're now in 1,000+ clinics across 5 product lines, serving more than 25% of the UK population. We are cash flow positive, growing fast, and have a tight crew of ~45 people who care deeply for each other and the mission. Everyone has real ownership and a voice in decisions.

Multiple trillion-dollar companies will be built in healthcare over the next two decades. We intend to be one of them.

If you want to work on problems where the stakes are high, you belong at Anima. Your work here will save lives.

-- Shun

£65k–£90k base, plus equity
UK remote, UK working hours, with occasional UK customer visits

The role

Help GP practices make a confident start with Anima.

Last quarter, we onboarded 131 practices. We’re building a dedicated Implementation team to support that growth, and you’ll be one of its first members.

You’ll own each implementation from kick-off through go-live and early support, helping practice teams build the skills and confidence to use Anima independently. You’ll also help shape how we implement: improving workflows, developing training and building a playbook that works across hundreds of practices.

What you’ll do

  • Own implementations from start to finish. Coordinate kick-off, configuration and go-live, aiming to get most practices live within their first week.

  • Make Anima work for each practice. Understand how their team operates and configure workflows around their needs.

  • Teach people to use it confidently. Run clear, practical training for clinicians and practice teams, adapting your approach to different levels of technical confidence.

  • Build confidence beyond go-live. Develop practice super users, provide 1–2 weeks of hypercare and hand over cleanly to Support and Customer Success.

  • Make great implementation repeatable. Create reusable training and group webinars. Use feedback from customers, Support and CS to solve recurring problems at their source.

What you’ll bring

  • SaaS experience. You’ve worked directly with customers on a SaaS product in onboarding, implementation or training.

  • Strong teaching and communication skills. You can make something unfamiliar feel manageable and check that people can put it into practice.

  • Patience and adaptability. You respond thoughtfully when someone is struggling or their priorities change.

  • Practical problem-solving. You learn products quickly and can work out why a workflow isn’t delivering the intended result.

  • Ownership and organisation. You can keep several implementations moving while making the next steps clear to everyone involved.

Healthcare experience isn’t required—we’ll help you learn primary care. Experience creating training videos, guides or webinars would be useful.

What we offer

Anima should be where you do your life’s best work. We support that with:

  • Time off: 25 days’ annual leave plus 8 UK public holidays, with flexible additional time off.

  • Health cover: private medical, dental, vision and mental health insurance.

  • Parental leave: 12 weeks’ maternity leave at full pay, rising to 24 weeks after two years; 4 weeks’ paternity leave at full pay.

  • Pension: 4% employer contributions, with salary sacrifice and 100% of the employer National Insurance savings passed on to you.

  • Learning: £1,000 annual budget for your development.

  • Fitness: gym subscription matching up to £50 per month.

  • Equipment: a high-spec MacBook and a home office budget.

  • Time together: two full-team off-sites each year, previous destinations include Mykonos and Mexico.

  • Farringdon office: a beautiful new London HQ, with most of the team together at least twice a week.

Everyone is welcome at Anima. We strongly believe in building a diverse and inclusive team. If you’re excited by our mission and believe you could do this work well, we’d love to hear from you, even if your experience doesn’t match every point above. If adjustments would help you participate fully in the interview process, please let us know.

Compensation: £65K – £90K • Offers Equity

descriptionHtml:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you’ll do at Jamf:

The Inside Account Executive I is a key member of the EMEIA sales team, helping prospects and channel partners understand how they can make the management and the security of their Apple devices robust and easy. The role works with the extended sales team to hit individual targets as well as contributing to the overall territory sales goals.

This role is offered as hybrid, with the expectation to be in the office (7-10 Chandos St, London W1G 9DQ) 3 days per week. We are only able to accept applications for those based in the UK and have sponsorship to live and work in the UK #LI-Hybrid

What you can expect to do this role:

  • Formulate and execute a sales strategy within an assigned territory (Poland, Czech, Estonia, Ukraine, Moldova and Bulgaria)
  • Work in partnership with other departments (Sales Development, Sales Engineers, Channel and Marketing) to build quality pipeline and ensure our prospects bridge the gap between what Apple creates and their organizations needs.
  • Forecast sales activity and revenue attainment on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Develop meaningful relationships with key stakeholders at prospect accounts while managing the entire sales-cycle from prospection to close.
  • Build trusted relationships within the sales ecosystem including Channel Partners and Apple as well as maintaining a strong relationships with other internal Jamf stake holders.
  • Leverage industry leading sales tech stack including SalesForce.com, Outreach.io, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Navigator, Gong.io and much more.    
  • Use Salesforce.com to document and manage sales activities.
  • Understand and explain business value related to the whole Jamf product experience (WPE) such as Client Management, Mobile Device Management and Mobile Security.

What we are looking for:

  • Professional working proficiency in English (required) and any CEE language (preferred)
  • Minimum of 2+ years of experience in a sales, business or entrepreneurial role (required).
  • General experience selling in both direct and indirect (channel) models (preferred).
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with dynamic co-workers in a result driven culture.
  • Ability to create and work in a collaborative environment.
  • Ability to learn quickly and to take and work with feedback provided.
  • Ability to simplify ideas in an easy to understand, non-technical manner.
  • Outgoing, can-do attitude.
  • Great communication skills.
  • Business acumen and a self-starter mindset.
  • 20% travelling expected

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

  • Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

Why Jamf?

  • Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News.
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families
  • Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.  

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.  

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement. 


What does Jamf do?Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

title: Internal Control Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We're looking for an Internal Control Manager to build and embed the internal control framework across our finance function. This is the team that owns the integrity of the group's financial reporting: close, reconciliations, AP, payroll and the systems underneath them.

There's a lot to do. As we scale across the UK and US, our controls need to move from something assembled ahead of audit to something that runs consistently every month. This role owns that shift end to end: mapping the process, identifying the controls, closing the gaps and embedding what's left into BAU. The core deliverable is auditability, control narratives, RACMs and testing protocols that hold up under external audit scrutiny.

What you'll be doing/impact on objectives

  • Map processes end to end across finance operations, including close, reconciliations, AP, payroll and the supporting IT environment

  • Identify key controls and carry out risk assessment across those processes

  • Run gap analysis and design remediation plans, then drive them to completion with process owners

  • Embed controls into BAU so they operate consistently month to month, not just in the run-up to audit

  • Build and maintain the control documentation set: control narratives, risk and control matrices (RACM) and testing protocols

  • Perform and evidence control testing, and track issues through to resolution

  • Act as the client-side counterpart to our Big 4 auditors on control testing and audit readiness

  • Partner with process owners across IT, finance operations, AP, payroll and close to make controls workable as well as effective

What we're looking for

  • Qualified accountant or equivalent (ACA/ACCA/CIMA/CIA) with a minimum of 5 years PQE

  • Direct experience in internal controls, SOX-equivalent control frameworks, or internal audit within a finance function

  • Big 4 audit background, either directly in external audit or via advisory/risk consulting

  • Demonstrable experience interfacing with Big 4 auditors from the client side on control testing and audit readiness

  • Proven track record across all four stages end to end: process mapping, control identification and risk assessment, gap analysis and remediation design, and embedding controls into BAU

  • Working knowledge of a recognised controls framework (COSO or equivalent) to structure control design and testing

  • Able to produce control narratives, RACMs and testing protocols that stand up to external audit scrutiny

  • Collaborative style: comfortable working across IT, finance operations, AP, payroll and close to get controls adopted

Interview process

  • Screening stage: an initial phone interview with the Talent / hiring team and a 15 minute online cognitive assessment

  • Remote Hiring Manager Interview

  • Onsite interviews with the Finance and Compliance team: 90 minutes

  • Follow up Final Stage Remote interview: 30 minutes

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: International Expansion
descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally.

Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s future markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at startup-urgent pace.

What you will be doing

  • High-level strategy development, defining and executing Axle’s international expansion plans, and assessing the commercial value of new markets and business models

  • Diving deep into policy and regulations, understanding how market access works and what needs doing to achieve it

  • Developing the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships with key stakeholders. You’ll be jumping on the phone (and eventually, getting on the ground) with grid operators, utilities/retailers and potential clients to create and disprove hypotheses as quickly as possible.

  • Building the aeroplane as it flies: getting hands dirty with implementation as each international business scales, scoping and setting up pilots, tracking down partners and building relationships.

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, sniff out commercial value, and run through walls to get us into markets at speed.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get ambitious projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification.

What's in it for you

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, additional references, and welcome to the team!

Compensation: £75K – £200K

  • • Total Compensation (salary + equity) £75K – £200K

title: Internship Strategy M&A (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Empower every Employee

AI has changed how office workers get things done. For the 80% of the global workforce that doesn’t sit at a desk, it has barely arrived. Flip AI is changing that.

Flip AI is the #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS) to build, automate, and orchestrate any frontline use case on a foundation of secure identity and comms with strong UX. In practice, that means one app where frontline workers in retail, manufacturing and logistics access their systems, run their processes, and use AI.

More than 1,000 brands trust Flip AI, and over two million people use it worldwide, at companies like Bosch, REWE, FORVIA HELLA and Greif. In August 2026, Notion Capital and HV Capital doubled down with a new $25M round, bringing our total funding to more than $85M.

Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.


About the Role

You work directly with the SVP Strategy & Growth and the senior leadership team. You turn data into recommendations on strategy, go-to-market, product focus and M&A. You will gain C-level exposure: as your work goes directly to the CEO and the Board.

  

What awaits you with us

Strategy & Growth: Run analyses and turn insights into strategic shifts

  • Assess market size, growth and trends to identify new opportunities.

  • Analyze competitors’ products and go-to-market strategies.

  • Define customer segments and ideal customer profiles.

  • Review product strategy, differentiation, strengths and gaps.

  • Analyze personas and buyer journeys to inform positioning and messaging.

  • Examine go-to-market metrics such as pipeline coverage and win rates.

  • Prepare board and leadership materials together with the C-level.

M&A: Take the lead in end-to-end M&A processes, from screening to integration.

  • Screen potential M&A targets.

  • Support due diligence, build preliminary valuation models with assumptions and sensitivities and early in-depth reviews.

  • Take a leading role in post-merger integration efforts.

AI: Use AI every day and take it further.

  • Build your own tools with AI: automate analyses and build dashboards and workflows.

  • Build AI skills and Agents to automate processes together with our internal AI Enablement team.

 

What you bring to the table

  • A Master’s or an advanced Bachelor’s in Business, STEM, Economics or a related field.

  • Availability for at least 3 months.

  • A structured, hypothesis-driven way of working with a focus on execution.

  • AI literacy: you use AI tools every day, leverage them for productivity and you check their output critically.

  • Strong analytical skills, and you can create visually compelling presentations for management and the board that get straight to the point.

  • Fluent German and English, written and spoken and you’re clear and persuasive in both speaking and writing.

  • Ideally experience in strategy consulting, business development, M&A or as a Founder’s Associate.

Nice to have

  • Industry Knowledge of software, SaaS or tech.

  • You have already vibecoded something. Send us the link.

What we offer you

  • AI is how we work: Access to frontier AI tools is standard here, not something you request. We actively encourage heavy use across content, design, analysis and reporting.

  • Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices, always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview.

  • Time off: 30 days of vacation plus public holidays.

  • Work-life balance: We don’t want you to grow roots to your desk chair. Choose between a Wellpass membership and a Givve card.

  • A team you’ll actually meet: The whole company gets together twice a year, plus regular team events and culture days.

  • Working abroad: After your probation period, you can also work from abroad within the European Union. Let’s talk about remote work in the interview.

At Flip AI, everyone is welcome – no matter what gender you identify as or how old you are. Sexual identity, origin, religion, world view and disabilities do not influence your potential job at Flip AI. The most important thing is that YOU fit in!

title: IT Reliability Engineer

title: IT Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:

We are looking for an IT System Architect on behalf of our client, a leading Swiss manufacturing company based in Canton Bern. The company is on a clear cloud transformation journey and needs someone to own it, drive it, and make it happen.

The role

You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and evolving the company's Azure cloud architecture end-to-end. descriptionHtml:

KAIA, our AI assistant, drafts the policies, checks the evidence, and monitors the controls, eliminating roughly 80% of manual work.

Your purpose at Kertos

You’ll be an essential part of our internal IT team and ensure that everyone at Kertos can work smoothly. Our team is growing rapidly, new employees, new tools, new devices and you’ll keep everything organized. You’ll be the first point of contact when something isn’t working, and you’ll actively help ensure that our IT infrastructure scales with us.   • Software Access & Accounts: You’ll manage tool access, create new accounts, and properly remove them during offboarding.

  • IT Administration: You’ll keep our IT processes organized and well-documented, so we can maintain a clear overview even as we continue to grow.

Why Kertos

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sectors by introducing robotics to applications that were previously out of reach. Our customers—large asset operators and industrial service providers—are pioneering the use of robotics for autonomous routine inspections, driving increased safety, productivity, and reduced OPEX. title: Key Account Manager

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

title: Lead Business Continuity
descriptionHtml:

About the role:

As Business Continuity & DR Manager, you will build, implement and maintain Parloa’s Business Continuity Management System (BCMS), including business continuity, disaster recovery and crisis management plans for our digital systems, operations and infrastructure. You will be part of IS&T Governance and play a key role in strengthening Parloa’s resilience and overall security posture.

This is your opportunity to build a BCMS at a fast-growing, global AI company and lead it to ISO 22301 certification, keeping essential services running for enterprise customers who trust Parloa with their most important customer moments.

Areas of ownership:

  • BCMS Design and ISO 22301 Certification: Run gap analyses, define the framework and maintain the policies, procedures and guidelines behind it. Lead the certification process end to end, including preparing for external audits.

  • Risk Assessment and Business Impact Analysis: Identify and prioritise critical business processes by building risk models and mapping dependencies and vulnerabilities. Turn business impact analyses into a tailored continuity strategy for each critical process.

  • Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plans: Create and maintain plans for all critical processes, with clear recovery objectives, resources and recovery teams. Review them regularly so they stay current as Parloa grows.

  • Testing and Exercises: Plan and run tabletop exercises, drills and simulations across critical functions on a recurring schedule. Evaluate results, close gaps and refine plans based on what you learn.

  • Stakeholder Alignment and Resilience Culture: Build strong relationships with department heads and report progress, risks and milestones to senior management. Define KPIs for the BCMS and deliver training and awareness programmes that make resilience part of how Parloa works.

  • Solid knowledge of how to implement a BCMS according to ISO 22301.

  • Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, risk management and crisis response.

  • A structured, execution-focused way of working: you build and follow a clear project roadmap, make decisions and see them through.

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.
