title: Lead Product Manager, User Platform
descriptionHtml:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

GetYourGuide knows a great deal about every traveler, and almost none of it is usable today. Identity, booking history, browsing behavior, care conversations, preferences and predictions sit in separate systems, in different shapes, so every team that wants to act on what we know rebuilds its own partial version of it. The User Platform team is building the traveler context layer: resolving who someone is across devices and sessions, and turning scattered signals into a shared, interpretable and predictive understanding that every team can build on. We start with travelers, because that is where the leverage is, and the layer is designed to extend to our other users over time.

Your mission

As a Lead Product Manager, you will own the vision and strategy for a new platform at GetYourGuide, and you will be the first product manager on the team that builds it. Working with an Engineering Manager, engineers, an embedded data scientist and an analyst, you will define what the traveler context layer holds, how it is served, and which problems it solves first. This is a genuine zero to one: the identity model, the semantic memory that both humans and LLMs can read, the forward-looking predictions on top of it, and the self-serve interfaces that make it usable are all still to be designed.

The work is equal parts product craft and demand creation. Our consumers are other teams: search and ranking, lifecycle and paid channels, customer care, and the traveler experience itself. Their need is real and widely felt, but they struggle to define what would really solve their problems.

We are looking for a product leader who is fluent in data and machine learning without needing to be a data scientist, who is comfortable when the scope of a domain is still being drawn, and who wants to build the foundation that personalization at GetYourGuide will run on for years.

What You'll Do

  • Ownership: Develop and own a 12+ month vision and strategy for the traveler context domain, define how we win in it, and take full responsibility for the outcomes. Identify where the non-incremental impact sits and sequence the roadmap to reach it.

  • Ambiguity: Operate in a domain that is being defined as you build it. Break an open-ended platform problem into a phased, coherent plan, and make confident calls with incomplete information.

  • Prioritization: Choose the few use cases that prove the platform, and be explicit about what we will not build. Balance the depth a single consumer wants against the breadth the platform needs, and sequence to maximise learning.

  • Collaboration: Build trust with consuming teams across Growth, Retention, Search, Care and Supply, and negotiate the line between what we own and what they own. Proactively manage the dependencies and handoffs that keep the strategy executable.

  • Communication and adoption: Make the platform legible to the rest of the company, from engineers to executives. Create demand where none exists yet by showing teams what becomes possible, then convert that into committed adoption.

  • Technical fluency: Set the technical bar for the team and work credibly with data scientists and engineers on identity resolution, feature and embedding design, and serving architecture. Bring a clear point of view on when a heuristic beats a model, and on build versus buy versus partner.

  • Experimentation: Validate the layer with real consumers and real traffic. Design the tests that show a shared representation outperforms the local copies teams build today.

  • Leadership: Represent the interests of our users and our internal consumers at every level of the organization. Act with openness and transparency with your team, your peers and executive leadership, and coach others on the craft of building platform products

Your toolkit

  • 6+ years of professional experience in product management, including at least 2 years at Lead level or with equivalent scope, and meaningful time spent on data, machine learning or platform products

  • Demonstrated ownership of a product area whose users are other teams, such as an internal platform, an API or a data product, including strategy, KPI definition, goal setting and adoption, not only delivery

  • Strong data literacy: comfortable querying and interpreting large datasets, designing experiments, and working day to day with data scientists and analysts

  • A working understanding of the machine learning lifecycle and how it differs from software delivery, plus the judgment to know when analytics and good heuristics are the better answer

  • A track record of building alignment across a large and varied set of stakeholders, including senior leadership, in a way that is consistent with our Guiding Principles

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Bonus: experience with customer data platforms, identity resolution, segmentation or personalization systems

  • Bonus: experience putting LLMs into production

  • Bonus: experience in a marketplace or another two-sided platform

  • Bonus: an engineering or analytics background

How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development

  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year

  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time. 

  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events

  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget

  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities

  • Language reimbursement program

  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

The position you are applying for is placed at level 7.

The role

We’re looking for a lead product marketing manager to join our marketing team.

You’ll be the product expert within marketing – someone who gets properly under the skin of what we’re building, why we’re building it and the value it creates for our customers.

Working closely with our product, sales and customer-facing teams, you’ll turn that understanding into clearer propositions, stronger product adoption and more compelling ways of explaining Seccl’s value to existing customers and future prospects.

We’re looking for someone senior enough to shape product marketing at Seccl, but who also enjoys getting into the detail – understanding how things work, asking difficult questions and turning complex capabilities into clear, useful outputs.

What you’ll be doing

  • Getting under the skin of Seccl’s products – working closely with product teams to understand what we’re building, why it matters, how it works and where it creates value for customers

  • Working closely with product teams throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery and development through to launch and adoption

  • Building trusted relationships across product, sales, customer and marketing, and establishing practical ways of working

  • Helping existing customer firms understand and use more of the platform, supporting feature adoption and customer growth

  • Using buyer, customer, competitor, CRM and win/loss insight to sharpen Seccl’s positioning and messaging

  • Helping commercial teams explain Seccl’s value through clearer propositions, sales materials, objection handling and support for priority deals

  • Building better feedback loops between customers, commercial teams and product, turning insight into recommendations that inform product and commercial decisions

  • Supporting and developing others through clear direction, useful feedback and high standards

This role’s for you if...

  • You have strong product marketing, proposition or go-to-market experience in a product-led B2B technology, fintech, SaaS or similarly complex environment

  • You’re genuinely fascinated by technology and how products work. You enjoy getting into technical detail, asking questions and working out how to explain complex capabilities in ways that make sense to different audiences

  • You have a strong commercial instinct and understand how product marketing can support both new business and existing customer growth

  • You enjoy getting stuck into the work yourself, while also being able to think strategically and set direction

  • You build strong relationships across teams, and are comfortable challenging thinking and influencing decisions

  • You’re confident working with customer, market and CRM data to identify trends and turn insight into useful recommendations

  • You’re comfortable working in ambiguity, bringing structure and rigour without unnecessary process

  • You’re curious about how AI is changing product marketing, from sales enablement and internal knowledge sharing to how buyers research and discover suppliers

This role isn’t for you if…

  • You only work at strategy level. We’re looking for someone who also enjoys getting into the detail and producing practical, useful work, as well as setting direction

  • You need everything clearly defined from day one. There’s plenty of opportunity to shape how product marketing works at Seccl, so you’ll need to be comfortable with ambiguity and building things as you go

  • You value process over progress. We need structure and rigour, but also someone who can make decisions and keep things moving when the answers aren’t clear-cut

  • You prefer to work independently of other teams. This is a highly collaborative role, and your success will depend on building trust and strong working relationships across the business

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 A salary between £80,000 and £95,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

Following an initial chat with our talent team, you can expect:

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Nice-to-have

title: Manager Architect Cloud - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Présentation du poste :

Concevoir une architecture d’IA, c’est engager une entreprise pour plusieurs années : l’emplacement des données, la gestion des accès, la manière dont un agent passe en production sous le regard des équipes de sécurité. Ces choix structurants, vous les construisez avec nos clients.

Tout le reste, ce sont les ambitions fonctionnelles et techniques du client, son cadre réglementaire, son budget, les compétences qu'il peut réellement mobiliser en interne, la gouvernance qu'il veut installer, et un écosystème d'éditeurs qui gravite autour de lui. Votre rôle est de trouver le point d'équilibre entre ces forces, de le faire accepter, puis de le réajuster dès que l'une d'elles bouge.

Votre point de départ n’est pas la technologie, mais l’ambition métier. Vous la traduisez en une plateforme data ou agentique pensée pour s’intégrer au système d’information existant, avec son histoire, ses contraintes et ses équipes. Votre rôle ne s’arrête pas à la validation du schéma cible : vous accompagnez les équipes de delivery jusqu’à la mise en production.

À titre d’exemple, chez l’un de nos clients, chaque nouvel agent repose désormais sur une plateforme commune qui gère nativement les droits d’accès, le monitoring et les coûts. Chaque cas d’usage s’appuie ainsi sur les fondations posées pour les précédents.

Ce poste s’adresse à vous si vous aimez embrasser un système dans son ensemble, prendre les décisions qui engagent et en expliquer les raisons.

Artefact est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes entreprises mondiales pour déployer l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, vous rejoignez le département Engineering (environ 300 personnes, sous la responsabilité du CTO), au sein du chapter AI Architect.

Activités et responsabilités :

Sur un projet, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les AI Applied Engineers, qui construisent et font tourner ce que vous concevez, et avec les AI Product Managers, qui portent le produit avec le client.

Côté client, deux publics sont à convaincre : les directions métier, avec lesquelles vous définissez la cible, et les équipes IT, sécurité, réseau et exploitation, sans l’adhésion desquelles rien ne passe en production. Une architecture qu’elles n’ont pas validée ne dépasse pas le stade du document. Vous êtes aussi l'interlocuteur des achats, de la conformité et des éditeurs qui veulent se positionner.

Au sein du chapter, vous relisez les designs de vos pairs, contribuez à faire grandir les architectes et les profils d’ingénierie qui vous entourent, et mettez en commun ce qui fonctionne. Vous travaillez également avec nos partenaires technologiques et les autres équipes d’Artefact.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Traduire les objectifs, les contraintes et les délais du client en une architecture que le métier comme l’IT comprennent, et défendre vos choix devant eux.
  • Concevoir des plateformes data et agentiques, on premise, dans le cloud ou en hybride.
  • Découper les périmètres techniques en fonction de la façon dont les équipes du client sont organisées.
  • Arbitrer entre les options en pesant leur valeur métier, leur coût total, leur conformité, leur dépendance à un éditeur et la capacité du client à les faire vivre.
  • Aider le client à évaluer et à mettre en concurrence des éditeurs, sans parti pris.
  • Préparer les propositions commerciales : cadrer la solution, la chiffrer et construire la roadmap de delivery.
  • Tenir la ligne  pendant le delivery : relire les designs, trancher les arbitrages et réajuster la cible quand le contexte du client change.
  • Faire vivre les patterns de référence et les bonnes pratiques du chapter, et suivre de près les évolutions de l’IA, du cloud et de la data.

Profil recherché :

Nous recherchons une personne qui pense comme un consultant et raisonne comme un ingénieur. Les architectes qui réussissent chez nous sont, entre autres, des profils techniques passés par le conseil, des pre-sales engineers, des FDEs, ou des personnes avec une expérience en tant que CTO.

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez conçu une architecture data ou IA qui a été mise en production, et vous savez expliquer pourquoi vous avez écarté les autres options, techniques ou non.
  2. Vous avez déjà recommandé une option techniquement moins séduisante parce qu'elle correspondait mieux au budget, aux compétences, à la gouvernance ou à la réglementation du client.
  3. Vous maîtrisez au moins un grand cloud (Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS) ainsi que les fondamentaux de la sécurité et du réseau : IAM, gestion des secrets, architecture réseau.
  4. Vous avez rédigé des dossiers d’architecture (HLD et LLD) qui ont servi de base à une équipe de delivery.
  5. Vous avez codé pendant une partie significative de votre parcours. Aujourd'hui, vous savez lire du code, challenger un design et dire ce qu'exige un système en production : CI/CD, monitoring, gestion des incidents.
  6. Vous avez déjà cadré et chiffré une solution, par exemple pour une proposition commerciale ou un plan projet.
  7. Vous avez défendu une architecture à la fois devant une direction métier ou un comité de direction, et devant les équipes sécurité et exploitation, en reliant la valeur business, les choix techniques et le plan de delivery.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Architecture de plateformes agentiques : RAG, orchestration multi-agents, choix des technologies couche par couche.
  • Gouvernance des données à l’échelle d’une grande entreprise : data mesh, gestion des accès.
  • Plateformes on premise, hybrides ou souveraines, basées sur des technologies open source ou sur Kubernetes.
  • Standards de run : SLA, PRA et PCA.
  • Une expérience de CTO, de tech lead ou dans un rôle au contact des clients.
  • Une certification d’architecture cloud.
  • Une pratique régulière des coding agents.

Ce poste n'est probablement pas pour vous si votre expertise porte sur une seule plateforme ou un seul éditeur et que vous souhaitez continuer à l'approfondir. Ni si construire et écrire du code est ce qui vous anime le plus : le rôle d'AI Applied Engineer vous correspondra mieux.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Process de recrutement :

  • HR Interview (30-45 min) : Échange sur votre parcours, vos compétences managériales et l'adéquation culturelle avec un Talent Acquisition Specialist.
  • Architecture Case  (60 min) : Session d'architecture avec un AI Architect basé en France sur un cas basé sur une vraie mission.
  • US / Manager Interview (60 min) : Échange avec un Director / Partner pour évaluer le fit managérial, opérationnel et la posture client.

Rémunération : Package :  75 000 € à 85 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 8 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité.

Présentation de l’entreprise

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable.

A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

title: Manager Business Development & Market Analysis (m/w/d) | Befristet auf 4 Jahre
descriptionHtml:
Wollen Sie Ihre berufliche Zukunft in einem wegweisenden Projekt gestalten? Bei der Deutschen Energy Terminal GmbH (DET) in Düsseldorf erwartet Sie eine spannende Herausforderung. Im Auftrag des Bundesministeriums für Wirtschaft und Energie entwickelt und betreibt die Deutsche Energy Terminal GmbH (DET) die vier schwimmenden LNG-Terminals an der deutschen Nordseeküste, über die LNG vom Schiff in das Gasnetz eingespeist wird. Die sogenannten Floating Storage and Regasification Units (FSRU) sind von entscheidender Bedeutung für die Versorgungssicherheit Deutschlands und damit kritische Infrastruktur mit hohem Risikopotenzial. Wir suchen motivierte Talente, die aktiv an der Gestaltung unseres Verantwortungsbereichs teilhaben möchten. Bewerben Sie sich noch heute und gestalten Sie die Zukunft mit uns!

Aufgaben

Ihre Aufgabe: Den Markt verstehen, weiterdenken und in Projekte übersetzen

Genau hier kommen Sie ins Spiel: Als Manager Business Development & Market Analysis (m/w/d) beobachten und analysieren Sie fortlaufend die Entwicklungen in den internationalen Energiemärkten – von LNG über Gas bis hin zu grünen Alternativen. Sie leiten daraus Empfehlungen für die Ausgestaltung unserer Marktangebote ab und entwickeln Tools zur systematischen Bewertung der Versorgungssicherheit in Deutschland.

Sie entwickeln und leiten strategische Projekte zur Nutzung unsere Terminalstandorte. Aktuell begleiten sie beispielsweise eine europaweit ausgeschriebene Konzeptstudie, aus der konkrete Projekte hervorgehen sollen. Diese können thematisch von der synergetischen Nutzung mit Nachbarstandorten über die Umwandlung zu Grün-Terminals bis hin zum Aufbau von CO2-Terminals Umschlagsplätzen an unseren Terminals reichen. Unser Gesellschafter ist das Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft und Klimaschutz (BMWK) und ihre Arbeit ist von besonderem öffentlichem Interesse.

Ihre Aufgaben bei uns

  • Analyse von Markttrends rund um LNG, Erdgas und grüne Energieträger – sowohl auf nationaler als auch internationaler Ebene
  • Entwicklung fundierter Marktanalysen und Marktberichte zur Bewertung unserer Marktangebote (z. B. Nachfrageeinschätzung, Preisbildung, Angebotsstrukturen)
  • Entwicklung von Tools zur Bewertung der Versorgungssicherheit, der Diversifizierung der Gasversorgung, von Marktpotenzialen und geopolitischen Einflussfaktoren
  • Unterstützung von Vermarktungsaktionen, insbesondere bei der organisatorischen Vorbereitung und Analyse der Ergebnisse
  • Entwicklung und Leitung strategischer Projekte zur z. B. Terminaltransformation,
  • Entwicklung von strategischen Partnerschaften
  • Koordination von Studien und Ausschreibungen (z. B. Terminalentwicklungen, grüne Infrastruktur) sowie Ableitung konkreter Projektkonzepte
  • Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen (Technik, Kommunikation, Regulierung) sowie externen Partnern und Berater:innen
  • Quantifizierung der Kapazitätsentwicklung für LNG-Terminals in Deutschland und international

Qualifikation

Was Sie mitbringen sollten

  • Ein abgeschlossenes wirtschafts-, ingenieur- oder energiewirtschaftliches Studium
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung oder ausgeprägtes Interesse an Marktanalyse, Energiewirtschaft und strategischer Projektarbeit
  • Erfahrung in der Leitung von Projekten
  • Analytisches Denkvermögen, Freude an der Arbeit mit Zahlen, Marktmodellen und Marktkennzahlen
  • Fähigkeit, geopolitische Entwicklungen einzuordnen und in marktbezogene Empfehlungen zu überführen
  • Strukturierte, konzeptionelle Arbeitsweise mit Erfahrung im Projektmanagement
  • Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen klar und verständlich zu vermitteln
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

  • Teilhabe an der Erfüllung einer Aufgabe, die für die Versorgungssicherheit Deutschlands und seiner Nachbarn von entscheidender Bedeutung ist
  • Aus- und Fortbildung
  • Ein dynamisches Umfeld mit abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben und hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Homeoffice nach Vereinbarung
  • Wir arbeiten stetig an weiteren Vorteilen für unsere Mitarbeitenden: aktuell bieten wir eine medizinische Gesundheitsvorsorge, die Kostenübernahme des Deutschland-Tickets sowie einen attraktiven Arbeitsplatz als weitere Benefits

Bereit, den Energiemarkt mitzugestalten?
Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung; auch, wenn Sie vielleicht nicht alle Stichpunkte erfüllen.
Gemeinsam sichern wir die Energieversorgung von heute – und gestalten die Infrastruktur von morgen.

title: Marketing & Branding Intern (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Description

We are looking for a creative owner, because how the world sees us decides which doors open. Join the CEO Office at QuantumDiamonds (QD) and take ownership of everything marketing and branding. You will shape how semiconductor manufacturers, failure analysis labs, partners and future colleagues experience QD, at trade shows, at events, online and in every piece of material we hand out. As an Intern in Marketing & Branding, you will drive our branding, prepare our trade show appearances and events from start to finish, and create the materials and merchandise that represent us. At the same time, you will set up the processes that make our marketing repeatable as we scale toward industrial production.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

  

What will you do

  • Own our brand day to day and drive our ongoing branding, from rollout across all touchpoints to keeping our look consistent

  • Plan and prepare our trade show appearances end to end: booth concept, materials, logistics, shipping, and coordination with organizers and vendors

  • Plan and organize our own events and customer visits, from invitation to follow-up

  • Design decks, flyers, brochures, posters and booth materials for trade shows and customer meetings

  • Develop new merchandise and manage the process with suppliers, from idea to delivery

  • Turn trade shows, customer installations and milestones into content for LinkedIn and our website

  • Gather input from the people who build and sell our technology and work directly with management

  • Set up templates, checklists and processes for trade shows, events and marketing materials so they can be repeated and scaled

 

What is expected of you

  • You are enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Marketing, Communication, Design, Business Administration, or a related field

  • You have first experience in marketing, branding, event management, or content creation, ideally in a B2B tech environment

  • You have a strong eye for design and are confident with tools such as Canva or Figma

  • You write clearly and can make complex technical topics understandable without oversimplifying them

  • You are well organized and keep many moving parts on track, especially under deadline pressure before trade shows and events

  • Experience with LinkedIn company pages, Webflow or another CMS, or AI tools in content production is a plus

  • You have a strong technical understanding and quickly get to grips with complex topics, so you can explain our technology and its value

  • A background in physics, engineering, or another technical field is a plus

  • You take ownership: you drive topics yourself and follow them through to completion

  • You are available for a full-time internship of 4 to 6 months, can work from our Munich office

  • Fluent English is required, German is a plus

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 24 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van een stagiair bij Heras? De eerste indruk: dynamisch in plaats van stoffig - Heras Nederland

Wie zijn wij?
Heras is Europa's toonaangevende aanbieder van 360° beveiligingsoplossingen, gespecialiseerd in perimeter- en technische beveiliging om te beschermen wat belangrijk is. We ontwerpen, installeren en onderhouden complete beveiligingssystemen die naadloos aansluiten op de bedrijfsvoering van onze klanten. Zo beschermen we mensen, locaties en kritieke infrastructuur. Gedreven door onze visie om de wereld veiliger te maken, zetten wij ons in voor kwaliteit, veiligheid en verantwoordelijkheid voor mens en milieu. Met meer dan 3.200 medewerkers ondersteunen wij klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren en landen. Als betrouwbare partner zijn wij één aanspreekpunt voor alle beveiligingsvraagstukken, en houden wij jouw wereld veilig.

Onze cultuur, werksfeer & waarden
Wij hebben binnen Heras een informele, open en toegankelijke cultuur. We zijn trots op ons werk, producten en dienstverlening. We hebben een no-nonsense mentaliteit, tonen ondernemerschap, zijn energiek en werken allemaal gedisciplineerd volgens de drie kernwaarden; betrokkenheid, betrouwbaarheid en deskundigheid. Heras is gewaardeerd op een Ecovadis Bronzen Ster en dat plaatst ons bij de duurzaamste 35% bedrijven van Nederland. Onze doelstelling is streven naar Goud in de komende jaren en volledig CO2 neutraal zijn in 2050. Wil je hier meer over weten? https://www.heras.nl/over-heras/kwaliteit-en-veiligheid/


Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt interesse in procesverbetering en data

  • Je hebt basiskennis van of affiniteit met Power BI en/of Power Automate

  • Je bent analytisch, proactief en communicatief sterk

  • Onze voorkeur gaat uit naar een kandidaat die de Nederlandse taal goed beheerst

  • Hoewel het niet zelf programmeren beterft vindt je het wel leuk om zelf oplossingen te verzinnen en te testen

title: Model-Based Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs.

What are you going to do?

  • Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack.

  • Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools.

  • Build reusable model libraries for key subsystems, including QPU interfaces, cryogenic wiring and attenuation, microwave signal paths, and control electronics.

  • Develop automated analyses on top of the model, such as heat-load, signal-integrity and noise budgets, channel counts, scalability, and full-system metrics such as power consumption as qubit counts grow.

  • Establish requirements traceability from customer and system-level requirements down to component specifications and verification tests.

  • Connect the system model to simulation and measurement data, creating a digital thread between design and test.

  • Support system architecture and trade studies for new VIO and QPU generations and customer system integrations.

  • Drive adoption across the company, training and supporting engineers in using the models and tools in their day-to-day work.

Qualifications

Core Requirements:

  • BSc. or MSc. in systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering or a related field.

  • 3+ years of hands-on MBSE experience, including building or extending a modelling framework rather than only using existing ones.

  • Hands on experience with hardware system models that encompass multiple subsystems with differing requirements and interfaces.

  • Strong working knowledge of SysML (v1 and/or v2) and at least one MBSE tool, such as Cameo, Capella or equivalent.

  • Proficiency in Python for model automation, analysis and tool integration via APIs.

  • A solid track record in requirements engineering and verification of complex, multidisciplinary hardware systems.

  • Strong organisational and communication skills. You thrive in a cross-disciplinary environment and are comfortable taking ownership from day one.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with cryogenic, RF/microwave or precision instrumentation systems, or direct experience with superconducting quantum hardware.

  • Background in high-tech, semiconductor, aerospace or scientific instrumentation industries.

  • Experience introducing MBSE into an organisation and driving its adoption.

  • Familiarity with SysML v2 APIs, digital thread concepts or co-simulation (e.g. FMI), as well as systems engineering standards such as ISO/IEC 15288.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

title: Non-Destructive Testing Technician – Level 2
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing, producing and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital vehicle designed to carry cargo and, in the longer term, potentially crew.

To support the ramp-up of our production activities in Munich, we are looking for a Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) Technician - Level 2 with strong practical experience in radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT). Ultrasonic testing (UT) experience is an advantage.

You will perform and document inspections on critical space components and assemblies. In your day-to-day work, you will collaborate with Production, Quality and Engineering teams, as well as external providers and the appointed Responsible Level 3. Your rigor will directly contribute to the conformity, traceability and reliability of flight hardware.

Your mission

You will prepare and perform NDT inspections in accordance with approved procedures and acceptance criteria, assess results within the scope of your qualification, and alert the relevant stakeholders when you identify a discrepancy or technical concern.


What you will do

  • Perform radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT) on production parts, welds, structures and other hardware in accordance with applicable procedures.

  • Prepare parts, verify inspection conditions, and use the required equipment and consumables.

  • Interpret and evaluate indications within the scope of your qualification and against approved acceptance criteria; seek guidance or escalate complex or ambiguous cases.

  • Produce complete inspection reports and maintain traceability of results, equipment, parameters and applicable documents.

  • Check the condition and validity of inspection equipment, and report any need for maintenance, verification or replacement.

  • Coordinate with Production to schedule inspections at the right stage and help resolve inspection-related production blockers.

  • Raise non-conformities and contribute to root-cause investigations, corrective actions and their follow-up.

  • Contribute to updating work instructions, procedures, inspection plans and report templates, under the coordination of authorized personnel.

  • When needed, coordinate inspections performed by external providers and check that their deliverables and supporting documentation are complete.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of NDT practices and the development of internal capabilities, including UT where your experience allows.

  • Follow the site’s safety, quality and document-control requirements.


What you bring

  • Level 2 qualification in radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT) under EN 4179, NAS 410, ISO 9712; current qualifications are strongly preferred.

  • Professional experience in the space industry is required, ideally involving flight hardware or critical equipment.

  • Practical experience inspecting welds, metallic structures, pressure vessels, propulsion systems, machined parts or composite components.

  • Ability to read drawings, specifications, procedures and acceptance criteria, and produce accurate, clear inspection reports.

  • Good understanding of inspection traceability, equipment control and the handling of non-conforming results.

  • Ability to work within the scope of your qualification and consult the Level 3 or technical focal points whenever a decision falls outside that scope.

  • Professional working proficiency in English, both spoken and written, to operate in an international environment.


Especially valuable

  • UT qualification or practical experience, particularly inspecting critical parts or structures.

  • Experience with digital radiography, phased-array UT, automated inspection or composite inspection.

  • Experience working with a Responsible Level 3, external NDT providers or certification bodies.

  • Experience preparing or reviewing procedures, technical instructions or inspection plans.


How you work

  • Rigorous and detail-oriented, with a consistent focus on conformity and traceability.

  • Sound technical judgment and a pragmatic, production-focused mindset.

  • Autonomous and organized, with clear communication whenever a discrepancy or concern arises.

  • Comfortable collaborating with Production, Quality, Engineering and external providers.

  • Motivated to help build robust NDT capabilities for demanding space hardware.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

title: NÜRNBERG - Station Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst als Standortleitung richtig etwas bewegen, und das in einer Branche, die nach Urlaub klingt? Als Station Manager bei roadsurfer in Nürnberg führst du dein eigenes Team, hältst unsere Camper-Flotte in Topform und schickst jeden Tag Menschen auf ihren nächsten Roadtrip. Ob du bisher als Stationsleiter:in in der Autovermietung, als Branch Manager im Tourismus oder als Teamleitung in der Hotellerie unterwegs warst: Bei uns spielst du deine Erfahrung voll aus und gestaltest deine Station mit.

Warum roadsurfer?

  • TEAMSPIRIT & TEAMEVENTS: Freu dich auf eine kollegiale Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien, jede Menge Spaß und großartigem Teamspirit sowie regelmäßige Teamevents wie gemeinsame Sportsessions, Grillabende oder einfach nur ein Feierabenddrink an deiner Station.

  • CAMPER BUDGET: Du bekommst eine jährliche Freimiete für unsere Camper, damit du den #happyroadsurfing Lifestyle selbst erleben kannst.

  • JOBRAD: Bleibe fit mit unserem Angebot eines Jobrads.

  • DISCOUNTS: Nutze unsere Corporate Benefits Plattform, die Travel Industry Card und Family & Friends Rabatte.

 

Deine Aufgaben als Standortleitung

  • Station führen: Du verantwortest das Tagesgeschäft an deiner Station in Nürnberg und sorgst mit deinem Team und unseren zentralen Fachbereichen für reibungslose Abläufe.

  • Team leiten: Du führst dein Team mit strukturiertem Onboarding, klarer Einsatzplanung und regelmäßigem Feedback.

  • Talente finden: Du übernimmst das Recruiting für deine Station und holst Leute an Bord, die unsere Begeisterung teilen.

  • Flotte managen: Du behältst den Überblick über unsere Camper vor Ort, sorgst für ihren einwandfreien Zustand und stimmst dich eng mit lokalen Servicepartnern ab.

  • Prozesse verbessern: Du setzt unsere Standards um und bringst eigene Ideen ein, z. B. für schnellere Fahrzeugübergaben und -rücknahmen.

  • Kund:innen beraten: Du bist Ansprechpartner:in rund um die Camper-Miete: von der Fahrzeugübergabe mit Einweisung bis zur Rücknahme. So schickst du Kund:innen als happy roadsurfer auf die Straßen Europas.

  • International vernetzt: Du tauschst dich regelmäßig mit roadsurfer-Teams in anderen Ländern aus.

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung, Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 1–2 Jahre Berufserfahrung, gern in Autovermietung, Tourismus oder Hospitality. Quereinsteiger:innen sind herzlich willkommen!

  • Empathie und Lust, ein Team unterstützend zu führen

  • Starke Service-Orientierung und Freude an offener, freundlicher Kommunikation

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst mit an und findest pragmatische Lösungen

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie Führerschein Klasse B

Nice to have

  • Erste Erfahrung als Teamleitung, Schichtleitung oder Stationsleitung

  • Erfahrung im Flottenmanagement oder in der Fahrzeugvermietung

Wir ❤️ Transparenz. Das Gehaltsband für diese Position liegt zwischen 42.000 EUR und 44.000 EUR brutto jährlich. Wir führen aktuell Gehaltsbänder in unseren Stellenbeschreibungen ein, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Sobald wir uns im Bewerbungsprozess besser kennenlernen und deine Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen noch genauer einschätzen können, finden wir gemeinsam heraus, welche Stufe innerhalb des Gehaltsbands am besten zu dir passt. In einem jährlichen Feedbackgespräch wird dein Gehalt mindestens einmal im Jahr überprüft.

Bereit zu surfen?

Du bist für die Aufgabe wie gemacht? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Für Rückfragen kannst Du dich auch gerne jederzeit an

But that’s only the beginning. We are growing fast, so hop on board and join us on our journey. The roadsurfer philosophy is simple: rent an RV, start your adventure, be happy. title: Offre de Stage : Ingénierie des électrodes pour les batteries résorbables à ions métalliques – “Electrode Engineering for Resorbable Metal-Ion Batteries “ -Stage de 4 à 6 mois
descriptionHtml:
Mines Saint-Etienne est une Ecole de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe public d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France. L’IMT est un EPSCP (grand établissement) sous la tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté Industrielle et Numérique.

L’École Nationale Supérieure des Mines de Saint-Étienne (Mines Saint-Etienne) est chargée de missions de formation, de recherche et d’innovation, de transfert vers l’industrie et de culture scientifique, technique et industrielle.

Mines Saint-Etienne représente: 2 400 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation, 480 personnels (150 Chercheurs et Enseignants-chercheurs), un budget consolidé de 46 M€, 3 campus dédiés à l’industrie à Saint-Etienne et Lyon (région AURA), à la microélectronique et aux objets connectés à Gardanne (Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence, région SUD) et à l’ingénierie pour la santé à Saint-Etienne ; 6 unités de recherche ; 5 centres de formation et de recherche ; un centre de culture scientifique technique et industrielle leader en France « La Rotonde » (> 50 000 visiteurs / an).

Contexte scientifique et objectifs du stage :

Les dispositifs électroniques biorésorbables constituent une approche prometteuse pour le développement de systèmes électroniques temporaires, notamment dans le domaine biomédical. Ces dispositifs sont conçus pour assurer une fonction spécifique avant de se dégrader progressivement, ce qui nécessite le développement de matériaux adaptés et de solutions de stockage de l’énergie compatibles avec cette approche.

Dans ce contexte, ce stage porte sur le développement de matériaux d’électrode pour des batteries destinées aux dispositifs électroniques biorésorbables (resorbtronics). L’objectif est de préparer et de mettre en œuvre des matériaux d’électrode, puis d’étudier leurs propriétés électrochimiques afin de mieux comprendre leur comportement et d’évaluer leur potentiel pour le stockage de l’énergie.

Le/la stagiaire participera à la préparation des matériaux, à la réalisation des expériences électrochimiques ainsi qu’à l’analyse et à l’interprétation des résultats. Ce travail contribuera à identifier les paramètres influençant les performances des électrodes et à orienter leur optimisation.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous :

  • Préparer et mettre en œuvre des matériaux d’électrode pour des systèmes de stockage électrochimique de l’énergie.

  • Réaliser des mesures électrochimiques afin d’évaluer les propriétés et les performances des matériaux étudiés.

  • Analyser et interpréter les résultats expérimentaux, puis contribuer à l’optimisation des protocoles de préparation et de caractérisation.

  • Présenter les résultats obtenus et participer aux discussions scientifiques autour du projet.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre les Mines de Saint-Etienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l'excellence, avec la conviction qu'ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c'est l'opportunité de trouver :

  • Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un cadre de travail accueillant et un solide réseau international (T.I.M.E., EULiST).

  • Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle représentant 11 millions d'euros par an, principalement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique, La Rotonde, engagé depuis 25 ans dans la médiation scientifique et accueillant plus de 50 000 visiteurs par an.

  • Frais de transports en commun pris en charge à hauteur de 75% (sous conditions),

  • Foyer du personnel (activités sportives, culturelles, avantages CE sur des loisirs et temps de convivialité),

  • 1 jour de congé par mois (à poser sous réserve de l'accord du tuteur)


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Les principaux critères d’évaluation du candidat seront les suivants (liste non exhaustive) :

· Étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou en dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs, avec une formation en science des matériaux, électrochimie, chimie des matériaux ou dans un domaine connexe.

· Bonnes connaissances fondamentales en électrochimie et en propriétés des matériaux.

· Intérêt pour la préparation, la mise en œuvre et la caractérisation expérimentale de matériaux.

· Une expérience en laboratoire, notamment en synthèse de matériaux ou en caractérisation électrochimique, serait appréciée.

· Rigueur expérimentale, esprit d’analyse, autonomie et capacité à travailler en équipe.

📩 Postulez Maintenant !

· Date limite de candidature : 02/12/2026

· Durée du stage : 4 à 6 mois

· Début du stage : 01/01/2027

· Lieu du stage : Gardanne (13) - France

· Gratifications : au taux horaire : 4,50 € par heure de présence effective

Modalités de candidature :

Les candidatures doivent être déposées sur la plateforme RECRUITEE, avant le 02/12/2026 (CV, lettre de motivation) :

https://institutminestelecom.recruitee.com/o/offre-de-stage-ingenierie-des-electrodes-pour-les-batteries-resorbables-a-ions-metalliques-electrode-engineering-for-resorbable-metal-ion-batteries-stage-de-4-a-6-mois

Le poste est ouvert à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap. Dans le cadre de sa politique Égalité, Diversité et Inclusion, l’École des Mines de Saint Etienne est un employeur soucieux de l’équité de traitement entre les candidatures.

Les candidats retenus à une audition seront informés dans les meilleurs délais. Une partie des échanges s’effectuera en anglais.

title: Order & Delivery Coordinator (C-UAS)
descriptionHtml:
Your next mission

Anchor our system deliveries. Connect internal teams seamlessly – so our life-saving radars reach the front lines without delay.

As our Order & Delivery Coordinator (C-UAS), you run the administrative engine behind dispatching our IRIS radar systems. You take charge of order flows in Odoo ERP, align documentation, and organise clean internal handovers from Operations to dispatch readiness. Working alongside Project Management, Customer Success, and Operations, you keep our internal gears turning smoothly. Your sharp attention to detail ensures our teams stay focused and our radars deploy on schedule.

What you'll do

  • Order processing and data integrity: Process incoming sales orders in Odoo ERP across the entire lifecycle. Verify system data, hardware configurations, and commercial terms with high accuracy. Maintain order statuses, serial numbers, and delivery confirmations daily.

  • Compliance and export documentation: Compile and verify complete delivery documentation packages before dispatch. Review export control paperwork, QA certificates, shipping manifests, and packing lists. Ensure every system leaves our premises with watertight paperwork.

  • Logistics coordination and internal handovers: Coordinate handovers with the Warehouse and Logistics crew with complete shipping files. Monitor dispatch statuses once Operations releases each radar system. Keep internal handovers structured, clean, and ready for physical freight execution.

  • Cross-functional status tracking: Supply real-time ERP delivery status updates to Project Management and Customer Success. Share accurate tracking data and handover packages across departments. Monitor administrative workflows proactively to eliminate handover bottlenecks and protect dispatch targets.

What you bring

  • Vocational degree (MBO Level 4 / Associate degree) or equivalent practical experience in administration, supply chain, or logistics

  • 3+ years of experience in administrative support, order processing, or logistics coordination, preferably within a high-tech manufacturing or hardware environment

  • Practical experience working with ERP systems and databases (experience with Odoo is a strong advantage)

  • Experience handling compliance or logistics paperwork, such as shipping manifests, export control documentation, or QA certificates

  • Strong command of English (both written and spoken) and working proficiency in Dutch is considered a strong asset

  • High attention to detail with a methodical approach to data accuracy and documentation

  • Strong organisational and coordination skills to handle multiple handovers efficiently

  • Collaborative, supportive mindset suited for cross-functional internal operations

What we offer

  • Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

  • Comprehensive pension plan;

  • Commuting allowance;

  • 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

  • Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

  • High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role

  • An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Robin Radar is a defence technology leader in detecting, tracking and classifying drones and other small airborne objects. Our radars and software protect military sites, borders and critical infrastructure from drone threats, and also help prevent bird strikes in aviation and reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning?

You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

Funding for customer programmes. Early access to new models and services. Joint go-to-market. But they only pay off when someone runs them properly. That's this role.

You'll own the operational side of our partner programmes. Your goals are clear: help us win partner funding for our customers, achieve new AWS competencies and programme designations, and keep our partner CRMs in excellent shape. The partner managers at AWS, Anthropic and OpenAI will know you by name.

This isn't a back-office admin job. AI partner programmes change quarter to quarter, and we want someone who'll build smarter ways of running them. If you've ever automated a tedious task because you couldn't face doing it by hand a second time, you'll fit right in.

External responsibilities

These responsibilities are partner-facing and customer-facing:

Competencies and programme designations - Driving our AWS competency and programme applications, and tracking tier requirements, certifications and renewals across AWS, Anthropic and OpenAI so that nothing lapses.

Partner funding applications - Preparing, submitting and tracking partner funding applications (for example the AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) and proof-of-concept funding), working with our sales and delivery teams to gather what each one needs.

Funding claims - Managing funding claims through to payment, keeping milestones, evidence and deadlines in order.

Partner relationships - Acting as the main operational contact for our partner teams, building strong working relationships with each company.

Joint campaigns and events - Helping plan and run joint marketing campaigns with our partners, and representing Cloudscaler at partner events across the UK.

Internal responsibilities

These responsibilities cover the systems, reporting and ways of working behind our partner programmes.

Partner CRMs - Owning our partner CRMs, keeping deal registrations, opportunity data and partner portals accurate across HubSpot and AWS Partner Central.

Reporting - Reporting on partner performance, funding pipeline and programme health to the leadership team.

Automation - Finding the repetitive work and automating it, using AI tools such as Claude to build workflows, trackers and agents that give the team time back.

Briefing colleagues - Briefing colleagues when programmes change, and explaining what it means for our customers and bids.

What we're looking for

This is an operational role with plenty of partner contact. We expect candidates to demonstrate the following:

Operational experience - Experience in partner operations, alliance management, programme management or a similar operational role, ideally in tech or professional services.

Attention to detail - A sharp eye for detail. You notice when a date, a figure or a requirement doesn't add up, and you fix it before it costs anyone.

Communication - Clear, confident communication in writing and in person, with colleagues, partners and senior stakeholders.

Organisation - Strong organisation across many moving parts and competing deadlines.

Systems - Comfort with CRM systems (HubSpot ideally) and spreadsheets.

Curiosity about AI - Genuine curiosity about AI. You already use tools like Claude or ChatGPT to work faster, and you want to go further.

Partner programme knowledge - Experience with AWS partner programmes or cloud funding is a real advantage, but not essential. We'll teach you the specifics.

Why this role

We hire people who are curious and like to tinker. The people who thrive in this role will be the ones who see a messy process and can't resist building something better, then can explain it to the rest of the team with real enthusiasm. You'll work directly with three of the companies shaping cloud and AI, and as the partner programmes grow, so will the role, with real room to develop your career here.

Benefits

  • Periodic offer of share options schemes

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • 25 days’ annual leave + 5 additional days for training/exams or volunteering

  • Travel and accommodation expensed where eligible in line with our expenses policy

  • Life Assurance

  • Long Term Disability cover

  • Employee Assist Programme for employee advice and support (including legal and counselling helpline)

  • Health, Mental Health, Wellbeing, Financial and Legal support

  • 24/7 GP access

  • Public holiday opt-out scheme giving you the option to work on public holidays creating the flexibility to enjoy your time off when it suits you

  • Individual training and development plans with online training and exam costs covered

  • Recruitment referral scheme – referral bonus if you introduce us to someone we then hire

  • Customer referral scheme – referral bonus if you introduce us to a new customer

  • Cycle To Work Scheme

title: Partner Solutions Architect - MSP
descriptionHtml:
Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Role Description

At Wiz, we're passionate about technical sales and helping our partners and their customers achieve maximum value. This starts with a team effort, collaborating with all available Wiz resources and teaming with the best partners in the world.  Cloud transformation isn't slowing down, and with the explosion of autonomous AI agents, frontier models, and multi-tenant cloud architectures, the demand for next-generation MSP and MDR services is shifting overnight. We don't react to trends, we set the standard.  As a Partner Solutions Architect (MSP), you won't just be supporting sales deals; you will influence and execute our technical MSP strategy from the ground up. Sitting at the absolute bleeding edge of technology, you will serve as the lead technical strategist empowering top-tier Managed Service Providers to rethink cloud security, package high-margin Wiz-powered offerings, and protect their clients' multi-cloud estates with the power of the Wiz Security Graph and our agentless architecture.

Responsibilities

Preferred qualifications

  • SOC Efficiency & AI-Driven SecOps: Practical experience leveraging AI and automation to streamline multi-tenant SOC operations, accelerate incident triage, reduce alert fatigue, and automate remediation workflows.
  • MDR & CNAPP Runtime Security: Experience with container security, eBPF, Kubernetes admission controllers, and real-time threat detection to power high-efficacy Managed Detection & Response (MDR) offerings.

title: Partnership Manager - Accountant Sector
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.

The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.

The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.

The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.

Here is how your key outcomes will look like:

  1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

  2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

  3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

  4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

  • Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

title: People & Culture
descriptionHtml:
Mit Perspektive als Coach für Selbstorganisation (m/w/d)

Unsere erste gemeinsame Aufgabe: Innerhalb der nächsten 12 Monate 65 neue Kolleg:innen an Bord holen und erfolgreich integrieren.

Dafür suchen wir einen Menschen, der Recruiting, Onboarding und Teamentwicklung zusammen denkt. Du findest die richtigen Kolleg:innen für b’steuern und hilfst ihnen, in einem Umfeld erfolgreich zu werden, in dem Eigenverantwortung den Alltag prägt.

Das Besondere daran: Wir verbinden Steuerberatung mit KI und konsequenter Selbstorganisation. Wir wollen die erste KI-First-Kanzlei Deutschlands aufbauen – mit einem Führungssystem, das auf selbststeuernden Teams basiert.

b’steuern ist keine klassische Kanzlei.

Wir beraten Selbstständige, Freelancer:innen, Interim Manager:innen und Unternehmen bis 100 Mio. Euro Umsatz. Dabei arbeiten wir voll digital, entwickeln eigene Tech- und KI-Lösungen und hinterfragen konsequent, was Steuerberatung unnötig kompliziert macht.

Unser Ziel: So einfach wie möglich für alle Beteiligten – mit der Kraft von Tech und KI.

Genauso konsequent denken wir unsere Zusammenarbeit weiter:

  • KI-First: Wir automatisieren Abläufe und entwickeln eigene Lösungen für unseren Arbeitsalltag.

  • Selbstorganisation: Unsere Teams übernehmen Verantwortung für Entscheidungen, Zusammenarbeit und ihre Entwicklung.

  • Remote-first: Wir arbeiten verteilt und haben ein Office in Berlin-Mitte.

  • Ambitioniertes Wachstum: In den nächsten 12 Monaten wollen wir 65 neue Kolleg:innen gewinnen und integrieren.

  • Unternehmerischer Antrieb: Unsere Gründer sind erfahrene Unternehmer, die gemeinsam mit dem Team die Steuerberatung weiterentwickeln wollen.

Deine Rolle

Du gestaltest, wie Menschen zu b’steuern kommen, bei uns ankommen und sich entwickeln.

Zum Start liegt dein Schwerpunkt auf dem gesamten Hiring- und Onboarding-Zyklus. Gemeinsam mit unseren Teams findest du Menschen, die fachlich zu uns passen und Freude daran haben, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Dabei machst du schon im Bewerbungsprozess greifbar, wie wir arbeiten. Du hilfst neuen Kolleg:innen, ihre Rolle zu verstehen, Beziehungen im Team aufzubauen und sich in unserer Selbstorganisation zurechtzufinden.

Perspektivisch kannst du dich zur Koordinator:in für einzelne Teams entwickeln. In dieser Rolle lernst du Führung aus einem anderen Blickwinkel kennen: Du begleitest Teams dabei, ihre Zusammenarbeit zu reflektieren, Entscheidungen eigenständig zu treffen und gemeinsam wirksamer zu werden.

Unser Ansatz basiert auf dem Framework #AdaptiveOrg unseres Founding Partners Joan.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Hiring von Anfang bis Ende: Du betreust den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess – von der Schärfung der Rollenprofile über die Ansprache und Gespräche bis zur Entscheidung gemeinsam mit den Teams.

  • Die passenden Menschen gewinnen: Du findest Kolleg:innen, die unsere fachlichen Anforderungen erfüllen und in einem Umfeld mit viel Eigenverantwortung arbeiten wollen.

  • Onboarding gestalten: Du entwickelst eine strukturierte Einarbeitung und begleitest neue Kolleg:innen beim fachlichen, sozialen und organisatorischen Ankommen.

  • Die Employee Journey aufbauen: Du gestaltest die Berührungspunkte vom ersten Kontakt über den Einstieg bis zur weiteren Entwicklung bei b’steuern.

  • Tech und KI einsetzen: Du nutzt externe Tools und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Tech-Team eigene Lösungen, die unsere People-Prozesse einfacher und besser machen.

  • Mit den Teams zusammenarbeiten: Du machst sichtbar, wo es im Hiring oder Onboarding hakt, holst Feedback ein und verbesserst die Abläufe.

  • Perspektivisch Teams begleiten: Du wächst in die Koordinatorenrolle hinein und unterstützt einzelne Teams bei ihrer Selbstorganisation und Entwicklung.

Was du mitbringst

  • Erfahrung im People-Bereich: Du hast praktische Erfahrung in Recruiting, People & Culture oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle – idealerweise in einem wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Freude an Recruiting und Umsetzung: Du gehst gerne auf Menschen zu, führst gute Gespräche und hältst Prozesse zuverlässig in Bewegung. Bei 65 neuen Kolleg:innen zählen gute Ideen und konsequente Umsetzung.

  • Gespür für Menschen: Du kannst Fähigkeiten, Erwartungen und Arbeitsweisen einordnen und sprichst offen darüber, ob sie zu einer Rolle und unserem Umfeld passen.

  • Interesse an Selbstorganisation: Du möchtest verstehen, wie Teams Verantwortung gemeinsam tragen und Entscheidungen eigenständig treffen können.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert, setzt Prioritäten und bringst Themen ins Ziel.

  • Technologische Neugier: Du nutzt digitale Tools und KI selbstverständlich und hast Lust, People-Prozesse mit unserem Tech-Team weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe: Du hörst zu, gibst klares Feedback und kannst auch schwierige Themen respektvoll ansprechen.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch. Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

Erfahrung im Coaching oder in der Organisationsentwicklung ist willkommen. Du kannst dich bei uns aber auch Schritt für Schritt in diese Richtung entwickeln.

Was wir bieten

  • Eine konkrete Aufbauaufgabe: 65 neue Kolleg:innen in 12 Monaten – du gestaltest einen entscheidenden Teil unserer nächsten Wachstumsphase.

  • Ein besonderes Arbeitsumfeld: Du erlebst, wie Steuerberatung, KI und selbststeuernde Teams zusammenwirken.

  • Eine Entwicklungsperspektive: Du kannst in die Koordinatorenrolle hineinwachsen und Teams auf Basis von #AdaptiveOrg begleiten.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Gründerteam, Joan, unseren Teams und der Tech-Entwicklung zusammen.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust Prozesse auf, probierst Lösungen aus und entwickelst sie anhand echter Erfahrungen weiter.

  • Remote-first: Du arbeitest flexibel und kannst unser Office in Berlin-Mitte nutzen.

Warum bei uns einsteigen?

Weil du hier mitgestaltest, wie ein stark wachsendes Unternehmen zusammenarbeitet.

Die nächsten 65 Kolleg:innen sollen bei uns Orientierung finden, Verantwortung übernehmen und ihre Stärken einbringen können. Du schaffst dafür gemeinsam mit den Teams die Voraussetzungen.

Wenn du Menschen gewinnen, Entwicklung ermöglichen und Führung aus einer neuen Perspektive kennenlernen willst, sollten wir sprechen.

Bewirb dich

Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil dieser spannenden Reise! Lass uns gemeinsam die Welt der Steuerberatung neu gestalten! 🚀
