title: People Operations Lead (Fixed term Contract)
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we're changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK's leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We're growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we're hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We're on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

About the role

You'll own the people engine room at Flock: the employee lifecycle, payroll input, benefits, the HRIS, the office and our in-person events. Your job is to design how a modern People function should work at a company where repetitive admin is automated out of existence and every process is simple, scalable and AI-native by default. You'll report to our Senior People Partner and work with everyone here, from a new joiner on day one to the CEO, who cares deeply about our culture. Please note this role is a 12-18 month fixed term contract.

What you'll be doing

People Operations

  • Own the full employee lifecycle: contracts, right-to-work, starter and leaver logistics, probations and changes. Shape the first day and first week alongside managers, delivering a strong employee experience across the lifecycle.

  • Be the first point of contact for people queries and audits. Own the People inbox and core HR templates, and drive every query to resolution.

  • Own the HRIS (HiBob) and people data: records, workflows, surveys and data integrity. Deliver monthly People reporting and metrics that spot and close gaps early.

  • Own payroll input end to end: collate, calculate and submit each month, including bonuses and comp changes. Manage the provider and partner with Finance on reporting and year-end.

  • Own benefits end to end as the main contact for providers, systems, data and employee advice, keeping policies and materials current.

  • Cut manual effort across the lifecycle by building AI-native workflows, so every routine people process is automated by default, then coach the business to use them. Own continuous improvement across People Ops.

  • Partner with IT on joiner and leaver access automation, and on cost and data audits.

Office Management & Socials

  • Run the office environment and vendor relationships, including routine upkeep like weekly snack orders and post. Cover health and safety as a trained First Aider and Fire Marshal, and provision hardware fast.

  • Own the company social calendar and rituals, from bi-weekly Flock o'Clock (working closely with the CEO) to quarterly Town Halls and larger events, keeping them engaging and on budget.

What you'll need

  • Hands-on People or HR Operations experience, ideally in a fast-moving scale-up, with real ownership of end-to-end processes. CIPD or equivalent experience required.

  • Hands-on payroll input and benefits administration. HiBob experience is a plus.

  • Strong HRIS skills across workflows, automations and integrations, plus confident data and spreadsheet ability.

  • Real evidence of building with AI: workflows or tools you've shipped and use, not ones you've only read about.

title: PIC Layout Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

We are looking for a Layout Engineer to join our design team and support the development of layouts for photonic integrated circuits. You will maintain our layout infrastructure, help translate new designs into fabrication-ready layouts, and contribute to the implementation of new design rules and verification flows.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Maintain and further develop our layout libraries and workflows in Synopsys

  • Support designers in generating layouts for new photonic devices and circuits

  • Run design rule checks (DRC) and layout-versus-schematic checks (LVS)

  • Investigate and resolve DRC violations, off-grid errors, and other layout issues

  • Implement new design rules

  • Assemble layouts

  • Support the mask flow from device layout through to mask data preparation

Your Qualifications

  • Degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Photonics, or a related technical field

  • Strong Python programming skills

  • Understanding of integrated-circuit design; knowledge of photonic integrated circuits is preferred

  • Experience with photonic layout software, ideally Synopsys OptoCompiler

  • Experience with physical verification tools, ideally Synopsys IC Validator or a comparable platform

  • Experience using KLayout

  • Familiarity with DRC, LVS and mask-data preparation

     

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

title: Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents. We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day. Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing. Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things. Want to join our pack? Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.

A day in the life

As a Platform Engineer, you will initially join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on.

This role has a strong security focus, and it will become more security focused over time. Much of the work is compliance and assurance: building and running the tooling that checks our cloud estate against our security standards, writing the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one, gathering the evidence we need for ISO 27001 and our other obligations, and supporting the audits that depend on it. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.

Over time this role moves across to work directly with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security function at ManyPets. You will help shape what that function does and how it works, rather than inheriting something already built.

Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.

We embrace modern development practices:

· All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.

· We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day.

· We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start.

As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.

Your responsibilities

ü Build and maintain secure platform foundations

o Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on.

o Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable.

o Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it.

o Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.

o Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads.

Make our security posture measurable

o Automate the gathering of evidence for ISO 27001 and our other compliance obligations, so that an audit means pulling a report rather than running a manual exercise.

o Write the scripts and small services that turn a manual security check into a scheduled, repeatable one.

o Triage findings from our scanning and posture tooling such as Aikido and Ascidian, work out which ones actually matter, and either fix them or get them in front of the team that can.

o Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.

Strengthen access and identity controls

o Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.

o Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.

o Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.

Extend our platform standards beyond AWS

o Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.

o Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.

Team collaboration

o Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.

o Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously.

o Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews.

o Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.

Self development

o Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan.

o Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.

o Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship.

Your skills and experience

We are looking for someone with:

· Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).

· Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code.

· Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines.

· A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals.

· Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.

· Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously.

You will also need at least one current associate-level cloud certification:

· AWS: Solutions Architect Associate, Developer Associate or SysOps Administrator Associate. We would also be interested in the AWS Certified Security Speciality.

· Google Cloud: Associate Cloud Engineer.

· Microsoft Azure: Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500).

Entry-level certifications such as AWS Cloud Practitioner, Google Cloud Digital Leader and Azure Fundamentals do not meet this on their own. Please include the certification name and your credential ID or badge link with your application.

We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other:

· A security specialism, where you can tell us about security or compliance tooling you have built and what it caught.

· Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud.

The interview process

This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom.

· Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.

· Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.

· Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.

· Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.

About the team

The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about.

Our tech stack

We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn. You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas.

Our "north star" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics. To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean. We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding.

We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices. We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud.

Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | MongoDB | Aikido | Ascidian | Cloudflare

Salary range:£55,000—£65,000 GBP

Ways of working

On a typical day you'll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset. You'll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we'd expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day. We'd ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively. We'll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support.

Inclusion at ManyPets

title: Pricing Strategy Director
descriptionHtml:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition.

About the Role-

As a Pricing Strategy Director, you will own and lead our pricing strategy across several core products and offerings, set the direction for how monday monetizes products, drives sustainable revenue growth, and delivers value to 250K+ customers worldwide. This is a senior role that sits at the intersection of strategy, commercial thinking, and execution, and directly influences the company’s growth decisions.

 

You will be a leading voice on pricing and monetization - navigating the complexity of a multi-product platform, a shift to AI-driven value, and a competitive market that’s evolving fast. You’ll shape thinking at the executive level while ensuring it translates into strategies the organization can execute at scale.

 

What You’ll Own-

  • Define and lead long-term pricing & packaging strategy across products, segments, and geographies - balancing growth, competitive positioning, and customer value

  • Be a leading voice on monday’s monetization approach in the AI era: develop new frameworks that reflect AI-driven value and set standards for how we capture this value

  • Own executive-level narrative on pricing across products and offerings - presenting recommendations, tradeoffs, and alternatives to executive stakeholders, with clarity and conviction

  • Drive high-stakes pricing decisions end-to-end: from market research and competitive intelligence through business case development, modeling, and full-scale implementation

  • Set governance frameworks for pricing across the sales org - policies, approval structures, discount thresholds, and implementation processes that scale

  • Serve as the senior cross-functional partner to Product, Sales, Finance, and Billing - aligning the organization around a coherent strategy and driving accountability for outcomes

  • Continuously evaluate pricing performance, competitive dynamics, and customer behavior to identify opportunities and course-correct proactively

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in Pricing Strategy, Growth & Monetization, or Strategic / Management Consulting, with a clear track record of increasing scope and seniority

  • Deep expertise in B2B SaaS pricing and monetization - including consumption-based, seat-based, and hybrid models

  • Proven ability to operate at a senior level: shaping strategy, influencing decisions, and driving alignment across senior stakeholders

  • Exceptional analytical horsepower combined with the business judgment to know what matters and the communication skills to make it land

  • A builder’s mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, capable of creating structure where none exists, and relentlessly focused on translating strategy into execution

  • Demonstrated ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives from concept through to measurable business outcomes

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience with pricing AI products or navigating a major business model transition (e.g., consumption-based pricing, outcome-based pricing, etc.)

  • Background in top-tier strategy consulting with a transition into an in-house strategic leadership role

  • Experience with billing, monetization infrastructure, and/or revenue systems at scale

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field

  

What monday.com can offer you:

  • Join a customer-obsessed team where transparency and ownership are how we actually operate - not just things we put on a wall

  • Work on a multi-product suite powered by advanced AI, where what you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide

  • Competitive salary, benefits, bonus potential, and equity eligibility for many roles — we believe people should share in our success

  • Grow fast through a dedicated L&D team, AI workshops, bootcamps, and internal hackathons - the industry moves quick and so do we

  • A collaborative, global culture backed by Employee Resource Groups and workplace teams across New York, Tel Aviv, London, Munich, Warsaw, Tokyo, Sydney, and more

title: Principal Consultant – Engagement Lead QA & Advisory (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über QESTIT

QESTIT ist ein auf Qualitätssicherung spezialisiertes Beratungsunternehmen mit Fokus auf Testmanagement und Organisationsberatung entlang des gesamten Software Development Lifecycle, SAP und Non-SAP, mit und ohne KI. Als Teil der international aufgestellten QESTIT Group sind wir in Deutschland, Österreich, der Schweiz, Schweden, Frankreich und Ägypten tätig. In Deutschland arbeiten wir aus Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Köln, Görlitz und München.

Deine Rolle

Wir entwickeln uns weiter: vom operativen Testmanagement hin zur Organisations- und Prozessberatung rund um die Qualitätssicherung im gesamten SDLC. Testing bleibt dabei unser Kern. Unsere Beraterinnen und Berater arbeiten meist allein oder in kleinen Teams direkt beim Kunden. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Als Engagement Lead verantwortest du die Ergebnisse und die Kundenzufriedenheit ausgewählter Accounts im DACH-Raum. Du setzt neue Kundensituationen methodisch auf, steuerst laufende Vorhaben als Projektleitung, auch wenn der Kunde diese Rolle nicht separat beauftragt, und baust die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden gezielt aus. Deine Rolle ist an Accounts und Projekten ausgerichtet, nicht an einer Region.

Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung und bist Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung der QESTIT GmbH. Du führst fachlich, die disziplinarische Führung liegt bei unseren Delivery-Center-Leitungen, mit denen du eng und auf Augenhöhe zusammenarbeitest. Perspektivisch kann die Rolle um disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung wachsen.

Deine Aufgaben

Projekte und Accounts steuern

  • Du übernimmst für deine Bestandskunden die Projektleitung und steuerst Scope, Budget, Timeline und Risiken im Rahmen der Projektverträge

  • Du setzt neue Kundensituationen methodisch auf: Zielbild, Vorgehen (klassisch, agil oder hybrid) und Team-Setup

  • Du legst das methodische Vorgehen in deinen Projekten fest und gibst den Teams die Richtung bei der Erarbeitung der Ergebnisse gemeinsam mit dem Kunden vor

  • Du sicherst die Qualität zentraler Liefergegenstände, bevor sie an den Kunden gehen, und gibst sie frei

Team anleiten und Standards setzen

  • Du leitest unsere Beraterinnen und Berater fachlich und methodisch an und coachst sie in ihren Einsätzen

  • Du meldest Staffing-Bedarfe für deine Accounts an und entscheidest bei der Besetzung deiner Projekte maßgeblich mit

  • Du entwickelst Standards, Playbooks und Templates und sorgst für einheitliche Qualitätsstandards über deine Projekte hinweg

Kunden entwickeln und transparent berichten

  • Du erkennst Wachstumspotenzial in deinen Accounts und hebst es gemeinsam mit unserem Sales-Team

  • Du gestaltest Angebote für deine Accounts aktiv mit

  • Du berichtest der Geschäftsführung regelmäßig über den Status deiner Accounts

  • Du sprichst Risiken früh und offen an und eskalierst, wenn nötig, gegenüber der Geschäftsführung und gegenüber dem Kunden

Dein Profil

Fachlich

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in Qualitätssicherung, Testmanagement und Beratung mit, idealerweise in einem Beratungsunternehmen

  • Du hast QA-Tiefe über den gesamten SDLC, von der Schnittstelle zum Requirements Engineering bis zur Testprozessreife

  • Du hast Erfahrung im SAP-Testmanagement (SAP Activate, Solution Manager bzw. Focused Build) und ebenso belastbare Erfahrung in Non-SAP-Projekten

  • Du setzt KI in der Qualitätssicherung gezielt ein, etwa bei der Testdatengenerierung oder im autonomen Testen

Methodik und Projektmanagement

  • Du bist in klassischen und agilen Vorgehensmodellen (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) gleichermaßen sicher und wählst situativ, was zur Reife des Kunden passt, in der Praxis meist hybrid

  • Du beherrschst das Handwerk der Projektsteuerung: Scope, Risiken, Budget und Stakeholder

  • Du hast Erfahrung in Organisations- und Prozessberatung und im Change Management, von der Ist-Aufnahme bis zu Zielbild und Roadmap

Persönlich

  • Du führst ohne disziplinarische Linie: Du coachst, moderierst Konflikte und gibst Struktur

  • Du trittst souverän auf Entscheiderebene auf und hast ein unternehmerisches Gespür für Potenziale im laufenden Projekt

  • Du kommunizierst klar und ehrlich, auch wenn die Nachricht unbequem ist

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und sehr gut Englisch

title: Principal Data Engineer, Data Warehouse (TPL)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship.

About the Role 

As Principal Data Engineer, you will own the intraday and end-of-day data serving layer between the CTRM platform and its downstream consumers. You will shape the architecture, standards and engineering practices that enable teams across the business to access trusted, timely and well-defined data. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with the opportunity to influence how the business builds and uses its data platform. 

This will be a full-time role, based in our London office, owning the following responsibilities: 

  • Own the intraday and EOD data serving layer between the CTRM platform and its consumers, including Market Risk, Credit Risk, Treasury, Finance, Reporting and desk tools. 
  • Design and maintain robust data schemas and serving contracts, including SQL, APIs and Kafka-based distribution. 
  • Define data versioning and reproducibility patterns, including as-of timestamps and run IDs, snapshots and incremental updates, with appropriate treatment of position and P&L data. 
  • Own the CTRM-to-warehouse data pipeline, ensuring reliable ingestion, transformation, validation and delivery to downstream consumers. 
  • Lead the implementation and production use of the data warehouse serving layer, closing out the current proof of concept and turning it into a production-ready platform. 
  • Set engineering standards for data modelling, schema evolution, data quality, observability, testing and operational support. 
  • Build and operate solutions using relevant platform technologies, including ClickHouse, S3, Kafka and schema registry tooling. 
  • Work closely with stakeholder teams to understand their needs, propose solutions, explain trade-offs and establish clear, dependable data contracts. 
  • Provide technical leadership to the data engineering team, raising the quality of design and implementation while encouraging collaboration, constructive challenge and continuous improvement. 
  • Help shape the longer-term data architecture and engineering approach as the business and its data requirements evolve.

About You 

You will be a technically strong and proactive data engineering leader who can turn complex business requirements into robust, scalable data products. You are comfortable supporting multiple teams, bringing forward clear recommendations and new ideas, and engaging constructively when your designs are challenged. You want to help shape the future data architecture of the business, not simply deliver against a predefined specification. 

As a result, we believe the following experiences and skills are essential for this role: 

  • Demonstrable experience designing and building data warehouses; this is a non-negotiable requirement. 
  • Hands-on production experience with ClickHouse; this is a non-negotiable requirement. 
  • Experience delivering a columnar OLAP data platform in production, with a strong understanding of analytical query performance and data modelling. 
  • Practical experience with Kafka and event-driven or streaming data architectures. 
  • Strong Python engineering skills and sufficient C# literacy to work effectively with systems and codebases that use C#. 
  • Experience modelling versioned position and P&L data, including point-in-time or as-of views and reproducible runs. 
  • Experience working in a trading or other time-sensitive, data-intensive business environment. 
  • Previous technical leadership, including setting standards and guiding engineering decisions. 
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to put forward solutions, bring ideas into discussions and engage positively with challenge. 
  • A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to balance the needs of multiple downstream teams while maintaining coherent platform standards. 

The following experience is not required, but highly desirable for this role: 

  • Experience in commodities trading or energy markets. 
  • Exposure to a Commodity Trading and Risk Management (CTRM) system, such as Orchestrade or Endur. 
  • Familiarity with dbt and/or data quality frameworks. 

What we offer 

  • Competitive compensation and participation in Engelhart’s discretionary bonus plan.  
  • 25 days of annual holiday entitlement, excluding UK public holidays. 
  • Robust benefits package such as medical, dental, life insurance, generous pension contribution, and supplemental benefits partially subsidised by the Company.   
  • Eligibility to receive external and internal training in accordance with our Training & Development Policy. 

We believe in inclusivity and are therefore dedicated to ensuring all employees – across gender identity, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, life experience, background and more – feel welcome and included in the company. We promote diversity because we believe it is essential to our ability to think holistically.

title: Principal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity? 

Principal Engineers at Fin have the opportunity to lead the definition and execution of key strategic initiatives.You will work autonomously and be accountable for strategic execution in part of the engineering organization. You will build both back-end and front-end systems, and work closely with designers, product managers, researchers, and data analysts. You will coach and mentor other engineers and partner closely with the Group Engineering Managers on technical strategy and leadership.

Learn more about our engineering culture at intercom.engineering

What will I be doing? 

As an experienced engineer you will:

  • Have a mastery of domain knowledge and work as a leader within the R&D org to drive key strategic projects.
  • Provide assessments of project progress, risks and challenges to engineering leadership to help guide resource allocation and prioritisation.
  • Contribute to our technical architecture as we grow. We scale to service requests from all our customers’ customers. We’re growing and so are they.
  • Care about agility as much you care for scalability and availability. Continuous deployment keeps us focused on incremental releases. Even our biggest technical achievements roll out piece by piece, feature flagged out of sight.
  • Contribute to all phases of software development including ideation, prototyping, design and implementation. This role has a mix of both hands-on development as well as lead/architecture work.
  • Build using the best tools in the industry. We invest heavily in AI-powered developer tools that remove friction and help you focus on solving meaningful problems.
  • Play an active role in hiring, mentoring and career development of other engineers
  • Raise the bar for technical standards, performance, reliability, and operational excellence

What skills do I need? 

  • Ideally, you’ve built an exciting SaaS product in your previous roles and loved the satisfaction that comes with knowing that people around the world are using something you’ve created
  • Significant, demonstrated impact that your work has had on the product and/or the teams
  • Deep knowledge of a high-level programming language (for example, Ruby, Python, Perl etc.) but it doesn’t need to be a language that we use here! Great people are effective and learn what we use quickly (or introduce us to better ways of working)
  • You will have experience with Distributed systems
  • 2+ years of experience as the primary technical leader for a team
  • Experience collaborating directly with technical leaders, product teams and designers, and a proven track record of delivering value to customers or users. Engineers at Fin are pragmatists who work closely with others on cross-disciplinary teams and have a strong sense of product strategy.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. 

Policies 

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.  

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Principal Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
What You'll Do

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will help set the technical direction for a core part of Radiant's AI cloud, joining one of four teams: Infra & Cluster, Observability, MLOps Training, or MLOps Inference. We'll match you to the team that fits your experience.

You'll lead the design and delivery of the distributed systems that run GPU infrastructure and AI workloads at scale, partnering closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, networking, and storage teams, and with customers running the most demanding workloads.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, delivered through architecture, code, and the standards other teams build on.

The teams

  • Infra & Cluster: provisioning, lifecycle, and cluster management behind our Bare Metal and Virtual Machine products

  • Observability: FlightDeck, our platform for observing and operating AI infrastructure, and the telemetry behind it

  • MLOps Training: the platform customers use to train models on our GPU clusters, including Managed Kubernetes and Managed Slurm

  • MLOps Inference: the platform customers use to serve models in production

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the technical vision and architecture for your team's area, and lead its design and implementation.

  • Design and build distributed systems that run reliably on GPU infrastructure at scale.

  • Translate product and customer requirements into robust architectures, APIs, and technical designs, working closely with Product.

  • Own the performance, reliability, and cost of your team's systems as the platform grows.

  • Partner with SRE, Infra Ops, and customers on operations, incident response, and the most demanding workloads.

  • Raise the engineering bar across the organisation through mentoring, design and code review, and technical standards.

 

Your Profile

  • Extensive experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, infrastructure software, or ML platforms.

  • A track record of technical leadership at staff or principal level, including setting direction across multiple teams and delivering complex, high-stakes systems.

  • Strong hands-on engineering skills in Go, Python, or similar.

  • Deep technical expertise in at least one of:

  • Infra & Cluster: provisioning (PXE, Redfish, IPMI, BMCs, firmware), cluster management, inventory, and lifecycle automation

  • Observability: metrics, logs, traces, OpenTelemetry, streaming pipelines, and high-cardinality time-series data

  • MLOps Training: Kubernetes and Slurm orchestration, PyTorch distributed, NCCL, checkpointing, and fault tolerance

  • MLOps Inference: model serving, batching, autoscaling, GPU utilisation, quantisation, and latency tuning

  • Strong foundations in Kubernetes, containers, Linux, high-performance networking, and GPU clusters.

  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as Redfish, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, ClickHouse, Kafka, Slurm, vLLM, NVIDIA Triton, or similar.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear design documents and explaining complex trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Comfortable working directly with customers on highly technical problems.

 

What You Bring

  • Domain expertise: Bring deep expertise in your team's area, and know where it breaks at scale.

  • Engineering excellence: Write and review code that sets the standard for correctness, performance, and maintainability.

  • Architectural judgement: Make sound long-term decisions on systems that are hard to change once built.

  • Technical leadership: Influence direction across teams without relying on authority, and grow the engineers around you.

  • Systems thinking: Understand how your area interacts with compute, networking, storage, and the rest of the cloud platform.

  • Ownership: Drive capabilities from design through production, operation, and continuous improvement.

 

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

 

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (two Principal Engineers) → Whiteboard Session → Final.

 

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

innovation while maintaining high standards of integrity, accountability and client trust.

Putting People First.

title: Product Design
descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

We’re looking for our first product designer to level-up design throughout the company.

Axle is building cutting-edge energy products across the sector - from simple offerings for mass-market consumers, through to advanced tooling for early adopters and enthusiasts. We’re innovating to solve new and complex problems where there’s no established answers and where the customer experience is key.

We have a highly autonomous, flat structure, delivering our products in small interdisciplinary teams of engineers and PMs. We want to add a design voice as a pillar to this: understanding our users, leading our strategic direction, and ensuring the customer is always represented.

You’ll operate across the business to raise the quality of all our design output - through both direct delivery, as well as enablement and coaching of others.

Alongside this, we’re looking for ownership and support on how Axle represents itself externally - to our prospects, clients, investors and potential employees.

What you will be doing:

  • Understanding user problems and designing great experiences to solve them

  • Building the systems that allow for strategic and scalable solutions - in Claude and code - to allow everybody to ship beautiful software, faster

  • Deepening our culture of user research and getting into the weeds of how people experience Axle's products, both B2C and B2B2C

  • Leading on our visual identity and finding new ways to tell Axle's story, through web, animation, and video

  • Working with global clients to help them to improve their user experiences

This could be a good fit if:

  • You're energised by ambiguity and take a pragmatic, outcome-first approach

  • You’re excited about bringing sophisticated technology to a broader audience and are happy to get into the technical details to do this

  • You’re deeply curious about the world and how people experience it

  • You have a strong aesthetic sense and know what good looks like.

What's in it for you:

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Deep dive on a project of your choice (in-person)

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

We design powerful, data-rich, and intuitive interfaces that help customers make confident business decisions, while defining the next generation of AI-powered experiences across the Anaplan platform. Our work spans core modeling capabilities, intelligent applications, agentic AI experiences, and user-facing planning workflows—all underpinned by a world-class design system.

In this role, you will own feature-level product design across the Anaplan platform. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and researchers to solve complex design challenges impacting thousands of enterprise users worldwide. From evolving core planning experiences to contributing to cutting-edge AI capabilities, you'll help build enterprise products that are scalable, accessible, and user-centered from concept through delivery.

What You’ll Do

  • End-to-End Design: Design and deliver user-centered solutions for a defined product area, balancing user needs, technical constraints, business goals, and emerging AI capabilities where appropriate.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, and fellow designers throughout the entire product development lifecycle.

  • Discovery & Research: Participate in discovery activities including customer interviews, workshops, journey mapping, usability testing, and the exploration of AI-driven user experiences.

  • Complex Workflow Simplification: Design intuitive experiences across both traditional enterprise workflows and AI-powered interactions, helping users accomplish complex tasks with confidence.

  • Prototyping & Artifacts: Produce high-quality user flows, wireframes, interaction patterns, and interactive prototypes using Figma.

  • Design System Stewardship: Work with and contribute to the Anaplan Design System to ensure consistent, accessible, and cohesive product experiences.

  • Data-Informed Iteration: Leverage qualitative and quantitative data, customer feedback, and experimentation to validate design decisions and continuously improve experiences.

  • Champion Best Practices: Advocate for accessibility (WCAG), usability, and the thoughtful, responsible adoption of AI across the product ecosystem.

What We’re Looking For

  • Professional experience in product design.

  • Strong foundation in user-centered design principles and design thinking methodologies.

  • Proven experience designing for data-rich, workflow-heavy interfaces and complex systems.

  • High proficiency in Figma and experience working within comprehensive design systems.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions, trade-offs, and rationale clearly to cross-functional partners.

  • A systems-thinking mindset with a passion for high craft, continuous iteration, and constructive feedback.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing for enterprise platforms, including admin, builder, data modeling, or AI-assisted workflows.

  • Exposure to designing AI-powered experiences (e.g., conversational interfaces, intelligent assistants, contextual recommendations, or generative AI features).

  • Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and how design decisions translate into technical implementation.

  • Familiarity with web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1+) and inclusive design practices.

  • Experience in enterprise SaaS, financial systems, business planning software, or complex B2B solutions.

  • Experience operating within Agile, cross-functional product teams.

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to shape the future of enterprise software at a pivotal moment for Anaplan. You’ll join a collaborative team of talented designers and researchers working on products trusted by many of the world's leading organizations.

You’ll have the opportunity to solve complex design challenges, influence product direction, and grow your career in a culture that values curiosity, collaboration, design excellence, and continuous learning. Whether you're refining core workflows or exploring the frontiers of AI-driven planning, your work will make a measurable impact on thousands of businesses across the globe.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.   

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for an ambitious Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your Mission

Understand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

Measure and Improve

Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes.

Build for Scale

Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

  • Python

  • FastAPI

  • React

  • TypeScript

  • Supabase

  • PostgreSQL

  • AWS

  • Serverless architecture

  • OpenAI APIs

  • Twilio

  • Stripe

  • Docker

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud architecture

  • A product mindset and curiosity about why users need a feature

  • Good judgment around usability, scope, and technical trade-offs

  • The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a practical, working solution

  • Confidence working directly with customers, designers, and founders

  • The ability to work independently and own outcomes

  • Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency

  • A bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

Bonus points for experience with:

  • Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations

  • AI agents and workflow automation

  • Product analytics and experimentation

  • Event-driven architectures

  • Supabase

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months:

  • You've shipped features that property managers actively use

  • Core short-term rental workflows are automated through products you've built

  • Customers spend less time on manual administration and repetitive tasks

  • Complex workflows become easier to understand and complete

  • Integrations move reservations, availability, payments, and operational data reliably

  • AI-powered features become part of customers’ everyday operations

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Own the Product Outcome

Help decide what to build, how it should work, and how to measure its success. Take responsibility for features from the first conversation through ongoing improvement.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across product, software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

title: Product Manager, Agentic Safety
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Mistral AI provides full-stack AI solutions, from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute, used by developers, enterprises, and public institutions worldwide. We are a dynamic, creative, low-ego team distributed across Europe, North America, Asia, and the Middle East, passionate about AI's potential to transform society.

As our models and products reach millions of people and power increasingly critical workloads across enterprises and public institutions, safety is becoming an essential product challenge.

We are looking for our first Product Manager, Agentic Safety to own this space end-to-end, translating safety research and policy into concrete, user-facing product behaviors across our API platform and product surfaces.

You will define which guardrails should be enabled by default, what controls customers should have, and how we measure and communicate residual risk. Working at the intersection of Product, Research, Engineering, Policy, Legal, and Security, you will shape how safety is built into our products, balancing protection, usability, and customer needs.

This is a unique opportunity to build a new product function from the ground up and directly influence how frontier AI is deployed responsibly at scale.

What You Will Do

Safety Product Strategy

  • Own the Safety roadmap across Mistral's API platform and products, including Vibe and Studio, from strategy through to product behavior and delivery.

  • Define the product vision and priorities for safety features, guardrails, controls, and safeguards.

  • Translate safety research and policy requirements into practical product capabilities that customers can understand, configure, and trust.

  • Determine which safety mechanisms should be enabled by default and where customers should have flexibility and control.

Safety Measurement and Evaluation

  • Define how safety is measured across our products, including evaluations, residual risk, precision and coverage trade-offs, and emerging harm trends.

  • Establish clear metrics and take accountability for tracking and improving safety performance.

  • Work closely with Research and Engineering teams to translate evaluation results into actionable product improvements.

  • Ensure safety considerations are embedded in feature launches and deployment decisions through a safety-by-design approach.

Incident Management and Continuous Improvement

  • Lead Safety incident response and post-incident reviews.

  • Turn safety events, emerging risks, and customer feedback into concrete product improvements.

  • Establish processes to identify, assess, and mitigate safety risks across our products.

  • Continuously assess the effectiveness of existing safeguards and identify opportunities to strengthen them.

Cross-Functional Leadership and External Representation

  • Partner closely with Policy, Legal, Research, Engineering, Security, and Operations to drive safety initiatives across the organization.

  • Align and mobilize cross-functional teams to deliver safety improvements without compromising product velocity or customer trust.

  • Represent Mistral on Safety product topics in discussions with customers and regulators.

  • Communicate complex safety decisions, trade-offs, and residual risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What We're Looking For

  • Several years of experience in Product Management, with meaningful exposure to Safety, platform integrity, abuse prevention, or AI safety.

  • Strong technical understanding of LLM guardrails, safety evaluations, and red-teaming, with the ability to discuss thresholds, methodologies, and trade-offs with researchers and engineers.

  • Strong product judgment when navigating ambiguous trade-offs between safety and freedom of expression, as well as safety and product utility.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex decisions and articulate the rationale behind product choices.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, align stakeholders, and inspire teams without direct authority.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous environments and building from zero, with the ability to define a new function rather than simply maintain an existing product line.

  • Experience working at an AI lab or frontier-model company is a plus.

  • Exposure to AI regulation and compliance frameworks, particularly the EU AI Act, is a plus.

  • An engineering or research background is a plus.

  • You don't necessarily check every box above but are genuinely driven by the mission of making frontier AI safe and trustworthy for the people and organizations who rely on it.

 

What We Offer

Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.

The Role

As Product Manager - you will coordinate the engine that produces everything CoMind puts in front of the outside world — marketing collateral, conference materials, brand content, IFUs, and the claims we make about our products. You will take requests for content from across the business and turn them into finished, correctly reviewed output, keeping a clear, current record of what's in flight, what's overdue, and who it's waiting on. This is a hands-on role focused on the administration and operations of content.

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day.

Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate marketing collateral production: manage requests, keep templates and source files organised, control versioning, and route sign-off through Product, Commercial, and Regulatory before anything goes out.

  • Own conference materials: booth collateral, printed and digital assets, deadlines, and vendor coordination for events.

  • Generate brand content within established guidelines: copy adaptation, slide assets, and social/web content, escalating anything that needs new creative direction.

  • Administer IFUs (Instructions for Use): keep documents current across product lines, track versions against released product configurations, and route changes through regulatory review.

  • Maintain the claims matrix: keep it up to date, chase evidence and sign-off from Regulatory and Clinical, and flag claims that lack current support.

  • Run the day-to-day operating rhythm for all of the above: a single, current tracker of status, owners, and deadlines across every content workstream.

title: Product Marketing Manager (F/H)
descriptionHtml:
At Younited, we believe credit and banking should feel as simple, fast and transparent as everything else in your digital life.

So we build financial services that way. We combine technology, data and automation to rethink the way people borrow, pay, save and manage their money.

Today, more than 1.5 million customers trust us, and nearly 500 employees contribute to our growth across 4 European countries.

What we build

    • Younited Credit – instant consumer credit, directly accessible to customers.
    • Younited Pay – instalment payment and financing solutions embedded into our partners' customer journeys.
    • Younited Cashback – cashback and personalised offers, enhanced by open banking data.
    • Younited Bank – our everyday banking offering, currently available through helios by Younited and being expanded.
Our ambition is to build a financial partner people genuinely trust, combining simplicity, transparency and responsible finance. As a certified B Corp, we integrate social and environmental considerations into the way we build our business.

The 5 values we work by

    • Make it simple - in the product, in the customer experience and in how we organise. Be transparent.
    • Act as an entrepreneur - take ownership, play as a team, dare to try and accept failure.
    • Innovate or die - challenge the status quo, however impossible it may seem.
    • Faster is better - speed over perfection, alignment over debate.
    • No limit - shoot for the moon, stay humble.
We give passionate problem-solvers the space to do their best work in diverse and inclusive teams across Europe, because that is how we build better financial products for our customers and partners.

Context 📄

How do you turn complex credit and payment products into propositions that customers understand, partners value and teams can sell?

As Product Marketing Manager at Younited, you will shape the insights, narratives and tools that help our products stand out and grow. You will work across Younited’s product portfolio, with Younited Pay as your initial priority given its strategic importance and the competitiveness of its market.

Within Marketing Central, you will join the Customer Engagement team and work with Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams. Depending on business priorities, your scope may evolve across different Younited products, audiences and customer journeys.

Your mission will be to understand the audiences we want to reach, clarify what makes our products valuable and turn market, customer and field feedback into concrete recommendations for Sales, Partnerships, Product and Marketing. You will connect market reality, commercial priorities and product decisions by turning research, customer insights and field feedback into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations. You will also work closely with the PRM/CRM teams to connect these insights with customer journeys, engagement and retention initiatives.

Key responsibilities 🚀

1) Build market and customer understanding

  • Conduct market research, competitive analysis and customer data analysis to identify target audiences, understand their needs, uncover opportunities and bring the voice of the customer into business and product decisions.

  • Work across several products, audiences and business priorities, with Younited Pay as the initial priority.

  • Work with the PRM/CRM and Customer Engagement teams on segmentation, use cases and customer journeys across acquisition, activation, repeat usage and retention, including merchant onboarding for Younited Pay and other priority journeys across the Younited portfolio.

2) Define positioning and support commercial teams

  • Clarify the benefits, differentiators and key messages of Younited products, making complex topics compelling and easy to understand for customers, merchants, partners and internal teams.

  • Turn market and customer insights into sales pitches, presentations, enablement materials, partner tools and practical recommendations that help Sales and Partnerships teams explain and sell our products.

  • Contribute to strategic RFPs by understanding requirements and shaping the response narrative, value proposition, differentiators, proof points and presentation materials.

3) Partner with Product teams and support product evolutions

  • Bring market feedback and customer insights into product discussions and roadmaps, and influence product decisions based on market and customer feedback.

  • Support product launches and evolutions with the necessary materials, including demos, training materials, operational guides, FAQs and sales enablement documents.

  • Work across Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams to turn insights into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations.

About you 👇

  • You have at least 5 years of experience in B2B Product Marketing, Product Marketing or a related role.

  • You know how to conduct market research, analyse competition and turn customer and market insights into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • You are comfortable working across several products, audiences and business priorities.

  • You understand Sales and Partnerships teams’ challenges and know how to create useful, practical materials that support commercial teams.

  • You are comfortable contributing to strategic RFPs and tailoring a value proposition to different business and partner contexts.

  • You are comfortable working with Product teams and influencing product decisions based on market and customer feedback.

  • Experience in payments, banking, credit, fintech, e-commerce or another complex or regulated industry is a plus.

  • You know how to make complex topics simple and compelling, both in writing and verbally.

  • You are fluent in French and English.

  • You are autonomous, structured, proactive and able to manage several projects in parallel.

  • You know how to adapt your approach to different audiences and switch between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

  • You know how to influence stakeholders without relying on hierarchical authority and deliver concrete results.

Hiring process 📅

  • First video interview with Arthur, Lead Talent Acquisition Manager, to discuss the role, your motivations and Younited.

  • Second interview with Lise, Head of Customer Engagement, to explore the expectations of the role in greater depth.

  • Business case, followed by a debrief and conversations with members of the team.

  • Final interview with Ricardo, Growth & Business Operations Director, to validate overall alignment with the role and potential development opportunities.


🎁 Other benefits from joining Younited ?

Wie ben jij?

Je weet hoe je complexe productontwikkeling in een softwareomgeving tot een goed einde brengt. Je houdt overzicht als er veel tegelijk gebeurt, je let op details zonder het grote plaatje te verliezen, en je krijgt mensen
