title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support (Detachering / ZZP)
descriptionHtml:
Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren.

Wie ben jij

Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.


Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.


Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.


Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.


Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

• Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
• Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
• Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;
• Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren;
• Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn;
• Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving;
• Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is;
• Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré.

Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening.

Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is?

We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.


• ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support;
• prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
• vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
• richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;
• sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid;
• onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen;
• afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams;
• samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren;
• signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren;
• richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur;
• kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;
• organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.

Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan.

Wat bieden wij

Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie.

Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf.

Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé.


IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.
Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner.
Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.

title: Product & Regulatory Counsel
descriptionHtml:
Tired of meeting the product at the terms and conditions stage?

Most product lawyers see the flow once it's built and the launch date is set. Here, you're on the whiteboard at ideation, so compliant by design is the plan, not the clean-up.

And the stakes are real. Taptap Send moves billions of dollars every month across 100 countries, and is now building wallets, cards and broader financial products for diaspora communities.

The job

You'll advise on new licensing and products from first idea to go-live, and own regulator engagement across our markets.

  • Shape products before they're built: review designs, UX, flows and terms against regulatory and customer-outcome rules, Consumer Duty included, while change is still cheap.

  • Turn regulation into decisions: what's mandatory, what's prudent, and the alternative route that still gets it launched.

  • Own the regulator relationship: across our markets, including new ones, and flag what regulatory change means for the roadmap early.

  • Take products to new countries: localise what already works, with country leads and local counsel.

  • Build the playbooks: templates that let Legal scale without adding friction.

Why you'll want it

Spend your time on the hard questions. You're asked to shape our roadmap and launches, and understand how to fit them to the relevant regimes

Be a peer, with room to run. You'll join a flat team of regulatory and commercial lawyers, with real autonomy and a manager who trusts you.

Make launches faster, not slower. Legal in the room from day one is how products here ship sooner. That's the whole point of your seat.

Make sending money home cheaper. Remittances pay for school fees, rent and medical bills, and are worth more than all foreign aid combined. Cheaper, reliable transfers put more of that money in families' hands.

Is this you?

You're a qualified lawyer (UK or equivalent) with 4+ years' PQE in payments, e-money or financial services regulation, at a firm, a regulator or a fintech.

You've advised payments or e-money firms under the FCA or an equivalent regime, dealt with the regulator directly, and helped product teams take live launches over the line.

You give the answer first and the reasoning second. Ambiguity across several jurisdictions doesn't stop you making the call.

If you'd rather be asked first than asked last, apply. Missing a box or two? Send your CV anyway.

title: Productmanager Parts & Tyres
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij commercieel ingesteld, analytisch sterk en heb je interesse in techniek en automotive? Krijg je energie van het ontdekken van nieuwe kansen en wil je zelf invloed hebben op het succes van jouw productgroepen? Dan is deze functie bij BAS Parts & Tyres iets voor jou!

BAS Parts & Tyres is een grote speler in de internationale handel van truckonderdelen en banden. We leveren nieuwe, gebruikte en gereviseerde onderdelen aan klanten in meer dan 100 landen. Van complete motoren met meer dan 700 pk tot truckcabines die in containers de hele wereld overgaan: bij ons draait alles op grote schaal!

Als Productmanager Parts & Tyres ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling en groei van jouw eigen assortiment. Je analyseert de markt, onderhoudt contact met leveranciers en bepaalt welke producten interessant zijn om in te kopen. Met jouw commerciële inzicht en analytische vaardigheden zorg je ervoor dat onze producten goed aansluiten bij de vraag van klanten wereldwijd.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om initiatief te nemen, nieuwe ideeën uit te werken en direct bij te dragen aan het commerciële succes van BAS Parts & Tyres.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Productmanager ben jij het aanspreekpunt voor jouw productgroepen. Je combineert markt- en data-analyse met inkoop, assortimentsbeheer en samenwerking met verschillende afdelingen.

Je houdt ontwikkelingen binnen de markt in de gaten, onderzoekt welke producten goed verkopen en kijkt waar nieuwe commerciële kansen liggen.

Jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Je analyseert marktontwikkelingen, verkoopcijfers en klantbehoeften om jouw assortiment verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Je onderhoudt contact met leveranciers, onderhandelt over inkoopmogelijkheden en koopt zelfstandig onderdelen in;

  • Je signaleert kansen om het assortiment uit te breiden, aan te passen of juist producten uit te faseren;

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat productinformatie, zoals specificaties, omschrijvingen en kenmerken, volledig en correct online staat;

  • Je bewaakt de commerciële prestaties van jouw productgroepen en stuurt op omzet, marges en beschikbaarheid;

  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van inkoop, sales, e-commerce, marketing en IT om verbeteringen door te voeren;

  • Je draagt actief bij aan het behalen van persoonlijke en teamdoelstellingen.

Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid om jouw eigen productgroepen verder uit te bouwen. Daarbij combineer je analytisch werken met commercie en ben je dagelijks bezig met het ontdekken en benutten van nieuwe kansen.

Wat maakt deze functie zo leuk?

Bij BAS Parts & Tyres krijg je de kans om zelfstandig aan jouw eigen assortiment te werken. Je hebt direct invloed op welke producten we aanbieden, hoe we deze presenteren en hoe succesvol ze worden verkocht.

Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met uiteenlopende technische producten en krijgt volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Of je nu nieuwe leveranciers ontdekt, verkoopresultaten analyseert of samen met collega's verbeteringen doorvoert: geen dag is hetzelfde!

Wij bieden jou

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris met een bonusregeling;

  • Een veelzijdige functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief;

  • Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen via producttrainingen, taalcursussen en andere opleidingen;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen een internationaal groeiende organisatie;

  • Een jong, ambitieus en gezellig team waarin successen samen worden gevierd;

  • Een informele werksfeer met korte lijnen en ruimte voor ondernemerschap;

  • Deelname aan het BAS Fit-programma met sportactiviteiten zoals de marathon van Eindhoven, het BAS Voetbaltoernooi en het BAS Padeltoernooi;

  • Gezellige borrels, teamuitjes en natuurlijk de legendarische BAS-feesten!


Jouw specificaties

We zoeken een ondernemende en analytische collega die commerciële kansen herkent, initiatief neemt en graag verantwoordelijkheid draagt.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je beschikt over hbo-werk- en -denkniveau;

  • Je hebt interesse in automotive, techniek en truckonderdelen;

  • Je bent analytisch sterk en weet data om te zetten naar concrete commerciële kansen;

  • Je werkt graag met Excel en kunt verkoopcijfers en marktontwikkelingen analyseren;

  • Je bent commercieel ingesteld en krijgt energie van het ontwikkelen en laten groeien van een assortiment;

  • Je neemt initiatief, stelt kritische vragen en denkt in oplossingen;

  • Je kunt goed plannen en organiseren en houdt overzicht wanneer het druk is;

  • Je werkt graag samen met verschillende afdelingen.

Nog geen uitgebreide kennis van truckonderdelen? Geen probleem! Met jouw analytische vaardigheden, commerciële instelling en interesse in techniek kun je bij ons volop leren en jezelf ontwikkelen.

Een nieuwe locatie, volop groeimogelijkheden

BAS Parts & Tyres blijft groeien en investeert daarom in een gloednieuwe vestiging in Veghel. Hier vind je een modern kantoor met ruimte voor 100 collega's, een uitgebreide kantine en twee magazijnhallen met samen 2.500 m² opslagruimte en een hoogte van 15 meter.

Deze nieuwe locatie biedt volop mogelijkheden om onze internationale handel verder uit te breiden. Als Productmanager speel jij een belangrijke rol in deze groei en krijg je de ruimte om jouw assortiment verder te ontwikkelen.

Interesse?

Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en wil je zelf invloed hebben op het succes van jouw productgroepen? Solliciteer dan direct en ontdek jouw mogelijkheden bij BAS Parts & Tyres!

Wij zijn BAS!

BAS Parts & Tyres is onderdeel van BAS Group, een internationaal familiebedrijf dat sinds 1962 actief is in de automotive sector. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's zijn we wereldwijd actief in de handel van vrachtwagens, trailers, machines, onderdelen en banden.

Bij BAS houden we van aanpakken, samenwerken en kansen benutten. Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap vormen de basis van onze organisatie. Samen blijven we groeien en onze dienstverlening verbeteren!

  • Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Systemzusammenhänge zu beurteilen
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit technischen Unterlagen, Stücklisten und ERP-Systemen
  • Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie eine klare, verbindliche Kommunikation
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Nice-to-have

Kenntnisse in der Regelungstechnik oder Erfahrung mit CAN-Bus-Kommunikation ergänzen Ihr Profil. Beides ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Über uns

Mit rund 70 Mitarbeitenden in Krefeld entwickeln wir hydraulische und mechatronische Antriebssysteme für Kommunalfahrzeuge, Arbeitsmaschinen, Transportwesen und Freizeitbereich.

Als Teil der internationalen Eddie Group mit rund 3.800 Mitarbeitenden weltweit arbeiten wir mit Teams und Partnern über Ländergrenzen hinweg zusammen – bei kurzen Wegen und globalen Fertigungsmöglichkeiten.

Warum diese Position?

Kaum ein Projekt ist wie das andere: Unterschiedliche Branchen, Anwendungen und Technologien bringen neue Herausforderungen. Ihre Lösungen begleiten Sie bis zur Serie.

Im Zuge des Generationswechsels in unserer Projektierung übernehmen Sie eine wichtige Fachfunktion – mit Freiraum für eigene Lösungen und der Möglichkeit, Ihre Rolle und Verantwortung weiterzuentwickeln.

descriptionHtml:

title: Recruiting Sourcer - Europe
descriptionHtml:
We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end software agents.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

About The Role

We are hiring a Recruiting Sourcer to join our EMEA Talent team, based in London. This is an in-office role.

You will own the top of the funnel for hiring across the region, partnering closely with recruiters and hiring managers to find, engage and convert exceptional people who aren't looking for us yet.

You will be expected to operate with urgency, creativity and high judgment. You will not simply run searches. You will build our outbound engine: mapping markets, mining our networks, showing up where great people are and turning cold prospects into engaged candidates.

The ideal person is a curious, resourceful hunter who measures success by pipeline quality, not volume, and knows how to create momentum in ambiguous, fast-moving markets.

What You’ll Do

  • Own outbound sourcing across our EMEA hiring priorities, with a focus on technical roles.

  • Build deep talent maps across enterprise software, AI, developer tools, cloud, infrastructure and high-growth technology companies.

  • Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to calibrate on profiles early, then iterate quickly based on feedback and conversion data.

  • Use the full sourcing toolkit (LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox, Boolean and X-ray search, GitHub, communities) and go beyond it with creative strategies that reach people others miss.

  • Run referral mining: work systematically through our team's, investors' and alumni networks to uncover warm paths to top candidates.

  • Plan, host and attend recruiting events, meetups and networking events, and turn them into qualified pipeline.

  • Write sharp, personalised outreach that represents Cognition's story with clarity, credibility and energy, and keep testing what works.

  • Engage passive candidates and run first-call qualifying screens, handing recruiters warm, qualified, well-briefed candidates.

  • Track and report on top-of-funnel metrics (response rates, pass-through rates, source of hire) and use them to keep raising pipeline quality.

  • Build and maintain talent pools in Ashby for recurring and future roles.

  • Work closely with international talent leadership to share what works and build scalable sourcing muscle across EMEA.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven sourcing experience at high-growth technology companies, ideally with a focus on technical roles.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise software, SaaS, AI, infrastructure, developer tools or cloud markets.

  • Mastery of modern sourcing tools and techniques (e.g. LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox), and the curiosity to keep adopting new ones, especially AI-powered tools.

  • Confidence running first-call qualifying screens and pitching the opportunity to passive candidates.

  • Creative instincts: you find candidates through communities, events, content, referrals and networks, not just databases.

  • Outreach that gets replies: concise, personalised and compelling.

  • Experience sourcing across multiple EMEA markets, with an understanding of local market dynamics.

  • A data-driven approach: you know your funnel numbers and use them to improve.

  • Strong partnership skills with the confidence to push back on and calibrate with recruiters and hiring managers.

  • High agency, high ownership and strong attention to detail.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-changing, 0 to 1 environment.

  • A builder mindset: you improve the system while delivering the work.

  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, London, and comfortable working from our London office.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have sourced for early teams in new international markets.

  • You have sourced for frontier AI, developer tools, infrastructure, cloud or enterprise software companies.

  • You have built or run a referral programme or recruiting event series that led directly to hires.

  • You already have a strong network in the London and European tech ecosystem.

  • You have built your own sourcing workflows or automations using AI tools.

  • You care deeply about quality, not just volume.

Our Commitment

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process - please let us know if you need any. Cognition also considers applicants with criminal histories consistent with the SF Fair Chance Ordinance and similar local laws.

title: Regional Vice President, Sales Benelux & Nordics
descriptionHtml:

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the role

We're hiring a Regional Vice President in EMEA to own and lead our Benelux and Nordics business. You'll inherit a team of four quota-carrying enterprise AEs across two hubs: Amsterdam and Stockholm and be responsible for building the management layer, operating model and partner ecosystem that takes both the Benelux and Nordics regions from early traction to consistent, scaled revenue.

This is a Director-level hire with second-line ambition. You'll report directly to the VP EMEA and operate with meaningful autonomy across pipeline, hiring, partner relationships and executive engagement.

 

What you'll own

Team leadership and performance

  • Lead, develop and expand the Enterprise Sales teams across Benelux and Nordics from day one

Partner ecosystem

Market presence

What we're looking for

Experience

title: Relationship Manager - Central Belt
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. We don’t pretend to have all the answers yet, and you will play a role in continuing to shape our offering.

Our Relationship Manager team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow with the Bank at pace. Providing every customer who opens an account with us with a Relationship Manager, to work alongside them and provide outstanding service, is core to our strategy.

In addition to providing outstanding service, our Relationship Managers build deep levels of understanding and trust with their customers, and get to understand their ambitions, goals and motivations. Allica Relationship Managers support their customers through the provision of appropriate Allica Bank products including Business Current Accounts, Savings Accounts, Commercial Loans, Asset Finance and Working Capital Facilities.

All Relationship Manager roles at Allica Bank carry a requirement for new business acquisition as we continue to build the bank. Where portfolios are held, they are built to allow capacity to do this. Relationship Managers will bring, and continue to build, a strong network of trusted SME advisors such as accountants, solicitors, business organisations and others (but not commercial finance brokers – these are looked after by our dedicated broker team). We expect our Relationship Managers to be recognised as valued partners and experts in business finance by their clients and in the communities they serve.

Principal Accountabilities

• Relationship Manage a portfolio of SME customers, understanding customer’s needs and business aspirations, and looking for opportunities to support them via Allica Bank services and through their own external networks

• Originating SME lending opportunities for both existing and new customers from initial enquiry through to completion, including writing credit papers in line with Allica’s credit policy and appetite.

• Delivering the business plan for your local area, and actively managing your objectives and personal development plan.

• Making your colleagues proud that you represent Allica in your local area, by ensuring excellent service for local SME customers, prospects and advisors.

• Working closely and collaboratively with all areas of Allica to ensure a seamless and professional service is always provided.

• Being a positive contributor to Allica’s culture, and always demonstrating the bank’s values

• Complying with all mandatory policies, and adherence to operational procedures to maintain internal controls.

Personal Attributes & Experience

• Highly capable Relationship Manager and Business Developer with a long-term track record of building high-value, trust based and long-lasting referral relationships.

• You will need to have a strong understanding of SME banking, which must include a background in commercial lending.

• You will be able to demonstrate a history of exemplary level of service, and of maximising the value with prospects and customers.

• You will be able to demonstrate a passion for SMEs, be a self-starter and bring an entrepreneurial mindset to your work.

• You will have excellent interpersonal and communication skills together with evidence of strong career progression and/or outperformance.

• You’ll be able to evidence an ability to work expertly with customers, colleagues and advisors to structure new lending proposals and write credit applications.

• You’ll have a proven track record in providing excellent customer service, and in generating new income opportunities whilst effectively managing credit risk.

• You’ll demonstrate an ability to analyse and review financial accounts and associated information.

#LI-Remote #LI-AD1

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: B2B Marketing - India
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

About the role

We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in India. This is a hands-on, in-country role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI.

Your work will shape how Indian businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise.

 

What you'll do

  • Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across India's priority industries from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement.

  • Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, events, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound - choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function.

title: Fintech Onboarding Manager & Consultant (w/m/d) - Buchhaltungs- und Steuerthemen
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

 

Deine Mission

Als Stimme unserer Kunden in Deutschland bist du verantwortlich für ihren Erfolg mit der Pennylane-Plattform.

Deine Kernaufgaben:

- Kunden-Onboarding: Du übernimmst die vollständige Einarbeitung (Onboarding) neuer Kunden – sowohl Unternehmen als auch Steuerberaterkanzleien – in die Pennylane-Plattform. Du stellst sicher, dass sie schnell den größtmöglichen Mehrwert aus unserer Lösung ziehen.

- Bestandskundenbetreuung: Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für unsere bestehenden Kunden. Du pflegst eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung, identifizierst Upsell-Potenziale und stellst sicher, dass die Kunden Pennylane optimal nutzen, um ihre Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

- Proaktive Beratung: Du führst regelmäßige Health-Checks und Reviews durch, um die Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung zu maximieren und Churn vorzubeugen.

- Interne Projektarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem deutschen Sales-Team und dem Management zusammen, um Prozesse zu optimieren, Feedback zu Produktanforderungen zu liefern und zum strategischen Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland beizutragen.

- Expertentum: Du entwickelst dich zum Produktexperten für die Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft in Deutschland und teilst dieses Wissen mit unseren Kunden.

  

Das bringst du mit

- Erfahrung: 2-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, Account Management oder einer ähnlichen kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise im Kanzlei-Umfeld oder alternativ im SaaS- oder Fintech-Bereich.

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Steuerberater oder Studium im Finance-Bereich

- Branchenwissen: Ein tiefes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse von Unternehmen und/oder Steuerberatern in Bezug auf Finanzen, Rechnungsstellung und Buchhaltung ist notwendig.

- Soft Skills: Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Empathie und ein Talent dafür, komplexe Sachverhalte einfach zu erklären.

- Hands-on Mentalität: Als Teil eines Early-Stage-Teams in Deutschland bist du proaktiv, lösungsorientiert und bereit, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

- Reisebereitschaft: Für das Onboarding im Pariser HQ und für regelmäßige Besuche bei unseren Kunden innerhalb von Deutschland (ca. 1mal im Monat

- Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau oder Muttersprache) und fließende Englischkenntnisse (für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem internationalen Team).

  

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

 

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

Bonus:

  • Experience with payment processing providers, or with billing and usage-based pricing systems

  • Experience with stream processing or high-throughput event pipelines.

  • Experience working with finance, tax or audit requirements.

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

Location

Our team is based across the UK, EU and US, and this is our main focus. We are flexible for exceptional candidates elsewhere. You can work remotely, or from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw.

title: Information Security Engineer - Application Security
descriptionHtml:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionaryin 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring an Information Security Engineer with a focus on Application Security to join our Information Security team at Camunda.

We are a team that takes security seriously without making it feel like a locked door. We work in a transparent, straightforward way, and we care about doing the work right rather than just checking a compliance box.

You will work side by side with our R&D engineers: reviewing designs, threat modeling new features, digging into code and helping teams make good, risk-based decisions about the vulnerabilities that come in. You'll also help build the internal tools that make this work scale, including our CVE registry and the LLM-assisted workflows we use to analyse code and triage findings.

Camunda is an AI-first company, and InfoSec is no exception: AI agents are part of how we review code, assess vulnerabilities, and build our tools. You will help shape how that works.

This is a hands-on role for someone who already has solid AppSec foundations and wants to grow. We are a generalist team, so you will also take part in our on-call rotation and incident response, and get exposure to other areas of security. But most of your time will be spent with engineers and building and maintaining internal tools and processes.

What You Will Do

  • Vulnerability management: triage findings from SCA, container and code scanning, external reports and internal security testing; assess whether Camunda is actually affected; agree fix / mitigate / accept with engineering and follow through to release.

  • Threat modeling and security reviews: run threat modeling sessions and design reviews with R&D teams for new features and architecture changes, and turn the results into concrete, prioritised actions.

  • Code analysis with LLMs: use and improve LLM-assisted tooling (agents, prompts, reusable skills) to review code, validate findings and reproduce issues, while applying your own judgement to know when the model is wrong.

  • Build internal security tooling: contribute to the CVE registry and related automation that connects scanners, engineering teams, and customer communication. Much of it is built on Camunda itself.

  • Help engineers do the secure thing by default: answer questions, review pull requests, improve guidelines and occasionally run a session or workshop.

  • On-call and incident response: share the InfoSec on-call rotation with the other engineers and help investigate and resolve security incidents.

  • Support the wider team: help write security advisories for our customers, answer customer security questions and support audits.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Around 3+ years in security or software engineering, with at least 2 of them working on application or product security (AppSec, product security, pentesting, or a security-focused developer role all count).

  • Experience at a SaaS or software product company, working closely with engineering teams that ship often through modern CI/CD and cloud environments.

  • Hands-on vulnerability triage: you've worked with tools like Snyk, Trivy, Semgrep, CodeQL or similar, can tell a real issue from a false positive, and can explain how exploitable something actually is in context (CVSS, exploitability, configuration).

  • Threat modeling and design review experience (e.g. STRIDE) on real systems, ideally web apps, APIs, or distributed services.

  • You read and write code. You're comfortable reading Java (Camunda is built on it) well enough to follow a data flow and spot a security bug. You can write scripts and small tools and contribute to an existing codebase with review.

  • You build with AI, not just chat with it. You use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) in your daily work to write tools, analyse code or automate tasks. And you know their output still needs a second look, especially when it comes to security.

  • Clear, friendly communication with engineers. You see yourself as an enabler, not a gatekeeper, and you can explain risk to people who aren't security specialists.

Nice to haves

  • Some Python and/or JavaScript experience, or experience building internal tools.

  • Willingness to learn and use Camunda, since we build a lot of our own security automation on it. Prior BPMN / workflow experience is a plus.

  • Experience responding to security incidents or being part of an on-call rotation.

  • Exposure to security advisories, CVE disclosure or bug bounty programmes.

  • Knowledge of AI/LLM security risks (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs / agentic apps, prompt injection, tool abuse).

  • Experience securing Kubernetes or container-based workloads, or open-source / B2B software.

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-SG1 #LI-Remote #C1 #USEAST

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

title: Lead Java Developer / Solution Architect (6-month contract)
descriptionHtml:
gravity9 is recruiting Java engineers and architects for a portfolio of engagements across UK central government. These are large-scale, data-intensive modernisation programmes: replacing legacy systems that carry statutory weight, decomposing monoliths that serve millions of users, and building secure data platforms where access control and auditability are first-class architectural concerns rather than late additions.

We are hiring across two overlapping profiles — Senior Java Developer and Application / Migration Architect — and expect most people to move between programmes as engagements start and complete. Several of these are hands-on architect roles: you will own design decisions and also write production code

The kind of work

The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.

Secure data catalogue and access-control platform

A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.

Real-time decision-support data architecture

Replacing point-to-point integration across a multi-vendor estate with a microservices architecture and a common data layer, so that operational data flows in near real time instead of over days. The work includes target-state architecture and decision records, change-data-capture ingest pipelines from upstream data services, ontology and mapping-layer design across suppliers with competing data models, separation of system, reference and insight data classes including time-series, and deployment topologies spanning cloud-hosted services down to constrained edge hardware.

Legacy-to-document-model migration at national scale

Migrating hundreds of millions of records and tens of terabytes of XML out of a legacy relational platform into a sharded document store, in support of a COBOL-to-Java microservices rewrite. The work includes a configuration-driven XML-to-JSON transformation framework backed by a versioned schema registry — twenty years of history, multiple record types and continual schema and semantic drift; CDC and streaming pipelines, or a checkpointed parallel bulk-extract alternative; a field-level mapping validation and reconciliation framework robust enough to stand up to audit; a replay and failure-diagnostics harness with dead-letter routing and idempotent re-runs; and repeated dress rehearsals toward a single cutover window with no dual running.

Monolith decomposition and data-ownership migration

Breaking a distributed monolith of well over a hundred Java services sharing a handful of database clusters into domain-owned services — moving from borrowed data to owned data without reintroducing hidden coupling. The work includes bounded-context analysis to establish which domain genuinely owns which collections, in-place data remodelling ahead of any physical move, a data-access facade with feature-flagged per-request routing between old and new stores, dual-write / backfill / reconcile / read-switch cutover lifecycles with a defined rollback at every step, cluster-to-cluster streaming and live migration tooling, and automated parallel-run and diff-on-read testing.

What you will be doing

Emphasis varies by role and programme, but MongoDB is the common thread. Every one of these engagements involves modelling for it, migrating onto it, or building on top of it, and genuine depth here is what most differentiates candidates.

Architecture and design

• Produce high- and low-level designs, security and data architectures, and architecture decision records — and take them through client design authorities and formal governance gates

• Make and defend architectural trade-offs in front of both engineering and non-technical stakeholders, including client technical authorities and third-party suppliers

• Analyse real access patterns and validate target MongoDB document models against genuine throughput, query and sharding requirements before they are baselined

• Design integration boundaries in multi-vendor programmes where you own one component and must collaborate across the seams of others

Hands-on build

• Build production Java services and RESTful APIs (Spring Boot or similar), designed for integration by multiple consuming systems and documented to OpenAPI

• Design and implement MongoDB document models, aggregation pipelines, indexing and sharding strategies, and integrate them cleanly into Java service layers rather than through a leaky abstraction

• Build data pipelines: CDC and streaming ingest, transformation frameworks, checkpointed batch extract workers, and MongoDB sink configuration and tuning at terabyte scale

• Implement access control, encryption and audit within the application and data layer, including enforcement inside the MongoDB query path, rather than bolted on around it

• Write the tests: unit, integration, golden-record fixtures, parallel-run reconciliation, and load and stress harnesses that prove performance under realistic volumes

• Work across both MongoDB Atlas and Enterprise Advanced, including Kubernetes-hosted deployments, and with the migration and sync tooling around them

Data modernisation and migration

• Model relational, XML or other legacy schemas onto MongoDB document models, handling schema and semantic drift through versioned, configuration-driven mappings rather than forked code

• Design and prove cutover mechanisms — dual-write, backfill, reconcile, read-switch, rollback — for systems where a failed migration is not an acceptable outcome

• Build validation and reconciliation tooling that satisfies audit: completeness, field-level fidelity, and query-level equivalence between old and new

Security, access control and assurance

• Design and implement attribute- or role-based access control models, including enforcement at the data layer and policy administration

• Work with application-layer and field-level encryption — MongoDB client-side field level and queryable encryption, and externally managed key material

• Produce tamper-evident audit trails and observability that answer not just what happened but why

Client-facing delivery and enablement

• Work as an embedded member of a small delivery team, frequently alongside client engineers and other suppliers

• Run workshops, playbacks and sprint demonstrations; produce design documentation, integration guides and operational runbooks

• Support knowledge transfer and upskilling of client teams — on these programmes enablement is a deliverable, not an afterthought

• Use AI-assisted engineering tooling as part of normal delivery, within the constraints client security policy sets


Essential

• Strong hands-on Java — building and running production services and RESTful APIs with Spring Boot or an equivalent framework

• MongoDB — solid working experience covering document modelling, querying, aggregation pipelines and indexing, and integrating MongoDB into Java application layers. Atlas and/or Enterprise Advanced

• Data-intensive systems — demonstrable experience of pipelines, migrations or integrations at meaningful scale, and sound reasoning about throughput, ordering, idempotency and failure recovery

• API design — clean, well-documented REST interfaces suitable for integration by multiple consuming systems

• Testing — genuine automated testing discipline, plus practical experience of load and stress testing against realistic volumes

• Infrastructure and deployment — Terraform or equivalent infrastructure as code, containerised deployment on Kubernetes, and AWS or a comparable cloud

• Communication — able to write clear design documentation and hold your own in a client design authority or architecture review

• UK resident, and either holding current UK SC clearance or clearly eligible to obtain it

For architect-level roles we additionally expect:

• Proven design authority on a delivery of comparable size and sensitivity, while remaining hands-on enough to prototype, pair and review code

• Experience operating inside multi-vendor or multi-supplier programmes, including holding a technical position when other suppliers hold a different one

Desirable

• UK public sector, or another regulated and security-conscious environment

• Kafka and change-data-capture tooling such as Debezium; stream processing

• Legacy modernisation patterns — strangler fig, operational data layers, dual running and phased cutover

• Domain-driven design and bounded-context analysis; monolith decomposition

• Attribute-based access control and policy-as-code frameworks (OPA, Casbin, XACML-based systems)

• Field-level or client-side encryption, key management, HSM/KMS and KMIP integration

• Search — Lucene-based or Atlas Search, vector search, hybrid retrieval and RAG patterns

• Metadata standards such as DCAT or Dublin Core; data cataloguing, data mesh and federated data architecture concepts

• Event-driven architecture and consistency patterns in distributed systems (saga, eventual consistency)

• Oracle, COBOL or other mainframe and legacy platform familiarity

• Time-series or geospatial data; deployment to constrained or edge hardware

• AI-assisted development workflows and agentic coding tools

Working context

Engagement Contract. Typically three to twelve months per programme, with a strong likelihood of rolling onto the next. Some roles begin part-time through a design phase before going full-time for build.

Clearance SC clearance is the standard requirement for these roles, and current SC will always be the fastest route onto a programme. We will consider especially strong candidates who hold BPSS only and can sponsor SC in those cases, though clearance takes roughly three months and start dates will reflect that.

Residency UK resident. All work on these programmes is delivered from the UK by UK-onshore staff.

Working model Predominantly remote with periodic onsite attendance. Locations vary by programme — expect occasional travel to client sites including London, Manchester and Leeds.

Environment Work is typically delivered through client-supplied devices or VDI, with VPN access to client environments. You should be comfortable operating within defined information-handling and access constraints, and with the pace that government security and onboarding processes set.

Team shape Small, focused, multi-disciplinary teams. On several programmes gravity9 delivers alongside partner organisations and other suppliers, and you will need to work effectively across those boundaries.

Timing These roles support a growing pipeline of central government work. Some engagements are contracted and mobilising; others are in contract negotiation with expected start dates in the coming months. We are building the bench now so that we can mobilise quickly, and clearance lead times mean early conversations are worthwhile even where a start date is not yet fixed.

title: Level Design - Puzzle (Turkish Speaker)
descriptionHtml:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones. At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The team

You join an 8-person puzzle studio in Istanbul, founded by Peak and Zynga alumni. It's backed by Homa's puzzle, data, art, and UA teams. Its new puzzle game is heading to global launch, and fresh levels are now its biggest growth lever.

The opportunity

You own the levels players see every week. You work every day with Homa's product director and the studio's level designers, artists, and engineers. You use a level editor and AI tools that generate layouts and estimate difficulty. AI makes you faster, and you stay the brain behind every level. You work remotely from Türkiye. The team is small, and the bar is high.

As the studio grows, you can own a family of mechanics or a pack of levels. You can also lead a group of level designers, or move toward a product role.

Your responsibilities

  • Build. Your levels keep fresh content reaching players, every single week.
  • Tune. Your difficulty curve makes levels feel hard but fair, so players keep trying.
  • Introduce. New mechanics land smoothly because your levels teach them step by step.
  • Test. You play every level before release, so players only see levels that work.
  • Optimize. You use win rate, attempts and churn data to turn weak live levels into strong ones.
  • Shape. Your ideas on new mechanics and content push the game forward.
  • Accelerate. You use AI to generate layout variants, explore difficulty options and check solvability.

What we look for

  • Ownership. You drive outcomes. When something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
  • Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
  • Pragmatism. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship.
  • AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink.
  • Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly.
  • Motivated. You're ambitious and grounded. You see this opportunity as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else.

Requirements

  • Experience. 1+ year in level design, game design or QA on mobile games, ideally puzzle games.
  • Languages. Fluent Turkish and English. You use both every day.
  • Volume with quality. You ship every week and never let quality slip.
  • Tool speed. You work fast in a level editor and pick up new tools quickly.
  • Data sense. You track level data and use it to tune your levels.
  • Puzzle instinct. You play puzzle games a lot and can explain why a level works.
  • AI native. You turn AI into output. You've built tools that generate layouts, check solvability or analyse level data.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Shipped levels on a live mobile puzzle game.
  • Experience with Unity or a similar game engine.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Our process (2 weeks max)

  • Call with our recruiter (30 min). A generalized conversation, and to tell you more about the role.
  • Level design case study. We look at your thinking and your technical skills.
  • Technical interview with the studio's level designers to dive deeper into technicalities.
  • Final interview with the studio founder and Homa's Puzzle lead. Focused on motivation, values, and fit.

Benefits

Why Homa

  • Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest. Your scope and your rewards grow with what you deliver, not with tenure.
  • Real ownership. No layers between you and the result. You own outcomes, not tasks, whatever your level.
  • Direct impact. Your work moves the business and shapes where Homa goes next. Decisions are made fast, and you see the results in the numbers.
  • AI at the core. With access to the best AI tools, you'll help shape how an AI-first company works, and your time goes where your judgment matters most.
  • High talent bar. Our teams are small, with people from the best companies, and the talent around you will push you to grow.

What we offer

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here's what you can expect:

  • Comprehensive benefits. Depending on where you're based, you'll get perks such as health insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym membership, and more.
  • A brand-new Paris HQ. A desk in our new office in the heart of Paris, whenever you want to work side by side with the team.
  • An international team. Work in English with top talent from 35+ countries across Europe, the UK, the US, and beyond. Our diversity fuels our creativity.
  • Team gatherings. We value time together beyond the screen. Join regular team gatherings and off-site retreats to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • Performance reviews. Every six months, we look back at your progress, recognise your wins, and agree on clear goals for what's next.
  • Equipment support. From day one, you get everything you need to do your best work, including a home office allowance if you work remotely.

Where we hire

Our Paris HQ is a lively hub for creativity, collaboration, and connection. From lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, it's a space people genuinely enjoy, in our brand-new office in the heart of Paris (awesome energy and snacks included).

We also have great teammates across Europe, from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you work from home in Barcelona or Warsaw, you're fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we mainly hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there, or planning to be, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Partnerships Manager (North West)
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

Finding effective ways of generating new business is critical to our continued growth. One way is through partnerships with third-parties who refer their SME clients to Allica on an ongoing basis based on mutual trust. Our Partnerships Team work with trusted advisors to established SMEs, in particular their Accountants.

As a Partnerships Manager, you will develop and nurture relationships with accounting firms across your region, taking a consultative, B2B sales approach. You’ll own the end-to-end client experience for Business Rewards Account clients - from generating introductions through to onboarding and funding and coordinate with our specialist Relationship Manager team on additional lending needs. The role involves regional travel, in-person meetings and you’ll be supported by our Marketing team in running events.

Principal Accountabilities

• Manage a regional portfolio of accounting firms- covering cold outbound, warm inbound, and active introducers- moving each firm through the pipeline to become a repeat client introducer.

• Build trust and credibility through a consultative approach, positioning Allica as the most recommended bank by accountants.

• Grow Allica’s presence across each firm, including multiple stakeholders, colleagues and offices, through regular regional travel and in-person meetings.

• Introduce the Business Rewards Account and other banking products to accounting firms and their clients, owning the end-to-end onboarding, funding and account usage journey.

• Qualify and introduce clients with lending needs (e.g. commercial mortgages) to the appropriate Relationship Manager.

• Act as the accounting firm’s dedicated point of contact at Allica

• Deliver and continuously improve our Accountants Playbook, ensuring firms are positively onboarded and become active, repeat introducers.

• Run regional activities - lunch and learns, roundtables and various other events

title: Principal Engineer, Duo Agent Platform
descriptionHtml:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

About the role

We are looking for a Principal Engineer to help build GitLab Duo Agent Platform, the agentic orchestration layer that runs AI agents and flows across the entire software lifecycle.

Principal Engineers at GitLab are recognized experts across multiple technology domains and represent the senior technical leadership within their organization. In this role you will set technical direction for a significant part of the Agent Platform, working across several teams to turn agentic capabilities into something engineering organizations can actually depend on: predictable, observable, governable, and fast enough to sit in the critical path of real development work.

The Agent Platform is not a single service. It spans agent execution and orchestration, flow definition and event-driven triggering, the AI Catalog through which customers discover and manage agents, model routing and evaluation, and the governance surface that decides which agents may act where and under whose identity. It runs on GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, and Self-Managed installations, including deployments that use self-hosted models to meet compliance requirements. You will work on the parts of that system where the hard architectural questions live, and you will do it hands-on.

This role reports into the VP of the AI Engineering organization and works closely with Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Product Management, Infrastructure and Security.

What you'll do

  • Define the technical direction for a significant area of Duo Agent Platform across several teams, and partner with Engineering Managers and Product to turn it into a roadmap with a six-month horizon.
  • Build the orchestration layer that makes agents and flows reliable: session lifecycle, tool invocation, context assembly, concurrency, retries, timeouts, and failure modes that degrade gracefully instead of stalling a developer's workflow.
  • Hands on work on driving topics throughout the whole organisation from POC level, architecture to full implementation. 
  • Participate in Incident Management on-call rotation, to help meet availability goals for GitLab.com.
  • Strong product builder and ownership mentality. Understanding of product strategy, technical strategy, delivering customer value and iteration towards a successful product
  • Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that let other teams make aligned decisions. Ensure the architecture holds across multi-tenant GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments, including self-hosted model configurations, and respects data governance boundaries in each.
  • Use the platform on our own work, find where it falls short of what we claim, and feed that back through improvements into the product.
  • Mentor Staff and Senior Engineers, and raise the bar for experimentation rigor and cross-team collaboration.
  • Work across the whole platform on different projects, features and teams. This reaches across:
    • Design the extensibility surface so customers can build custom agents and flows, connect their own tools and internal systems, and bring external agents such as Claude Code and Codex into GitLab workflows without weakening the platform's guarantees.
    • Drive down the cost and latency of agentic requests, and work with Product on how model selection, routing, and credit consumption behave as usage grows.
    • Define the evaluation practice for the platform: offline benchmarks and online experiments that measure task completion, correctness, tool-call accuracy, latency, and cost per task, and that catch regressions before customers do.
    • Build the governance and safety surface with Security and Compliance: policy-driven controls over which agents and models may run where, permission and identity semantics that align to existing roles and group structure, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, traceability of every flow session, and audit that stands up to enterprise review.
  • Complete Interview Training and participate in hiring for the department as a technical interviewer or panel member.

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years at Staff, Principal level or equivalent senior technical leadership.
  • Hands-on production experience building on large language models: agent loops, tool calling, context management, retrieval, prompt and model evaluation. Experience shipping this to real users, not only prototyping it.
  • Strong background in distributed systems, including service decomposition, fault tolerance, observability, and operational resilience under multi-tenant load.
  • A track record of defining evaluation frameworks and using benchmark and experiment results to make architecture decisions, rather than shipping on intuition.
  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop controls, safety guardrails, and responsible AI practices for systems that act on a customer's behalf.
  • Ability to drive alignment across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and Security on problems that start out ambiguous.
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and shaping technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority.
  • Comfort working in one or more of Ruby, Go, Python, or TypeScript, and willingness to work across the stack the platform spans.
  • Excellent written and asynchronous communication, and the ability to work effectively in a fully remote, globally distributed organization.

About the team

The AI engineering organisation is building the product and infrastructure that make GitLab an effective environment for running agents across the software development lifecycle. We’re distributed across the world and partner with teams throughout GitLab to help the GitLab Duo Agent Platform become the backbone of GitLab's AI features. You will report directly to the VP of Engineering for AI and especially work together with all the teams, the engineering management and other principal engineers in the AI department. This is an opportunity to lead a consequential group as AI changes how software is built.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits.
