title: Principal Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer

Reports to: Engineering Manager

Location: UK / Europe

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

About the Role

As a Principal Infrastructure Engineer, you will help set the technical direction for the platform one of our engineering teams builds on: the infrastructure, tooling, and automation that let us run GPU clusters, Kubernetes, and our managed services reliably at scale.

You'll partner closely with software engineers, SRE, Infra Ops, and the other infrastructure engineers across Radiant.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on making the platform & infrastructure reliable, secure, and easy to build on, through architecture, code, and the standards other teams build on.

Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows:

  • Infrastructure: Compute, Infra, Cluster, Network & Storage

  • Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security

  • AI: Training & Inference

What You'll Do

Infrastructure Design & Virtualisation:

  • Architect, design and implement virtualisation solutions optimised for AI-native workloads, focusing on HPC environments and hypervisor tuning.

  • Design infrastructure that dynamically adjusts to meet customer demands for storage and networking resources, ensuring resilience and scalability.

Bare-Metal and Operating System Management:

  • Lead the lifecycle management of bare-metal hardware, ensuring efficient provisioning, orchestration, and optimisation.

  • Maintain deep expertise in Unix/Linux systems, delivering secure, performant configurations at scale.

Networking and High-Performance Storage:

  • Design and implement high-performance, cloud-native storage and networking solutions for demanding workloads.

  • Apply advanced knowledge of networking protocols (TCP, UDP, DNS, encryption) and software-defined networking (SDN) technologies.

Kubernetes and Cloud-Native Platforms:

  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes clusters across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, leveraging CNIs and service meshes.

  • Define how infrastructure changes are rolled out safely across clusters and environments, partnering with DevOps on delivery tooling.

Security and Audit:

  • Kubernetes security hardening (RBAC, PSA/PSP successors, network policies, admission controllers - OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno)

  • Secrets management and rotation across clusters (Vault/OpenBao, sealed-secrets, external-secrets patterns)

  • Supply chain security — image scanning, signed artifacts (cosign/sigstore), provenance attestation

  • IAM and least-privilege design across bare-metal, cluster, and cloud control planes

Observability and Automation:

  • Build observability pipelines to monitor and troubleshoot global systems, integrating tools for logs,metrics, and tracing.

  • Create automation frameworks to reduce operational toil, streamline deployments, and enhance scalability using tools like Terraform, Ansible, Go, and Python.

Architecture & Solution Design:

  • Analyse emerging technologies and assess their potential fit within our platform, considering scalability, security, and performance.

  • Develop high- and low-level architectural proposals, balancing technical and business requirements.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful implementation of infrastructure solutions.

  • Provide thought leadership on architecture best practices, driving alignment across engineering and product teams.

Collaboration and Leadership:

  • Foster a 'how do we achieve this?' mindset, championing a positive, solution-oriented approach to challenges.

  • Mentor and guide team members in architectural principles, emerging technologies, and best practices.

  • Partner with engineering leaders and stakeholders to align infrastructure projects with broader organisational goals.

Your Profile

  • Extensive experience in platform, infrastructure, or SRE engineering at scale.

  • A track record of technical leadership at staff or principal level, including setting direction across multiple teams and delivering complex, high-stakes systems.

  • Strong hands-on engineering skills in Go, Python, or similar.

  • Deep technical expertise across:

  • Kubernetes and containers in production, including operators

  • Infrastructure-as-code and configuration management (e.g. Terraform, Ansible)

  • Linux, networking, and cloud or bare-metal infrastructure

  • Experience with GPU, HPC, or bare-metal platforms is a strong plus.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear design documents and explaining complex trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

What You Bring

  • Platform thinking: Build the foundations other engineers rely on, and make them easy to use.

  • Engineering excellence: Write and review code that sets the standard for correctness, performance, and maintainability.

  • Architectural judgement: Make sound long-term decisions on systems that are hard to change once built.

  • Technical leadership: Influence direction across teams without relying on authority, and grow the engineers around you.

  • Systems thinking: Understand how your area interacts with compute, networking, storage, and the rest of the cloud platform.

  • Ownership: Drive capabilities from design through production, operation, and continuous improvement.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (two Principal Engineers) → Whiteboard Exercise → Final.

title: Research Engineer, Agents
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz was founded by former MIT scientists who created Boltz-1, the first fully commercially available open-source model to approach AlphaFold 3-level accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Foundation models. Our open models, Boltz-1, Boltz-2 and BoltzGen, are trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations. Our latest proprietary foundation models power our products and the custom models we build with partners.

  • Boltz Lab and the Boltz API. Our products run our latest models, design pipelines (BoltzMol for small molecules, BoltzProt for protein design) and agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules in Boltz Lab, run our models from their own code and agents through the Boltz API, or deploy them inside their own environment.

The two feed each other: our open releases earn scientific credibility and community insight, and our products turn our full range of models into real impact for partners including Pfizer, Takeda, GSK, Bristol Myers Squibb and DSM-Firmenich.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

 

About the role
As a Research Engineer (Agents), you will build and own the agent harnesses behind research at Boltz. You will design them for our scientific and research use cases, including agentic research pipelines and researcher tooling, and scale them to run on our cluster.
You will be part of Research Engineering and work with researchers across our teams.
This role is ideal for a strong systems engineer who has built agent systems, has sharp intuitions for the capabilities and limitations of current frontier LLMs, both open- and closed-source, and is rigorous about the correctness of agent output. You do not need an ML research background.

What you’ll do

  • Design and build agent harnesses for research: tool use, orchestration, and context and state management.

  • Work with researchers to build agentic pipelines and tooling for their work, and make them reusable across teams.

  • Scale these harnesses to support large agent swarms on our cluster.

  • Build observability, verification and cost control for large agent runs.

  • Evaluate agent setups rigorously, and keep our harnesses current as frontier LLMs evolve.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • Strong software engineering experience, including distributed systems or infrastructure that runs many long-running jobs in parallel and handles failures.

  • Experience building agent systems or harnesses (tool use, orchestration, context and state management, evaluation) that you can discuss in depth.

  • Good judgment about the capabilities and failure modes of frontier LLMs, and about keeping agent-produced work correct and maintainable.

  • A track record of building tools that were widely adopted by researchers or engineers.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience developing open-source agent harnesses (e.g. Pi, Codex, DSH) or extending existing ones (e.g. Claude Code).

  • Understanding of LLM architectures, and experience fine-tuning LLMs with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or reinforcement learning (e.g. RLHF, RLVR, GRPO).

  • Background in NLP or information retrieval, such as search, ranking, embeddings, vector search or retrieval-augmented generation.

  • Experience running workloads on a shared compute cluster or cloud infrastructure (e.g. Kubernetes).

  • Exposure to scientific research workflows.

  • Experience using Boltz models.

 

What we offer

  • Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field.

  • Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment.

  • Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company.

  • Benefits:

    • 25 days plus bank holidays a year

    • Annual team offsite trip

    • Private healthcare (BUPA), covering pre-existing conditions

    • Pension program

    • Paid parental leave

    • Wellhub gym membership

    • Free lunch every day

    • Travel expenses

 

How we hire

  1. Initial screen with a member of the Talent team

  2. Diagnosis interview: work through a degraded training run with us (no manual coding test)

  3. Onsite in London or virtual onsite with the team

  4. Offer + Onboarding

 

Our commitment

Boltz is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, tell us and we'll make it work.

title: Responsable Scientifique et Technique pour le projet européen AMRIT
descriptionHtml:
Contexte :

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

Le projet AMRIT :

Aujourd’hui, en Europe, l’exploitation des plateformes d’observation in situ s’appuie sur un réseau d’infrastructures de recherche réparties sur l’ensemble du continent. Les activités menées au sein de ce réseau comprennent des opérations in situ et à distance en mer, ainsi que la gestion des données issues d’un grand nombre de ressources pour une large gamme d’applications. Ces activités nécessitent d’importantes ressources informatiques, des efforts de R&D visant à améliorer les capacités des plateformes, ainsi que des activités de gestion et de financement pour assurer le fonctionnement des infrastructures et en garantir l’accès. AMRIT (Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together) est un projet pionnier conçu pour révolutionner le paysage des infrastructures de recherche marine (MRI) en Europe, en renforçant leur capacité à répondre aux enjeux politiques européens et aux défis scientifiques mondiaux.

AMRIT (https://www.amritproject.eu/) est un projet financé par Horizon Europe et l’UKRI, réunissant 26 partenaires européens, et destiné à faire progresser les MRIs au plan de leur coordination, en proposant la fédération de certains de leurs services informatiques. Il est coordonné scientifiquement par l’ENSTA. En développant des outils et des services pour la conduite des opérations des plateformes d’observation marine, AMRIT vise à :

  • Assurer un fonctionnement sans faille des plateformes d’observation marine.

  • Garantir la pleine utilisation nominale des capteurs et accélérer leur évolution.

  • Exploiter la complémentarité des différentes plateformes d’observation.

  • Assurer la cohérence globale de la chaîne de valeur des données océaniques.

  • Garantir une liste cohérente et exhaustive de métadonnées et de descripteurs.

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein du Campus de Brest.

Missions / Activités principales :

En tant que coordinateur scientifique du projet AMRIT dans le cadre d’Horizon Europe, l’ENSTA recherche un responsable scientifique et technique.

Les principales missions du responsable de projet sont les suivantes :

  • Coordonner la mise en œuvre globale du projet et en suivre l’avancement, notamment les lots de travail, les livrables, les jalons, les échéances et les indicateurs clés de performance, en étroite collaboration avec le coordinateur scientifique et avec le soutien du personnel administratif d’ARMINES ;

  • Suivre les risques liés au projet, les écarts et les actions correctives, et proposer des mesures d’atténuation ou d’ajustement si nécessaire ;

  • Diriger et coordonner le consortium, en maintenant une communication régulière avec ses membres, en facilitant la collaboration entre les partenaires, en assurant une circulation efficace de l’information et en accompagnant les partenaires dans la mise en œuvre de leurs activités ;

  • Organiser et coordonner les réunions du consortium, notamment les réunions du comité de pilotage, les réunions techniques et les assemblées générales, ainsi que leur préparation et leur suivi ;

  • Coordonner la préparation des rapports et des livrables du projet, en regroupant les contributions des partenaires et en garantissant leur qualité ainsi que leur remise dans les délais ;

  • Contribuer à la communication, à la diffusion et à l’exploitation des résultats du projet, notamment par le biais d’ateliers et de conférences, en coordination avec les partenaires concernés ;

  • Assurer la liaison principale avec la Commission européenne, notamment en maintenant.

Missions / Activité annexe :

  • Participer à la démarche Qualité de l’établissement ;

  • Contribuer à la démarche RSE dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités au sein de l’Ecole.

ENSTA Campus de Brest, 2 rue François Verny, 29200 Brest.

Le poste est à temps plein et comprend des déplacements en France et à l’étranger en fonction des besoins du projet.

Informations complémentaires :

    ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID). Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

    ENSTA (https://www.ensta.fr) is a higher education and research institution under the supervision of the Ministry of the defense. The school’s mission is to train civil and military engineering students, as well as highly qualified executives and PhD graduates for the public and private sectors, particularly in the fields of defence and security, transport, energy, maritime activities, digital technology and cutting-edge technologies.

    ENSTA supports the transformation of major national strategic sectors through its research, innovation and educational programmes, thereby addressing the challenges of national sovereignty. It comprises six teaching and research units (UFRs) which conduct applied research in close collaboration with industry.

    ENSTA is a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). As part of IP Paris, the school participates in the activities of IP Paris interdisciplinary centres, notably the Interdisciplinary Centre for Seas and Ocean (CIMO), co-founded with Ifremer and supported by the Defence Innovation Agency (AID) and the French research council CNRS. Researchers from the school also collaborate on studies led by interdisciplinary centres such as Hi-Paris – winner of the 2024 AI Cluster award – E4C and E4H, amongst others.

    Joining the school means becoming part of an institution committed to gender parity and professional equality, diversity and supporting its staff with disabilities, from the moment of recruitment and throughout their careers. To safeguard wellbeing at work, the school pursues an active policy on working conditions, based in particular on a healthy work-life balance.

    The AMRIT project :

    Today in Europe, the operations of in situ observing platforms rely on a network of Research Infrastructures distributed all around Europe. The activities in the network include in situ and remote operations at sea and data management of a large number of assets for a wide variety of applications. Such activities rely on important IT resources, R&D to improve the capacity of the platforms, as well as managerial and financial activities to run the infrastructures and provide access to them. AMRIT (Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together) is a pioneering project designed to revolutionise the landscape of marine research infrastructures in Europe, strengthening their ability to respond to Europe's policy and global scientific challenges.

    AMRIT (https://www.amritproject.eu/) is a Horizon Europe & UKRI funded project, with 26 European partners, designed to advance Marine Research Infrastructures (MRIs). By developing tools and services integrating the operations of marine observation platforms, AMRIT aims to:

    • Ensure seamless operation of marine observation platforms.

    • Ensure the full nominal use of sensors and accelerate their evolution.

    • Exploit the complementarity of the various observation platforms.

    • Ensure the overall coherence of the ocean data value chain.

    • Ensure a consistent and comprehensive list of metadata and descriptors.

    Mission of the Scientific and Technical Manager :

    As third party of ARMINES, the administrative Coordinator of the Horizon Europe Project AMRIT, ENSTA is seeking a Scientific and Technical Manager. Under the supervision of the project Scientific Coordinator, Professor Laurent Mortier (ENSTA), the main tasks of the Project Manager are to:

    • Coordinate the overall implementation of the project and monitor its progress, including work packages, deliverables, milestones, deadlines and key performance indicators, in close collaboration with the Scientific Coordinator and with the support of ARMINES administrative staff.

    • Monitor project risks, deviations and corrective actions, and propose mitigation or adjustment measures where necessary.

    • Lead and coordinate the consortium, maintaining regular communication with consortium members, facilitating collaboration among partners, ensuring the effective flow of information and supporting partners in the implementation of their activities.

    • Organise and coordinate consortium meetings, including steering committee meetings, technical meetings and general assemblies, as well as their preparation and follow-up.

    • Coordinate the preparation of project reports and deliverables, consolidating contributions from partners and ensuring their quality and timely submission.

    • Contribute to the communication, dissemination and exploitation of project results, including through workshops and conferences, in coordination with the relevant partners.

    • Act as the main liaison with the European Commission, including maintaining regular communication and follow-up with the Project Officer.

    • Represent the consortium and build and maintain high-level relationships with key stakeholders at national, European and international levels.

    Required qualifications and skills :

    • Applicants must have an advanced university degree (M.Sc or equivalent degree) in Oceanography, Marine Science or Engineering, or related fields. A PhD in a relevant field is an advantage.

    • Applicants must have at least 5 years (PhD included) of relevant experience in ocean observations or services in ocean observation organisations.

    • Applicants must have demonstrated experience in coordinating, managing and implementing projects, desirably at the European or international level.

    • Excellent organizational, written and communication skills.

    • Professional command of both spoken and written English, and good knowledge of French and/or another European language.

    Desired qualifications and skills :

    • Motivation and ability to interact with multiple stakeholders on national, international (and interdisciplinary) levels including researchers, operators, administrative staff, science officers, and policy makers.

    • Degree in management of European affairs or similar.

    • Knowledge of major national and EU funding instruments.

    • Experience of working and collaborating among Research Infrastructures in the environmental field.

    Working conditions :

    ENSTA is committed to a recruitment process that promotes equality, diversity and inclusion. All applications, regardless of any distinction (age, disability, gender, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, etc.), are welcome in our recruitment process.

    The role is full-time and involves travel within France and abroad, depending on the project’s requirements. Remote working is possible in accordance with the employer’s current policies.

    Administrative :

    The position is for a duration of 18 months, based in ENSTA premises in Brest, Brittany. Other locations may be considered.

    Enquiries about the position should be addressed to Professor Laurent Mortier (). Enquiries regarding the detailed terms and conditions of employment at ENSTA can be addressed to Margot Provost ().

    Please also send your CV, a covering letter, and the name of 2 referees in the project field, before 20th September 2026 to:

descriptionHtml:
Job Title: SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) Senior Developer / Engineer

Experience: 8–12 Years

Location: Germany / EU Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Work Mode: Remote

Role Summary

We are seeking a SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) Senior Developer / Engineer with 8–12 years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM) to design, build, and support enterprise-scale identity solutions. This role focuses on hands-on development and integration in SailPoint IIQ, delivering access governance, lifecycle management, joiner-mover-leaver (JML) processes, and compliance controls across diverse applications and directories.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead design and development of SailPoint IdentityIQ solutions (workflows, rules, forms, certifications, policies, identity lifecycle events).

  • Develop and enhance integrations/connectors with target systems (AD/Azure AD, LDAP, databases, HR systems, SaaS applications) using IIQ connectors, Web Services (REST/SOAP), and custom provisioning logic.

  • Implement and optimize JML processes, access request, approvals, provisioning/deprovisioning, and role/entitlement management.

  • Configure and customize governance features including access certifications, access reviews, segregation of duties (SoD), policy violations, and reporting.

  • Build and maintain IIQ artifacts: Identity Cubes, Applications, Managed Attributes, Roles, Policies, LCM configurations, and Identity Profiles.

  • Create and maintain custom rules (BeanShell/Java), workflows, and task schedules; troubleshoot and resolve issues in lower environments and production.

  • Own end-to-end delivery: requirements analysis, technical design, development, unit testing, deployment, and hypercare.

  • Support upgrades, patching, and environment migrations; assess impact, remediate customizations, and validate functionality post-upgrade.

  • Collaborate with IAM architects, security, infrastructure, and application teams to define standards, patterns, and roadmaps.

  • Drive engineering quality: code reviews, documentation, CI/CD practices, and performance tuning.

  • Provide Level 3 support, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement for IAM services and operational processes.

Required Qualifications

  • 8–12 years of overall IT experience, with strong hands-on experience in SailPoint IdentityIQ development and implementation.

  • Solid understanding of IAM concepts: authentication vs authorization, identity lifecycle, access governance, RBAC/ABAC, SoD, least privilege.

  • Strong development skills with Java and/or BeanShell, and the ability to debug code effectively.

  • Experience building integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, JDBC/SQL, flat files, and directory services (LDAP/Active Directory).

  • Experience with IIQ LCM, Access Requests, Provisioning, Workflows, Rules, Forms, Roles, Certifications, and Policies.

  • Working knowledge of IdentityIQ deployment models, environment setup, and production support practices.

  • Familiarity with source control and build/deploy processes (e.g., Git, Maven/Gradle, Jenkins/Azure DevOps).

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, including log analysis, performance considerations, and root-cause analysis.

  • Ability to translate functional requirements into technical designs and deliver with minimal supervision.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional and global teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SailPoint IdentityIQ certification(s) or equivalent IAM certification(s).

  • Experience with SailPoint IdentityNow, PAM tools, or IGA platforms (Saviynt, Okta IGA, etc.).

  • Experience with cloud IAM patterns and integrations (Azure AD, AWS IAM/SSO, Google Workspace).

  • Experience implementing SoD policies and compliance controls for frameworks such as SOX, ISO 27001, or GDPR.

  • Hands-on experience with DevSecOps practices, automated testing, and infrastructure-as-code (where applicable).

  • Experience with ITSM processes/tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and on-call/production support.

Technical Skills (Core)

  • SailPoint IdentityIQ: LCM, certification campaigns, role model, policies, workflows, rules, task scheduling, reporting, troubleshooting

  • Languages: Java, BeanShell; scripting (PowerShell/Python) is a plus

  • Integrations: REST/SOAP, JDBC/SQL, LDAP/AD, Azure AD

  • Platforms/Tools: Tomcat, application servers, Linux/Windows basics, Git, CI/CD pipelines

  • Security: RBAC, least privilege, auditability, access review controls

title: Sales Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Sales Consultant

 

THE CARWOW GROUP

 

Carwow Group is building the go-to destination for car-changing, reaching drivers everywhere through a portfolio of automotive brands: Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer.

Carwow started as a car reviews site and is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe, with over 10m customers helping them buy and sell cars. Our Sell My Car service lists cars for sale through a daily online auction, matching sellers with dealers who want to buy. In 2024 we acquired Autovia, doubling our audience. Our team of around 500 people across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal is revolutionising car-changing, and we are expanding across every brand and country we operate in.

 

WHY JOIN US?

 

Shortlisted in the prestigious Culture 100 list of the top Growth companies to work for by Hyer; we also recently raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify, Bessemer Venture Partners, to accelerate our growth plans!

As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility – building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers.

Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!).

Our team of 500 employees across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal are revolutionising car-changing and we are fast expanding our mission across every single brand and country we operate in, so jump in!

  

THE ROLE

As a Sales Consultant in the Sales Team, you are the main person guiding our customers into the auction and getting their car sold.

Our daily online auction can list over 1,000 cars a day, and behind every one is a seller who wants the best price and a hassle-free sale. You will take them from first conversation to sale: getting their listing right, setting realistic price expectations, then negotiating the sale to land the best price. Owning the whole journey means stronger rapport, better phone calls and fewer cancellations, and you will see the result of your work in every sale.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Manage a daily pipeline of sellers, making calls to guide each one from first conversation to a completed listing and an accepted offer, and hit daily, weekly and monthly targets.

  • Review listings uploaded by sellers and work with them to fix any omissions or errors, so every car enters the auction accurately and complete.

  • Explain the Carwow auction process and give honest, market-based pricing advice, so sellers feel informed and confident.

  • Listen to sellers' concerns and overcome objections, using our sales frameworks.

  • Negotiate on the seller's behalf to get their offer accepted at the best price the market will pay.

  • Uphold our call quality standards in every interaction, so sellers have a positive experience with Carwow.

  • Meet daily KPIs for call volumes, for email and text contact.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams, including pre-qualification and post-sales fulfilment, sharing insight and feedback on what sellers need.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • We are looking for someone with a track record of hitting targets who is equally comfortable building rapport with a seller and negotiating confidently on their behalf.

  • Previous experience in a target-driven role, with goals based on revenue or volume of sales.

  • Experience managing a high-volume lead pipeline independently, with a consistent sales process and performance.

  • Proven ability to negotiate and handle objections.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to build rapport with sellers from diverse backgrounds.

  • Comfort working across phone, email, live chat and SMS.

  • A proactive, customer-focused approach, with a genuine desire to help sellers achieve their goals.

  • Strong attention to detail and organisation, for accurate listings, tidy pipeline records and efficient follow-up.

  • You are self-motivated, driven by both your own targets and the teams, and work just as well independently as you do as part of a team.

  • Flexibility to work weekends on a rota (see Working pattern and location).

  • Enthusiasm for the automotive industry and for keeping up with trends is a plus.

 

WORKING PATTERN AND LOCATION

This is a full-time role of 37.5 hours a week, worked over 5 days. Shifts rotate across Monday to Sunday and fall between 9am and 7pm.

  • Weekends: Weekend days are shared across the Sales Team on a rota that repeats every eight weekends and is published in advance. When you work a weekend day, you'll get a weekday off in the same week / time off in lieu, so you still work 5 days in total.

  • Public holidays: Carwow operates seven days a week, so you may be scheduled to work on public holidays

  • Location: hybrid, with a minimum of three days a week in the office at Bournemouth, Winnersh, London or Porto.

 

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Vitality Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

    • 28 days annual leave

    • 1 day for your wedding

    • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

    • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

  

Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.

Compensation: £50K

  • Inspire Higher: We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.

About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Second Charge Mortgage Underwriter to join our underwriting team.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a successful business that is expanding into secured lending. We are bringing Open banking and AI to the secured lending process to save customers money.

We are looking for someone with strong property underwriter experience in a second charge lending space, someone who can work to targets and thrives in a startup environment.

We have great opportunities for progression in an ever-growing business.

About the Team

Unlike traditional lenders, we’re focused on doing things differently. Our underwriting approach combines a state-of-the-art in-house built technology that blends traditional lending methods with Open Banking analysis to create a smoother and more flexible experience for our customers.

We work together to our common goals using Ai to assist our daily lives. We are always working towards improvement and encourage feedback from everyone; you can see your ideas comes to life.

Working Hours

Monday to Friday, 9:00am – 6:00pm

What You'll Be Doing

  • Assess and underwrite second charge mortgage applications, using Open banking, affordability, credit history, and security property details against lending policy and regulatory requirements

  • Liaise directly with brokers, request further information, and keep cases progressing to completion within SLA

  • Ensure every decision is fully documented and auditable, meeting FCA and internal compliance standards (including affordability, vulnerable customer, and consumer duty requirements)

  • Provide clear, constructive feedback to brokers and internal sales teams on declined or conditioned cases

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of underwriting policy, criteria, and process as the second charge product and book matures

  • Work cross-functionally with Risk, Compliance, and Operations to ensure underwriting practices support both growth and good customer outcomes.

Skills & Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years' experience in second charge mortgages

  • Strong working knowledge of FCA regulation, UK responsible lending rules, affordability assessment, MCOB requirements, fraud prevention, and AML regulations, with the credibility to interpret and apply these commercially.

  • Proven track record in manual underwriting of complex, high-value, and non-standard cases, with the judgement to make balanced decisions beyond a tick-box approach.

  • Relevant industry qualifications (e.g., CeMAP, CeRER, DipFA or equivalent) are highly desirable.

How We Work

• We prioritise sound credit decisions and continuous learning from outcomes.

• We take ownership of our work and support one another to achieve shared goals.

• We work collaboratively across the business and contribute beyond individual responsibilities.

• We encourage open discussion, constructive challenge, and accountability.

• Strong performance and positive contribution are recognised and rewarded.

What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

  • Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership

  • Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Desired:

  • Artifact & Evidence Triage: Collects intrusion artifacts and forensically sound images to analyze malware, trojans, and source code.
  • Threat Intelligence Integration: Monitors external vendor data and threat intelligence to analyze trends and proactively defend against emerging risks.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Ireland or U.K.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

title: Security Engineer, Incident Response
descriptionHtml:
About Fluidstack

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

How We Operate

  • Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

  • Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

  • Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

  • Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

  • Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Security Team

  • Examples of key problems the team is working on

  • You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

  • Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.

  • Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.

Role Scope

  • Lead incident response end to end across corporate, cloud, and data center environments, from detection and containment through eradication and post-incident review.

  • Build the detection logic, response playbooks, and forensic tooling for an environment where the assets under threat are the most targeted model weights in technology.

  • Run investigations across a threat surface measured in gigawatts, correlating signals from cloud, endpoint, network, and physical systems into a single picture of an attack.

  • Stand up the incident response function from the ground up, defining severity models, on-call rotations, and the escalation path to leadership.

  • Turn each incident into a permanent improvement by partnering with the security and IT teams to close the gaps your investigations surface.

What We're Looking For

  • The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.

  • You've personally led major security incidents from first alert to resolution, making containment calls under pressure with the business watching.

  • You've built detection logic and response playbooks that caught real intrusions, not just theoretical ones.

  • You've run digital forensics across cloud, endpoint, and network evidence and reconstructed what an attacker actually did.

  • You've stood up or substantially rebuilt an incident response program rather than only operating inside someone else's.

  • You've hunted for threats proactively and found activity that existing tooling missed.

  • You write incident reports and postmortems clear enough that both engineers and executives act on them.

  • Bonus: Experience defending high-value targets such as AI labs, financial infrastructure, or critical infrastructure against nation-state threat models. Cloud-native forensics (AWS, GCP). Detection engineering and SIEM or SOAR tooling. Malware analysis or reverse engineering.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
descriptionHtml:
Help fix customer-centricity at scale


Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

  • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

  • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

  • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

  • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

  • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

  • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

  • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

  • It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

  • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

  • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

  • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

  • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

  • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

  • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

  • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

What we offer our permanent employees:

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size

To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions.

About TheyDo

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make.

We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’, never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘Simply to accelerate', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process.

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. We will never discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education, or race.

Our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive TheyDo includes making reasonable adjustments to the interview process. If you need any adjustments, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

If you are a woman or part of an underrepresented group, we encourage you to apply. Even if you don’t check every box — your skills and perspective could be just what we need to succeed. We value diversity and know you bring something unique to the table!

title: Senior AI Engineer (GTM)
descriptionHtml:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

 

The role:

We’re looking for an entrepreneurial and technically strong Senior AI Engineer to join our Data & AI team and work with our Go-To-Market organisation.

This is a builder's role, end to end. You’ll work closely with Marketing, Sales, and RevOps to solve high-value problems, design practical AI solutions and build them into reliable systems that people use every day. You’ll be expected to move comfortably from an ambiguous business challenge to a technical design, a working prototype, and then a production-ready solution.

Your work could include building systems that segment and prioritise accounts, developing agents that automate sales workflows, or creating intelligent tools that help our teams research prospects and act on buying signals. You’ll own the full lifecycle of what you build, including evaluation, observability, reliability and cost optimisation.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being close to users, can write production-quality code and is excited by the challenge of turning rapidly evolving AI capabilities into valuable commercial outcomes. Experience working with GTM teams is useful, but the ability to understand problems, build effective systems and measure their impact is more important.

 

What you'll do:

  • Design and build AI-powered systems for account segmentation, enrichment, scoring, prioritisation and buying-signal detection

  • Develop and deploy agentic workflows for use cases such as account research, outbound personalisation, call summarisation and CRM hygiene

  • Write production-quality code and build the integrations, data pipelines and services required to take solutions from prototype to reliable daily use

  • Optimise systems for quality, latency and cost through evaluation, prompt design, model selection, routing, caching, context management and token optimisation

  • Establish practical patterns for building AI systems at Paddle, including monitoring, guardrails, documentation and clear measures of business impact

 

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • Have strong software engineering experience and can independently take a problem from technical design through to production; Python and SQL experience would be particularly relevant

  • Have hands-on experience building applications with large language models, APIs, retrieval systems, agents or other applied AI technologies

  • Understand how to evaluate and operate AI systems in production, including managing hallucination risk, latency, reliability, context limits and variable model costs

  • Are comfortable working with structured and unstructured data, building integrations and turning information from multiple sources into useful systems

  • Have an interest in commercial problems and can understand concepts such as ICP, segmentation, pipeline, buyer intent and sales workflows; direct GTM experience is beneficial but not essential

  • Enjoy working directly with the people who use what you build, are comfortable with ambiguity and can balance speed, quality, and long-term maintainability

     

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

 

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

 

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

 

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

 

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

 

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

  • In APAC: Singapore

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

 

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

 

Compensation: CA$0 – CA$150K

title: (Senior) AI Engineer (m/f/d) – Remote
descriptionHtml:
What we do

MAIA is an AI platform for companies. With MAIA, teams search their internal data and embed agents deep into their processes. We help companies use AI not just in individual departments, but across the entire organisation.

On a technical level, this means: we build a GenAI application with our own agent systems, RAG pipelines and agent-based workflows, connect our customers' external systems and analyse their data. We use the best available models, operated in the EU, and make them reliable for demanding work with large, complex datasets.

Many industrial companies have been using MAIA intensively for years. Following our successful 2026 funding round, we are now taking MAIA to a broader market. MAIA has been developed in Leipzig since 2021.

What you'll do

As an AI Engineer, you develop MAIA further and help decide from the start how we solve problems.

What you can work on:

  • From concept to feature. Together with product management, you sharpen rough concepts and own features from prototype to continuous improvement based on feedback and usage data.

  • Chat and agents. You shape how people work with MAIA: asking questions, providing context and letting agents complete multi-step tasks, with traceable progress and verifiable results.

  • Unlocking company knowledge. You connect external systems and make knowledge from many different file formats usable. This way, MAIA finds the right passages, delivers answers with sources and respects existing access rights.

  • Models and quality. You integrate new language models and compare quality, cost and speed. With evals, you detect errors and systematically improve answers and agents.

  • Secure, fast and stable. You build isolated environments for running code and tools and improve response times and data processing, so that MAIA runs reliably even with large knowledge bases.

What we're looking for

  • Solid software engineering. You have built and shipped backend systems and operated them in production over a longer period. Architecture, API design, data modelling and asynchronous processing are familiar to you. You recognise weak architecture even when a coding agent wrote it.

  • Very strong in at least one of our languages. TypeScript, Python or Go, ideally one of the statically typed ones. You don't need all three. You'll get up to speed in the others.

  • At home in the LLM ecosystem. You have built real applications with LLMs, professionally or in complex personal projects. You know RAG, embeddings, vector search and tool calling from practice, including where they fail. You try out new models and frameworks on your own initiative and separate substance from hype. Production experience with LLM systems is a big plus.

  • Measure, don't guess. You know how to test and evaluate systems that don't always give the same answer to the same question. You build the simplest solution that solves the problem. Additional retrieval stages, prompt chains or abstractions only come in when measurements justify them.

  • Product thinking. You think about the person who needs to finish a quote under time pressure or clarify a technical question with MAIA. You like to get involved early in product management's concepts, ask the right questions and contribute your own ideas, even when not everything is settled yet.

  • Agentic engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You write plans that others review and that coding agents can build on, you review the results critically, and you know where agents help and where they don't.

  • Security-minded. Our customers trust us with their internal knowledge. Tenant isolation, access rights and secure development are second nature to you.

  • Remote-ready. You communicate proactively, document your work so others can follow it, and move things forward without constant coordination.

  • Clear communication. You explain technical topics clearly, including to product management, customer success and sales. You are fluent in English. German is a plus.

This role has no people management responsibility. Whether you join at regular or senior level is something we'll discuss openly with you after the technical interview at the latest.

Working at MAIA

We share a common goal: building a really great product. Everyone takes ownership of their own area. We enjoy our work and are proud of what our customers achieve with MAIA. Paths are short and decisions are made quickly. In the engineering team, we critically question how we develop and continuously improve our processes, especially in agentic development.

Much of the team works together in our office in Leipzig, centrally located between the city centre and the zoo, where we cook together almost every day. You work remotely from anywhere in Germany. You need to live in Germany for this role. Twice a year, we meet in person for team events, and from time to time there are team days in Leipzig. When your day starts is up to you.

  • Access to the latest frontier models and coding agents

  • Support for training that fits your professional development

  • Access to a Wellpass membership

Compensation

The annual gross salary is €75,000 to €95,000. Where you fall within this range depends on your level. We'll discuss this after the technical interview at the latest. On top of that, you receive a virtual share in our VSOP.

Application and next steps

You don't need a cover letter. Send us your CV and answer one question in a few sentences of your own: Why do you want to help shape MAIA?

We work with AI every day. For this answer, though, your own perspective is what counts. So please write it yourself. Short and unpolished is fine.

If there's a fit, you'll have a 30-minute intro call, a 90-minute technical interview and a final conversation with our management. After each step, you'll usually hear from us within two business days. Our goal is a decision in about three weeks.

We look forward to your application.

title: Senior AI Researcher- Pre-training (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

We are hiring a Senior AI Researcher to join our Pre-training team and to advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about designing inference-efficient architectures, optimizing training recipes that scale reliably, and training models on a large scale cluster (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture

We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organisational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues.

About the Role

As a Senior AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will own the critical technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

Working at the high-leverage intersection of research and engineering, you will translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions - from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs.

We are looking for an expert who can combine rigorous experimental design with high-quality production code, directly influencing model quality, run reliability, and the efficiency of the models we ship.

Your Responsibilities

  • Recipe & Architecture Optimization: Own core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization) and design PyTorch-based architectural improvements to maximize convergence, stability, and training efficiency.

  • Scaling Strategy & Predictability: Develop hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methodologies, using small-scale proxy experiments to reliably predict multi-thousand-GPU behavior and de-risk major training decisions.

  • Stability, Diagnostics & Debugging: Investigate complex convergence issues (loss spikes, divergence) and resolve hard-to-reproduce distributed system failures like communication bottlenecks, race conditions, and synchronization errors.

  • System-Model Co-Design: Partner with Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to align the model lifecycle with hardware constraints, memory bandwidth, and communication topologies.

Core Qualifications

  • You are proficient in Python and deeply familiar with PyTorch-based training workflows.

  • You have a strong track record in machine learning research and software engineering, demonstrated through shipped models, impactful open-source contributions, or published research.

  • You have a strong mathematical foundation and are comfortable reasoning formally about optimisation, scaling behaviour, and training dynamics.

  • You deeply understand transformer training dynamics, optimisation, and the behaviour of large distributed training jobs.

  • You can design rigorous experiments, reason clearly from noisy results, and translate empirical observations into robust training decisions.

  • Hands-on experience pre-training large models (e.g., 7B+ parameters) on substantial infrastructure (e.g., 100+ GPU clusters).

  • You apply strong software engineering practices, including writing maintainable, well-tested code and supporting reproducible experimentation workflows.

  • You are able to implement complex model architectures efficiently and reliably and to debug complex issues across model code, training dynamics, and distributed systems.

  • You collaborate effectively within a research and engineering team and communicate clearly about your work across Pre-training and the broader AAR/AA organization.

  • You are able to work in Germany and collaborate regularly on site in Heidelberg as part of the Pre-training team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Large-Scale Training: Hands-on experience training LLMs or multimodal models on large GPU clusters using distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan).

  • Predictive Scaling: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer, or methods for predicting large-scale training behavior from smaller proxy runs.

  • Stability & Performance: Experience profiling distributed jobs and diagnosing training anomalies like loss spikes, numerical instability, or optimizer pathologies.

  • Advanced Architectures: Exposure to sparse training approaches (e.g., Mixture-of-Experts) and an understanding of their routing and systems trade-offs.

  • Track Record of Impact: Demonstrated research excellence through top-tier publications (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR), impactful open-source contributions, or significant shipped technical work.

  • Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale.

What we offer

  • Become part of an AI revolution!

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub

  • Mental health support through nilo.health

  • Substantially subsidized company pension plan for your future security

  • Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket

  • Budget for additional technical equipment

  • Flexible working hours for better work-life balance and hybrid working model
