title: Senior Paid Social Manager | Cult Beauty
descriptionHtml:
About THG 

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. 

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. 

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.  

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

Life at THG Beauty 

We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.

By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin, with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.

THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader. 

 Cult Beauty

Cult Beauty is one of the UK's leading online beauty destinations, known for a curated, expert-led edit of the best emerging and established beauty brands. As part of THG, Cult Beauty combines an entrepreneurial, fast-moving culture with the scale, data and technology of a global e-commerce group. The affiliates and partnerships channel is a genuine growth priority for the business, with strong performance to date and significant headroom to scale reach, revenue and brand awareness over the next 12–24 months.

Why be a Senior Paid Social Manager at THG Beauty? 

The Senior Paid Social Manager is responsible for developing and executing Cult Beauty’s paid social strategy to drive customer acquisition, engagement, and retention. This role involves day-to-day management of paid social campaigns, budget ownership, and performance optimization across key platforms like Meta, TikTok, and Pinterest.

Working closely with Brand and Ecommerce teams, the Senior Paid Social Manager ensures that paid social activities are aligned with commercial priorities and deliver against key business objectives. This role is ideal for an experienced paid social specialist looking to take on greater strategic responsibility, budget ownership, and stakeholder engagement.

As Senior Paid Media Manager, you’ll:  

  • Budget & Forecasting: Day-to-day management of the paid social budget, including forecasting and reporting in partnership with the Digital Director.
  • Strategy Development: The development and delivery of the paid social strategy across all key platforms (e.g., Meta, TikTok, Pinterest).
  • Campaign Lifecycle: End-to-end campaign management, from planning and setup to optimization, testing, and analysis.
  • Partner Relationships: Relationships with key social media platform partners, staying ahead of new features, best practices, and investment opportunities.
  • Performance Insights: Reporting and insights on paid social performance to inform investment decisions and strategic planning.
  • Measurement Frameworks: Adoption and utilization of measurement and attribution platforms to demonstrate the value and impact of paid social activities.

What skills and experience do I need for this role? 

1. Paid Social Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive paid social strategy aligned with Cult Beauty’s overall marketing and business goals.
  • Plan and execute both always-on and campaign-specific activities across all relevant paid social channels.
  • Ensure paid social plans are aligned with the trading calendar, new brand launches, and promotional activities.
  • Collaborate with the Brand team to ensure creative assets are best-in-class and optimized for each platform.

2. Budget Management & Forecasting

  • Manage the paid social marketing budget, tracking spend against the plan and identifying risks or opportunities.
  • Own in-month and in-quarter forecasting of paid social spend and performance metrics.
  • Provide evidence-led recommendations for budget allocation based on channel performance and strategic priorities.

3. Campaign Management & Optimisation

  • Manage day-to-day campaign execution, including audience targeting, creative setup, and bidding strategies.
  • Continuously monitor and optimize campaigns to meet performance targets such as ROAS, CPA, and LTV.
  • Champion a robust test-and-learn approach, running A/B tests on creative, copy, and targeting to drive continuous improvement.
  • Analyze performance data to generate actionable insights and recommendations for future campaigns.

4. Platform & External Partnerships

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key platform partners, including Meta, TikTok, and Pinterest.
  • Stay informed about new ad formats, platform updates, and emerging trends to keep Cult Beauty at the forefront of paid social innovation.
  • Identify and explore new platform opportunities to expand reach and drive growth.

5. Stakeholder, Peer & SLT Relationships

  • Act as the key paid social contact for internal teams, including Ecommerce, Brand, and Creative.
  • Build strong working relationships with peers across the marketing function to ensure an integrated approach.
  • Confidently present performance updates, insights, and strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders.

6. Measurement & Attribution

  • Utilize attribution and marketing mix modelling (MMM) outputs to understand the true impact of paid social and optimize spend accordingly.
  • Work with the wider marketing team to ensure a consistent approach to measurement and reporting.
  • Translate complex data into clear, practical recommendations for channel and budget optimization.

7. Reporting, Insight & Continuous Improvement

  • Own regular reporting on paid social performance, budgets, and core KPIs.
  • Translate performance data into clear, actionable insights for the Digital Director and the wider business.
  • Stay current with industry trends and best practices, bringing new ideas into the team to foster innovation.

What Success Looks Like

  • Target Delivery: Paid social budget delivered within agreed COS/ROAS targets, with accurate and confident forecasting.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Strong, trusted relationships with internal teams that ensure paid social is fully integrated with wider business activities.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Platform partnerships that provide Cult Beauty with early access to new features and strong commercial terms.
  • Data-driven Decisions: Clear, evidence-led investment decisions that drive growth in customer acquisition and retention.
  • Innovation: A robust test-and-learn culture that leads to continuous performance improvement.

What’s in it for me? 

Career Development 

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team. 
  • Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider. 

Enhanced Leave 

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays. 
  • Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us! 
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.  
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave. 
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year. 
  • Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months. 

Wellbeing Support 

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.
     
  • Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.  

Other Perks 

  • Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.
     
  • Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1000 when they pass their probation. 
  • Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service. 

THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.

THG is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.

Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG please contact one of our Talent team to discuss further.

title: Senior Partner Account Executive, UK - Insurance
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role: 

We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Senior Partner Account Executive to launch, scale, and optimise partnerships across our ecosystem with a focus on insurance carriers and brokers. Samsara’s telematics and dashcam technology already help thousands of customers improve safety and reduce risk - this role will accelerate those benefits by developing high-impact partnerships that drive mutual growth.

You will be the face of Samsara to insurance executives, building scalable programmes that directly influence customer acquisition, retention, and loss cost improvement. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, are motivated by measurable business impact, and enjoy turning ideas into reality, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

In this role you will:

  • Own and grow our relationships with insurance carriers, brokers and MGAs in the UK
  • Design and run partner programmes that drive customer acquisition, retention and loss-cost improvement - and the Samsara revenue that comes with them
  • Map accounts with partners, pick joint targets and bring Samsara sales into the deals
  • Build the playbook: how we qualify, onboard and scale insurance partnerships

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact - helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your partners are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live. Samsara’s top employees do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You want to develop the playbook, not just follow one: Our partner ecosystem is young. You'll define how we take partners to value - from first conversation to joint customers - and build the model that lets those partnerships deliver maximum value for Samsara at scale.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your partners and our customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Strong sales, partnerships, or business development experience, ideally within a B2B technology or insurance-related field and a track record of overachievement. 
  • A builder mentality - you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale. 
  • Exceptional relationship management skills, with experience engaging stakeholders from the C-suite to front-line sales teams.
  • A strategic and data-driven mindset, using insights to optimise programmes and drive revenue.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously. 

An ideal candidate also has: 

  • Experience working in or with insurance carriers, brokers, or related financial services.
  • Consulting experience, ideally working with insurance companies.  

Why Join Samsara? 

  • Make an impact: Your work will directly improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in industries that power the global economy. 
  • Work with the best: Join a high-performance, mission-driven team that values collaboration, innovation, and results. 
  • Grow with us: We’re scaling rapidly, which means new challenges, learning opportunities, and career advancement. 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. title: Senior Payroll Specialist (APAC)
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Payroll Specialist (APAC) to join our team in Sydney. In this role, you will take full ownership of our APAC payroll operations, primarily focusing on our growing Australian footprint (~300 employees) alongside smaller regional entities across Asia.

This is a high-visibility, technical role. You will initially run Australian payroll using Employment Hero while collaborating with third-party accounting partners across the region. Concurrently, you will play a central role in our migration to Workday, transitioning our Australian payroll fully in-house for a targeted July go-live. Once live, you will own the end-to-end processing directly in Workday.

This position demands strong technical knowledge of Australian taxation, equity reporting (pre/post-IPO), salary packaging, shadow payroll, and termination compliance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. End-to-End Payroll Operations & System Migration
  • Support the transition of Australian payroll from Employment Hero to Workday (target go-live: July), assisting with data validation, UAT, and parallel payroll runs.
  • Once implemented, take full ownership of processing end-to-end payroll directly within Workday.
  • Oversee and coordinate smaller regional payrolls across Asia, working closely with local third-party providers.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for all employee payroll enquiries, delivering exceptional employee support.
  1. Specialised Calculations, Compensation & Benefits
  • Incentive Compensation: Verify bonus payments and calculate appropriate foreign currency conversions for payroll integration.
  • Terminations: Calculate and process all termination payments (voluntary, involuntary, redundancies, PILON, annual leave accruals), ensuring accurate tax treatments, tax-free thresholds, and Employment Termination Payment (ETP) codes are strictly applied.
  • Benefits & Expense Reimbursements: Review and administer vendor-based employee expense reimbursements, executing accurate gross-up calculations for benefits, where applicable.
  • Salary Packaging: Manage the end-to-end setup, ongoing deductions, and termination adjustments for novated leases.
  • Superannuation: Manage employee super choice elections, including setting up and validating new superannuation funds directly in Workday.
  1. Global Mobility & Shadow Payroll
  • Partner with our Global Mobility team and external tax partners to process complex shadow payroll calculations for inbound and outbound cross-border remote/mobile employees.
  • Ensure correct withholding and reporting of PAYG and state payroll tax for international assignees.
  1. Tax, Equity (ESS) & Statutory Compliance
  • Manage equity tax reporting for RSUs and stock options, including verifying and filing annual Employee Share Scheme (ESS) statements and reports with the ATO.
  • Reconcile, verify, and complete all month-end and year-end statutory requirements, including Single Touch Payroll (STP Phase 2) finalisations, Superannuation Guarantee contributions, and state-by-state payroll tax returns.
  • Perform regular payroll audits, support Australian Government statutory payroll reporting, reconciliations, and variance analyses in close partnership with the Finance and Accounting teams.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of hands-on Australian payroll experience managing high-volume corporate payrolls (300+ employees).
  • Australian Regulatory Mastery: Deep functional knowledge of Australian employment standards (Fair Work Act, NES, Modern Awards), ATO withholding rules, Superannuation Guarantee, and state payroll taxes.
  • Equity Compensation: Proven experience reporting RSUs and stock compensation in Australia, ideally across both pre-IPO and post-IPO environments (including ESS annual reporting).
  • Terminations & ETPs: Extensive practical experience calculating complex terminations (genuine redundancies, invalidity, notice periods) and applying proper ATO tax caps and treatments.
  • Salary Packaging & Benefits: Direct experience setting up and administering novated leases and superannuation funds.
  • Global Mobility: Direct experience running shadow payroll for inbound and outbound cross-border employees.
  • Employee-Facing Support: Demonstrated experience serving as the lead, employee-facing point of contact for complex payroll and benefits enquiries.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience processing payroll in Workday or other cloud-based payroll systems.
  • Experience coordinating small international payrolls across the broader APAC region (e.g. South Korea, Japan, Taiwan).
  • Experience in supporting WGEA reporting.

title: Senior Platform Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
AI FactoryOS Operations 

AI FactoryOS is Firmus' proprietary operating system for the AI Factory. It governs GPU telemetry, cooling, power and grid interaction as one integrated layer, so that every Firmus site can be optimised and monitored as a single system. 

AI FactoryOS Operations runs that platform in production and owns the 24/7 reliability of AI FactoryOS, Firmus AI Cloud and the platforms built on them, together with the service levels the estate is measured against. 

The remit is an engineering one. The function builds the guarded automation, remediation and operational tooling that turn manual response into a software-defined capability, and builds and operates the shared services the estate's own operation depends on. The function works closely with the engineering teams that build the platform, supplying the production evidence that shapes what they fix and what they build next. 

Senior Platform Security Engineer 
Role Summary 

Firmus runs large-scale, state-of-the-art AI infrastructure built on the latest generation of GPU rack-scale systems and operated as one estate to power the next generation of AI innovation. The Senior Platform Security Engineer owns the operational security of that platform.  The multi-tenant Kubernetes estate sits at its heart: production access, admission policy, workload identity and network policy in the live estate, and the operational security controls that keep it defensible as it grows. 

This is a hands-on senior role with deep technical expertise. This role owns security in production: the technical response to security incidents on the function's 24/7 security on-call roster, runtime visibility and enforcement built with modern eBPF-based tooling, the security acceptance requirements a release has to meet before it is authorised, the authority to grant or refuse a security exception, and the deepest technical escalation for security-related platform faults. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Lead the technical response to security incidents across the estate as part of the 24/7 security on-call roster: triage alerts and reports escalated from first response, distinguish a security signal from an ordinary operational symptom, contain the threat, remove the cause and recover affected services, working under the incident commander, who holds the incident record, communications and customer commitment. 
  • Preserve and handle evidence during security incidents, including logs, host and container captures and access records, with a recorded chain of custody, so that findings stand up to customer, legal and regulatory scrutiny, and provide the technical input to any customer, contractual or regulatory notification made by the accountable leaders. 
  • Own the security incident playbooks for the estate's main threat scenarios (for example credential or key compromise, a breach of tenant isolation, a malicious or compromised workload, and software supply-chain compromise), keep them executable by any engineer on the roster, and test them through regular exercises with the incident commanders and the wider function. 
  • Build runtime visibility and enforcement using eBPF-based tooling (for example Cilium, Falco or Tetragon), feeding high-quality signal into the estate's security monitoring, tune detection so that alerts stay actionable as the estate grows, and turn repeat findings into guarded automated response where it is safe to do so. 
  • Own the security gates in the delivery pipeline: image signing, software bills of materials, vulnerability gating and policy checks, and maintain the policy-as-code controls that govern what ships to production, running on the delivery toolchain operated by Shared Services Operations. 
  • Set and own the security content of the multi-tenant Kubernetes estate: admission policy, workload identity and network policy, and verify that what runs in production matches it. 
  • Set the operational security standard the platform's Kubernetes control planes and baselines must meet in production, validate against it continuously, and raise deviations as engineering requirements to the AI Infrastructure team. 
  • Validate the layered controls that limit the blast radius of a fault or compromise across tenant boundaries, test them against realistic failure and attack paths, and feed the findings to AI Infrastructure where the control belongs to the product. 
  • Operate the platform's security controls in line with ISO 27001 and NIST frameworks, applying deep expertise in securing large-scale GPU infrastructure, and produce the security evidence those controls generate for collation by the Service Delivery Manager. 
  • Provide the deepest technical expertise for security-related platform faults, lead post-incident review for security incidents and drive the resulting fixes to closure through the problem record, and mentor engineers across the function on secure design, runtime security and incident response practice. 
  • Provide independent monitoring of privileged activity across the estate, including on the identity, certificate and secrets platforms, using the access mechanisms built by the Principal Platform Identity Engineer. 

Skills & Experience 

Required Skills 

  • Strong experience of privileged access security, including least-privilege design, secrets management, and the auditing of privileged operations in production environments. 
  • Strong experience securing multi-tenant Kubernetes environments, including admission policy, workload identity, network policy and control plane hardening. 
  • Extensive experience with eBPF-based runtime security tooling (for example Cilium, Falco or Tetragon), including building detection and enforcement that feeds a security monitoring platform. 
  • Strong DevSecOps experience owning security gates in a delivery pipeline: image signing, software bills of materials, vulnerability gating and policy checks. 
  • Solid understanding of hardware-enforced or network-based tenant isolation, and how it interacts with Kubernetes-level policy. 
  • Experience with policy-as-code tooling for Kubernetes and delivery pipelines. 
  • Demonstrated experience as a senior escalation point for security-related faults in a 24/7 production environment, including post-incident review. 
  • Practical incident investigation skills on Linux and Kubernetes, including analysing logs, process and network activity, and container and host artefacts to work out what happened and how far it spread. 
  • Strong scripting or programming ability for security automation and tooling (for example Python, Go or Bash). 
  • Clear technical judgement and communication, with the ability to translate security findings and standards for engineering teams and leadership. 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience securing GPU or HPC infrastructure and multi-tenant AI workloads. 
  • Experience in a multi-tenant service provider, cloud or colocation environment. 
  • Experience with workload identity and secrets management patterns, and how runtime enforcement ties back to them. 
  • Experience with security frameworks and evidence production under ISO 27001, SOC 2 or NIST frameworks. 
  • Experience with incident response frameworks and practice, such as NIST SP 800-61, and with running incident response exercises or tabletop tests. 
  • Experience with digital forensics and incident response tooling for Linux, cloud and container environments. 
  • Relevant security certification (for example GCIH, GCFA, OSCP, or a Kubernetes security credential). 
  • A Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of relevant experience and training. 

Expected Outcomes 

  • Security incidents contained and resolved within the targets set by the severity model, with evidence preserved, the incident record complete, and post-incident actions closed by their agreed dates. 
  • Security incident playbooks in place for the main threat scenarios, exercised on a regular schedule, and executable by any engineer on the security roster. 
  • Runtime detection covering the estate, with an alert set that stays actionable as the estate grows. 
  • Every production release meeting the security acceptance requirements, with exceptions owned, time-bound, compensating-controlled and on the register. 
  • The operational security standard for Kubernetes validated continuously in production rather than asserted at design time. 
  • Blast radius controls tested against realistic failure and attack paths, with findings closed or evidenced to the platform engineering teams. 
  • Security evidence produced through normal operation rather than assembled before an audit. 

Location & Reporting 

Location: Based in Australia or Singapore, with travel to Australian AI Factory sites as required. 

On-call: The function runs 24/7. First line monitoring and first response sit with the operations centre. This role shares the 24/7 security on-call roster with the other Senior Platform Security Engineers, and works under the duty incident commander during major security incidents. 

Reporting to:  Reports to the Head of AI FactoryOS Operations while the function is being established, working under broad direction with a high degree of autonomy and direct access to the decision makers. As the function reaches its planned structure, the role will report to the Platform Security Operations Manager, with the Head of AI FactoryOS Operations remaining accountable for the function. The scope, level and remit of the role do not change under either arrangement. 

Employment Basis 

Full-time

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications  
from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future  
through innovative engineering solutions. 

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and  
cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

title: Senior Product Manager (Used Cars)
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE OPPORTUNITY

Used cars are the biggest part of the UK car market, and Carwow is going all in. We already sit at the start of the used journey: through Sell My Car, dealers buy cars from Carwow sellers every day. But today that car leaves our platform the moment it’s bought. The dealer preps it, prices it and lists it somewhere else, and the buyer finds it somewhere else too.

We want to close that loop. If every car a dealer buys can go live on Carwow in hours, priced to sell and matched to the buyers who want it, we become the place dealers source, retail and sell their used stock. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for a vertical we are fully investing in, and working day to day with design and engineering to build it.

AI changes what’s possible here. A dealer shouldn’t have to work out what a car is worth, write the advert or chase the buyer. The product should do it for them. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that looks like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to separate real dealer value from noise.

If you want to build a used car marketplace where cars sell faster and buyers trust what they see, and do it with applied AI from day one, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Obsess over dealers:

    • Spend time with dealers: visit forecourts, sit with sales teams and learn how they buy, price and sell

    • Run your own discovery through interviews, usage data and behavioural analysis, so every decision starts from a real dealer or buyer problem

    • Know when a dealer request would hurt buyer trust, such as thin adverts, hidden history or prices out of line with the market, and be willing to say no to the customer who pays

  • Own the outcome and set the direction:

    • Own used cars sold through Carwow and dealer retention in the vertical. Treat the themes below as hypotheses to test, not a roadmap to ship, starting with cars bought through Sell My Car listing automatically, which no other marketplace can offer

    • Set the product direction for the partner side of Carwow Used with your engineering manager and designer: what we build, in what order, and why

    • Make supply effortless: get dealer stock onto Carwow with no manual effort, through feeds and integrations, stock upload and cars bought via Sell My Car

    • Build the data products that help dealers trade profitably: what to buy, how a car compares with the market and how fast it is likely to sell

    • Own the metric tree for your area, from inputs such as time to list and listing quality up to cars sold, sell-through and dealer retention. Set OKRs from it, define the tracking for what you ship, and spot when a number is wrong

  • Build with AI:

    • Identify, prototype and ship AI that does the work for dealers: automated listings, pricing guidance, demand matching and buyer follow-up. Write the evals that define good before you build, make sure AI-written adverts are accurate, and keep a human in the loop wherever an agent speaks to buyers

    • Make AI your default way of working: run research, synthesis and data analysis with AI, so you cover the ground of a much larger team

    • Work with engineers on spec-driven development: write the specs and acceptance criteria that AI coding agents build from, review what comes back against them, and ship production changes jointly with your engineering counterpart, with tests and review gates in place

  • Work with the team around you:

    • Work as one of three equal partners with your engineering manager and designer. You own value and viability, and co-own the roadmap with the EM. Together you shape dealer journeys, test them before build, and make the right calls on data quality, integrations and build versus buy

    • Align data, commercial and account management on priorities, and explain strategy and trade-offs clearly in writing and in person

    • Manage upwards: bring a clear point of view, backed by data and dealer evidence, to senior and commercial leaders. When a request would not move the outcome, say so, offer the smallest test that would settle it, and bring people with you

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years in product, including owning the supply side of a two-sided marketplace. You have moved supply, conversion or retention metrics, and dealt with multi-homing or customers asking for things that hurt the other side

  • Your own discovery and analysis: you interview customers, query the data yourself, run experiments and can name a time the data changed a decision

  • AI-native: you have shipped AI to production with evals written before the build, designed for it being wrong, and know its cost per task. You use AI to cover more ground and have shipped production changes jointly with engineers through AI-orchestrated builds

title: Senior Propulsion Engineer - Electric Engine (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As a Senior Propulsion Engineer – Electric Engine, you will drive the development of the electric engine for the VÆRIDION Microliner. You will act as VÆRIDION’s internal technical expert for the complete electric engine, including the motor and controller. You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements.

Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. You will maintain a holistic technical overview of the complete electric engine, including the electric machine, engine controllers, power electronics, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, control functions and supporting hardware and software.

As a senior member of the Propulsion team, you will play a key role in technical decision-making, supplier management, testing and certification activities, helping to bring one of the world's most advanced electric aircraft propulsion systems into service.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the development and certification of the electric engine throughout its complete lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and certification

  • Act as VÆRIDION’s electric engine subject-matter expert and primary technical counterpart to the external engine supplier.

  • Define, maintain and manage electric engine requirements, interfaces, operating limitations and verification strategies.

  • Review and challenge supplier architectures, designs, calculations, simulation models, and substantiation reports, identifying technical gaps and proposing solutions.

  • Evaluate the electric engine performance across its operating envelope, including efficiency, dynamic response, control stability, thermal limits and performance margins.

  • Contribute to system safety activities, including Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA), Failure Mode Effect Analyses (FMEA) and System Safety Assessments (SSA), in accordance with applicable airworthiness and safety standards.

  • Identify and assess applicable certification requirements, means of compliance and industry standards, including relevant aspects of EASA SC E-19, and ensure that certification considerations are addressed throughout the development cycle.

  • Coordinate the electric engine development and qualification test campaigns, in collaboration with the testing team, including the definition of test plans, objectives, and success criteria.

  • Review and assess test results, identify technical risks and deviations, and coordinate the resolution of issues encountered during testing.

  • Prepare and review technical documentation, including specifications, interface documents, design reviews, qualification reports, and compliance statements.

  • Support prototype build, aircraft integration and ground/flight testing activities throughout the maturation of the propulsion system

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related technical field.

  • At least 8 years of relevant professional experience in the development, integration or testing of electric motors, engine controllers/inverters or integrated electric-drive systems.

  • Strong knowledge of electric machines and power electronics, including motor topologies, inverter architectures, operating characteristics & limits, losses & thermal behaviour, motor control strategies & protection functions, and manufacturing processes.

  • Broad understanding of electric engine development, including thermal management, insulation systems, high-voltage systems, EMC, mechanical integrity, reliability & durability, and system integration.

  • Experience defining and managing technical requirements, specifications, interfaces and verification strategies for electric engines or electric-drive systems.

  • Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers.

  • A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Strong analytical, technical-writing and written communication skills.

  • Excellent verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

  • Previous experience as a Certification Verification Engineer or in a comparable compliance-related role is a plus.

  • Familiarity with EASA SC E-19 and its application to electric or hybrid propulsion systems would be an advantage.

  • Experience in verification, validation and qualification of electric engines, including performance, thermal, endurance and environmental testing, would be a plus.

  • Previous experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or an international equivalent is a plus.

  • Knowledge of systems engineering and safety assessment methodologies, such as SAE ARP4754A and ARP4761, would be beneficial.

  • Specialized expertise in thermal management, high-voltage insulation systems, EMC, electric machine mechanics and vibration, or propulsion-system integration is an advantage.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Senior RF Engineer (All Gender)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

A

ABOUT THE TEAM

Ground Test & Prototyping. We are the engineering enabler turning theoretical concepts into battle-proven hardware through rapid prototyping, comprehensive environmental qualification, Hardware-in-the-Loop simulation, and physical testing.

YOUR MISSION

As our Senior RF & EMC Qualification Engineer, you will own Electromagnetic Environmental Effects (E3), Radio Frequency (RF) performance, and EMC qualification across our autonomous airframe fleet. You will bridge hardware design, in-house pre-compliance screening, and external military qualification campaigns (MIL-STD-461, VG 95373, DO-160) to ensure our unmanned systems reliably execute their missions in intense electronic warfare (EW) environments.

  • WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK
  • EMC & E3 Qualification Strategy: Define, execute, and own the formal electromagnetic environmental effects (E3) and EMC qualification roadmap across all STARK airframe platforms.
  • Pre-Compliance Testing: Establish and operate an in-house pre-compliance screening bench (near-field probes, conducted emissions, ESD testing) to troubleshoot issues rapidly during early design.
  • Test Plan Authoring: Author formal EMC Test Plans (ETP), test procedures, and qualification reports (ETR) aligned with MIL-STD-461G (RE102, RS103, CE102, CS114/115/116), VG 95373, and RTCA DO-160G.
  • External Campaign Leadership: Serve as the technical lead and authority during formal qualification test campaigns at accredited external test facilities (e.g., IABG).
  • Design-for-EMC Guidance: Collaborate with electrical and mechanical engineering teams to optimize PCB grounding, harness shielding, enclosure bonding, and antenna co-site isolation.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Education & Experience: Degree (B.Sc., M.Sc., or Dipl.-Ing.) in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or equivalent with 5+ years of hands-on experience in EMC testing and qualification.
  • Defence / Aerospace Standards: Deep practical working knowledge of military and aerospace EMC standards: MIL-STD-461 (preferred: Methods RE102, RS103, CE102, CS114/115/116), VG 95373, or RTCA DO-160G Section 20–22.
  • Lab Instrumentation Mastery: Expertise configuring and operating spectrum analyzers, EMI receivers, signal generators, power amplifiers, LISNs, current probes, and near-field sniffers.
  • Root-Cause Troubleshooting: Demonstrated track record of diagnosing and resolving complex EMI/RFI issues (common-mode noise, ground loops, aperture leakage, harness radiation).
  • Language Skills: Fluent English proficiency; German language proficiency is a strong advantage for interfacing with local external test houses.

NICE TO HAVE

  • RF System Integration: Experience with antenna placement, co-site interference mitigation, RF link budgets, or GNSS anti-jam architectures on unmanned airframes.
  • High-Intensity Radiated Fields (HIRF) & Lightning: Familiarity with HIRF testing and indirect lightning effects (DO-160 Section 22 / MIL-STD-464).
  • Automotive / Space Background: Prior qualification experience from aerospace, defense primes, space systems, or high-voltage automotive.

descriptionHtml:

We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.

At Quantum Systems, we are building the next generation of autonomous aerial systems. The Drone Port is a key element of this vision, enabling fully autonomous launch, landing, charging, health monitoring and mission readiness of our UAV platforms.

As a Senior Robotics Engineer, you will play a central role in developing the intelligence that allows the Drone Port and aircraft to interact seamlessly. You will work on perception algorithms, control systems, embedded software and sensor integration to create reliable autonomous behaviours that operate in real-world environments.

Working closely with experts from Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Systems Engineering Flight Controls, Embedded Software, AI and Flight Test, you will help shape one of the most advanced autonomous drone infrastructure products on the market. Your work will directly influence the future of fully autonomous BVLOS operations and scalable drone deployments worldwide.

  • Develop perception algorithms for precision landing, docking, localisation and environmental awareness.

  • Design and optimize closed-loop control algorithms for ground-based robotic systems and UAV interactions.

  • Develop embedded software for sensors, actuators and hardware interfaces.

Über uns

Die hairfree GmbH ist Marktführer für dauerhafte Haarentfernung¹ in der DACH-Region. Mit über 70 Standorten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz sowie mehr als 100 Mitarbeitenden gehören wir zu den führenden Anbietern im Bereich ästhetischer Dienstleistungen.

Seit über 20 Jahren verbinden wir professionelle Beratung, innovative Behandlungskonzepte und echte Leidenschaft für Beauty. Unser Ziel ist es, Menschen zu einem neuen Hautgefühl zu verhelfen, sicher, individuell und mit höchstem Qualitätsanspruch.

title: Senior Sales Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

Let's be honest: 2026 is a strange time to be in Talent Acquisition. Most recruiters are currently looking at their own internal dashboards with a sense of unease. They're seeing the pivots, the shrinking req loads, and the 'doing more with less' memos. If you're currently at a startup that's struggling to find its footing, or a business where the hiring bar has dropped just to fill seats, you know exactly how fragile that 'growth' story feels.

Samsara is the exception. We are a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy.

And we aren't just stable—we're expanding. Our UK Mid-Market team grew 70% year-over-year last year, and we need the talent engine to match that velocity. We aren't looking for someone to manage inbounds; we're looking for a recruiter who wants to move from a shaky seat into a high-conviction, high-growth environment where the fundamentals actually make sense.

The Challenge:

  • Self-Sourced: You own your destiny. You will be expected to find, engage, and convert your own pipeline using best-in-class tools like HireEZ, Juicebox, and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • The High Talent Bar: We aren't looking for CV pushers. You will be expected to act as a rigorous gatekeeper, ensuring that only the top 1% of gritty, A player sales hunters make it into our process.
  • Technical Assessment: You aren't checking vibes. You will be conducting deep-dive sales assessments, evaluating discovery mechanics, and ensuring every candidate has a structured methodology for success.

In this role, you will:

  • Execute & Deliver: Your mission is to fuel the Sales Account Executive engine. You will deliver high-quality, targeted pipelines at pace across EMEA, including the UK, France, Germany, and the Netherlands.
  • Own the Data: You are the CEO of your funnel. You will have total ownership of your response rates, passthrough rates, and talent market mapping. We make decisions based on data, not gut feel.
  • Partner with Sales Heavyweights: Work directly with our Sales VP and GTM leaders to align on hiring strategies that move the needle. You are a consultant, not an order-taker.
  • Master the Craft of Strategic Talent Acquisition: We hire for execution but develop for mastery. You will be mentored by some of the most sophisticated talent leaders in SaaS, learning how to move beyond execution to becoming a strategic talent partner who can influence the trajectory of an entire region.

Strong Backgrounds successful in this role:

  • The Agency Foundation: You started your career in a fast-paced recruiting agency. You still have that hunter DNA and the resilience to handle a relentless quarterly pace.
  • In-House Impact: In-house SaaS sales recruiting experience within a high-talent bar GTM organisation. You've proven you can translate agency grit into internal success.
  • EMEA Experience: You've successfully closed reqs in the UK and at least one other European market.
  • Technical Acumen: You can speak the language of sales. You know the difference between an order-taker and a territory owner. You have experience hiring for a scaling playbook environment and understand how to identify the elite within this market from the B players.

The Ideal Candidate is:

  • Foundational Mastery: The goal is to bridge the gap between execution and influence. You are here to build the bulletproof foundations of an exceptional recruiter—learning how to own a region, influence high-level stakeholders, and use data as a weapon.
  • Focused & Structured: You understand that structuring your inputs—sourcing volume, message personalization, and rigorous screening—is the only way to get consistent output.
  • Data-Minded: You study your own conversion rates and market talent availability to stay ahead of hiring needs.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You iterate on your outreach and your screening questions based on what the data tells you.

What's in it for you?

  • Build the Foundation for Leadership: We believe leadership is a set of skills, not just a job title. In this role, you will develop the data literacy to lead a boardroom with metrics, the strategic insight to advise VPs on market conditions, and the technical acumen to assess elite GTM talent.
  • Elite Exposure: You will be exposed to a broad range of international roles and learn from some of the best sales and recruiting leaders in the industry.
  • The Fortress Stability: NYSE-listed, GAAP profitable, and essential to the global economy. We are building for the long term, which means your career development here is backed by real revenue, not just a VC's hopes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Networked Systems (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Networked Systems to join the Core team within our Platform Team. Everything we build is a node: from small embedded devices to full compute systems and ground infrastructure. Together they operate as one network, in the field and over denied, degraded and intermittent links. You design how this works end to end: how nodes find and connect to each other, how trust propagates, how they communicate, and how every node exposes what the application stack needs. And you build it: the network itself, the node agent that runs on every node, the node API and the SDK.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • System design: Own the end-to-end design of how our systems connect and communicate: topology, links, transports, delivery semantics and failure behaviour. When a new requirement lands, such as operating a system beyond line of sight over LEO satellite or cellular links, you design how it works: latency budget, link selection and failover, security, and what keeps working when the link drops

  • The network: Build it: addressing plans, routing, segmentation and multi-homing across tactical radio, cellular, satcom and wired links, with dynamic routing and link selection for nodes that move and links that fail

  • Secure links: IPsec/IKEv2 or WireGuard overlays with certificate authentication from hardware-backed keys, including rekeying, NAT traversal and behaviour on link loss

  • Trust: Design how trust propagates from production to the field: device identity, certificate lifecycle, mutual authentication, authorisation tiers, revocation and signed commands that keep working without backend connectivity

  • Node agent: Design and build the agent that runs on every node and exposes identity, health, software state, connectivity and updates through one API, served locally, over the network and in compact form over constrained links. Devices too small to run it are represented through their parent node

  • Node API and SDK: One resource model for every node type, versioned and backward compatible across a fleet that never updates all at once, with SDKs generated from the contract for the languages our teams use

  • Discovery and directory: How nodes find each other with and without infrastructure, and a directory that survives restarts and shows what should exist versus what is present, at fleet scale without polling every node

  • Communication: Build on proven middleware and transports instead of reinventing them, define delivery semantics per traffic class, and engineer QoS so command and control traffic survives congestion on constrained links

  • Network as code: Configuration templated, version controlled, validated in CI and shipped as part of the system release

  • Verification: Network emulation that reproduces measured field link profiles, fault injection in CI, and network test campaigns at test ranges and flight tests with root cause from packet captures

  • Direction: Write the design documents and contracts that embedded, backend and application engineers build against, and review designs


  • Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 5+ years building networked or distributed systems in production, combining software engineering with hands-on network engineering, including technical ownership of a core component other teams depend on

  • Designed a networked system end to end, and can reason through a new connectivity scenario from first principles: topology, latency budget, failure modes and security

  • Expert in Rust, Go or C++, working proficiency in Python, and comfortable reading and writing C++

  • Strong networking across the stack: IP addressing and routing, UDP, TCP and QUIC internals, congestion control, multicast, NAT traversal, MTU and fragmentation; fluent with Wireshark and tcpdump

title: Senior Software Engineer, Proactive Security
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, as a part of Doordash, we're building the industry's most scalable and reliable delivery platform to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and courier partners.

What makes our team unique:

  • Our global Security team aspires to be the world's most admired security team, with members across EU, UK and North America (operating as Wolt, Deliveroo and Doordash).
  • We're shaping our next generation infrastructure that is hardened from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity - no legacy tech or off-the-shelf product solutions. There is a lot to do around this new development as well as our "classic" platforms of the three companies.
  • The greater team is not just information security - we're more holistic, and also physical security and safety are a part of our global operations.

This position is open in our Wolt hubs in Berlin, Germany, or Helsinki, Finland, and will be a part of the Global Security Engineering team.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Build and maintain core security products, including but not limited to Remote Access Management, Secrets Management, Tokenization, Encryption and Knowledge Graphs, Access Control at global scale.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Core Infrastructure, Product Engineering, Legal, Security teams and Vendor Partners to build "paved paths" that provide actionable feedback to embed secure design practices into the product and infrastructure development process.

  • Lead the technical direction and roadmap for your assigned area of ownership.

  • Build and maintain high Operational Excellence (OE) to ensure we operate T0 services with excellence, rigor and durable standards to ensure minimal to no downtime.

  • Participate in on-call rotation and promptly respond to on-call events with urgency and rigor.

  • Manage the lifecycle of security product feature requests and improvements full life-cycle from triage, validation, design, testing, and implementation.

  • Influence and drive improvements to engineering standards, leverage advancements and LLMs to improve productivity and velocity.

  • Mentor and coach earlier career engineers, setting and enforcing high standards for Operational Excellence and Software Engineering.

Over time, your role can evolve depending on your interests and skills. Our company is a large place and there's a lot to do!

As the Security team sometimes needs to address high-priority security issues as well as ensure the availability of the components we have built, this position includes an on-call duty. On-call compensation and terms will be agreed separately in accordance with the local employment law.

Our humble expectations*

  • Able to demonstrate a track record of driving improvements to a company's infrastructure security posture.

  • Breadth of technical experience across various infrastructure and security areas running in large production environments.

  • Highly skilled in distributed systems and platforms development using program languages such as Java/Scala/Kotlin, Golang, or Python.

  • Strong experience with infrastructure as a code tooling like Terraform.

  • Expertise with cloud infrastructure and management in AWS.

  • Experience solving complex, systemic issues that require creative thinking and solutions.

  • Exceptional analytical and investigative abilities with hands-on experience leading root cause analysis.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to review design documents with respect to cloud infrastructure, security and engineering personnel.

  • Must be comfortable regularly exercising discretion and independent judgment in performing job duties, including evaluating options, making informed decisions, and determining appropriate courses of action within the scope of assigned responsibilities with minimal oversight.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Senior Space Systems Engineer, Mission Optimization
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

The Mission Optimization team is responsible for continuously improving the operations and productivity of the world’s largest Earth observation satellite constellation. We identify, triage, and resolve the bottlenecks that limit what our fleets can deliver – from contact scheduling and downlink latency, to collection capacity, to concepts of operation for our future missions.

As a Senior Space Systems Engineer on this team you will own the definition of novel concepts of operations. You will take problems that begin as a customer commitment, a contractual obligation, or an unexploited spacecraft capability, and turn them into an operational concept that engineering teams can build and operators can run.

You will operate with substantial latitude, working closely with spacecraft and systems engineering groups to understand what current and future fleets are capable of, with the software and operations teams who build and run the systems you're changing, and with Product and customer-facing teams to stay anchored to commitments and SLA risk. Being effective across those boundaries is a core part of this job.

  This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Define and own concepts of operations for new missions, new spacecraft capabilities, and new customer products, from early design through nominal operations
  • Lead optimization initiatives that span multiple organizations – setting the technical direction, building agreement, and holding the outcome against fleet SLAs and KPIs
  • Serve as a primary technical interface for the team with stakeholders across engineering, operations, and product
  • Translate contractual and customer obligations into operational concepts and capacity commitments the fleet can actually meet
  • Model and analyze fleet performance with operational data to identify where capacity, latency, or agility are being left on the table
  • Design, develop, and maintain the software solutions that implement these concepts
  • Act as a recognized subject-matter expert across Planet and provide technical mentorship within the team

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in spacecraft operations, mission systems engineering, or a closely related field
  • Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
  • Ownership of concepts of operations for complex operational systems, from definition to implementation
  • Working proficiency in Python or a comparable language, ability to model systems, analyze operational data, and contribute production code
  • Quantitative approach, including statistical analysis and reasoning over large operational datasets
  • A track record of leading technical initiatives across organizational boundaries
  • Ability to communicate and negotiate technical positions with senior stakeholders
  • Experience mentoring or technically leading other engineers

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Experience operating or designing operations for a large-scale satellite constellation
  • Background in optimization, scheduling, or operations research
  • Experience taking a new mission from design through commissioning and nominal operations
  • Familiarity with commercial Earth Observation, tasking, or fulfillment systems
  • Experience in a customer- or partner-facing technical role
