title: Senior/Staff Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team

AlphaSense’s Design team is a strategic driver of product differentiation, shaping how the world’s leading companies make high-stakes decisions with confidence. We believe great UX is not just about usability, it’s about deeply understanding our customers’ workflows and building experiences that feel tailored, intelligent, and indispensable to how they work.

As AlphaSense evolves into an AI-native platform, Design plays a critical role in defining how AI shows up in real workflows, from search to synthesis to decision-making. We partner closely with Product and Engineering to turn complex data and advanced AI capabilities into cohesive, intuitive, and high-quality experiences.

Our team is a global group of craftspeople, systems thinkers, and innovators who care deeply about quality, velocity, and impact. We operate with a strong sense of ownership, a bias toward action, and a commitment to raising the bar for what great product design looks like in an AI-first world.

About the Role

We are seeking Senior and Staff Design Engineers to play a key role in shaping the future of AlphaSense’s product experience. This is a senior individual contributor role, where you’ll lead through craft, systems thinking, and technical excellence, building AI-powered experiences that feel tailored, intelligent, and essential to our customers’ workflows.

You will operate at the intersection of design, engineering, and product strategy, translating complex, data-rich problems into high-quality, production-ready experiences. You won’t just prototype ideas; you’ll define how they are built, scaled, and experienced in the product.

As a senior member of the Design team, you’ll act as a multiplier—mentoring others, guiding technical and design decisions, and strengthening the connection between user needs, business goals, and engineering realities.

Why this role matters

At AlphaSense, design is a core driver of how we win. As we build an AI-native platform, the quality of our user experience will define how effectively customers can navigate complexity, build conviction, and make decisions. In this role, you will help define that standard—through the systems you build, the experiences you ship, and the team you help elevate.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience in product design, design/UX/front-end engineering, design systems, or a related discipline.
  • A bachelor’s degree or higher. A degree in design, computer science, information sciences, psychology, or human-computer interaction is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with modern front-end technologies (e.g., HTML/CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, React) and evolving design systems.
  • Experience building AI and agentic experiences, and you are already leveraging AI to speed up and augment your end-to-end design and development process.
  • Expertise with modern AI technologies and ability to apply them to design problems (e.g., MCP, Claude Code, Codex, Skills).
  • Experience shipping production-ready experiences and influencing technical and design choices across teams.
  • Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, end-to-end customer workflows, and the ability to turn new users into habitual users.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

  • Create high-fidelity, coded prototypes and interaction models that bring complex, AI-powered workflows to life and clearly communicate product direction.
  • Own high-impact initiatives from concept through production, shipping experiences that reflect strong design thinking, technical rigor, and a deep understanding of customer workflows.
  • Lead technical design discussions, make architectural decisions, and guide cross-team implementation efforts.
  • Advance AlphaSense’s design system as a core piece of product infrastructure—defining scalable patterns, enabling consistency, and accelerating teams building across AI-native experiences.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to research and evaluate user requirements, translate them into effective designs, and ensure that the final product meets both user and business needs.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams during development, advocating for design quality and user experience by championing design fidelity and attention to detail throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment by helping teams navigate tradeoffs between technical constraints, business goals, and user experience to deliver high-quality outcomes.

  • AI-First Execution
    • Apply an AI-first mindset to how you design and build—leveraging modern AI tooling, agent-driven workflows, and code-based prototyping to accelerate iteration and unlock new product possibilities.
    • Partner with product and engineering teams to shape how intelligent capabilities are integrated into real user workflows, ensuring outputs are transparent, trustworthy, and usable.

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent.

We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites, with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far.

We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring a Senior Staff Engineer for our brand new Payments squad, part of Saldo, our Billing and Payments Service.

Payments at tem works today, but it's a basic service. We're growing fast, and it needs to be built for the scale we're moving towards. You'll be the first tech lead in a squad that already has a senior engineer and three junior engineers, and you'll own the outcome of the squad's delivery and the standards it works to.

This is a hands-on role. You'll write design docs, review code, solve the hardest problems alongside the team, and set the technical direction for payments. The number you'll move is the cost of processing every pound that flows through tem. Your job is to bring it down, and keep it low as we scale.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Set the architecture direction that takes payments from a functional service to one built for growth.

title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Pricing
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

🏅 The Role:

Rosso is tem's core IP, the transaction infrastructure that prices electricity for thousands of businesses, balances portfolios in real time, and sits on the critical path for every deal tem closes. Machine learning is at the heart of Rosso, combining forecasting, optimisation and classical ML to process billions of data points and drive thousands of automated decisions a day. Every inference shapes the prices our customers see, so you can immediately see the impact of your work.

We have proved the concept with MVPs and POCs to grow to 2% of the UK market. Now we want to take it to the next level and build towards a state of the art solution, to fuel our expansion in the UK and take Rosso international.

We're looking for a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer to lead pricing ML within Rosso, building a platform that proactively drives growth by targeting the right customers to sign at the right time. Your primary focus will be the pricing engine, which sets the fees added to every quote tem serves, carefully balancing growth and margin. You will also contribute to the systems which manage both short and long-term imbalance decisions to determine how tem deals with its exposure across its portfolio.

This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role. You own the technical direction of pricing by building it: most of your week is writing and shipping production code. It is not a people leadership role, and not an architecture role where others do the implementing.

The right person is energised by the greenfield environment: comfortable taking on ambiguity and able to make progress before the path is fully defined. They have built pricing, trading or optimisation systems that worked, ideally in energy or another market-driven domain, and have learned from the times they haven't. They'll bring that hard-won judgment to a system where the foundations are still being laid, and where early decisions compound. Success will be turning our current reactive system into a pricing engine which proactively drives growth by targeting the right customers to sign at the right time.

🚀 Responsibilities:

  • Own the technical direction for pricing ML: Define what to build and how within the pricing engine, setting the strategy and roadmap for pricing machine learning as a core piece of tem's IP.

  • Build ML systems for price optimisation: Design and implement models that dynamically set prices, balancing the trade-off between signing probability, portfolio balance and margin maximisation.

  • Solve imbalance problems: Develop probabilistic models to optimise risk management and short-term balancing decisions in a highly dynamic environment.

  • Bridge modelling and production: Own the modelling and data layer while working closely with software engineers and MLOps to ensure models are architected for production, contributing to system design decisions that affect performance and reliability.

  • Communicate pricing decisions clearly: Articulate model behaviour, assumptions, and trade-offs to other technical stakeholders so that pricing decisions are understood across the teams that depend on them.

🎯 Requirements:

Must-haves:

  • Deep experience building ML systems for pricing, revenue optimisation, or decision-making under uncertainty, with a track record of models that went from concept to production and delivered measurable commercial impact.

  • A quantitative background in a domain where prices, forecasts and risk interact: energy markets, power trading, batteries and flexibility, market making, or similar. Energy is strongly preferred and where our strongest fits have come from.

  • Strong foundation in stochastic optimisation and probabilistic modelling, with the judgement to formulate ambiguous business problems as the right mathematical approach rather than reaching for familiar tools.

  • Proven first-principles reasoning: you choose between stochastic programming, classical ML, reinforcement learning, or a simple heuristic based on the problem, not the technique you know best.

  • The engineering craft to match your modelling depth: production-grade Python, a high bar for code quality and system design, and the ability to work alongside software engineers as a technical peer across the full ML lifecycle.

  • Breadth across the full lifecycle: you carry the modelling and quant work and the productionising (deploying, monitoring, reasoning about the software systems around your models), and you would rather ship the whole thing to a good standard and iterate than perfect one component. You reason at the level of the outcome, the portfolio and its levers, not a single model.

Bonus points:

  • Experience with reinforcement learning or causal inference in applied, commercial settings.

  • PhD or equivalent research depth in a quantitative discipline (statistics, applied mathematics, physics, operations research, or similar).

  • Ability to reason about the trade-offs between optimisation solvers (Gurobi etc) and gradient-based ML methods (PyTorch etc), and the judgement to know when to reach for each.

  • Experience working with high data throughput systems in production.

✨ Benefits & Perks:

  • Salary: Competitive. We are looking to pay £127,000 or equivalent in local currency.

  • Stock Options: everyone on the team has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday + public holidays. Swap public holidays for ones that matter most to you. Plus, get an extra day off for your birthday 🎉.

  • Remote working: we're fully remote, distributed across Europe

  • Home working & wellbeing budgets:

    • Up to £1,200 / €1,200 annually to upgrade your remote setup (co-working passes, equipment, etc.).

    • Up to £150 / €150 monthly on anything that supports your wellbeing, from therapy to gym memberships to meditation apps.

🗣️ Interview Process:

Our processes normally take around 2-3 weeks from first call to offer. Please let us know about any adjustments to timelines that may be required.

  1. First call with our Talent Team (30 mins). This is to understand your experience, motivations, and discuss the role in more detail.

  2. Behavioural interview with our Rosso GM, hiring manager for this role (30 mins). This is your chance to really understand the role, the expectations, and ensure alignment on ways of working.

  3. Technical interview with the Team (90 mins). You'll meet with potential peers in this session and work through a live technical exercise.

We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.


The role

We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most.

Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform

Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations.

Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody

Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements.

Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure

Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap.

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience (8+ for Staff), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale
  • Strong backend experience with a statically compiled language (e.g. Rust, Go, C#, C++) is a must. Deep fundamentals matter more to us than your specific language history
  • Prior professional Rust experience is not required, but interest in Rust and motivation to become an expert in it are very welcome, since our services are written in Rust
  • Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, and asynchronous processing
  • Comfort working in domains where precision matters, such as financial systems, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, or similarly correctness-critical software
  • A pragmatic, autonomous, ownership-driven mindset. You care about outcomes, communicate clearly, and thrive on high throughput: on this team, features ship in hours to days and products in days to weeks

How we work

MoonPay Enterprise operates like a startup inside a scale-up: small, senior, high-throughput teams with real ownership, direct access to customers and decision-makers, and the backing of MoonPay’s global licenses, banking relationships, and distribution network. We move fast and expect engineers to act as product owners for their domain, not just implementers. This role is open as a hybrid position from our Berlin, London and New York offices.

title: Senior Trade Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us 

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world. 

AI at SharkNinja

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

About the Role

We are a social-first business, revolutionising how retail marketing is approached, and we are looking for a Senior Retail (Trade) Marketing Manager to lead our Pureplay vertical across the UK & ROI. Leading a team across our five pureplay retail channels, all three of our brands (Shark, Shark Beauty and Ninja) and a portfolio of 39 product categories, you will own Retail Media Planning and Trade Marketing Strategy for the vertical, bring a sharp commercial lens to everything we do, be our senior marketing relationship for the retailers, and partner closely with Sales and the wider marketing community to unlock growth. Social-first collaboration is a growing and exciting part of the remit. If it is not yet your strength, we will help you build it.

Here are some of the EXCITING things you’ll get to do:

Strategy & Planning

• Lead the Pureplay vertical against ambitious growth targets, owning the number and advising the business on how that growth will be unlocked across retail media and trade marketing.

• Lead Retail Media and Trade Marketing strategy and planning for the vertical across the full marketing funnel: setting the standard for what good looks like, guiding your team’s planning, calendar and prioritisation, aligning UKI execution with global objectives, and deploying investment where it drives the strongest commercial return.

• Be the senior, retailer-facing marketing lead for the vertical, building and progressively deepening relationships with the senior marketing contacts within your retailers, and using them to shape joint plans, unlock opportunities and position SharkNinja as a priority partner.

• Act as the sense-check on the viability of what the Strategy, Sales & Analytics (SSnA) and Sales teams propose: probing, collaborating and keeping a helicopter view to ensure full-funnel plans (including promotional and launch events across the year) are joined up, deliver the commercial volume objectives set by SSnA, align to the SKUs and volumes secured by Sales, and keep marketing investment where it needs to be. Develop and own the digital-channel Joint Business Plans with Sales.

• Align plans with the Brand Media and Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) teams to maximise the efficiency and impact of total marketing investment, working with them to adjust plans where necessary due to commercial or operational blocks.

• Champion data- and AI-driven commercial planning to sharpen investment decisions, forecasting and prioritisation.

Commercial, Social & Growth

• Bring a commercial lens to everything the team does, spotting opportunities and gaps, developing retailer campaigns and propositions that turn existing and incremental marketing budget into substantial uplifts in product orders and strong return on investment, and partnering and leading with your Sales counterparts (including the Senior Sales Director, Pureplay) and retailers on these conversations.

• Champion social-first collaborations with our retail partners (influencer, organic social and affiliate), amplified through wider full funnel (on and offsite) retailer-owned media activations to build reach, engagement and conversion.

• Own the digital shelf and content excellence agenda (PDPs, brand stores, search and content) and ensure flawless GTM and NPD support, with assets, listings and launch readiness delivered in time and aligned to launch dates.

• Lead the vertical’s presence at selected physical retailer events, partnering with Retail Excellence (Field & Branded Display) and agencies to deliver brand experiences that add commercial value.

Budget & Performance

• Own your vertical’s multi-million-pound marketing budgets, both contracted A&P (Co-op) and any incremental budget secured, ensuring your team plans and deploys them effectively and adjusting at pace to maximise every pound.

• Set the standard for measurement and reporting, ensuring your team reports spend and performance accurately and on time each week to the Head of Retail Marketing and the wider UKI Leadership team, where it feeds into regional and global visibility.

Leadership & Collaboration

• Lead, motivate and support your team (two Trade Marketing Managers and two Retail Marketing Executives across the five pureplay channels, plus a dotted-line Manager), leading from a place of empathy, owning individual development plans, setting clear objectives and building an unstoppable team.

• Work closely with the other vertical leads, and partner end-to-end with Sales, Brand/Category Marketing, SSnA, Studio, Brand Media, IMC and Retail Excellence (Field & Branded Display) to deliver joined-up, best-in-class activation.

• Act as the bridge between local execution and global strategy, connecting UKI pureplay activity to global brand media workstreams and representing UKI in cross-market and EMEA forums.

• Embody the SharkNinja Outrageously Extraordinary mindset and values, living our leadership principles (including ‘winning is a team sport’), comfortable with ambiguity, energised by rewriting the rule book, and bringing retailers, agencies and colleagues on the journey with you.

What You'll Need:

• Strong commercial acumen and aptitude with the ability to bring a commercial lens to everything the team does, see the opportunities and the gaps, and partner and lead confidently with Sales counterparts and retailers on commercial conversations.

• Experience in retail, trade or channel marketing, ideally within pureplay, e-commerce or marketplace environments (consumer electronics, FMCG or durable goods a plus).

• Proven brand-side experience, having worked in-house for a brand or manufacturer. Retailer and/or agency background alongside this is welcome and valuable.

• A strong working understanding of full-funnel retail media planning and the digital shelf to enable leading a team of specialists, define what good looks like and challenge the plans guiding where adaptions are needed.

• Proven people-leadership experience: managing, coaching and developing a team with empathy, including building individual development plans that grow your people.

• Strong budget planning skills, with experience owning and reporting on significant (multi-million-pound) marketing budgets;

• Excellent stakeholder management, able to manage upwards to local, regional and global leadership and outwards to senior retail and agency partners with equal confidence.

• Confident with fast-paced, test-and-learn ways of working (fail fast and small) and the agility and ambiguity that comes with it - we pivot plans hourly or daily across our three brands and 37 categories on the back of commercial, market, consumer and operational data, and act on it. This is the SharkNinja Outrageously Extraordinary mindset.

• Strong analytical, presentation and communication skills at leadership level, with a high level of ownership, entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to keep a helicopter view in a fast-paced, fast-changing environment.

Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day.  Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

What We Offer

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.  

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.

descriptionHtml:
Jobbeschreibung

Hey!

Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Unser Ziel: Gesunde, pflanzliche Milchalternativen, die nicht nur dir guttun sondern auch unserem Planeten. Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Aber das soll erst der Anfang sein! Neben der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produkte ist natürlich unsere Sichtbarkeit im Handel mit der wichtigsten Treiber für die Zukunft von vly. Hier beginnt dein nächster Schritt bei vly...

Deine Mission: Als Shopper & Trade Marketing Manager:in bist du die Brücke zwischen unserer Marke und dem Handel. Du sorgst dafür, dass vly maximale Aufmerksamkeit im Regal bekommt – durch überzeugende Argumente, aufmerksamkeitsstarke Materialien und aktivierende Maßnahmen, die unsere Produkte noch schneller aus dem Regal heraus verkaufen. Du berichtest an unsere Head of Marketing, arbeitest aber auch sehr eng mit Sales, Brand und Design zusammen und bist dabei eine der Schlüsselpersonen, die das große Bild von der Brand bis zur Regalplatzierung versteht.

Deine Rolle:

  • Du trägst zur Entwicklung unserer Trademarketing-Strategie für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz bei und bist für deren Umsetzung verantwortlich.
  • Du unterstützt unser KAM- und Field-Force-Team beim Entwickeln von überzeugenden Sell-in-Unterlagen und Category-Management-Argumenten für einschlägige LEH-Kunden.
  • Du planst und koordinierst POS-Maßnahmen: Displayaktionen, Zweitplatzierungen und In-Store-Aktivierungen (z.B. Gewinnspiele).
  • Du analysierst Marktdaten (Nielsen, GfK, interne Sell-out-Daten) und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.
  • Du entwickelst starke Trade Marketing Materialien (z.B. Sales Folder, Präsentationen, Wobbler) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Brand, Design und Sales.
  • Du organisierst und standardisierst unseren Auftritt bei Trade Messen und Verkostungen in Supermärkten.
  • Du beobachtest den Wettbewerb sowie die Regalentwicklung und bringst proaktiv Impulse, die unsere Sichtbarkeit und den Impact am POS erhöhen.
  • Du bist das Verbindungsstück zwischen Marketing, KAM und Field Force mit dem Ziel, effektive Maßnahmen auf Kundenbedürfnisse zuzuschneiden.

Deine Benefits:

  • Purpose: Es ist absolut essenziell, dass sich das Lebensmittelsystem zum Besseren verändert. Deine Rolle trägt direkt dazu bei, es gesünder und nachhaltiger zu machen.
  • Impact vom ersten Tag: Du baust Trade Marketing bei vly auf – keine fertige Struktur, die du übernimmst, sondern echte Ownership.
  • Echtes Startup Teamgefühl: Ein kreatives und motiviertes Team, das zusammenhält – inklusive regelmäßiger vly-Day- und Offsite-Events.
  • Teamlunch: Unser Highlight - jeden Tag frisch gekochtes Lunch von unserer eigenen vly-Köchin!
  • Mobilität und Company Fitness: Zuschuss sowohl zum BVG / Deutschland-Ticket sowie zu deiner USC Mitgliedschaft.
  • Moderne Ausstattung & Coaching: Wir statten dich mit Mac/Windows-Equipment aus und bieten individuelle Coaching-Möglichkeiten.
  • FoodTech-Community: Sei Teil einer wachsenden Bewegung, mit spannenden Events und Networking-Möglichkeiten.
  • vly-Flatrate: Genieße so viel vly, wie du willst!

Stellenanforderungen

Dein Profil:

  • Hands-on Erfahrung: Du hast 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im Trade Marketing oder Category Management in einer FMCG-Brand oder im LEH-Umfeld.
  • Expertise: Du hast bereits Trade Marketing Konzepte eigenverantwortlich entwickelt und umgesetzt. Displayaktionen, Sonderplatzierungen und kreative Materialien sind für dich kein Neuland.
  • Netzwerk: Du hast ein Netzwerk von einschlägigen Herstellern von Trade Materialien und kennst die Produktionsprozesse vom Design-Briefing bis zum Versand.
  • Daten sind deine Grundlage: Du kannst Nielsen-Daten und interne Daten lesen, interpretieren und in überzeugende Storys für den Handel übersetzen.
  • Mindset: Du denkst unternehmerisch und packst an – du wartest nicht, bis jemand eine Vorlage für dich erstellt.
  • Struktur: Du bist strukturiert, verlässlich und behältst auch mit mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick.
  • Stakeholder: Du arbeitest gerne cross-funktional und kannst zwischen Sales, Marketing und externen Partnern vermitteln.
  • Verfügbarkeit: Du wohnst in Berlin und kannst regelmäßig (mind. 50% der wöchentlichen Zeit) im Büro sein.
  • Sprache: Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprache-Level und sehr gutes Englisch.

Klingt das nach einer Stelle, in der du etwas bewegen kannst und möchtest? Dann meld’ dich bei uns! Wir freuen uns schon auf ein Gespräch mit dir!

title: Social Creative
descriptionHtml:
Intro

Wil jij als creative deel uitmaken van een snel groeiend en tech gedreven creatief advertising & content bureau in de Houthavens en samen met een leuk team werk maken dat opvalt, werkt én connact? ACT. Now!

Advertising, Content en Technology, samen met jou

ACT.agency staat voor Advertising, Content & Technology together. Wij geloven dat advertising en content via een geïntegreerde aanpak ontwikkeld moet worden, versnelt door technology. Met onze ACT.vertising aanpak zorgen we ervoor dat merken zich strategisch en creatief onderscheiden, always-on communiceren en zo consistent blijven op de lange én korte termijn. In ons kantoor in de Amsterdamse Houthavens werken we met 32 mensen aan accounts als Odido, PwC, Mercedes-Benz Trucks, Schiphol, Museumkaart, Noordhoff en Prinses Máxima Centrum.

ACT zoekt een medior Social Creative. Of ben je juist een medior creatief met veel social ervaring? Allebei kan. Want dat is ook precies waar wij ons als ACT begeven: tussen advertising en content, met veel social werk. Je bedenkt alleen of samen in een team het concept, schrijft het uit en maakt het zelf, snel en met de nieuwste technologie.

Taken

Als creative bij ACT bedenk je concepten die kloppen, de kern raken en waar iedereen energie van krijgt. Social is jouw vak: ongeveer 80% van je werk. De rest is breder creatief werk, zoals campagne-ideeën en pitches.

Je schrijft het script, pakt zelfs eventueel de camera en kan het ook zelf monteren. Van idee tot eindresultaat is het van jou. Je idee staat als t moet als eerste versie binnen een dag. Je weet wat er speelt op Insta, TikTok en YouTube Shorts.

Je presenteert je ideeën intern en bij de klant, onderbouwt ze op basis van de briefing en denkt tactisch mee, met gelaagdheid in je campagnes. Je spart dagelijks met de creative directors en werkt samen met strategie, account, social media manegers en community management.

Wij vragen

  • Je maakt zelf content en brengt een idee in korte tijd van concept naar een eerste versie

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en gebruikt AI-tools in je dagelijkse werk, bijvoorbeeld voor beeld, video, geluid of tekst.

  • Je schrijft soepele social en short copy

  • Je bent een nieuwsgierige, sterke persoonlijkheid met humor en energie, die goed kan samenwerken maar ook goed alleen kan werken

  • Je weet wat er speelt in het vak en je ideeën plus tone-of-voice zijn van deze tijd

Wat we bieden

title: Social Media Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du brennst für Social Media, triffst Entscheidungen datenbasiert und liebst es, starke Ideen blitzschnell und verlässlich auf die Straße zu bringen? Dann wirst Du Dich hier wohlfühlen.

Unser Ziel:

350.000 auf 1 Mio. Follower skalieren – mit zielgruppenspezifischen Content (v.a. Fokus auf Short Videos), datengetriebenen Entscheidungen und einem starken Team. Wenn Du weißt, wie Social Media Wachstum funktioniert, lies weiter.

Deine Mission:

Du entwickelst die Content-Strategie für unsere neue Brand-Ausrichtung und bringst TikTok, YouTube und Instagram auf Wachstumskurs. Statt Bestehendes nur zu verwalten, hast du bei uns die Freiheit, neue Formate zu testen und unser Team aus Community Management, Video-Agentur und Grafikern zu steuern. Perfekt für Dich, wenn Du ein System neu aufbauen und echtes Wachstum gestalten willst.

Aufgaben

  • Social Media Ownership: Du steuerst TikTok, Youtube und Instagram, testest Formate und optimierst auf Wachstum.
  • Growth & Analytics: Du analysierst Inhalte, erkennst Muster und steuerst Views & Follower bewusst.
  • Pulse of the Community: Du bist ganz nah dran an unserer Zielgruppe, reagierst blitzschnell auf Trends und stärkst Beziehungen mit Humor und authentischem Ton.
  • Creator Relations: Du scoutest passende Gesichter vor der Kamera und steuerst Agenturen & Partner.

Deine Ziele:

In den ersten 3 Monaten:

  • Strategische Weichenstellung: Du evaluierst unser bestehendes Setup und erarbeitest gemeinsam mit uns die neue, zukunftsfähige Content-Strategie.
  • Testing & Validierung: Du testest neue Content-Ansätze und etablierst eine klare Bewertungssystematik für deren Erfolg.
  • Struktur & Tracking: Du etablierst ein lückenloses Tracking- & Optimierungssetup, das uns erlaubt, Content ab Tag 1 datenbasiert zu steuern.
  • Steuerung von Partnern: Du übernimmst die Steuerung von Community Manager, Video-Agentur und Grafiker.
  • Wachstum: Du erzeugst erste sichtbare Wachstumsimpulse über unsere Kernkanäle.

Nach 12 Monaten:

  • Skalierung: Du hast unsere Kanäle von 350.000 auf 500.000+ Follower weiterentwickelt – mit einem stabilen, wiederholbaren Wachstumssystem basierend auf unserer neuen Brand-Ausrichtung.
  • Planbares Social Growth: Du stehst für datengetriebenes Wachstum: klare KPIs, wöchentliche Analysen und performancebasierte Entscheidungen. Du weißt genau, welche Formate funktionieren und warum.
  • Infrastruktur & Kanäle: Du hast kanalindividuellen Strategien erfolgreich umgesetzt und die dafür notwendigen Stakeholder fest im Griff.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Wirtschaft o.ä.
  • 2-3 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Social Media Wachstum mit klar belegbaren Ergebnissen.
  • Content-DNA: Du weißt, welche Formate performen, wie Algorithmen funktionieren und welche Trends relevant sind.
  • Analytische Stärke: Du kombinierst Kreativität immer mit Daten.
  • Ownership & Speed: Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und treibst Projekte ohne Micro-Management voran.
  • Growth Mindset: Du willst skalieren, testen und optimieren.

Du passt perfekt zu uns, wenn Du …

  • Social Media eigenständig voranbringst statt „Content zu verwalten“.
  • genau weißt, wie man Reichweite, Follower und Engagement steuert.
  • nie stagnierst – Du testest, optimierst, entwickelst weiter.
  • relevante Stakeholder zuverlässig koordinierst.
  • datenbasiert arbeitest und Learnings dokumentierst.
  • Energie, Humor und Drive ins Team bringst.

Wir sind kein Match, wenn …

  • Du keine Erfahrungen für Social Growth nachweisen kannst.
  • Du Social eher kreativ statt analytisch steuerst.
  • Dein Perfektionismus Dich blockiert und es bei Dir lange dauert, bis besprochene Themen wirklich live gehen.
  • Deadlines und eine extrem hohe Umsetzungsgeschwindigkeit Dich stressen.
  • Community-Arbeit für Dich lästig statt energiefördernd ist.

Benefits

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Arbeite aus unserem Büro im Frankfurter Ostend oder hybrid.

  • Feedback & Wertschätzung: Erlebe eine offene Feedback-Kultur und ehrliche Anerkennung für Deinen Einsatz.

  • Status Tracking – Keep RFP trackers and dashboards current so that the GTM Org and leadership always have visibility into RFP performance.

    • Infosec Questionnaire Support

    • Technical SC Partnership – Work closely with the Technical Solution Consulting team to respond to Infosec questionnaires, coordinating inputs and ensuring responses are submitted accurately and on time.

    • Question Routing – Triage incoming Infosec questions, handling standard items directly from the answer library and routing anything technical to the Technical SC team.

      • Demo Automation Platform Administration (Consensus)

      • User Administration – Manage user access and permissions within Consensus, Pigment's demo automation platform.

      • Content Administration – Organise, tag, and maintain content within Consensus so that demo videos and Interactive Product Tours stay current and easy for the field to find.

        • Content Creation & Video Editing (Descript)

        • Content Support – Support the creation of demo videos and other digital content, using Descript to edit and produce assets for the Video demo library.

          • Cross-Functional Coordination

          • GTM Partnership – Act as a responsive point of contact for AEs on RFP status, timelines, and next steps.

          • Legal & Security Coordination – Work cross-functionally with teams such as Legal and Security to route questions, gather input, and get RFP and Infosec responses reviewed and signed off.

Who You Are:

  • Experience: Entry level or early career (1-3 years). Some experience in the software industry or operational experience in an industry setting would be an advantage. No prior presales experience required.

  • Organised & Detail-Oriented: Comfortable managing multiple requests at once, with a strong eye for accuracy and consistency in written material. You must be able to work under pressure and manage tight deadlines.

title: Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Join the pre-sales team at a Series A industrial R&D software company, serving as a technical partner to prospective customers. You will connect deep chemistry and materials science expertise with value-based selling to help R&D organizations modernize data management and accelerate product development.

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical pre-sales process from initial demonstrations through value cases, technical evaluations, and pilot execution.

  • Build tailored demonstrations, workshops, and pilots around prospective customers' R&D workflows.

  • Partner with account executives and customer champions to communicate business value and support new business growth.

  • Lead technical evaluations and present how modern R&D data platforms can improve data management and innovation.

  • Mentor early-career team members supporting technical evaluations.

  • Write Python scripts and configure integrations as needed for customer engagements.

  • Travel 25% to 50% for prospect meetings, presentations, and workshops.

What We're Looking For

  • Four to seven years of relevant experience, including at least four years in digitalization, change management, or R&D leadership.

  • An MS or PhD in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, or a related field, ideally with a computational or machine learning focus.

  • Strong chemistry or materials science expertise and familiarity with enterprise R&D workflows and laboratory informatics systems.

  • Experience building and demonstrating technical platforms for enterprise customers, with a value-based selling approach.

  • Background in digitalization or change management, preferably in industrial R&D; technical consulting experience is also relevant.

  • Python scripting skills and willingness to travel regularly.

  • Fluent English and advanced proficiency in the relevant local language for European-based candidates.

  • Authorization to work in the United States, United Kingdom, or Germany. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $120,000 to $150,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Hybrid, based in Munich, Bavaria, Germany. New York or London may also be considered.

title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible - Cholet)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

🤝 Process de recrutement

● Une première rencontre avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

● Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec un(e) Associate Team Lead (1h)

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

title: Spezialist Werkstofftechnik & Prozessentwicklung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Remloy

Seltene Erden sind unverzichtbar für zahlreiche Zukunftstechnologien – von Elektromobilität und Windkraft bis hin zu Robotik und industriellen Anwendungen. Mit innovativen Recyclingtechnologien tragen wir dazu bei, wertvolle Rohstoffe zurückzugewinnen, natürliche Ressourcen zu schonen und unabhängige, nachhaltige Lieferketten aufzubauen.

Die Remloy GmbH ist Teil der internationalen Mkango-Gruppe und spezialisiert auf das Recycling von Seltene-Erden-Permanentmagneten sowie die Herstellung hochwertiger Neodym-Eisen-Bor-Legierungspulver (NdFeB). An unserem Standort in Bitterfeld-Wolfen betreiben wir eine moderne Produktionsanlage und arbeiten daran, unsere Technologien und Produktionskapazitäten weiter auszubauen. Für den weiteren Aufbau unseres Unternehmens suchen wir einen engagierten Spezialisten Werkstofftechnik & Prozessentwicklung (m/w/d), der unsere metallurgischen Produktionsprozesse und Anlagen aktiv weiterentwickelt und als technische rechte Hand eng mit dem Produktionsleiter und dem Produktionsteam zusammenarbeitet. Im Mittelpunkt steht das Zusammenspiel von Werkstoffeigenschaften, Prozessparametern und Anlagentechnik – mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und direktem Bezug zur industriellen Praxis.

Das können Sie bewegen:

  • Werkstoff- & Prozessentwicklung: Analyse und Optimierung metallurgischer Produktions- und Schmelzprozesse sowie Weiterentwicklung der Verarbeitung von NdFeB-Legierungen. Untersuchung, wie Prozessbedingungen das Verhalten und die Eigenschaften metallischer Werkstoffe beeinflussen.
  • Materialqualität & Produktionsoptimierung: Analyse der Einflussgrößen auf Materialeigenschaften, Produktqualität und Materialausbeute sowie Ermittlung der Ursachen von Qualitätsabweichungen und Prozessabweichungen. Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen für höhere Reproduzierbarkeit, Effizienz und Prozesssicherheit.
  • Technische Anlagenoptimierung: Analyse des Zusammenspiels von Material, Prozess und Produktionsanlage, Identifikation technischer Schwachstellen und Entwicklung geeigneter Anlagenmodifikationen. Praktische Umsetzung und Bewertung gemeinsam mit dem Produktionsteam zur Verbesserung von Anlagenleistung, Verfügbarkeit, Ergonomie und technischer Zuverlässigkeit.
  • Versuchsplanung & Datenanalyse: Eigenständige Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung systematischer Produktionsversuche. Analyse von Prozessparametern, Materialeigenschaften und Qualitätsdaten, Umsetzung datenbasierter Verbesserungen sowie Weiterentwicklung von Prozessüberwachung und Datenerfassung.
  • Technische Weiterentwicklung: Mitwirkung bei der Optimierung von Vakuumtechnik, Schmelzanlagen, Sensorik und Steuerungssystemen. Weiterentwicklung bestehender Produktionsverfahren und Anlagenkomponenten sowie Bewertung und praktische Erprobung neuer technischer Ansätze.
  • Anlagenbetreuung & Produktionsunterstützung: Unterstützung bei technischen Fehleranalysen, Wartungsplanung und Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktionsleiter und dem Produktionsteam.
  • Eigenverantwortliche Projektarbeit: Betreuung technischer Entwicklungs- und Optimierungsprojekte von der Problemanalyse über die Lösungsentwicklung bis zur aktiven Begleitung der Umsetzung im Produktionsumfeld.

Das bringen Sie mit:

Grundlegende Anforderungen:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Materialwissenschaften, Werkstofftechnik, Metallurgie oder einer vergleichbaren naturwissenschaftlich-technischen Fachrichtung.
  • Fundiertes Verständnis metallischer Werkstoffe, ihrer Eigenschaften und ihres Verhaltens unter unterschiedlichen thermischen und verfahrenstechnischen Bedingungen sowie Kenntnisse ihrer Verarbeitung, insbesondere thermischer und metallurgischer Verfahren.
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, um Zusammenhänge zwischen Materialeigenschaften, Prozessparametern und Produktqualität zu untersuchen und wissenschaftlich-technische Erkenntnisse in konkrete industrielle Verbesserungsmaßnahmen zu übertragen.
  • Interesse an industriellen Produktionsanlagen, Bereitschaft zur aktiven Mitarbeit im Produktionsumfeld und Fähigkeit zur Einarbeitung in komplexe Prozesse. Bewerber aus anwendungsnaher Forschung und Entwicklung mit ausgeprägtem Umsetzungsinteresse sind ebenfalls willkommen.
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsbewusstsein. Sie verstehen technische Probleme, entwickeln geeignete Lösungen und begleiten deren Umsetzung aktiv.

Wünschenswerte Zusatzqualifikationen:

  • Erfahrung mit Permanentmagneten, insbesondere NdFeB, Kenntnisse über Seltene Erden, deren Legierungen und metallurgische Eigenschaften sowie Praxis mit Vakuumschmelzanlagen oder anderen industriellen Schmelzverfahren.
  • Kenntnisse in Sensorik, Mess- und Regeltechnik, Automatisierung und Steuerungssystemen (z. B. SPS), industrieller Datenerfassung, IoT und Datenanalyse sowie Erfahrung mit statistischer Versuchsplanung (DoE), Six Sigma oder DMAIC.
  • Grundkenntnisse in CAD-Konstruktion und technischer Zeichnungserstellung sowie Erfahrung mit Wartungsplanung, technischer Instandhaltung oder Ersatzteilmanagement.

Darauf können Sie sich bei Remloy freuen:

  • Attraktives Vergütungspaket – wettbewerbsfähiges Grundgehalt, Bonusmöglichkeiten und Unterstützung bei der privaten Altersvorsorge.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung – hohe zeitliche Eigenverantwortung und ergebnisorientiertes Arbeiten.
  • Mobiles Arbeiten - Homeoffice möglich in Abstimmung .

  • Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung – eigenständige Aufgaben, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung.
  • Innovatives und internationales Umfeld – abwechslungsreiche und unternehmensübergreifende Aufgaben innerhalb einer wachsenden internationalen Unternehmensgruppe.

title: Sr Agent Architect (Germany)
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience - one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role

As a Sr Agent Architect at Parloa, you will act as a solution architect for enterprise AI Agent deployments. You will design end-to-end system architectures that connect Parloa's platform to complex enterprise environments, solve multi-system integration challenges, and apply systems thinking to build reliable, scalable AI solutions for global enterprise clients.

You will also shape the conversational experience layer, using prompt engineering and your knowledge of LLMs to translate customer requirements into agent behavior. Architecture and integration depth are the core of this role. Conversational design skills are valued and can be developed on the job.

Areas of ownership

  • Design end-to-end solution architectures for AI Agent deployments, mapping how Parloa's platform integrates into customers' enterprise systems (CRMs, ERPs, ticketing systems, contact center platforms).
  • Build and configure integrations using integration platforms and APIs, applying systems thinking to solve complex, multi-system data flows.
  • Collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineers on complex or custom integration scenarios that go beyond standard integration capabilities.
  • Apply structured testing approaches to validate architecture, integration reliability, and AI agent performance under real-world conditions.
  • Identify and resolve blockers together with other departments at Parloa (e.g., Product, Solution Engineering, Sales) and the customer.
  • Scope AI Agent deployments, providing strategic architecture advice and execution support to customers and partners.
  • Use your knowledge of LLM internals (e.g., embeddings) to analyze customer requirements and design prompts for reliable, user-aligned agent behavior.
  • Translate complex customer workflows into structured conversational components that LLMs can execute reliably.
  • Fine-tune conversational flows and voice output (e.g., SSML, Lexicons, Regex) to align with customer brand standards.
  • Document best practices, how-to guides, and product capabilities for internal and external audiences, representing the expertise of the Agent Architect team.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise customer-facing roles, with proven expertise in solution architecture, systems architecture, or enterprise integration.
  • Strong systems thinking, with a track record of solving complex technical problems across multiple systems and data sources.
  • Experience with complex SaaS implementations at scale (CRMs, ERPs, contact center platforms, ticketing systems).
  • Proficiency in REST API design, JSON/XML data structures, API testing tools (e.g., Postman), and API authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys, JWT).
  • Experience reading and consuming API documentation across enterprise SaaS platforms, including data transformation and field mapping logic.
  • Analytical and critical thinker with expertise in risk assessment and problem-solving.
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with a passion for meeting milestones and effective communication.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with initiative, results orientation, and ability to identify opportunities for impact.
  • Ability to analyze customer requirements and translate them into LLM prompts and conversational flows, with attention to subtle conversational nuance and A/B testing to assess agent performance. 
  • Prior conversation design, prompt engineering (e.g., chain-of-thought, few-shot learning), or A/B testing experience is a plus, not a requirement - we will train this.
  • Fluency in German and English is required 

Our Recruiting Process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

title: Sr. Compliance Consultant
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity.

Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance.

We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth.

Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures.

 

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Compliance Consultant to help our clients navigate regulatory change, horizon-scan upcoming regulation, and overcome regulatory challenges so they can transform their businesses and meet their strategic growth objectives.

This is a versatile, high-impact role at the intersection of regulation, client advisory, practical delivery and product strategy. Your mission is to deeply understand our clients’ needs and regulatory obligations, and to deliver solutions that help them achieve their compliance and business outcomes. You’ll stay ahead of the risk and compliance landscape, translating regulatory change into clear guidance for our customers and concrete requirements for our Product team.

Whether you’re shaping a client’s regulatory strategy or influencing our product roadmap, you’ll bring deep knowledge and hands-on experience of financial crime compliance, along with strong commercial awareness. Acting as an in-house consultant, you’ll connect long-term regulatory horizons with granular operational realities.

 

As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move comfortably between complex challenges, and have the judgement to turn them into sharp, practical solutions. You’ll also work on long-horizon strategic projects, such as building government relationships and expanding Condukt’s global data footprint, where progress is measured in weeks, not months.

If you thrive in dynamic environments where no two days look the same, enjoy tackling a constant stream of new and complex problems, and want to help shape how financial institutions and fintechs approach compliance, this role is for you.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Act as Condukt’s subject matter expert on KYB/KYC and AML/CFT, giving clients clear, commercially minded advice on their regulatory obligations

  • Lead client engagements end to end, from understanding the business challenge and assessing current controls to designing solutions that combine Condukt’s platform with third-party providers and supporting their implementation

  • Produce high-quality, client-ready deliverables, such as gap analyses, risk assessments, onboarding and monitoring frameworks, policies and decision papers

  • Run workshops with client stakeholders, from compliance teams to the C-suite, turning discussion into practical next steps

  • Horizon-scan regulation across the UK, Europe and beyond, and brief clients on what’s coming and what it means for them, directly or alongside our commercial team

  • Advise clients on their compliance stack, testing and benchmarking providers through structured, RFP-style evaluations

  • Build and maintain relationships with regulators, government bodies and company registers to secure access to data, expand Condukt’s global footprint and represent Condukt in industry forums

  • Shape Condukt’s advisory proposition, identifying emerging client needs and opportunities to bring new capabilities to existing clients alongside our commercial team

  • Partner with Product to translate regulatory and client needs into the signals, data and capabilities we build

  • Contribute to business development and thought leadership with a clear, well-argued point of view on regulation, through proposals, client pitches, whitepapers, briefings, webinars and industry events

 

What you bring:

  • 4+ years’ experience in financial crime compliance, gained in a consultancy, a regulator or a regulated financial services firm

  • Deep domain expertise in risk and compliance, ideally across KYB/KYC, AML/CFT or business onboarding in financial services

  • A track record of advising financial institutions and fintechs on risk, compliance or regulatory matters, with a toolkit of structured frameworks you can adapt to a fast-growing company

  • Experience leading client engagements and producing polished, client-ready deliverables

  • Experience advising on vendor assessment and selection, including running or contributing to RFP processes

  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with C-suite stakeholders, regulators and government agencies

  • Strong commercial awareness: you can turn regulatory requirements into solutions clients see real value in

  • A legal background, or solid working knowledge of financial regulation and how legislation translates into operational requirements

  • Sound judgement and tact in sensitive situations: you know what to communicate, to whom and when

  • The analytical rigour to dig into complex legislation and question established interpretations

  • A self-starter mindset that thrives in fast-moving, high-ownership environments

Bonus:

  • Experience in government relations or regulatory affairs

  • Prior experience in fintech, banking, payments or compliance infrastructure

  • Early-stage startup experience

  • Second language proficiency (German, French, and Dutch, especially valued)

 

Our offer:

  • Tackle meaningful problems with real-world impact

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Flat hierarchy with direct access to the founders

  • Top-of-the-line equipment

  • Private health insurance, plus sick and compassionate leave as needed

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you'll do

Kaluza runs the billing and payments engine behind some of the world's biggest energy retailers. This role builds and evolves the platform other engineering teams build on top of: the shared APIs, integration patterns, and technical standards that let billing and payments capability get built once and reused everywhere, instead of rebuilt separately for every new market or client relationship.

That matters because of where Kaluza is headed: as we grow into new markets and take on more of the world's largest energy retailers as clients, having a consistent, well-designed API platform is what lets new capability get adopted quickly and safely across every team that needs it, rather than each team solving integration and standards problems on its own. Getting this right directly shapes how fast Kaluza can extend billing and payments capability to new markets and clients.

We're also in the middle of reorganising how this part of the business works, moving toward one shared global core that every market configures rather than rebuilds. This role's remit, API platform and standards, is one of the technical foundations that shift depends on. Responsibilities include:

  • You'll own system design and architecture for the API Platform and Standards squad, not just a single service.

  • You'll create and challenge product and engineering proposals, backing design trade-offs with data.

  • You'll diagnose and resolve complex technical and product issues, including in areas outside your immediate domain.

  • You'll establish architectural patterns and technical standards that other teams build on top of.

  • You'll take ambiguous, loosely-defined technical requirements and turn them into a concrete plan others can execute against.

  • You'll influence engineering leadership, product, and adjacent squads to bring clarity and alignment on technical direction.

What you'll bring
Ideally you’ll have:

  • Deep technical expertise applied to system design and architecture ownership across a squad, not just a single team or service.

  • Be able to create and challenge product and engineering proposals and make design trade-offs, backed by data.

  • A track record diagnosing and resolving complex technical and product issues, including in domains you aren't already close to.

  • Be skilled at establishing and driving adoption of architectural patterns and technical standards that other teams build on top of.

  • Be comfortable taking ambiguous, loosely-defined technical requirements and turning them into a concrete plan others can execute against.

  • Be accomplished at influencing both upwards and outwards, bringing clarity and alignment to engineering leadership, product, and adjacent squads on technical direction.

What will set you apart 

  • Direct experience with API gateway, versioning, or developer-experience standards work at scale.

  • Direct experience in billing, payments, or financial-services domains.

  • Experience operating a "global core, configurable edge" or multi-market platform model (one engine, configuration at the edge, no client-specific forks of core logic).


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:
