title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Pricing
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent.

We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites, with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far.

We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🏅 The Role:

We're hiring a Staff Machine Learning Engineer (L4) for Pricing in Rosso.

Rosso is tem's core IP. It forecasts prices and volumes, holds a live view of our portfolio, and sets the fees on every quote. You'll join the pricing ML team and own key components of our dynamic pricing system. The direction is set. Within your components, choosing the bets and proving whether they worked is yours. This is a hands-on role. Most of your week will be writing and shipping production code, and you'll stay accountable for what that code does once it's live.

You will:

  • Own key components of our dynamic pricing system end to end, from design through to running them in production.

  • Choose the bets within those components most likely to reduce sales adjustment, and show whether they worked.

  • Make your components observable, guarded and replayable, so a wrong price is caught before a customer sees it.

  • Unblock your own delivery across engineering, platform and commercial teams.

You will report into the ML Leader for Rosso.

🚀 Responsibilities:

  • Own key components of dynamic pricing

    • Take ownership of one or more core components, such as the models that learn from won and lost deals, the experimentation and measurement layer, or the live guardrails that keep price changes safe.

    • Within your components, choose between competing bets based on which is most likely to move the metric, and stop the ones that don't.

    • Design experiments and holdouts that work with low-volume, high-value deals, where a textbook A/B test often isn't possible.

    Run it live, safely

    • Build the monitoring, alerting, guardrails and staged release your components need. That includes detecting drift, catching runaway feedback loops and holding unexpected price moves for review.

    • Make any pricing decision your components produce reproducible after the fact, for debugging and for regulators.

    • Work with the Price Quoting squad and ML Platform so models are built for production from the start, not handed over at the end.

    Close the loop with the business

    • Find out why sales teams adjust prices, and turn those reasons into model inputs or new bets.

    • Explain model behaviour and trade-offs to engineers, product and commercial colleagues clearly enough that they can act on it.

    • Redesign the team's recurring pricing workflows with AI built in, such as feedback triage, daily price review and experiment write-ups. Decide which steps stay human.🎯

🎯 Requirements:

Must-haves:

  • You build. Most of your current role is writing and shipping production code, and you want to keep it that way. This is not a people leadership role or an architecture role where others implement.

  • You have owned a live ML system that made automated decisions with money attached, for example in algorithmic trading, dynamic pricing, marketplaces, ad bidding, credit or betting. You have dealt with its failures in production, such as feedback loops, silent drift, bad outputs reaching customers and rollbacks, and changed how you build because of them.

  • Strong probabilistic modelling and decision-making under uncertainty, such as pricing, conversion or elasticity modelling, and experimentation. You formulate the problem from first principles and pick the simplest approach that works.

  • You've run ML as production services on modern cloud infrastructure: containerised models behind APIs, event-driven microservices, infrastructure as code and CI/CD on AWS or similar. Your model changes go through the same pipeline, tests and rollback as any other code, so shipping one on a Thursday afternoon is routine.

  • Production-grade Python, and a habit of designing for observability, testing and replay. You work as a peer with software engineers.

  • A track record of moving a commercial metric, working alongside product managers and commercial stakeholders to get there.

  • You use AI tooling as a day-to-day multiplier on your own work, and you know where it fails.

Energy experience is not required. We will teach you the market. What we can't teach quickly is the judgement that comes from running a live pricing or trading system.

Bonus points:

  • Experience in energy, commodities or other markets where prices, forecasts and risk interact.

  • Contextual bandits, causal inference or Bayesian methods used in production.

  • Stochastic optimisation or operations research.

  • A PhD in a field such as maths, physics, computer science or operations research.

✨ Benefits & Perks:

  • Salary: Competitive. We are looking to pay £115,000 or equivalent in local currency.

  • Stock Options: everyone on the team has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday + public holidays. Swap public holidays for ones that matter most to you. Plus, get an extra day off for your birthday 🎉.

  • Remote working: we're fully remote, distributed across Europe

  • Home working & wellbeing budgets:

    • Up to £1,200 / €1,200 annually to upgrade your remote setup (co-working passes, equipment, etc.).

    • Up to £150 / €150 monthly on anything that supports your wellbeing, from therapy to gym memberships to meditation apps.

🗣️ Interview Process:

Our processes normally take around 2-3 weeks from first call to offer. Please let us know about any adjustments to timelines that may be required.

  1. First call with our Talent Team (30 mins). This is to understand your experience, motivations, and discuss the role in more detail.

  2. Behavioural interview with our Rosso GM, hiring manager for this role (30 mins). This is your chance to really understand the role, the expectations, and ensure alignment on ways of working.

  3. Technical interview with the Team (90 mins). You'll meet with potential peers in this session and work through a live technical exercise.

  4. Bar Raiser interview with Stakeholders (45 mins). The final session will be with two cross-functional stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

As our Staff Robotic Sales Engineer (m/f/d), you are RobCo's most senior technical voice in sales, owning your own deals alongside Account Executives while setting the technical standards that make the whole Robotics Sales Engineering team stronger. If something is broken, you fix it. If something can be automated, you build it.

This is a technical leadership role without people management. You keep a quota with your own Account Executives, and a fixed part of your time goes into raising the technical bar across the team. You work where modular robotics, software and AI come together, and you help bring physical AI from the lab into real production. Sales leadership turns to you first when they want to know how strong the pipeline really is.

  • A track record as the person colleagues turn to when a feasibility question gets hard

Why join RobCo?

title: Strategic Project Manager - Strategic Planning & Insights
descriptionHtml:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot,based on 55,000+ reviews. Our cultureputs customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 byAlexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 

Join us as a Strategic Project Manager – Strategic Planning & Insights to help shape Qonto’s strategy and turn priorities into action. Working with Fanny, our Strategy Director, and senior stakeholders across Qonto, you’ll assess opportunities, inform key decisions and lead cross-functional projects through to execution.

You’ll join a Strategy talent pool where you can learn quickly, collaborate across teams and potentially grow into another function over time, such as Growth, Operations, Product or Tech.

➡️ What you’ll do

  • Shape strategic planning and priorities: Contribute to Qonto’s strategic planning process, help define company-wide priorities and turn them into company OKRs and key projects. Track progress and help assess when priorities need to evolve. Work with Corporate Development to articulate Qonto’s vision and strategy for internal and external audiences.

  • Build market and strategic insights: Analyze market trends, customer needs and Qonto’s competitive position to assess opportunities, develop clear and actionable recommendations and support decision-making, particularly for Product, Growth, Ops and Corporate Development.

  • Drive strategic projects from framing to execution: Lead cross-functional initiatives or bring strategic input to unblock a team’s project across new products and adjacencies, growth acceleration and operational efficiency.

➡️ What we’re looking for

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm and/or as a strategic project manager in a startup or company. Experience in banking or financial services is a plus, not a requirement; curiosity about the sector is important.

  • Strategic thinking & analysis: You enjoy exploring complex questions, combining market and customer insights with quantitative and financial analysis to build structured, actionable recommendations.

  • Communication & synthesis: You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and can structure and present insights to a range of audiences, including senior stakeholders.

  • Project & stakeholder management: You can lead cross-functional projects with autonomy, bring people together around shared goals and break down silos to move work forward.

  • Ownership & pragmatism: You’re proactive, detail-oriented and hands-on. You take responsibility for moving from an idea or recommendation to concrete action and follow through on delivery.

  • Curiosity & AI: You’re eager to learn, explore new opportunities and experiment with AI in your work. Advanced AI expertise is not required.

  • Languages: Fluent English is required; French or another European language is a plus.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Team & impact: Join a Strategy team working on high-impact topics across Qonto, from strategic planning and new products to growth acceleration and operational efficiency.

  • Exposure & collaboration: Work closely with senior management and colleagues across functions on a variety of strategic challenges in an international fintech environment.

  • From strategy to execution: Stay close to the business and see your recommendations move beyond the slide deck into real projects and outcomes.

  • Learning & growth: Benefit from coaching and exposure to different areas of Qonto, with opportunities to grow within the Strategy team and potentially explore roles in other functions over time.

  • AI & ways of working: Experiment with AI on projects and exchange practices with the team during strategy office hours.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Fanny De Vesinne-Larüe, our Strategy Director.

  • Her background: Fanny has been at Qonto for four years, spotting new opportunities and driving key projects to help Qonto accelerate. Before joining Qonto, she held roles across strategy, marketing, venture and e-business at financial institutions including AXA and BNP Paribas, working with fintechs and startups.

  • What she brings to the team: Fanny supports team members through coaching, exposure to different functions and conversations about their development and potential future moves within Qonto.

title: Strategy Analyst - Operations Strategy & CRM
descriptionHtml:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Our Operations teams deliver exceptional customer service, and the Operations Strategy & CRM team helps make that possible. We exist to understand Operations performance, find efficiencies and improve the service our customers receive. Our contact strategy is a core part of this, reaching customers at every stage, from sign-up to collections. Getting this right means customers get what they need without having to get in touch, so our teams can focus where they add most value.

The role

As a Strategy Analyst, you’ll run the projects that decide when and how iwoca contacts its customers through our in-house CRM system. You’ll steer which experiments the team runs, with customer lifetime value as your key metric. You’ll work closely with the Senior CRM Executive, who will bring your changes to life in the messages customers receive. The role will include:

  • Contact strategy. You’ll find the points in the customer journey where a message adds the most value. You’ll weigh the conversion a message brings against the risk of contacting customers too often. You’ll balance short-term gains against long-term customer value, and decide when an automated message is enough and when a person from Operations should step in.

  • Model-driven emails. We’ve started using a model to choose who receives some of our emails. You’ll be responsible for understanding where this approach works well, and collaborate with the data science team to make any improvements.

  • Split tests. You’ll design, run, and interpret controlled experiments on customer contact. For example, you might test the timing and content of emails at key points in the customer journey. You’ll apply statistical thinking so decisions rest on evidence.

  • Ownership and growth. You’ll manage analytical and strategic projects end-to-end. You’ll share findings and recommendations directly with senior leadership, and join iwoca’s wider community of analysts and data scientists.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Commercial experience. You’ve worked in strategy, analytics, product, finance, or consulting. You understand how to use data to make commercial decisions on revenue, cost, or risk that the business acts on.

title: Talent Acquisition Sourcing Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The Role

Our Talent Acquisition team is growing! We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Sourcing Specialist to join our team in London.

In this role you will own sourcing strategy for our hardest, business-critical roles, turning hiring briefs into talent maps, targeted headhunting and market intelligence, and build the talent pipelines that give every search a warm start and drive our internal model. This is a sourcing role, with end-to-end recruitment exposure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own sourcing strategy for business-critical, specialist and hard-to-fill roles, agreeing a brief with the TA Manager and hiring manager that covers essential skills, evidence of capability, target markets and candidate motivations, within priorities set by the Head of TA

  • Lead proactive headhunting to identify, engage and build relationships with high-calibre passive candidates, writing tailored outreach and testing messages and channels

  • Lead talent mapping and market research on competitors, emerging talent pools and market trends, looking beyond familiar job titles and companies

  • Hold initial conversations to assess experience, motivation, expectations and availability against agreed criteria, recording evidence and separating confirmed information from assumptions

  • Hand over qualified candidates to the TA Manager with concise notes and high-quality shortlists, use their feedback to refine the search, and keep candidates informed

  • Build and maintain talent pools for recurring and hard-to-fill roles across all Quantum business units

  • Share actionable market intelligence with hiring managers and TA leadership on talent availability, candidate expectations and market conditions, at kick-off and mid-search

  • Use LinkedIn Recruiter, AI, automation and talent intelligence tools to improve sourcing, measure what lifts reply and conversion rates, and share best practice across the TA team

  • Track sourcing metrics, pipeline quality and conversion rates, including time to first qualified shortlist, handover acceptance and progression to interview, to measure impact and find improvements

  • Learn Quantum’s business and employer proposition, and keep high standards of candidate experience, data integrity, contact preferences and recruitment compliance

About You

  • Experience in talent sourcing, headhunting or talent research, from agency or in-house, with examples of finding and engaging passive candidates beyond inbound applications

  • A track record of sourcing specialist, technical or hard-to-fill roles through proactive headhunting and talent mapping, with reply rates you can quote

  • Strong search skills, including Boolean techniques, LinkedIn Recruiter and talent intelligence or AI tools, and willingness to test and improve your methods

  • Analytical skills: able to turn market research and talent data into clear insight, and to measure sourcing through pipeline quality, shortlist delivery and conversion

  • Clear, persuasive writing and the ability to build trust with passive candidates in an initial conversation

  • Stakeholder skills to build credibility with TA Managers, leadership and hiring managers, with commercial awareness of talent markets, competitor activity and candidate expectations

  • Curiosity about different careers, and the judgement to assess transferable skills against a specific brief

  • Strong organisation and prioritisation to manage four to five live searches, with care for confidential information and an inclusive approach to search

  • You thrive when working as part of a team

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment

  • Last but not least, you’ll have no ego!

What You’ll Get

  • Private Health Care (Vitality)

  • Hybrid Working (3 days in office)

  • Travel Insurance

  • Competitive Base Salary

  • Company Bonus Scheme

  • Paid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)

  • Market-Leading Training Programme

  • Recognition & Reward Scheme

  • Annual Company Conference

  • Regular Happy Hours & Team Lunches

  • Free Coffee, Drinks & Snacks

title: Talent Lead
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs has grown to over 1,000 in three years, and the rate of growth is not slowing down. As Talent Lead, you will be in charge of one of the most visible and impactful functions in the company: hundreds of hires a quarter across Research, Engineering, GTM and Operations, in one of the most competitive talent markets in history. You’ll move Talent from a high-volume recruiting engine to a strategic partner that tells leaders what is achievable, and you’ll rebuild how we hire using the same AI products we make.

You'll run the entire Talent team (currently 20 - 30 recruiters, sourcers, and talent operations) across verticals, setting the strategy, building the systems, and staying hands-on where it matters. You'll report directly to the Operations Lead and be a close partner to the People team. This isn't a pure executive role - we want someone who still loves the craft of recruiting and can model what great looks like for the team around them.

The right person has done this before at scale - at a company that grew fast and hired harder. Your team will look to you not just for direction, but as someone they can genuinely learn from. This will be an opportunity to shape the direction of Talent at ElevenLab; where we go, how we get there and who we get there with. If you want to shape the future of the Talent industry by building industry-defining playbooks using the latest technology and AI solutions, whilst building an expert team - this might be your best fit yet.

In this role you will:

  • Lead the full talent function across Research, GTM, Engineering & Product, and G&A hiring - setting strategy, managing team performance, building a recruiter capacity engine, and driving outcomes across all verticals.

  • Shape Talent Operations: ATS (Ashby) configuration, headcount tracking, hiring velocity metrics, and recruiter tooling - ensuring the function runs with precision and minimal friction.

  • Identify innovative ways of approaching Talent: design the next-gen Talent org structure, envision how Talent processes can be agentified and work with the team to build ElevenLabs products throughout.

  • Act as a strategic partner to department heads and hiring managers, bringing market intelligence, pipeline health visibility, and honest counsel on what it takes to consistently win the best people in the market.

  • Build and maintain a strong talent brand through thoughtful candidate experience, community engagement, building a Talent events program and creative sourcing strategies.

  • Coach and develop a team of recruiters, establishing clear standards for quality of hire, speed, and candidate experience.

  • Partner with functional leaders across Research, Engineering, GTM, and Operations - acting as a trusted advisor who can challenge, align, and mobilize leaders around talent priorities and workforce strategy.

We’re moving quickly on this search. Applications close on 13 November 2026, and we’ll start reviewing right away, so we’d encourage you to apply early.

Requirements

  • Proven track record leading large TA functions at high-growth companies, with direct experience filling hundreds of roles per year across multiple functions and geographies.

  • Hands-on recruiting instincts - comfortable being in the weeds on critical searches, not just managing from a distance.

  • Strong people leader who builds, develops, and retains recruiting talent.

  • Sharp on process: able to design and iterate on systems, tooling, and workflows that make a team of 20–30 perform at a high level with AI.

  • Close collaborator with People, Finance, and business leaders - comfortable operating at the intersection of headcount planning, compensation, and hiring strategy.

  • Held a high bar for quality of hire while hitting aggressive volume, with the metrics to show it.

  • Advised founders and executive suite on workforce planning, and changed a plan with your judgment.

  • Worked with Finance, People and RevOps on headcount planning, capacity modelling, compensation and offer strategy.

  • Has recruited across the Americas, EMEA and APAC and understands the differences between markets.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere, with the ability to operate from New York or London strongly preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

title: Teamlead Customer Support & Sales (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du machst aus unserem Support ein Team, das Kund:innen hält und gewinnt

Bei eRecht24 melden sich jeden Tag Website-Betreiber, Online-Shops und Agenturen: per Ticket, per Telefon, mit Fragen zu Tarifen, Rechnungen und Rechtstexten. Hinter vielen dieser Anfragen steckt mehr als ein Supportfall: ein Upgrade, das hilft, eine Kündigung, die sich abwenden lässt, eine Agentur, die zwanzig Kundenprojekte im kleinsten Tarif verwaltet.

Wir suchen eine erfahrene Person, die unser Customer-Support-Team führt, den Betrieb stabil und messbar macht und daraus Schritt für Schritt eine Kundenberatung mit Vertriebsblick aufbaut. Du führst, du planst, und du bist selbst am Telefon.

Wer wir sind und wo wir stehen

eRecht24 ist Deutschlands größte Plattform für Rechtssicherheit im Web: Impressum Generator, Datenschutz Generator, Website Scanner und viele weitere Tools, kostenlos im Freemium-Bereich und vollumfänglich in eRecht24 PREMIUM (Basic, Business, Enterprise).

Die Firma ist in wenigen Jahren stark gewachsen und professionalisiert sich gerade: neue Rollen in Marketing, Product und Data, ein Data Warehouse, klarere Prozesse. Im Support sind die Werkzeuge da, ein modernes Ticketsystem und eine voll funktionsfähige Telefonanlage. Der Support betreut inzwischen die gesamte Unternehmensgruppe. Was fehlt, ist eine Führung, die daraus ein belastbares System macht.

Deine Aufgaben

Team führen und Betrieb steuern

  • Du führst das Customer-Support-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch, arbeitest Mitarbeitende ein und entwickelst sie weiter.

  • Du planst Einsätze, Urlaube und Vertretungen und sorgst dafür, dass wir erreichbar sind und Anfragen zeitnah bearbeitet werden.

  • Du analysierst Kontaktvolumen, Bearbeitungszeiten und Kapazität, erkennst Engpässe früh und begründest, wann wir mehr Leute brauchen.

Qualität, Prozesse und Systeme

  • Du etablierst Service-, Qualitäts- und Dokumentationsstandards, Gesprächsleitfäden und Kennzahlen.

  • Du bewertest unsere Support- und Telefoniesysteme, empfiehlst Verbesserungen und steuerst freigegebene Systemwechsel samt Migration.

Kundenberatung und Sales aufbauen

  • Du baust die telefonische Beratung aus: Inbound und Outbound, Produkt- und Tarifberatung, Unterstützung bei Tarifwechseln, Upselling, das wirklich zum Bedarf passt.

  • Kund:innen zurückgewinnen: Du holst gekündigte und inaktive Kund:innen zurück, verstehst, warum sie gegangen sind, und entwickelst mit dem Marketing die passenden Angebote.

  • Du bindest Kund:innen und beugst Kündigungen vor, gerade bei Business- und Enterprise-Kund:innen und Agenturen.

  • Du spielst Kundenwissen zurück: Wer sind unsere besten Kund:innen, was brauchen sie, woran scheitern sie? Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Product schärfst du so unser Bild der idealen Kund:innen.

So verteilt sich deine Zeit: rund 40 % operativ im Kundenkontakt, davon ein guter Teil am Telefon, 30 % Führung und Kapazitätssteuerung, 30 % Prozesse, Telefonie und Systeme. In der Einarbeitung ist der operative Anteil höher.

Deine ersten Monate

  • Monat 1 bis 3: Produkt, Tarife und Kundenanliegen kennenlernen, das Team übernehmen, Erreichbarkeit stabilisieren, Kapazitäten und Engpässe analysieren.

  • Monat 3 bis 6: Qualitätsstandards und Kennzahlen etablieren, Telefonberatung strukturiert aufbauen, Systeme bewerten, Personal- und Prozessbedarf ableiten.

  • Danach: Beratung und Sales weiterentwickeln, Reporting aufbauen, Prozesse standardisieren und skalierbar machen.

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Customer Support, Customer Success, Inside Sales oder Contact Center, idealerweise bei einem SaaS- oder Abo-Anbieter

  • Erfahrung als Führungskraft eines Support-, Service- oder Inside-Sales-Teams, inklusive Einsatz- und Kapazitätsplanung

  • Du hast Inbound- und Outbound-Telefonie selbst gemacht und aufgebaut und telefonierst gern: erst zuhören, dann beraten

  • Du erkennst Kaufsignale und Einwände und gehst mit beiden souverän um, ohne Rabatt als ersten Reflex

  • Sicher mit Ticket- und Telefoniesystemen; idealerweise hast du schon einmal ein System ausgewählt, eingeführt oder migriert

  • Du arbeitest mit Kennzahlen und kannst Personalbedarf nachvollziehbar begründen

  • Strukturiert, verlässlich, entscheidungsfreudig im Tagesgeschäft

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, in Wort und Schrift. Du berätst unsere Kund:innen am Telefon auf Deutsch

  • Plus: Erfahrung im Aufbau eines Service- oder Beratungsbereichs, mit Retention und Rückgewinnung, mit Agenturen als Kund:innen, Nähe zu Website-Recht oder Datenschutz

Ein bestimmter Abschluss ist nicht nötig. Entscheidend sind Führungserfahrung, Aufbaukompetenz und die Lust, selbst mit anzupacken.

Warum sich die Rolle lohnt

  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entscheidest selbst über Einsatzplanung, Prioritäten, Standards, Leitfäden und Einarbeitung.

  • Werkzeuge sind da: Ticketsystem, Telefonanlage, Data Warehouse. Du musst nicht bei null anfangen, sondern daraus ein System bauen.

  • Sichtbarer Impact: Jede gerettete Kündigung, jedes passende Upgrade ist messbar und wird gesehen.

  • Kurze Wege: Du berichtest direkt an die Marketing-Leitung und arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Product und IT.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Vollzeit

  • Hybrid in Berlin, mindestens drei Präsenztage pro Woche vor Ort

  • Operative Mitarbeit während unserer Supportzeiten von 9 bis 16 Uhr

  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung

Klingt nach dir?

Dann lass uns sprechen: 15 Minuten Kennenlernen, ein einstündiges Fachgespräch, dann Team und ein kurzes Rollenspiel aus unserem Alltag.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beantworte uns stattdessen in der Bewerbung kurz drei Fragen:

  1. Welches Team hast du zuletzt geführt (Größe, Aufgabe), und was hast du dort als Erstes verändert?

  2. Welche Kundin oder welchen Kunden hast du zuletzt zurückgeholt oder von der Kündigung abgehalten, und wie?

  3. Wie viel Zeit verbringst du heute selbst am Telefon mit Kund:innen?

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

title: Technical Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout already use Kernel across their enterprise systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

title: Technical Program Manager - Data
descriptionHtml:
At Oxa, we're building the future of Industrial Mobile Autonomy (IMA) and are in the market for new talent.

Oxa’s customers are the operators of some of the world's largest industrial facilities. Our technology transforms existing industrial vehicles into intelligent autonomous fleets, unlocking new levels of productivity, safety, and performance.

 

‘The phone in your hand, the coffee on your desk, the shirt on your back - they all moved through a web of ports (air and sea), distribution yards and manufacturing hubs. This is the invisible circulatory system of global trade, and it relies entirely on a relentless, repetitive shuffle of goods. Towing.

This towing task happens in complex, commerce-critical industrial environments. Here, having self driving technology “do the driving” delivers immediate, measurable impact. IMA will revolutionise the movement of goods across the world's ports, airports, and yards.

You can be part of that as an Oxbot’

‘Paul Newman - Founder and CEO’

 

Our Products:

Our products are built on four core technology pillars which come together to build a complete system:

Oxa Ware – Our modular autonomy hardware systems for consistent and repeatable integration of autonomy with existing vehicles.

Oxa Driver – Our Physical AI, embodied in Oxa Ware, self-driving software that enables vehicles to perceive, reason, and drive autonomously in complex real-world environments.

Oxa Foundry – Our development toolchain that leverages generative AI to continuously train and assure Oxa Driver, synthesising situations and sensor data.

Oxa Hub – Our suite of cloud services for monitoring, managing and orchestrating fleets driven by Oxa Driver, including an API for integration with existing logistics systems.

 

Behind these technologies is our exceptional team, the Oxbots. We are home to some of the world's leading experts in autonomous systems, robotics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, and distributed software engineering. Together, we're solving some of the hardest technical challenges in autonomy, turning the research and development we do into production and deploying it into environments. Making robots do useful work.

 

Your Team:

You will join the Data layer of Oxa Driver: the teams that train, teach and test the machine-learning systems our vehicles rely on. They turn data from our vehicles and simulation into the datasets, scenarios and tools the rest of the stack builds on, and their workload grows with each new operating domain and site we take on.

Data is a group of teams responsible for:

  • collecting and curating real-world data, including dataset quality and labelling

  • generating synthetic sensor data to fill gaps in real-world coverage

  • simulation and digital twins of the sites our vehicles operate in

  • the data infrastructure that stores, organises and serves this data

  • applying machine learning to hard problems across the stack

The teams work closely with Autonomy Applications, who train and deploy models on this data, Integration & Test, our data ingest and platform teams, our safety team, and the Solutions team who take our products to customers.

Your Role:

Our Technical Program Manager is the delivery enabler for the Data teams. They coordinate delivery so the teams can collect, curate, generate and ship data with less friction, and their leads can focus on engineering.

They will work with engineering, product and solutions leaders across the stack who own customer outcomes. The focus of the Program Manager is to make sure the datasets, simulations and tools other teams depend on arrive when planned, with risks and dependencies visible early.

This role will be based in our Oxford office, with occasional visits to our vehicle sites to support understanding of how data is collected and used.

  

Your Responsibilities:

  • Take the layer's commitments in our product engineering plan and, with the leads, turn them into sequenced work with dates and a clear definition of done. Bring the teams' planning into Jira in a way that adds little overhead, and keep work traceable to the products it supports.

  • Run the regular triage of data-quality issues that affect model training, such as calibration, timing and labelling problems. Make sure every issue has an owner, a priority and a next step.

  • Coordinate the data, scenarios and simulation each new operating site needs, so they are ready when the site goes live.

  • Run the layer's cloud cost reporting, and help leads balance cost against keeping available the data that teams need.

  • Track what the teams need from others and what others need from them, raise conflicts early and broker the trade-offs:

    • data from our vehicles and ingest pipelines

    • datasets, scenarios and simulation for model training and testing

    • external labelling and cloud compute providers

  • Report monthly progress against plan, plus data-quality and cost health. Use simple metrics, such as dataset turnaround time and cost per training cycle, to show whether delivery is improving.

  • Find the friction, such as manual curation steps, unclear ownership or slow data turnaround, and drive fixes with the teams.

What you need to succeed:

  • A career thatstarted in engineering (a degree in computer science, software, data, electrical, robotics or similar) and have moved into delivery, with 2+ years as a TPM, project engineer or delivery manager on a technical product.

  • Knowledge of the data and ML lifecycle: You know how data moves from collection through curation, labelling and dataset release to model training and evaluation, and why data quality and versioning matter. Hands-on experience in data engineering, machine learning or simulation is preferred but not essential.

  • Data and cloud fluency: Enough to follow the engineering and ask good questions: data pipelines, cloud storage and compute, datasets and labelling, and simulation.

  • You break down work, map dependencies and forecast from data (using tools like Jira, Confluence and Miro), and you build trust with engineers when priorities shift.

Extra kudos if you have:

  • Experience in automotive, robotics or other autonomous systems.

  • Experience with MLOps, data platforms or labelling operations.

  • Exposure to simulation, synthetic data generation or digital twins.

  • Experience tracking or optimising cloud spend.

  • Comfort with Git-based planning, documentation-as-code, or AI tools for reporting.

Your Interview Experience:

Our interview process is designed to give you every chance to get the measure of us, and us of you. You will join three stages which will give you every opportunity to show your strengths and qualities, via scenario based questions and technical exercises.

 

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary benchmarked against the market

  • Participation in a great company equity scheme

  • Enhanced pension contributions

  • Annual holiday allowance of 25 days per year

  • Overseas working policy for up to 8 weeks per year

  • Flexible, hybrid and remote working arrangements

  • Comprehensive Private Health cover with the option to add family members,

  • Enhanced health and wellbeing benefits including health cash plan, critical illness cover, life assurance and group income protection

  • Enhanced paid maternity and paternity policy

 

If you're excited by deep technical problems, real-world AI, and the opportunity to build technology that will reshape global industry, you'll find both the challenge and the impact you're looking for at Oxa.

Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. title: Treasury Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our investment platform and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our capital markets capabilities with leaders who can combine rigorous underwriting with commercial judgement and execution excellence.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

As Radiant scales its portfolio of GPU clusters, AI factories, and supporting infrastructure, we are hiring a Treasury Manager to support the Group's treasury function, partnering with the Group Finance Director and Head of Capital Markets to build a best in class treasury operation.

You will play a central role in managing Radiant's cash and liquidity position, supporting bank relationships and financing activities, and helping build out treasury processes and controls as the business scales. You will work closely with finance, capital markets, accounting, and the wider business to ensure the Group has the visibility and controls it needs over its cash, funding, and financial risk exposures.

This is an opportunity to help build treasury capabilities from the ground up within a fast-growing AI infrastructure platform, working alongside senior finance leadership on high-impact, high-visibility initiatives.

What You'll Do

  • Manage day-to-day cash management activities, including bank account administration, payments oversight, and intercompany funding.

  • Prepare and maintain short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts across the Group, monitoring actual versus forecast performance.

  • Support management of banking relationships, including account opening/closing, KYC processes, and day-to-day bank queries.

  • Assist with the administration of financing arrangements, including drawdowns, covenant monitoring, and compliance reporting.

  • Support treasury-related aspects of financing transactions, including due diligence, documentation review, and liaison with lenders and advisors.

  • Monitor and help manage financial risk exposures (FX, interest rate, and counterparty risk), including implementing hedging strategies where appropriate.

  • Maintain and develop treasury policies, procedures, and controls, ensuring compliance with internal governance requirements.

  • Prepare treasury reporting and analysis for senior management, including liquidity, debt, and risk dashboards.

  • Partner with the wider finance team on cash forecasting, working capital initiatives, and ad hoc treasury projects as the function scales.

What You'll Bring

  • 5–8 years of experience in treasury, corporate finance, banking, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of cash and liquidity management, banking operations, and financial risk management.

  • Experience with financing documentation, covenant monitoring, or debt administration is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical and numerical skills, with high attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Proficiency in Excel; experience with treasury management systems (TMS) or ERP systems including implementation is a plus.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, growing environment.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across finance and the wider business.

  • High levels of ownership, integrity, and accountability when handling sensitive financial information.

  • A proactive, hands-on approach with a willingness to build processes and take on new challenges as the function scales.

  • Team-oriented with a demonstrated commitment to shared success above any personal accomplishment or recognition.

  • Intellectual curiosity and enthusiasm for the AI infrastructure ecosystem, analytical skills and creative problem-solving ability.

Nice to Have

  • Professional qualification (or progress towards one), such as ACT (Association of Corporate Treasurers), ACA, ACCA, or CFA.

  • Experience in infrastructure, data centres, energy, or technology sectors.

  • Exposure to project or acquisition finance, syndicated debt, or capital markets transactions.

  • Experience with FX and interest rate hedging instruments.

  • Familiarity with treasury management systems (e.g., Kyriba, GTreasury, or similar).

What Success Looks Like

  • Robust, reliable cash flow forecasting and reporting across the Group.

  • Strong, well-managed banking relationships and efficient payment processes.

  • Clear visibility and proactive management of the Group's financial risk exposures.

  • Well-documented and controlled treasury policies that scale with the business.

  • Become a trusted advisor to the wider team.

Why Join Radiant

  • Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry

  • Build infrastructure that underpins the next industrial revolution.

  • Help shape a category-defining company at the intersection of power, compute and capital.

  • Participate in the company's growth and value creation.

title: VP Data Centres
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: VP OF DATA CENTRE STRATEGY

Everything we sell depends on having the right power, in the right place, at the right time. Until now, decisions about where we build, who we partner with and how we secure capacity have been spread across the business. This new role brings them under one owner: someone who sets NexGen’s global data centre strategy and makes sure capacity is there before customers need it.

This is a senior individual contributor role, and it covers both strategy and execution. One day you’re taking a site recommendation to the executive team. The next you’re across the table from a colocation operator negotiating a multi-year contract. We plan to build a dedicated development function over time. Until then, you’ll do more of the hands-on delivery work yourself, and you’ll help decide when that team gets built.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:
- Build and own NexGen’s global data centre strategy and the 12–36 month capacity roadmap, so capacity is never the reason we miss a customer commitment
- Decide which markets and regions we expand into, set the criteria for choosing sites, and build a pipeline of data centre opportunities against them
- Make the call on colocation vs. owned infrastructure, and own the investment case for each site
- Secure reliable, cost-effective power for GPU-dense workloads, in line with our 100% renewable commitment, and spot grid and capacity constraints before they hit customers
- Lead the big negotiations on colocation agreements, power contracts and strategic vendor deals, and hold partners to their SLAs
- Set NexGen’s position on data sovereignty and planning across jurisdictions, and deal with regulators and government directly when the stakes are high
- Bring cost per MW and cost per GPU rack down, and make sure capex goes where the commercial pipeline needs it

ABOUT YOU

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential:
- 10+ years in data centre infrastructure, with significant time in a senior strategy, development or commercial role
- A proven track record in site selection, colocation negotiation and data centre partner management at scale
- A deep understanding of power procurement and capacity planning, and of the commercial side of running GPU-dense AI infrastructure
- Experience negotiating complex, multi-year contracts with data centre operators and vendors
- An established network across the colocation ecosystem, plus experience at or with neoclouds, hyperscalers or GPU infrastructure platforms

Nice to Have:
- Power procurement for high-density compute specifically, rather than general enterprise space
- Grid connection, sovereign cloud or government engagement in more than one jurisdiction
- Existing relationships with renewable power providers or experience structuring PPAs
- Experience growing an infrastructure function from a standalone role into a team, including deciding when to bring in dedicated delivery capability

WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme
- Employee wellbeing benefits
- 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
- Private Medical Insurance
- Enhanced Pension Scheme
- Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)
- Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment
- Visible, meaningful impact as we scale
- Clear career progression in a high-growth company
- A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership
- The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future

WHY APPLY

We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we’d like to hear from you.

MORE INFORMATION

Visit our careers page to learn more about us or follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.

title: Website Growth Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

About the role

ElevenLabs is building the most advanced AI audio platform in the world. Millions of creators, developers, and businesses use our products, and our website is one of the company’s most important sources of new users and subscriptions.

We are looking for a Growth Engineer to work at the intersection of engineering, product, data, and business. You will build and optimize the experiences that help users discover ElevenLabs, understand its value, and become active customers.

This is a highly autonomous role focused on measurable outcomes. You will identify growth opportunities, form hypotheses, build and launch experiments, analyze the results, and decide what to do next. You will work across conversion-rate optimization, organic search, programmatic pages, onboarding, web performance, and experimentation infrastructure.

Organic search and our website are major drivers of new signups and subscriptions at ElevenLabs. Engineers on this team have the opportunity to generate significant business impact through rapid experimentation, improvements to high-traffic pages, and systems that scale successful ideas across thousands or millions of search intents.

The right person is a strong product-minded engineer who enjoys moving quickly, working with data, and owning problems from initial idea through implementation and measurable impact. You should be equally comfortable analyzing a funnel, discussing an experiment with design, building the solution, and evaluating whether it worked.

What you will do

  • Identify and build opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and revenue

  • Own growth experiments from hypothesis through implementation, instrumentation, launch, analysis, and iteration

  • Build and improve high-traffic product pages, landing pages, onboarding experiences, and programmatic page systems

  • Improve technical SEO, crawlability, structured data, internal linking, page quality, and website performance

  • Collaborate with design, SEO, product, data, marketing, and frontend engineering to turn successful experiments into scalable systems

Requirements

  • Strong experience building production web applications using React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies

  • Experience independently taking projects from an initial idea through launch and measurable impact

  • Strong product judgment, with the ability to identify friction, form hypotheses, and prioritize opportunities

  • Experience working with analytics, funnels, experimentation, SQL, and product or business metrics

  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy, shipping quickly, and collaborating across engineering, design, product, data, and marketing

Bonus

  • Experience working as a Growth Engineer, Product Engineer, startup founder, or early-stage engineer

  • Experience building programmatic SEO systems or scaling large numbers of landing pages

  • Experience with technical SEO, experimentation platforms, feature flags, or A/B testing

  • Experience improving onboarding, activation, monetization, referral, or sharing flows

  • A portfolio of side projects, products, automations, or experiments you have launched

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Own a major acquisition, activation, or monetization area across ElevenLabs

  • Lead the strategy and technical direction for organic growth, conversion, or experimentation

  • Build and lead a larger Growth Engineering function

  • Expand into broader product engineering or growth leadership

  • Take ownership of company-level growth metrics and cross-functional growth initiatives

Location

This role is remote and can be executed from the US East Coast or Europe, with sufficient working-hour overlap with the broader team.

You may also work from one of our offices, including London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw, and other ElevenLabs locations.

  • Du bist eingeschrieben; beispielsweise in Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, Design, Wirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.

  • Du hast Freude daran, verständlich zu schreiben und Inhalte visuell ansprechend zu gestalten. Erste Beispiele können aus dem Studium, einem Nebenjob oder eigenen Projekten stammen.

  • Du hast ein Gespür dafür, was eine Zielgruppe interessiert, und möchtest herausfinden, wie man komplexe Themen einfach erklärt.

Was die Arbeit bei uns ausmacht

title: Workforce Management Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

This role exists to keep clinics staffed to target coverage. The Workforce Management Specialist owns bi-weekly and monthly rota creation, maintains accurate schedules in the workforce management system, and produces the staffing reports that let clinic and market leadership make fast, informed decisions. The role sits within the Operations Planning function and partners directly with clinic leads on coverage, staffing, and labour metrics.

 

What You'll Deliver in the First 6-12 Months

  • Own accurate, on-time bi-weekly/monthly rota publication for all assigned Swedish clinics, with late changes, swaps, and backfills handled without service disruption.

  • Establish daily tracking of open shifts and coverage gaps across assigned clinics, with escalation to bank pools and agency partners triggered before gaps affect throughput.

  • Administer Quinyx (locations, roles, templates, policies, leave rules) for assigned clinics and configure at least one automation that measurably reduces manual admin time (Tech-enabled, human-centred).

  • Deliver a reliable weekly staffing pack (coverage %, overtime, additional hours, tardiness, utilisation, variance vs plan) that clinic and market leadership use to make staffing decisions.

  • Reduce payroll queries and adjustments through cleaner timesheet reconciliation and consistent HRIS-to-payroll data flow.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Previous experience in strategic workforce planning (Quinyx is preferable but other systems are accepted)

  • Comfortable in Excel: filters, lookups, pivot basics, conditional formatting; able to analyse CSVs and spot anomalies

  • Demonstrated ownership of detail-heavy, deadline-driven admin work (the "last mile" that keeps a rota accurate)

  • Demonstrated ability to build recurring reporting/dashboards (Tableau, Power BI, or advanced Excel) covering variance-to-plan, utilization, or forecast accuracy

  • Experience improving data integrity or process efficiency in a workforce data pipeline
